name: qh_reciprocal
stmt: theorem qh_reciprocal (m p E : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hE : 0 < E) (hEp : E ^ 2 = m ^ 2 + p ^ 2) : (m / E) * (E / m) = 1 ∧ p / E = (p / m) / (E / m) ∧ (m / E) ^ 2 + (p / E) ^ 2 = 1 ∧ (E / m) ^ 2 - (p / m) ^ 2 = 1
doc: 逆数の関係

name: gudermann
stmt: theorem gudermann (η : ℝ) : sin (arctan (sinh η)) = sinh η / cosh η ∧ cos (arctan (sinh η)) = 1 / cosh η ∧ tan (arctan (sinh η)) = sinh η
doc: Gudermann 関数:sin(gd η) = tanh η、cos(gd η) = 1/cosh η、tan(gd η) = sinh η

name: gudermann_momentum
stmt: theorem gudermann_momentum (m η : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) : sin (arctan (sinh η)) = (m * sinh η) / (m * cosh η) ∧ cos (arctan (sinh η)) = m / (m * cosh η)
doc: 運動量で書くと:p = m sinh η、E = m cosh η なら sin χ = p/E、cos χ = m/E

name: gd_deriv
stmt: theorem gd_deriv (η : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun t => arctan (sinh t)) (1 / cosh η) η

name: conformal
stmt: theorem conformal (m η : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) : (1 / cosh η) ^ 2 = (m ^ 2 * 1) / (m * cosh η) ^ 2 ∧ sin (arctan (sinh η)) ^ 2 = (m ^ 2 * sinh η ^ 2) / (m * cosh η) ^ 2
doc: Q の計量 = H の計量 / E²:(gd′)² = m²/(m cosh η)²·1、sin²(gd η) = m² sinh²η/(m cosh η)²

name: slope_H
stmt: theorem slope_H (m p : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) : HasDerivAt (fun q => √(m ^ 2 + q ^ 2)) (p / √(m ^ 2 + p ^ 2)) p
doc: 双曲面の傾き:dE/dp = p/E

name: slope_Q
stmt: theorem slope_Q (x : ℝ) (hx : x ^ 2 < 1) : HasDerivAt (fun y => √(1 - y ^ 2)) (-x / √(1 - x ^ 2)) x
doc: Q の断面の傾き:w(x) = √(1 − x²) の傾きは −x/√(1 − x²)、x = p/E では −p/m

name: slope_Q_value
stmt: theorem slope_Q_value (m p : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) : -(p / √(m ^ 2 + p ^ 2)) / √(1 - (p / √(m ^ 2 + p ^ 2)) ^ 2) = -(p / m)

name: normal_H
stmt: theorem normal_H (m p E : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hE : 0 < E) (hEp : E ^ 2 = m ^ 2 + p ^ 2) : -(p / E) * (E / m) + 1 * (p / m) = 0 ∧ -(E / m) ^ 2 + (p / m) ^ 2 = -1
doc: Minkowski の法線 = 4 元速度

name: normal_Q
stmt: theorem normal_Q (m p E : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hE : 0 < E) (hEp : E ^ 2 = m ^ 2 + p ^ 2) : -(p / m) * (m / E) + 1 * (p / E) = 0 ∧ (m / E) ^ 2 + (p / E) ^ 2 = 1
doc: Euclid の法線 = 状態 U

name: contact
doc: 接点 p = 0:二つの法線は (1, 0) で一致し、運動量は m 倍の法線

name: ck_deriv
stmt: theorem ck_deriv (κ X : ℝ) (h : 0 < 1 - κ * X ^ 2) : HasDerivAt (fun Y => √(1 - κ * Y ^ 2)) (-(κ * X) / √(1 - κ * X ^ 2)) X
doc: Σ_κ:f(X) = √(1 − κX²) の微分

name: cayley_klein
stmt: theorem cayley_klein (κ : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun X => -(κ * X) / √(1 - κ * X ^ 2)) (-κ) 0 ∧ √(1 - κ * 0 ^ 2) = 1 ∧ -(κ * 0) / √(1 - κ * 0 ^ 2) = 0
doc: 接点での 2 階微分は −κ(f′(X) = −κX/√(1 − κX²) の X = 0 での微分)

name: curv_H_Q
stmt: theorem curv_H_Q : HasDerivAt (fun X => -((-1) * X) / √(1 - (-1) * X ^ 2)) 1 0 ∧ HasDerivAt (fun X => -(1 * X) / √(1 - 1 * X ^ 2)) (-1) 0

name: curv_Q_over_u
stmt: theorem curv_Q_over_u : HasDerivAt (fun u => -u / √(1 + u ^ 2) ^ 3) (-1) 0
doc: Q を固有速度 u の上のグラフにすると w(u) = 1/√(1 + u²) = 1/X₀(u)、u = 0 での 2 階微分は −1

name: area_H
stmt: theorem area_H (m η0 : ℝ) : ∫ η in (0 : ℝ)..η0, 2 * π * m ^ 2 * sinh η = 2 * π * m * (m * cosh η0 - m)

name: area_Q
stmt: theorem area_Q (χ0 : ℝ) : ∫ χ in (0 : ℝ)..χ0, 2 * π * sin χ = 2 * π * (1 - cos χ0)

name: area_ratio
stmt: theorem area_ratio (m η0 : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) : 2 * π * (1 - cos (arctan (sinh η0))) = 2 * π * (1 - m / (m * cosh η0)) ∧ 2 * π * m * (m * cosh η0 - m) = m * (m * cosh η0) * (2 * π * (1 - m / (m * cosh η0)))
doc: χ₀ = gd η₀ のとき Q の帽子は 2π(1 − m/E₀)、Area_H = m E₀ Area_Q

name: hemisphere_area
stmt: theorem hemisphere_area : ∫ χ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), 2 * π * sin χ = 2 * π
doc: 半球全体の面積 2π

name: gauss_bonnet_H
stmt: theorem gauss_bonnet_H (m η0 : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hη : 0 < η0) : -(1 / m ^ 2) * (2 * π * m * (m * cosh η0 - m)) + cosh η0 / (m * sinh η0) * (2 * π * m * sinh η0) = 2 * π
doc: H の円板の Gauss–Bonnet:−(1/m²)·Area + (cosh η₀/(m sinh η₀))·(2πm sinh η₀) = 2π

name: on_hyperboloid
stmt: theorem on_hyperboloid (l t z : ℝ) : -(l * cos (t / l) * cosh (z / l)) ^ 2 - (l * sin (t / l)) ^ 2 + (l * cos (t / l) * sinh (z / l)) ^ 2 = -l ^ 2
doc: AdS₂ の同期の座標は双曲面の上

name: dt_embedding
stmt: theorem dt_embedding (l t z : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun s => l * cos (s / l) * cosh (z / l)) (-sin (t / l) * cosh (z / l)) t ∧ HasDerivAt (fun s => l * sin (s / l)) (cos (t / l)) t ∧ HasDerivAt (fun s => l * cos (s / l) * sinh (z / l)) (-sin (t / l) * sinh (z / l)) t
doc: 同期の座標の t 微分(ℓ cos(t/ℓ)cosh(z/ℓ) → −sin(t/ℓ)cosh(z/ℓ) など)

name: dz_embedding
stmt: theorem dz_embedding (l t z : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun s => l * cos (t / l) * cosh (s / l)) (cos (t / l) * sinh (z / l)) z ∧ HasDerivAt (fun s => l * cos (t / l) * sinh (s / l)) (cos (t / l) * cosh (z / l)) z
doc: 同期の座標の z 微分

name: neck_gaussian
stmt: theorem neck_gaussian (t z l : ℝ) : -(-sin (t / l) * cosh (z / l)) ^ 2 - cos (t / l) ^ 2 + (-sin (t / l) * sinh (z / l)) ^ 2 = -1 ∧ -((-sin (t / l) * cosh (z / l)) * (cos (t / l) * sinh (z / l))) - cos (t / l) * 0 + (-sin (t / l) * sinh (z / l)) * (cos (t / l) * cosh (z / l)) = 0 ∧ -(cos (t / l) * sinh (z / l)) ^ 2 - 0 ^ 2 + (cos (t / l) * cosh (z / l)) ^ 2 = cos (t / l) ^ 2
doc:
【α-X.9】首の同期の座標はガウス正規:g_tt = −1、g_tz = 0、g_zz = cos²(t/ℓ)
(誘導計量 −dX₀² − dX₁² + dX₂² に上の微分を入れる)

name: cap_gaussian
stmt: theorem cap_gaussian (l η : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun e => l * sin e) (l * cos η) η ∧ l * sin (π / 2) = l
doc: 【α-X.9】帽子の共動の時間 τ_c = ℓ sin η:dτ_c/dη = a = ℓ cos η(ガウス正規)、崩壊 η = π/2 で τ_c = ℓ

name: two_events
stmt: theorem two_events (l : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) : l < π * l / 2 ∧ cos (π * l / 2 / l) = 0
doc: 【α-X.9】共通の時計で、帽子の崩壊 ℓ は首の焦点 πℓ/2(cos(t/ℓ) = 0)より前の、別の出来事

name: same_point
stmt: theorem same_point (l t z τ x : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (h1 : l * sin (t / l) = l * cosh (x / l) * sin τ) (h2 : l * cos (t / l) * sinh (z / l) = l * sinh (x / l)) : sin τ * cosh (x / l) = sin (t / l) ∧ sinh (x / l) = cos (t / l) * sinh (z / l)
doc: 【α-X.9】同じ点の座標の関係(同期の座標と静的な座標)

name: static_clock
stmt: theorem static_clock (t l τ x u : ℝ) (h : sin τ * cosh (x / l) = sin (t / l)) (hu : cosh (x / l) * sin u = 1) : sin τ = sin (t / l) * sin u
doc: 【α-X.9】静的な位置 u(cosh(x/ℓ) sin u = 1)では sin τ = sin(t/ℓ) sin u

name: neck_centre_clock
stmt: theorem neck_centre_clock (l t τ x : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (h0 : l * cos (t / l) * cosh (0 / l) = l * cosh (x / l) * cos τ) (h1 : l * sin (t / l) = l * cosh (x / l) * sin τ) (h2 : l * cos (t / l) * sinh (0 / l) = l * sinh (x / l)) : x = 0 ∧ sin τ = sin (t / l) ∧ cos τ = cos (t / l)
doc: 【α-X.9】首の中心 z = 0 では x = 0、sin τ = sin(t/ℓ)、cos τ = cos(t/ℓ):静的な時計はガウス時間そのもの

name: dilaton_invariant
stmt: theorem dilaton_invariant (l A B C t z : ℝ) : (A * sin (t / l) + cos (t / l) * (B * cosh (z / l) + C * sinh (z / l))) ^ 2 - (-(A * cos (t / l) - sin (t / l) * (B * cosh (z / l) + C * sinh (z / l))) ^ 2 + (B * sinh (z / l) + C * cosh (z / l)) ^ 2) = A ^ 2 + B ^ 2 - C ^ 2
doc: 【橋 B】dilaton の不変量:φ² − ℓ²(∇φ)² = A² + B² − C²(ℓ²(∇φ)² = −(ℓφ_t)² + (ℓφ_z/cos)²)

name: dilaton_grad
stmt: theorem dilaton_grad (l A B C t z : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hc : cos (t / l) ≠ 0) : l * (A / l * cos (t / l) - sin (t / l) / l * (B * cosh (z / l) + C * sinh (z / l))) = A * cos (t / l) - sin (t / l) * (B * cosh (z / l) + C * sinh (z / l)) ∧ l * (cos (t / l) * ((B * sinh (z / l) + C * cosh (z / l)) / l)) / cos (t / l) = B * sinh (z / l) + C * cosh (z / l)
doc: ℓφ_t と ℓφ_z/cos(IX.14 の `jt_dt`、`jt_dz` を ℓ 倍)

name: xi_norm
stmt: theorem xi_norm (φt φz c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) : -(φz / c) ^ 2 + c ^ 2 * (-φt / c) ^ 2 = -(-φt ^ 2 + φz ^ 2 / c ^ 2)
doc: 【橋 B】ξ^t = φ_z/cos、ξ^z = −φ_t/cos のノルム −(ξ^t)² + cos²(ξ^z)² = −(−φ_t² + φ_z²/cos²)

name: accel_formula
stmt: theorem accel_formula (φ l I N : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hN2 : N ^ 2 = φ ^ 2 / l ^ 2 - I) (hφ : φ ^ 2 - I * l ^ 2 ≠ 0) : (φ / (l ^ 2 * N)) ^ 2 * N ^ 2 / N ^ 2 = φ ^ 2 / (l ^ 2 * (φ ^ 2 - I * l ^ 2))
doc:
【橋 B】固有加速度:N² = φ²/ℓ² − I、|∇N|² = (φ/(ℓ²N))²(∇φ)²、(∇φ)² = N² なら
a² = |∇N|²/N² = φ²/(ℓ²(φ² − Iℓ²))

name: accel_identity
stmt: theorem accel_identity (φ l I : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hφ : φ ^ 2 - I * l ^ 2 ≠ 0) : φ ^ 2 / (l ^ 2 * (φ ^ 2 - I * l ^ 2)) - 1 / l ^ 2 = I / (φ ^ 2 - I * l ^ 2)
doc: 【橋 B】a² − 1/ℓ² = I/(φ² − Iℓ²)

name: deser_levin
doc:
【橋 B】表面重力:κ² = φ²/ℓ⁴(∇_μξ_ν = ε_μν φ/ℓ²、−½ε·ε = 1)、地平線 φ² = Iℓ² で κ² = I/ℓ²。
局所温度の 2 乗 κ_h²/(−ξ·ξ) = (I/ℓ²)/(φ²/ℓ² − I) は a² − 1/ℓ² に等しい(Deser–Levin の形)

name: three_classes
doc:
【橋 B】三つの類:IX.14 の対称な解(A = C = 0)は I = B²/ℓ² > 0(熱的)、A = 0、B = C は I = 0(極限)、
A = B = 0 は I < 0(C ≠ 0)

name: rindler_lapse
stmt: theorem rindler_lapse (l ρ : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun x => sinh (x / l)) (cosh (ρ / l) / l) ρ ∧ HasDerivAt (fun x => cosh (x / l) / l) (sinh (ρ / l) / l ^ 2) ρ ∧ cosh (0 / l) / l = 1 / l
doc: 【橋 B】規格化した Rindler の lapse N = sinh(ρ/ℓ):N′ = cosh(ρ/ℓ)/ℓ、N″ = N/ℓ²(Jacobi の式)、N′(0) = 1/ℓ

name: unit_observer
stmt: theorem unit_observer : sinh (Real.log (1 + √2)) = 1 ∧ cosh (Real.log (1 + √2)) = √2
doc: 【橋 B】N = 1 の観測者:sinh(log(1 + √2)) = 1、cosh = √2(加速度 a = cosh/(ℓ sinh) = √2/ℓ)

name: junction_tan
stmt: theorem junction_tan (L l u : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (hL : 0 < L) (hu1 : 0 < u) (hu2 : u < π / 2) (hs : sin u = 1 / cosh (L / l)) : tan u = 1 / sinh (L / l)
doc: 【橋 B】接合:sin u = 1/cosh(L/ℓ)(0 < u < π/2、L > 0)なら tan u = 1/sinh(L/ℓ)

name: eps_eq
stmt: theorem eps_eq : eps = I • s2
doc: ε = iσ₂

name: s1T
stmt: theorem s1T : s1ᵀ = s1

name: s2T
stmt: theorem s2T : s2ᵀ = -s2

name: s3T
stmt: theorem s3T : s3ᵀ = s3

name: xsT
stmt: theorem xsT (x0 x1 x2 : ℝ) : (xs x0 x1 x2)ᵀ = (x0 : ℂ) • s1 - (x1 : ℂ) • s2 + (x2 : ℂ) • s3

name: eps_xsT
stmt: theorem eps_xsT (x0 x1 x2 : ℝ) : eps * (xs x0 x1 x2)ᵀ = -(xs x0 x1 x2 * eps)
doc: 【橋 A】ε(x̂·σ)ᵀ = −(x̂·σ)ε(湯川の項 M(fε) = −(Gvh/2)f(x̂·σ)ε の核心)

name: xs_sq
stmt: theorem xs_sq (x0 x1 x2 : ℝ) : xs x0 x1 x2 * xs x0 x1 x2 = ((x0 ^ 2 + x1 ^ 2 + x2 ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)

name: gauge_singlet
stmt: theorem gauge_singlet (x0 x1 x2 : ℝ) : (-I / 2) • ((x2 : ℂ) • (s2 * eps * s1ᵀ) + (x0 : ℂ) • (s3 * eps * s2ᵀ) + (x1 : ℂ) • (s1 * eps * s3ᵀ) - (x1 : ℂ) • (s3 * eps * s1ᵀ) - (x0 : ℂ) • (s2 * eps * s3ᵀ) - (x2 : ℂ) • (s1 * eps * s2ᵀ)) = xs x0 x1 x2 * eps
doc:
【橋 A】平坦なはりねずみのゲージ場の項:
−(i/2) Σ ε_{akj} x̂_j σ_k ε σ_aᵀ = (x̂·σ)ε(σ·D(fε) の (1 − W)/ρ の項)

name: pole_singlet
stmt: theorem pole_singlet (x0 x1 x2 : ℝ) (h : x0 ^ 2 + x1 ^ 2 + x2 ^ 2 = 1) : xs x0 x1 x2 * eps * (I • xs x0 x1 x2)ᵀ = -I • eps
doc: 【橋 A】極 2:(x̂·σ)ε(i x̂·σ)ᵀ = −iε(|x̂| = 1)。スピン枠とゲージの遷移が一重項の上で打ち消し合う

name: chi_deriv
stmt: theorem chi_deriv (r R f : ℝ → ℝ) (r' f' ρ : ℝ) (hr : HasDerivAt r r' ρ) (hR : HasDerivAt R (R ρ / r ρ) ρ) (hf : HasDerivAt f f' ρ) (hr0 : r ρ ≠ 0) (hR0 : R ρ ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun x => r x / R x * f x) ((r' - 1) / R ρ * f ρ + r ρ / R ρ * f') ρ
doc: χ = (r/R)f の微分(dR/dρ = R/r)

name: conformal_transfer
stmt: theorem conformal_transfer (r r' R f f' W m : ℝ) (hr0 : r ≠ 0) (hR0 : R ≠ 0) : ((r' - 1) / R * f + r / R * f') * (r / R) + (1 - W) / R * (r / R * f) + r / R * m * (r / R * f) = (r / R) ^ 2 * (f' + (r' - W) / r * f + m * f)
doc:
【橋 A】平坦の残差 E_flat = dχ/dR + (1 − W)/R χ + Ω m χ(Ω = r/R、dχ/dR = (dχ/dρ)(r/R))は
曲がった残差 E_curv = f′ + (r′ − W)/r f + m f の (r/R)² 倍

name: twist_cancel
stmt: theorem twist_cancel (r r' W : ℝ) (hW : W = r') : (r' - W) / r = 0
doc: 【橋 A】ダンベル(W = r′)では係数 (r′ − W)/r = 0:スピン接続とゲージ場が打ち消し合う

name: system_reduce
stmt: theorem system_reduce (m f s : ℝ) (hs : s ^ 2 = 1) : -(I * m * ((s : ℂ) * I * f)) = (s : ℂ) * m * f ∧ (s : ℂ) * I * ((s : ℂ) * m * f) = I * m * f
doc: 【橋 A】係数 0 の系 f′ = −i m g、g′ = i m f は g = s·i·f(s = ±1)で f′ = s m f になる

name: zero_mode
stmt: theorem zero_mode (M m : ℝ → ℝ) (s ρ : ℝ) (hM : HasDerivAt M (m ρ) ρ) : HasDerivAt (fun x => Real.exp (s * M x)) (s * m ρ * Real.exp (s * M ρ)) ρ
doc: 【橋 A】ゼロモード f = exp(s·M)(M′ = m、s = ±1)は f′ = s m f

name: localization
stmt: theorem localization (M m : ℝ → ℝ) (a b m0 : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) (hM : ∀ x, HasDerivAt M (m x) x) (hm : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, m0 ≤ m x) : Real.exp (-2 * (M b - M a)) ≤ Real.exp (-2 * (m0 * (b - a)))
doc: 【橋 A】局在:[a, b](首)で m ≥ m₀ なら |f|² = exp(−2(M(b) − M(a))) ≤ exp(−2m₀(b − a))

name: can_el_Om_of
stmt: theorem can_el_Om_of (r ru rv ruv Om W l : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (h : ruv = 2⁻¹ * Om * (l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 / r ^ 2 - 1) / r - ru * rv / r) : 2 * (2 * r * ruv + 2 * ru * rv) + 2 * Om - 2 * l ^ 2 * Om * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 / r ^ 2 = 0

name: can_el_W_of
stmt: theorem can_el_W_of (r Om W Wuv l : ℝ) (h : Wuv = 2⁻¹ * Om * W * (1 - W ^ 2) / r ^ 2) : -16 * l ^ 2 * Wuv + 8 * l ^ 2 * Om * W * (1 - W ^ 2) / r ^ 2 = 0

name: can_el_r_of
stmt: theorem can_el_r_of (r ruv Om Omu Omv Omuv W l : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hO : Om ≠ 0) (h : Omuv = Omu * Omv / Om - 2 * Om * ruv / r - Om ^ 2 * l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 / r ^ 4) : 4 * r * (Omuv / Om - Omu * Omv / Om ^ 2) + 8 * ruv + 4 * l ^ 2 * Om * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 / r ^ 3 = 0

name: can_mass_identity
stmt: theorem can_mass_identity (r r1 r2 L L1 PL PL1 Pr : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hL : L ≠ 0) : PL * PL1 / r - PL ^ 2 * r1 / (2 * r ^ 2) + r1 / 2 * (1 - r1 ^ 2 / L ^ 2) - r * r1 * r2 / L ^ 2 + r * r1 ^ 2 * L1 / L ^ 3 = -(r1 / L) * (-Pr * PL / r + L * PL ^ 2 / (2 * r ^ 2) + r * r2 / L - r * r1 * L1 / L ^ 2 + r1 ^ 2 / (2 * L) - L / 2) - (PL / (r * L)) * (Pr * r1 - L * PL1)

name: can_mass_constraint
stmt: theorem can_mass_constraint (r r1 r2 L L1 PL PL1 Pr Hm PW W1 : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hL : L ≠ 0) (hH : (-Pr * PL / r + L * PL ^ 2 / (2 * r ^ 2) + r * r2 / L - r * r1 * L1 / L ^ 2 + r1 ^ 2 / (2 * L) - L / 2) + Hm = 0) (hHx : (Pr * r1 - L * PL1) + PW * W1 = 0) : PL * PL1 / r - PL ^ 2 * r1 / (2 * r ^ 2) + r1 / 2 * (1 - r1 ^ 2 / L ^ 2) - r * r1 * r2 / L ^ 2 + r * r1 ^ 2 * L1 / L ^ 3 = (r1 / L) * Hm + (PL / (r * L)) * (PW * W1)

name: H_a
stmt: theorem H_a (a b pa pb c l : ℝ) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun x => Hfun x b pa pb c l) (-c + c * l ^ 2 / b ^ 2 + pa ^ 2 / (4 * b ^ 2 * c)) a

name: H_pb
stmt: theorem H_pb (a b pa pb c l : ℝ) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun x => Hfun a b pa x c l) (-pa / (2 * b * c)) pb

name: H_pa
stmt: theorem H_pa (a b pa pb c l : ℝ) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun x => Hfun a b x pb c l) ((a * pa - b * pb) / (2 * b ^ 2 * c)) pa

name: H_b
stmt: theorem H_b (a b pa pb c l : ℝ) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun x => Hfun a x pa pb c l) ((-4 * a * c ^ 2 * l ^ 2 + pa * (-a * pa + b * pb)) / (2 * b ^ 3 * c)) b

name: hj_exact
stmt: theorem hj_exact (a b c l C σ σ' : ℝ) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hs2 : σ ^ 2 = C * b - 4 * c ^ 2 * (b ^ 2 + l ^ 2)) (hss : σ * σ' = (C - 8 * c ^ 2 * b) / 2) : Hfun a b σ (a * σ') c l = 0
doc: S = aσ(b)(p_a = σ、p_b = aσ′)、σ² = Cb − 4c²(b² + ℓ²)、σσ′ = (C − 8c²b)/2 なら H = 0

name: center_ode
stmt: theorem center_ode (r q ru ruu ruv σu Wu l : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hruv : ruv = (q ^ 2 * l ^ 2 * (1 - 0 ^ 2) ^ 2 / (2 * r ^ 2) - ru * ru - q ^ 2 / 2) / r) (hcons : ruu - 2 * σu * ru + 2 * Wu ^ 2 / r = 0) : let rt
doc:
二重 null 計量 −2e^{2σ}du dv + r²dΩ² の中心(鏡映対称 u ↔ v、W = 0)で:
    r_u = r_v、r_uu = r_vv、σ_u = σ_v、W_v = −W_u。
    方程式 r_uv = (q²ℓ²(1−W²)²/(2r²) − r_u r_v − q²/2)/r(q = e^σ)と
    拘束 r_uu − 2σ_u r_u + 2W_u²/r = 0。
    t = (u+v)/2、s = (v−u)/2、固有時 dτ = √2 q dt、固有長 dl = √2 q ds とすると
    r′ = r_t/(√2q)、W_l = W_s/(√2q)、r″ = (r_tt − σ_t r_t)/(2q²)(連鎖律)。
    このとき r″ = −(r′² + 1 − ℓ²/r²)/(2r) − W_l²/r

name: arrival_time
stmt: theorem arrival_time (l z : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) : ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..z, 1 / cosh (t / l) = l * CFT.AlphaIV.gd (z / l)

name: energy_ineq_alg
stmt: theorem energy_ineq_alg (r r1 rp κ l : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hr1 : r < r1) (hκ : l ^ 2 / 2 ≤ κ) (h : r * rp ^ 2 ≥ (r1 - r) + (2 * κ - l ^ 2) * (1 / r - 1 / r1)) : rp ^ 2 ≥ (κ - l ^ 2 / 2) * (1 / r ^ 2 - 1 / r1 ^ 2)
doc:
(i) エネルギー不等式の代数部分:r r′² ≥ (r₁ − r) + (2κ − ℓ²)(1/r − 1/r₁)、0 < r < r₁、
    κ ≥ ℓ²/2 なら r′² ≥ (κ − ℓ²/2)(1/r² − 1/r₁²)

name: energy_monotone_integrand
stmt: theorem energy_monotone_integrand (W rp r κ : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hrp : rp ≤ 0) (hW : κ ≤ W ^ 2 * r ^ 2) : 0 ≤ -2 * W ^ 2 * rp + 2 * κ * rp / r ^ 2
doc:
E − 2κ/r は、崩壊中(r′ ≤ 0)かつ W²r² ≥ κ なら減らない(エネルギー不等式の単調性部分):
    (E − 2κ/r)′ = −2W²r′ + 2κr′/r² = −2r′(W² − κ/r²) ≥ 0

name: collapse_time
stmt: theorem collapse_time (r rp : ℝ → ℝ) (A r1 τ0 τ1 : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (hτ : τ0 ≤ τ1) (hd : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc τ0 τ1, HasDerivAt r (rp τ) τ) (hr : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc τ0 τ1, 0 < r τ ∧ r τ < r1) (hineq : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc τ0 τ1, rp τ ≤ -√(A * (1 / r τ ^ 2 - 1 / r1 ^ 2))) : τ1 - τ0 ≤ r1 ^ 2 / √A
doc:
(ii) 比較定理:0 < r < r₁ で r′ ≤ −√(A(1/r² − 1/r₁²))(A > 0)が [τ₀, τ₁] で成り立つなら
    τ₁ − τ₀ ≤ r₁²/√A

name: energy_inequality
stmt: theorem energy_inequality (r rp W : ℝ → ℝ) (l κ τ1 τ2 : ℝ) (h12 : τ1 ≤ τ2) (hpos : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc τ1 τ2, 0 < r τ) (h1 : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc τ1 τ2, HasDerivAt r (rp τ) τ) (h2 : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc τ1 τ2, HasDerivAt rp (-(rp τ ^ 2 + 1 - l ^ 2 / r τ ^ 2) / (2 * r τ) - W τ ^ 2 / r τ) τ) (hdown : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc τ1 τ2, rp τ ≤ 0) (hW : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc τ1 τ2, κ ≤ W τ ^ 2 * r τ ^ 2) : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc τ1 τ2, r τ1 * (1 + rp τ1 ^ 2) + l ^ 2 / r τ1 - 2 * κ / r τ1 ≤ r τ * (1 + rp τ ^ 2) + l ^ 2 / r τ - 2 * κ / r τ
doc:
(i′) エネルギー不等式そのもの:転回点 τ₁(r = r₁、r′ = 0)から崩壊中(r′ ≤ 0)、
    中心の式と W²r² ≥ κ が成り立つなら、各時刻で
    r(1 + r′²) + ℓ²/r − 2κ/r ≥ r₁ + ℓ²/r₁ − 2κ/r₁

name: energy_inequality'
stmt: theorem energy_inequality' (r1 r rp l κ : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hr1 : 0 < r1) (h : r1 * (1 + 0 ^ 2) + l ^ 2 / r1 - 2 * κ / r1 ≤ r * (1 + rp ^ 2) + l ^ 2 / r - 2 * κ / r) : r * rp ^ 2 ≥ (r1 - r) + (2 * κ - l ^ 2) * (1 / r - 1 / r1)
doc: 系:転回点(r′(τ₁) = 0、r(τ₁) = r₁)からなら r r′² ≥ (r₁ − r) + (2κ − ℓ²)(1/r − 1/r₁)

name: rho_injective
stmt: theorem rho_injective (q : ℍ[ℝ]) (h : rho q = 0) : q = 0
doc: ρ は単射

name: rho_star
stmt: theorem rho_star (q : ℍ[ℝ]) : rho (star q) = (rho q).conjTranspose
doc: ρ(q̄) = ρ(q)†(共役転置)

name: rho_one
stmt: theorem rho_one : rho 1 = 1

name: rho_SU2
stmt: theorem rho_SU2 (q : ℍ[ℝ]) (hq : Quaternion.normSq q = 1) : rho q * (rho q).conjTranspose = 1 ∧ (rho q).det = 1
doc: 単位四元数は SU(2) に写る:ρ(q)ρ(q)† = 1、det ρ(q) = 1

name: lorentz_action
stmt: theorem lorentz_action (A X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (hA : A.det = 1) (hX : X.conjTranspose = X) : (A * X * A.conjTranspose).conjTranspose = A * X * A.conjTranspose ∧ (A * X * A.conjTranspose).det = X.det
doc: Lorentz 実形:A ∈ SL(2,ℂ) は X ↦ AXA† でエルミート性と行列式を保つ

name: II_iff_cotton
stmt: theorem II_iff_cotton (N : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (hsym : ∀ c b d, N c b d = N c d b) (hBianchi : ∀ d, ∑ c, N c c d = (∑ b, N d b b) / 2) : let gradR : Fin 3 → ℝ
doc:
N c b d = ∇_c Ric_bd(直交枠、b, d について対称)、∇_d R = Σ_b N d b b、
    縮約 Bianchi Σ_c N c c d = ½∇_d R。
    (II):T c b d = N c b d − N b c d = 0。
    Cotton:C c b d = (N c b d − ¼∇_c R δ_bd) − (N b c d − ¼∇_b R δ_cd)

name: frame_eq
stmt: theorem frame_eq (m iE : ℂ) (p : Fin 3 → ℂ) (hiE : (m ^ 2 + p 0 ^ 2 + p 1 ^ 2 + p 2 ^ 2) * iE ^ 2 = 1) (i : Fin 3) : Uinv m iE p * dU m iE p i = A p (iE ^ 2) (-m * iE ^ 2) i
doc: e_i = U⁻¹∂_iU = i[σ·(p×e_i) − mσ_i]/E²(= A p (1/E²) (−m/E²) i)

name: maurer_cartan
doc:
捩れゼロ(Maurer–Cartan):e = A(a = 1/E², b = −m/E²)の曲率は 0。
    a′ = d(1/(m²+s))/ds = −1/E⁴、b′ = m/E⁴

name: inv_deriv
stmt: theorem inv_deriv (m s : ℝ) (h : m ^ 2 + s ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun s => 1 / (m ^ 2 + s)) (-(1 / (m ^ 2 + s)) ^ 2) s
doc: 1/(m² + s) の s 微分は −1/(m² + s)²(a′ = −1/E⁴ の根拠)

name: frame_metric
stmt: theorem frame_metric (m iE : ℂ) (p : Fin 3 → ℂ) (hiE : (m ^ 2 + p 0 ^ 2 + p 1 ^ 2 + p 2 ^ 2) * iE ^ 2 = 1) (i j : Fin 3) : -(1 / 2) * trace (A p (iE ^ 2) (-m * iE ^ 2) i * A p (iE ^ 2) (-m * iE ^ 2) j) = (if i = j then iE ^ 2 else 0) - p i * p j * iE ^ 4
doc: 枠の計量:−½tr(e_i e_j) = δ_ij/E² − p_i p_j/E⁴

name: quantum_metric
stmt: theorem quantum_metric (m iE : ℂ) (p : Fin 3 → ℂ) (hiE : (m ^ 2 + p 0 ^ 2 + p 1 ^ 2 + p 2 ^ 2) * iE ^ 2 = 1) (i j : Fin 3) : (1 / 2) * trace (dP m iE p i * dP m iE p j) = (1 / 2) * ((if i = j then iE ^ 2 else 0) - p i * p j * iE ^ 4)
doc: 量子計量 ½tr(∂_iP ∂_jP) = ½(δ_ij/E² − p_i p_j/E⁴)

name: pullback_metric
stmt: theorem pullback_metric (m iE : ℂ) (p : Fin 3 → ℂ) (hiE : (m ^ 2 + p 0 ^ 2 + p 1 ^ 2 + p 2 ^ 2) * iE ^ 2 = 1) (i j : Fin 3) : ∑ μ, dQ m iE p i μ * dQ m iE p j μ = (if i = j then iE ^ 2 else 0) - p i * p j * iE ^ 4
doc: 引き戻し計量 Σ_μ ∂_iQ_μ ∂_jQ_μ = δ_ij/E² − p_i p_j/E⁴

name: dQ0_deriv
stmt: theorem dQ0_deriv (m c x : ℝ) (h : 0 < m ^ 2 + x ^ 2 + c) : HasDerivAt (fun x => m / Real.sqrt (m ^ 2 + x ^ 2 + c)) (-(m * x) / Real.sqrt (m ^ 2 + x ^ 2 + c) ^ 3) x
doc: 連鎖律の確認:∂/∂p₁ (m/√(m² + p₁² + c)) = −m p₁/E³

name: F_diag
stmt: theorem F_diag (p : Fin 3 → ℂ) (a ap : ℂ) (i : Fin 3) : F p a ap 0 0 i i = 0

name: F_anti
stmt: theorem F_anti (p : Fin 3 → ℂ) (a ap : ℂ) (i j : Fin 3) : F p a ap 0 0 j i = -F p a ap 0 0 i j

name: F_eps

name: starF_closed

name: bps_closed
stmt: theorem bps_closed (m iE iS : ℂ) (p : Fin 3 → ℂ) (hiE : (m ^ 2 + p 0 ^ 2 + p 1 ^ 2 + p 2 ^ 2) * iE ^ 2 = 1) (hiS : (p 0 ^ 2 + p 1 ^ 2 + p 2 ^ 2) * iS = 1) (k : Fin 3) : (m ^ 2) • DPhi m iE iS p k + ∑ c, Kmat m iE p k c • Fs p (aB m iE iS) (apB m iE iS p) c = 0
doc: 3. m² D_kΦ + Σ_c K_kc F*_c = 0(a = aB、a′ = apB)

name: bps
stmt: theorem bps (m iE iS : ℂ) (p : Fin 3 → ℂ) (hiE : (m ^ 2 + p 0 ^ 2 + p 1 ^ 2 + p 2 ^ 2) * iE ^ 2 = 1) (hiS : (p 0 ^ 2 + p 1 ^ 2 + p 2 ^ 2) * iS = 1) (k : Fin 3) : (m ^ 2) • DPhi m iE iS p k + starF m iE p (aB m iE iS) (apB m iE iS p) k = 0
doc: まとめ:ε で定義した Hodge 双対について m²D_kΦ + m²(*F)_k = 0、すなわち D_AΦ = −*F

name: aB_eq
doc: a = (1 − m/E)/(2s) は 1/(2E(E+m)) に等しい(s = E² − m²、E > m > 0)

name: apB_eq
doc: a′ の式は berry_deriv の値 −(2E+m)/(4E³(E+m)²) に等しい

name: zero_mode
stmt: theorem zero_mode (m q θ : ℝ) (h0 : 0 < θ) (hπ : θ < π) : HasDerivAt (fun θ => tan (θ / 2) ^ m * sin θ ^ q) ((m + q * cos θ) / sin θ * (tan (θ / 2) ^ m * sin θ ^ q)) θ
doc: ゼロモード u(θ) = tan(θ/2)^m sin(θ)^q は u′ = ((m + q cos θ)/sin θ) u を満たす

name: zero_mode_other
stmt: theorem zero_mode_other (m q θ : ℝ) (h0 : 0 < θ) (hπ : θ < π) : HasDerivAt (fun θ => tan (θ / 2) ^ (-m) * sin θ ^ (-q)) (-((m + q * cos θ) / sin θ) * (tan (θ / 2) ^ (-m) * sin θ ^ (-q))) θ
doc: もう一方の分岐 v = tan(θ/2)^{−m} sin(θ)^{−q} は v′ = −V v

name: count_integer_charge
stmt: theorem count_integer_charge (n : ℕ) : (Finset.Ico (-(n : ℤ)) n).card = 2 * n
doc: q = n(正の整数):許される半整数 m = k + 1/2(|m| < n + 1/2 ⇔ −n ≤ k < n)は 2n 個

name: admissible_half
stmt: theorem admissible_half (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ) : |((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2)| < n + 1 / 2 ↔ (-(n : ℤ) ≤ k ∧ k < n)
doc: 半整数 m = k + 1/2 が |m| < n + 1/2 を満たす ⇔ −n ≤ k < n

name: count_half_charge
stmt: theorem count_half_charge (n : ℕ) : (Finset.Icc (-(n : ℤ)) n).card = 2 * n + 1
doc: q = n + 1/2:許される整数 m(|m| < n + 1)は 2n + 1 個 = 2q

name: other_chirality_empty
stmt: theorem other_chirality_empty (q m : ℝ) (hq : 1 / 2 ≤ q) : ¬ (q - 1 / 2 < m ∧ m < 1 / 2 - q)
doc: カイラリティ:q ≥ 1/2 なら他方の分岐の条件 q − 1/2 < m < 1/2 − q を満たす m はない

name: exponent_condition
stmt: theorem exponent_condition (m q : ℝ) : (-(1 / 2) < m + q ∧ -(1 / 2) < q - m) ↔ |m| < q + 1 / 2
doc: 端点の指数:θ → 0 で m + q、θ → π で q − m。両方 > −1/2 ⇔ |m| < q + 1/2

name: one_generation_from_twist
stmt: theorem one_generation_from_twist : (2 : ℝ) * ((2 : ℝ) / 4) = 1
doc: α-VII.9:U(1)_F = ½ スピン接続のひねりは S² で電荷 q = χ(S²)/4 = 1/2、ゼロモードは 2q = 1 個

name: ca_turning
stmt: theorem ca_turning (r0 l : ℝ) (hr : r0 ≠ 0) (hl : l ≠ 0) : 1 - l ^ 2 * (1 - (1 + r0 / l)) ^ 2 / r0 ^ 2 = 0

name: ca_soliton_deriv

name: ca_soliton
stmt: theorem ca_soliton (q sh ch ci li : ℝ) (hq : q ^ 2 = 2) (hcs : ch ^ 2 - sh ^ 2 = 1) (hci : ch * ci = 1) : (-q * sh * li * ci ^ 2) ^ 2 = (q * ci) ^ 2 * (2 - (q * ci) ^ 2) * li ^ 2 / 2

name: ds2_friedmann
stmt: theorem ds2_friedmann (l η : ℝ) : (l * cos η) ^ 2 + (-(l * sin η)) ^ 2 = l ^ 2

name: ds2_neck_action
stmt: theorem ds2_neck_action (G l A : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) (hl : l ≠ 0) : 1 / (8 * π * G * l ^ 2) * (4 * π * l ^ 2) * A = A / (2 * G)

name: ds_weyl_mass
stmt: theorem ds_weyl_mass (r ru rv Om W l : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hO : Om ≠ 0) : r ^ 2 / Om * (6 * ru * rv / r ^ 2 - 3 * Om * l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 / r ^ 4 + 2 * Om / r ^ 2) + 1 = 3 * ((1 + 2 * ru * rv / Om) - l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 / r ^ 2)

name: ds_mass_u
stmt: theorem ds_mass_u (r ru rv ruu ruv Om Omu W Wu l : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hO : Om ≠ 0) (hC : ruu = Omu / Om * ru - 2 * l ^ 2 * Wu ^ 2 / r) (h1 : ruv = 2⁻¹ * Om * (l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 / r ^ 2 - 1) / r - ru * rv / r) : ru / 2 * (1 + 2 * ru * rv / Om) + r * (ruu * rv + ru * ruv) / Om - r * ru * rv * Omu / Om ^ 2 = -2 * l ^ 2 * Wu ^ 2 * rv / Om + ru * l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 / (2 * r ^ 2)

name: ds_N_u
stmt: theorem ds_N_u (r ru rv Om W Wu l m mu N : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hO : Om ≠ 0) (hmu : mu = -2 * l ^ 2 * Wu ^ 2 * rv / Om + ru * l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 / (2 * r ^ 2)) (hN : N = 2 * m * r - l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2) : 2 * mu * r + 2 * m * ru + 4 * l ^ 2 * W * Wu * (1 - W ^ 2) - ru / r * N = 2 * ru * l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 / r + 4 * l ^ 2 * W * Wu * (1 - W ^ 2) - 4 * l ^ 2 * r * rv * Wu ^ 2 / Om

name: ds_circle_of_flat
stmt: theorem ds_circle_of_flat (r W l : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hW : 1 - W ^ 2 ≠ 0) (h : 1 - W ^ 2 = l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 / r ^ 2) : r ^ 2 + l ^ 2 * W ^ 2 = l ^ 2

name: ds_cap_on_circle
stmt: theorem ds_cap_on_circle (l x : ℝ) : (l * sin (x / l)) ^ 2 + l ^ 2 * cos (x / l) ^ 2 = l ^ 2

name: ds_neck_on_circle
stmt: theorem ds_neck_on_circle (l : ℝ) : l ^ 2 + l ^ 2 * (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 = l ^ 2

name: ds_cap_disc
stmt: theorem ds_cap_disc (l η χ : ℝ) : (l * cos η * sin χ) ^ 2 + l ^ 2 * cos χ ^ 2 = l ^ 2 - l ^ 2 * sin η ^ 2 * sin χ ^ 2

name: ds_branch
stmt: theorem ds_branch {r r' : ℝ → ℝ} {l x r'' : ℝ} (hl : l ≠ 0) (h : ∀ y, r y ^ 2 + l ^ 2 * r' y ^ 2 = l ^ 2) (hr : HasDerivAt r (r' x) x) (hr' : HasDerivAt r' r'' x) : r' x = 0 ∨ r'' = -(r x) / l ^ 2

name: fam_birkhoff_u
stmt: theorem fam_birkhoff_u (r ru rv Om W Wu l : ℝ) (hW : W ^ 2 = 1) (hWu : Wu = 0) : -2 * l ^ 2 * Wu ^ 2 * rv / Om + ru * l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 / (2 * r ^ 2) = 0

name: fam_birkhoff_slice
stmt: theorem fam_birkhoff_slice (r r1 r2 L L1 PL PL1 Pr PW : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hL : L ≠ 0) (hH : (-Pr * PL / r + L * PL ^ 2 / (2 * r ^ 2) + r * r2 / L - r * r1 * L1 / L ^ 2 + r1 ^ 2 / (2 * L) - L / 2) + 0 = 0) (hHx : (Pr * r1 - L * PL1) + PW * 0 = 0) : PL * PL1 / r - PL ^ 2 * r1 / (2 * r ^ 2) + r1 / 2 * (1 - r1 ^ 2 / L ^ 2) - r * r1 * r2 / L ^ 2 + r * r1 ^ 2 * L1 / L ^ 3 = 0

name: fam_jt_U0

name: fam_jt_slope

name: fam_jt_coeff
stmt: theorem fam_jt_coeff (l : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : 2 * l ^ 2 * ((l ^ 2) ^ 2)⁻¹ * l ^ 2 = 2

name: fam_jt_S0

name: fam_jt_Wmass

name: fam_no_real_dim

name: fam_hawking_slope

name: fam_extremal_T
stmt: theorem fam_extremal_T (l : ℝ) : (l - l) / (l * l) = 0

name: fam_first_law
stmt: theorem fam_first_law (rp l : ℝ) (hrp : rp ≠ 0) : (1 - l ^ 2 / rp ^ 2) / 2 = ((rp - l ^ 2 / rp) / (rp * rp)) / (4 * π) * (2 * π * rp)

name: fam_hagedorn

name: fer_hedgehog

name: fer_triplet

name: fer_j_half

name: fer_susy_factor

stmt: theorem total_conserved (βg κ c : ℝ) (a ad : ℝ → ℝ) (add t : ℝ) (ha : HasDerivAt a (ad t) t) (had : HasDerivAt ad add t) (hpos : 0 < a t) : HasDerivAt (fun τ => βg * (-3 * (CFT.FRW.Xf a ad τ * CFT.FRW.Xf a ad τ)) + CFT.NeckQuantum.rhoB κ c a τ) (-3 * (ad t / a t) * ((βg * (-3 * (CFT.FRW.Xf a ad t * CFT.FRW.Xf a ad t)) + CFT.NeckQuantum.rhoB κ c a t) + (βg * (4 * (add / a t) * CFT.FRW.Xf a ad t - CFT.FRW.Xf a ad t * CFT.FRW.Xf a ad t) + (CFT.NeckQuantum.rhoB κ c a t / 3 + 2 * c / a t ^ 4)))) t

doc: 【α-VIII.7】帽子の ODE を [0, π/2) でだけ仮定しても a = ℓ cos η

name: no_killing_spinor_local
stmt: theorem no_killing_spinor_local (l : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (a ad : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ η ∈ Ico 0 (π / 2), HasDerivAt a (ad η) η) (had : ∀ η ∈ Ico 0 (π / 2), HasDerivAt ad (-a η) η) (h0 : a 0 = l) (hd0 : ad 0 = 0) (Kr : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (hKr : ∀ η ∈ Ioo 0 (π / 2), ∀ χ ∈ Ioo 0 (π / 2 - η), Kr η χ = 24 * l ^ 4 * ((a η) ^ 8)⁻¹) (Kη Kχ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℝ → ℝ → Fin 4 → ℝ × ℝ) (hε : ∀ η χ, ε η χ ≠ 0) (hKη : ∀ η χ, Kη η χ = (∑ i, ((ε η χ i).1 ^ 2 + (ε η χ i).2 ^ 2)) / a η) (dKη dKχ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (hdη : ∀ η χ, HasDerivAt (fun s => Kr s χ) (dKη η χ) η) (hdχ : ∀ η χ, HasDerivAt (fun s => Kr η s) (dKχ η χ) χ) (hKill : ∀ η ∈ Ioo 0 (π / 2), ∀ χ ∈ Ioo 0 (π / 2 - η), Kη η χ * dKη η χ + Kχ η χ * dKχ η χ = 0) : False
doc:
【α-VIII.7】帽子の領域(0 ≤ η < π/2 の ODE、0 < η < π/2・0 < χ < π/2 − η の曲率の式と Killing の式)だけを仮定しても
Killing スピノルはない(点 (π/4, π/8) で ∂_χK = 0、∂_ηK ≠ 0、K^η > 0)

name: jt_dt
stmt: theorem jt_dt (l A B C z t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun t => A * sin (t / l) + cos (t / l) * (B * cosh (z / l) + C * sinh (z / l))) (A / l * cos (t / l) - sin (t / l) / l * (B * cosh (z / l) + C * sinh (z / l))) t
doc: φ の t 微分

name: jt_dtt
stmt: theorem jt_dtt (l A B C z t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun t => A / l * cos (t / l) - sin (t / l) / l * (B * cosh (z / l) + C * sinh (z / l))) (-(A / l ^ 2) * sin (t / l) - cos (t / l) / l ^ 2 * (B * cosh (z / l) + C * sinh (z / l))) t
doc: φ_t の t 微分 = φ_tt

name: jt_dz
stmt: theorem jt_dz (l A B C t z : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun z => A * sin (t / l) + cos (t / l) * (B * cosh (z / l) + C * sinh (z / l))) (cos (t / l) * ((B * sinh (z / l) + C * cosh (z / l)) / l)) z
doc: φ の z 微分

name: jt_dzz
stmt: theorem jt_dzz (l B C t z : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun z => cos (t / l) * ((B * sinh (z / l) + C * cosh (z / l)) / l)) (cos (t / l) * (B * cosh (z / l) + C * sinh (z / l)) / l ^ 2) z
doc: φ_z の z 微分 = φ_zz

name: jt_dtz
stmt: theorem jt_dtz (l A B C t z : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun z => A / l * cos (t / l) - sin (t / l) / l * (B * cosh (z / l) + C * sinh (z / l))) (-(sin (t / l) / l) * ((B * sinh (z / l) + C * cosh (z / l)) / l)) z
doc: φ_t の z 微分 = φ_tz

name: jt_neck_solution
stmt: theorem jt_neck_solution (l A B C t z : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hc : cos (t / l) ≠ 0) : let Z
doc:
【α-IX.14】首の座標での JT の dilaton の方程式(tt、zz、tz)の解
φ = A sin(t/ℓ) + cos(t/ℓ)(B cosh(z/ℓ) + C sinh(z/ℓ))

name: no_static_dilaton
stmt: theorem no_static_dilaton (l A B C : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (h : ∀ t z : ℝ, A / l * cos (t / l) - sin (t / l) / l * (B * cosh (z / l) + C * sinh (z / l)) = 0) : A = 0 ∧ B = 0 ∧ C = 0
doc: 【α-IX.14】静的な dilaton は 0 だけ:すべての (t, z) で φ_t = 0 なら A = B = C = 0

name: jt_gradient
stmt: theorem jt_gradient (l B t z : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hc : cos (t / l) ≠ 0) : -(-(sin (t / l) / l) * (B * cosh (z / l))) ^ 2 + (cos (t / l) * (B * sinh (z / l) / l)) ^ 2 / cos (t / l) ^ 2 = (B / l) ^ 2 * (sinh (z / l) ^ 2 - sin (t / l) ^ 2 * cosh (z / l) ^ 2)
doc: 【α-IX.14】対称な解 φ = B cos(t/ℓ)cosh(z/ℓ) の勾配 (∇φ)² = −φ_t² + φ_z²/a²

name: jt_bifurcation
stmt: theorem jt_bifurcation (l B : ℝ) : (B / l) ^ 2 * (sinh (0 / l) ^ 2 - sin (0 / l) ^ 2 * cosh (0 / l) ^ 2) = 0
doc: 【α-IX.14】首の中心 (0, 0) で勾配は 0(分岐面)

name: junction_near_boundary
stmt: theorem junction_near_boundary (L l uc : ℝ) (huc : 0 < uc) (huc2 : uc ≤ π / 2) (hjoin : sin uc = 1 / cosh (L / l)) : uc ≤ π * rexp (-(L / l))
doc: 【α-IX.14】接合 sin u_c = sech(L/ℓ)(0 < u_c ≤ π/2)なら u_c ≤ πe^{−L/ℓ}(長い首で境界に近づく)

name: jt_normalization
stmt: theorem jt_normalization (G l φr : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) : 1 / (16 * π * (G / (4 * π))) = 1 / (4 * G) ∧ l ^ 2 / (4 * (G / (4 * π))) = π * l ^ 2 / G ∧ φr / (8 * π * (G / (4 * π))) = φr / (2 * G)
doc:
【α-IX.14】結合の規格化:G₂ = G/(4π) で 1/(16πG₂) = 1/(4G)、S₀ = ℓ²/(4G₂) = πℓ²/G、
C = φ_r/(8πG₂) = φ_r/(2G)

name: int_sin_cos
stmt: theorem int_sin_cos (Y : ℝ) (hY : 0 < Y) : ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..Y, sin (π / Y * y) * cos (π / Y * y) = 0
doc: ∫₀^Y sin(πy/Y)cos(πy/Y) dy = 0

name: G1_integral
stmt: theorem G1_integral (Y : ℝ) (hY : 0 < Y) : ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..Y, G1 Y y = Y / 2 * ((π / Y) ^ 2 - 3 / 4)

name: change_var
stmt: theorem change_var (g : ℝ → ℝ) (u1 Y : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u1) (hY : 0 < Y) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc 0 Y)) : ∫ u in u1..(u1 * rexp Y), g (log u - log u1) * u⁻¹ = ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..Y, g y
doc: 変数変換 y = log u − log u₁:∫_{u₁}^{u₁e^Y} g(log u − log u₁) u⁻¹ du = ∫₀^Y g(y) dy

name: test_deriv
stmt: theorem test_deriv (u1 Y u : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) : HasDerivAt (fun x => Real.sqrt x * sin (π / Y * (log x - log u1))) ((sin (π / Y * (log u - log u1)) / 2 + π / Y * cos (π / Y * (log u - log u1))) / Real.sqrt u) u
doc: 試験関数 f(u) = √u sin(π(log u − log u₁)/Y) の微分

name: integrand_eq
stmt: theorem integrand_eq (u1 Y u : ℝ) (hu1 : 0 < u1) (hu : 0 < u) (hsin : sin u ≠ 0) : ((sin (π / Y * (log u - log u1)) / 2 + π / Y * cos (π / Y * (log u - log u1))) / Real.sqrt u) ^ 2 - (Real.sqrt u * sin (π / Y * (log u - log u1))) ^ 2 / sin u ^ 2 = G2 u1 Y (log u - log u1) * u⁻¹
doc: 中身の一致:f′² − f²/sin²u = G₂(log u − log u₁)·u⁻¹

name: norm_integrand_eq
stmt: theorem norm_integrand_eq (u1 Y u : ℝ) (hu1 : 0 < u1) (hu : 0 < u) : (Real.sqrt u * sin (π / Y * (log u - log u1))) ^ 2 = (u1 * rexp (log u - log u1)) ^ 2 * sin (π / Y * (log u - log u1)) ^ 2 * u⁻¹
doc: 中身の一致(ノルム):f² = (u₁e^y)² sin²(πy/Y)·u⁻¹

name: G2_cont
stmt: theorem G2_cont (u1 Y : ℝ) (hu1 : 0 < u1) (hwin : u1 * rexp Y < π) : ContinuousOn (G2 u1 Y) (Icc 0 Y)
doc: G₂ は [0, Y] で連続(窓 u₁e^Y < π)

name: liouville_actual
stmt: theorem liouville_actual (u1 Y : ℝ) (hu1 : 0 < u1) (hY : 0 < Y) (hwin : u1 * rexp Y < π) : ∫ u in u1..(u1 * rexp Y), (((sin (π / Y * (log u - log u1)) / 2 + π / Y * cos (π / Y * (log u - log u1))) / Real.sqrt u) ^ 2 - (Real.sqrt u * sin (π / Y * (log u - log u1))) ^ 2 / sin u ^ 2) = ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..Y, G2 u1 Y y
doc: 【α-XI.1】Liouville の変換(本当のポテンシャル):∫(f′² − f²/sin²u) du = ∫₀^Y G₂

name: liouville_norm
stmt: theorem liouville_norm (u1 Y : ℝ) (hu1 : 0 < u1) (hY : 0 < Y) : ∫ u in u1..(u1 * rexp Y), (Real.sqrt u * sin (π / Y * (log u - log u1))) ^ 2 = ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..Y, (u1 * rexp y) ^ 2 * sin (π / Y * y) ^ 2
doc: 【α-XI.1】Liouville の変換(ノルム):∫ f² du = ∫₀^Y (u₁e^y)² sin²(πy/Y) dy

name: G2_le_G1
stmt: theorem G2_le_G1 (u1 Y y : ℝ) (hu1 : 0 < u1) (hy : u1 * rexp y < π) : G2 u1 Y y ≤ G1 Y y
doc: sin u ≤ u から G₂ ≤ G₁

name: actual_le
stmt: theorem actual_le (u1 Y : ℝ) (hu1 : 0 < u1) (hY : 0 < Y) (hwin : u1 * rexp Y < π) : ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..Y, G2 u1 Y y ≤ Y / 2 * ((π / Y) ^ 2 - 3 / 4)

name: actual_form_neg
stmt: theorem actual_form_neg (u1 Y : ℝ) (hu1 : 0 < u1) (hY : 2 * π / Real.sqrt 3 < Y) (hwin : u1 * rexp Y < π) : ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..Y, G2 u1 Y y < 0
doc: 【α-XI.1】Y > 2π/√3 なら本当の二次形式 ∫(f′² − f²/sin²u) は負

name: long_neck_unstable_actual
stmt: theorem long_neck_unstable_actual (L l uc : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (huc : 0 < uc) (huc2 : uc ≤ π / 2) (hjoin : sin uc = 1 / cosh (L / l)) (hL : 2 * π / Real.sqrt 3 + Real.log 2 < L / l) : ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(Real.log (π / (2 * uc))), G2 uc (Real.log (π / (2 * uc))) y < 0
doc: 【α-XI.1】首への読み替え:L/ℓ > 2π/√3 + log 2 なら、窓 [u_c, π/2] の本当の二次形式が負

name: growth_rate_bound
stmt: theorem growth_rate_bound (L l uc lam2 : ℝ) (huc : 0 < uc) (huc2 : uc ≤ π / 2) (hjoin : sin uc = 1 / cosh (L / l)) (hL : 4 < L / l) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam2) (hRay : -lam2 * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..4, (uc * rexp y) ^ 2 * sin (π / 4 * y) ^ 2) ≤ ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..4, G2 uc 4 y) : (3 / 4 - π ^ 2 / 16) * rexp (2 * (L / l - 4)) / π ^ 2 ≤ lam2
doc:
【α-XI.1】成長率の下限:min–max(−λ²∫f² ≤ ∫(f′² − f²/sin²u))と Y = 4 の窓から
λ² ≥ (3/4 − π²/16)e^{2(L/ℓ − 4)}/π²(L/ℓ > 4)

name: one_efold_before_collapse
stmt: theorem one_efold_before_collapse (L l uc lam2 : ℝ) (huc : 0 < uc) (huc2 : uc ≤ π / 2) (hjoin : sin uc = 1 / cosh (L / l)) (hL : 7 ≤ L / l) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam2) (hRay : -lam2 * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..4, (uc * rexp y) ^ 2 * sin (π / 4 * y) ^ 2) ≤ ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..4, G2 uc 4 y) : 1 ≤ lam2
doc: 【α-XI.1】L/ℓ ≥ 7 なら λ² ≥ 1:帽子の崩壊の時間 ℓ のうちに少なくとも 1 回 e 倍になる

name: cap_collapse_time
stmt: theorem cap_collapse_time (l : ℝ) : ∫ η in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), l * cos η = l
doc: 【α-XI.1】帽子の崩壊までの固有時間 ∫₀^{π/2} ℓ cos η dη = ℓ

name: front_marginally_trapped
stmt: theorem front_marginally_trapped (η : ℝ) (h0 : 0 < η) (h1 : η < π / 2) : cos (π / 2 - η) / sin (π / 2 - η) - sin η / cos η = 0 ∧ -(cos (π / 2 - η) / sin (π / 2 - η)) - sin η / cos η < 0
doc: 【α-XI.3】波面 χ = π/2 − η の上で θ₊ ∝ cot χ − tan η = 0、θ₋ ∝ −cot χ − tan η < 0(0 < η < π/2)

name: neck_marginal
stmt: theorem neck_marginal (l t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun _ : ℝ => l) 0 t
doc: 【α-XI.3】首の球(半径 ℓ で一定):ヌルの方向の微分は 0、θ± = 0

name: nonempty_window
stmt: theorem nonempty_window : ∃ u1 Y : ℝ, 0 < u1 ∧ 2 * π / Real.sqrt 3 < Y ∧ u1 * rexp Y < π
doc: 窓の例:u₁ = 10⁻⁶、Y = 4(2π/√3 < 4、u₁e⁴ < π)

name: int_inv_sq
stmt: theorem int_inv_sq (rp : ℝ) (hp : 0 < rp) : ∫ r in Ioi rp, (r ^ 2)⁻¹ = rp⁻¹

name: maxwell_magnetic
stmt: theorem maxwell_magnetic (β rp Q : ℝ) (hp : 0 < rp) : 1 / (16 * π) * (β * (4 * π)) * (∫ r in Ioi rp, 2 * Q ^ 2 / r ^ 4 * r ^ 2) = β * (Q / rp) * Q / 2
doc: 【α-IX.24】Maxwell の項:(1/16π)·β·4π∫ 2Q²/r⁴·r² dr = βΦQ/2(Φ = Q/r₊)

name: magnetic_action
stmt: theorem magnetic_action (β rp Q : ℝ) (hp : 0 < rp) (hβ : β * ((rp - Q ^ 2 / rp) / (4 * π * rp ^ 2)) = 1) : Imag β rp Q = β * (Thermo.Mrn rp Q - (rp - Q ^ 2 / rp) / (4 * π * rp ^ 2) * (π * rp ^ 2)) ∧ β * Thermo.Mrn rp Q - Imag β rp Q = π * rp ^ 2
doc:
【α-IX.24】磁荷の首:I = β(M − TS)(磁荷を固定した正準集団)、S = βM − I = πr₊² = A/4
(T = (r₊ − Q²/r₊)/(4πr₊²)、βT = 1)

name: electric_action
stmt: theorem electric_action (β rp Q : ℝ) (hp : 0 < rp) : β * Thermo.Mrn rp Q / 2 - β * (Q / rp) * Q / 2 = β * (Thermo.Mrn rp Q - (rp - Q ^ 2 / rp) / (4 * π * rp ^ 2) * (π * rp ^ 2) - Q / rp * Q)
doc: 比較:電荷のとき(Maxwell の項の符号が逆)は I = β(M − TS − ΦQ)

name: free_energy
stmt: theorem free_energy (rp Q : ℝ) (hp : rp ≠ 0) : Thermo.Mrn rp Q - (rp - Q ^ 2 / rp) / (4 * π * rp ^ 2) * (π * rp ^ 2) = rp / 4 + 3 * Q ^ 2 / (4 * rp)

name: same_T_product
doc: 同じ温度の二つの r₁ ≠ r₂ では r₁r₂ > 3Q²

name: small_branch_preferred
doc: 【α-IX.33】同じ温度なら小さい枝(極限 = 首につながる)の自由エネルギーが低い

name: heat_capacity_sign
stmt: theorem heat_capacity_sign (r Q : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) : HasDerivAt (fun x => 1 / x - Q ^ 2 / x ^ 3) (-1 / r ^ 2 + 3 * Q ^ 2 / r ^ 4) r ∧ (0 < -1 / r ^ 2 + 3 * Q ^ 2 / r ^ 4 ↔ r ^ 2 < 3 * Q ^ 2)
doc: 比熱の符号:T ∝ g(r) = 1/r − Q²/r³、g′(r) = −1/r² + 3Q²/r⁴ > 0 ⇔ r² < 3Q²

name: sqrt_lower
stmt: theorem sqrt_lower (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h8 : t ≤ 8) : 1 + t / 2 - t ^ 2 / 8 ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + t)

name: nr_limit
stmt: theorem nr_limit (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) : Tendsto (fun m : ℝ => m * (Real.sqrt (1 + x / m) - 1)) atTop (𝓝 (x / 2))

name: juttner_to_maxwell
stmt: theorem juttner_to_maxwell (β q : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun m : ℝ => rexp (-β * (Real.sqrt (m ^ 2 + m * q ^ 2) - m))) atTop (𝓝 (rexp (-β * (q ^ 2 / 2))))
doc: 【α-IX.27】p² = mq² の尺度で e^{−β(E − m)} → e^{−βq²/2}(Maxwell 分布)

name: nr_monotone
stmt: theorem nr_monotone (x m : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hm : 1 ≤ m) : Real.sqrt (1 + x) - 1 ≤ m * (Real.sqrt (1 + x / m) - 1)

name: fdt_from_kms
stmt: theorem fdt_from_kms (β ω g h : ℝ) (hkms : g = rexp (-(β * ω)) * h) : (h + g) * sinh (β * ω / 2) = (h - g) * cosh (β * ω / 2)
doc: 【α-IX.30】KMS の成分の式 g = e^{−βω}h だけから (h + g) sinh(βω/2) = (h − g) cosh(βω/2)

name: kms_weights
stmt: theorem kms_weights (ω : ℝ) : gω E β w ω = rexp (-(β * ω)) * hω E β w ω
doc: 【α-IX.30】KMS(IX.26)の成分:g(ω) = e^{−βω} h(ω)(詳細つり合い p_m = e^{−βω}p_k)

name: fdt_spectral
stmt: theorem fdt_spectral (ω : ℝ) : (hω E β w ω + gω E β w ω) * sinh (β * ω / 2) = (hω E β w ω - gω E β w ω) * cosh (β * ω / 2)
doc: 【α-IX.30】揺動散逸の関係 S(ω) = coth(βω/2) χ″(ω)(S = h + g、χ″ = h − g)

name: hedgehog_jacobian
stmt: theorem hedgehog_jacobian (θ φ : ℝ) : (sin θ * cos φ) * ((cos θ * sin φ) * 0 - (-sin θ) * (sin θ * cos φ)) + (sin θ * sin φ) * ((-sin θ) * (-(sin θ * sin φ)) - (cos θ * cos φ) * 0) + cos θ * ((cos θ * cos φ) * (sin θ * cos φ) - (cos θ * sin φ) * (-(sin θ * sin φ))) = sin θ
doc: n = (sin θ cos φ, sin θ sin φ, cos θ) で n·(∂_θn × ∂_φn) = sin θ

name: hedgehog_degree
stmt: theorem hedgehog_degree : 1 / (4 * π) * ∫ _φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * π), ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..π, sin θ = 1

name: nonempty_magnetic
stmt: theorem nonempty_magnetic : ∃ β rp Q : ℝ, 0 < rp ∧ β * ((rp - Q ^ 2 / rp) / (4 * π * rp ^ 2)) = 1
doc: magnetic_action の仮定をみたす例:r₊ = 2、Q = 1、β = 32π/3

name: nonempty_same_T
stmt: theorem nonempty_same_T : ∃ r1 r2 Q : ℝ, 0 < r1 ∧ r1 < r2 ∧ Q ≠ 0 ∧ (r1 - Q ^ 2 / r1) / (4 * π * r1 ^ 2) = (r2 - Q ^ 2 / r2) / (4 * π * r2 ^ 2)
doc: same_T_product の仮定をみたす例:r₁ = 1、r₂ = 2、Q² = 4/7

name: noether
stmt: theorem noether {n : ℕ} (p Lq K : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (pd Kd : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, HasDerivAt (p i) (pd i t) t) (hK : ∀ i, HasDerivAt (K i) (Kd i t) t) (hEL : ∀ i, pd i t = Lq i t) (hsym : ∑ i, (Lq i t * K i t + p i t * Kd i t) = 0) : HasDerivAt (fun s => ∑ i, p i s * K i s) 0 t
doc: 【α-X.1】一般の Noether の定理:ṗ_i = ∂L/∂q_i、Σ(∂L/∂q_i K_i + p_i K̇_i) = 0 なら Σ p_i K_i は保存

name: cyclic_from_noether
stmt: theorem cyclic_from_noether {n : ℕ} (p Lq : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (pd : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (j : Fin n) (hp : ∀ i, HasDerivAt (p i) (pd i t) t) (hEL : ∀ i, pd i t = Lq i t) (hcyc : Lq j t = 0) : HasDerivAt (fun s => ∑ i, p i s * (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) 0 t
doc: 【α-X.1】循環座標:K = e_j(定数)、∂L/∂q_j = 0 なら p_j は保存(Noether の特別な場合)

name: wkb_2d
stmt: theorem wkb_2d (A ψ0 Sph ik w c : S) (hikt : Dt ik = 0) (hikz : Dz ik = 0) (hψt : Dt ψ0 = ik * Dt Sph * ψ0) (hψz : Dz ψ0 = ik * Dz Sph * ψ0) : -(Dt (Dt (A * ψ0))) - c * Dt (A * ψ0) + w * Dz (Dz (A * ψ0)) = ψ0 * (ik ^ 2 * (A * (-(Dt Sph) ^ 2 + w * (Dz Sph) ^ 2)) + ik * (-(2 * Dt A * Dt Sph + A * Dt (Dt Sph)) - c * A * Dt Sph + w * (2 * Dz A * Dz Sph + A * Dz (Dz Sph))) + (-(Dt (Dt A)) - c * Dt A + w * Dz (Dz A)))
doc: 【α-X.2】2 次元の □(Aψ₀)(Dψ₀ = (ik)DS ψ₀):(ik)² の係数は A(−S_t² + wS_z²)

name: neck_eikonal
stmt: theorem neck_eikonal (l t : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (hc : 0 < cos (t / l)) : HasDerivAt (fun t => -(l * arsinh (tan (t / l)))) (-(1 / cos (t / l))) t ∧ -(-(1 / cos (t / l))) ^ 2 + (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 / cos (t / l) ^ 2 = 0
doc:
【α-X.2】首の波面 S = z − ℓ arsinh(tan(t/ℓ)):S_t = −1/cos(t/ℓ)、S_z = 1 で
アイコナール −S_t² + S_z²/cos²(t/ℓ) = 0

name: cap_ms_mass
stmt: theorem cap_ms_mass (a ad ρ χ : ℝ) (hF : ad ^ 2 + 1 = 8 * π / 3 * ρ * a ^ 2) : a * sin χ / 2 * (1 - (-(ad ^ 2 * sin χ ^ 2) + cos χ ^ 2)) = 4 * π / 3 * ρ * (a * sin χ) ^ 3
doc:
【α-X.4】帽子:R = a sin χ、(∇R)² = −ȧ² sin²χ + cos²χ、Friedmann ȧ² + 1 = (8π/3)ρa² なら
m = (R/2)(1 − (∇R)²) = (4π/3)ρR³

name: cap_first_law
stmt: theorem cap_first_law (a : ℝ → ℝ) (ad C χ t : ℝ) (ha : HasDerivAt a ad t) (h0 : a t ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun s => 4 * π / 3 * (C / a s ^ 4) * (a s * sin χ) ^ 3) (-(C / a t ^ 4 / 3) * (4 * π * (a t * sin χ) ^ 2 * (ad * sin χ))) t
doc: 【α-X.4】帽子の第一法則:ρ = C/a⁴、m = (4π/3)ρR³ なら dm/dt = −(ρ/3)·4πR² dR/dt

name: neck_ms_mass
stmt: theorem neck_ms_mass (l : ℝ) : l / 2 * (1 - 0) = l / 2
doc: 【α-X.4】首:R = ℓ 一定で (∇R)² = 0、m = ℓ/2

name: witten_Ftr
stmt: theorem witten_Ftr {n : Type*} [Fintype n] (T : Matrix n n ℝ) (a0 a1 a0r a1t : ℝ) : a1t • T - a0r • T + ((a0 • T) * (a1 • T) - (a1 • T) * (a0 • T)) = (a1t - a0r) • T
doc: 【α-X.5】A_t = a₀T、A_r = a₁T(同じ生成子)なら F_tr = ∂_tA_r − ∂_rA_t + [A_t, A_r] = (∂_ta₁ − ∂_ra₀)T

name: color_charge_vanishes
stmt: theorem color_charge_vanishes {n : Type*} [Fintype n] (T : Matrix n n ℝ) (r : ℝ) : (0 : ℝ) • T - (0 : ℝ) • T + (((0 : ℝ) • T) * ((0 : ℝ) • T) - ((0 : ℝ) • T) * ((0 : ℝ) • T)) = (0 - 0 : ℝ) • T ∧ 4 * π * r ^ 2 * (0 - 0 : ℝ) = 0
doc: 【α-X.5】ダンベル(a₀ = a₁ = 0、したがって ∂_ta₁ = ∂_ra₀ = 0):E_r = 0、Q(r) = 4πr²E_r = 0

name: norm_sq_expand
stmt: theorem norm_sq_expand {N : ℕ} (b v : Fin N → ℝ) (ε : ℝ) : ∑ i, ((1 + ε * b i) * v i) ^ 2 = ∑ i, v i ^ 2 + 2 * ε * ∑ i, b i * v i ^ 2 + ε ^ 2 * ∑ i, b i ^ 2 * v i ^ 2
doc: |(1 + εB)v|² = |v|² + 2ε⟨v, Bv⟩ + ε²|Bv|²(B は対角)

name: inner_expand
stmt: theorem inner_expand {N : ℕ} (b x v : Fin N → ℝ) (ε : ℝ) (hxv : ∑ i, x i * v i = 0) : ∑ i, ((1 + ε * b i) * x i) * ((1 + ε * b i) * v i) = ε * (2 * ∑ i, b i * x i * v i) + ε ^ 2 * ∑ i, b i ^ 2 * x i * v i
doc: ⟨Ax, Av⟩ = ε·2⟨x, Bv⟩ + ε²⟨Bx, Bv⟩(⟨x, v⟩ = 0)

name: ellipsoid_conformal_first_order
doc:
分母を払った恒等式:G = a₀ + 2εa₁ + ε²a₂、K = εc₁ + ε²c₂、D = 1 + 2εu₁ + ε²d₂ で
(G − (1 + 2εu₁)(G − K²/D)/D)·D² = ε²(G D d₂ + (1 + 2εu₁)(c₁ + εc₂)²)

name: ellipsoid_first_order
stmt: theorem ellipsoid_first_order {N : ℕ} (b x v : Fin N → ℝ) (ε : ℝ) (hx : ∑ i, x i ^ 2 = 1) (hxv : ∑ i, x i * v i = 0) (hD : ∑ i, ((1 + ε * b i) * x i) ^ 2 ≠ 0) : ∃ P : ℝ, (∑ i, ((1 + ε * b i) * v i) ^ 2 - (1 + 2 * ε * ∑ i, b i * x i ^ 2) * ((∑ i, ((1 + ε * b i) * v i) ^ 2 - (∑ i, ((1 + ε * b i) * x i) * ((1 + ε * b i) * v i)) ^ 2 / ∑ i, ((1 + ε * b i) * x i) ^ 2) / ∑ i, ((1 + ε * b i) * x i) ^ 2)) * (∑ i, ((1 + ε * b i) * x i) ^ 2) ^ 2 = ε ^ 2 * P
doc:
【α-VII.4 (1)】楕円体の誘導計量 |Av|² と、微分同相 φ_ε(x) = Ax/|Ax| で引き戻した丸い計量
|dφ_ε v|² = (|Av|² − ⟨Ax, Av⟩²/|Ax|²)/|Ax|² の差:|Av|² − (1 + 2εu₁)|dφ_ε v|² は ε² の次数

name: killing_stress
stmt: theorem killing_stress {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℝ A] (φ : A →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (X Y : A) (g μ : ℝ) (hcl : X * Y + Y * X = (-2 * g) • (1 : A)) : μ * φ (X * Y) + μ * φ (Y * X) = -2 * μ * g * φ 1
doc:
【α-VII.4 (2)】Killing スピノル:T(X, Y) = μ(⟨XYψ, ψ⟩ + ⟨YXψ, ψ⟩) = −2μ g(X, Y)⟨ψ, ψ⟩
(φ は Clifford の元 a ↦ Re⟨aψ, ψ⟩、XY + YX = −2g)

name: first_variation_coeff
stmt: theorem first_variation_coeff (lam n c : ℝ) (hn : n ≠ 0) (hsc : c * (2 * n) = -lam) : c = -(lam / (2 * n))
doc: δλ = c·m(m = tr h の平均)が相似変換 h = 2g(m = 2n、δλ = −λ)でも成り立てば c = −λ/(2n)

name: normalized_first_variation
stmt: theorem normalized_first_variation (lam n m : ℝ) (hl : lam ≠ 0) (hn : n ≠ 0) : (-(lam / (2 * n)) * m) / lam + 1 / n * (m / 2) = 0
doc: 【α-VII.4 (2)】δN/N = δλ/λ + (1/n)·δVol/Vol = 0(δλ = −(λ/2n)m、δVol/Vol = m/2)

name: second_order_equal
stmt: theorem second_order_equal {H : Type*} (Nd Q : H → ℝ) (hN : ∀ h, Nd h = 0) (h1 h2 h2' : H) : Q h1 + Nd h2 = Q h1 + Nd h2'
doc: 【α-VII.4 (3)】N₂ = Q(h₁) + N′[h₂] で N′ = 0 なら、h₂ によらず 2 次の係数は同じ

name: ellipsoid_local_min
stmt: theorem ellipsoid_local_min (Λ : ℝ → ℝ) (hΛ : (fun t => Λ t - Λ 0 - (99 / 250) * t ^ 2) =o[𝓝 0] (fun t => t ^ 2)) : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 0, Λ 0 ≤ Λ t
doc: 【α-VII.4】まとめ:2 次の係数 99/250 > 0 なら ρ = 1 は楕円体族に沿った局所最小

name: gen_unimodular
stmt: theorem gen_unimodular (C S c s : ℝ) (hC : C ^ 2 - S ^ 2 = 1) (hc : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) : (C + S * c) * (C - S * c) - (S * s) ^ 2 = 1

name: gen_trace_free
stmt: theorem gen_trace_free (C S c s bd td : ℝ) (hc : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) : (C - S * c) * (2 * bd * (S + C * c) - 2 * td * S * s) + (C + S * c) * (2 * bd * (S - C * c) + 2 * td * S * s) - 2 * (S * s) * (2 * bd * C * s + 2 * td * S * c) = 0

name: gen_shear
stmt: theorem gen_shear (C S c s bd td : ℝ) (hC : C ^ 2 - S ^ 2 = 1) (hc : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) : -((2 * bd * (S + C * c) - 2 * td * S * s) * (2 * bd * (S - C * c) + 2 * td * S * s) - (2 * bd * C * s + 2 * td * S * c) ^ 2) / 4 = bd ^ 2 + S ^ 2 * td ^ 2

name: gen_focusing
stmt: theorem gen_focusing (r ru ruu w S bu tu Wu l : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hC : ruu - w * ru + (r * (bu ^ 2 + S ^ 2 * tu ^ 2) + 2 * l ^ 2 * Wu ^ 2 / r) = 0) : ruu - w * ru ≤ 0

name: gen_kn_area
stmt: theorem gen_kn_area (a Q M : ℝ) (h : M ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + Q ^ 2) : 4 * π * (M ^ 2 + a ^ 2) = 4 * π * (Q ^ 2 + 2 * a ^ 2)

name: gen_kn_area_ge
stmt: theorem gen_kn_area_ge (a Q : ℝ) : 4 * π * Q ^ 2 ≤ 4 * π * (Q ^ 2 + 2 * a ^ 2)

name: gen_kn_round_iff
stmt: theorem gen_kn_round_iff (a Q : ℝ) : 4 * π * (Q ^ 2 + 2 * a ^ 2) = 4 * π * Q ^ 2 ↔ a = 0

name: i_sq
doc: i² = −1

name: j_sq
doc: j² = −1

name: k_sq
doc: k² = −1

name: ijk
doc: ijk = −1

name: normSq_mul'
stmt: theorem normSq_mul' (p q : ℍ[ℝ]) : normSq (p * q) = normSq p * normSq q
doc: ノルムの乗法性 |pq|² = |p|²|q|²

name: det_rho
stmt: theorem det_rho (q : ℍ[ℝ]) : (rho q).det = ((Quaternion.normSq q : ℝ) : ℂ)
doc: det ρ(q) = |q|²

name: rho_mul
stmt: theorem rho_mul (p q : ℍ[ℝ]) : rho (p * q) = rho p * rho q
doc: ρ は積を保つ(代数準同型であることの核心部分)

name: det_lorentz
stmt: theorem det_lorentz (t x y z : ℝ) : (!![(t : ℂ) + z, (x : ℂ) - y * Complex.I; (x : ℂ) + y * Complex.I, (t : ℂ) - z] : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ).det = ((t ^ 2 - x ^ 2 - y ^ 2 - z ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
doc: Lorentz 実形:X = tI + x·σ の行列式は t² − |x|²

name: dirac_sq
doc: β² = α_i² = 1、相異なるものは反可換なら、H = mβ + Σ pᵢαᵢ は H² = (m² + |p|²)·1

name: proj_idem
doc: H² = E²·1、E ≠ 0 なら P = ½(1 + H/E) は冪等(P² = P)

name: qD_unit
stmt: theorem qD_unit (m p1 p2 p3 E : ℝ) (hE0 : E ≠ 0) (hE : E ^ 2 = m ^ 2 + p1 ^ 2 + p2 ^ 2 + p3 ^ 2) : normSq (⟨m / E, p1 / E, p2 / E, p3 / E⟩ : ℍ[ℝ]) = 1
doc: q_D = (m + p)/E は単位四元数

name: qD_upper
stmt: theorem qD_upper (m E : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hE : 0 < E) : 0 < m / E
doc: m > 0、E > 0 なら q_D の実部は正(開いた上半球)

name: Qm_unit
doc: 速度表示 Q_m = √(1 − |β|²) + β も単位四元数

name: Qm_rest
doc: 静止極限(β = 0)は北極 1

name: radial_metric
stmt: theorem radial_metric (m p E : ℝ) (hE0 : E ≠ 0) (hE : E ^ 2 = m ^ 2 + p ^ 2) : (-(m * p) / E ^ 3) ^ 2 + (m ^ 2 / E ^ 3) ^ 2 = (m / E ^ 2) ^ 2
doc: 動径方向:d(m/E)/dp = −mp/E³、d(p/E)/dp = m²/E³ の二乗和は (m/E²)²

name: chi_deriv
stmt: theorem chi_deriv (m p : ℝ) (hm : m ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun p => arctan (p / m)) (m / (m ^ 2 + p ^ 2)) p
doc: χ(p) = arctan(p/m) の導関数は m/(m² + p²) = m/E²

name: hopf_norm
stmt: theorem hopf_norm (q x : ℍ[ℝ]) : normSq (q * x * star q) = normSq q ^ 2 * normSq x
doc: |q x q̄|² = |q|⁴ |x|²

name: hopf_re
stmt: theorem hopf_re (q x : ℍ[ℝ]) : (q * x * star q).re = normSq q * x.re
doc: Re(q x q̄) = |q|² Re x。とくに x が純虚なら q x q̄ も純虚(S² に値をとる)

name: bps_k
stmt: theorem bps_k (η : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun η => (cosh η)⁻¹) (-(sinh η / cosh η) * (cosh η)⁻¹) η
doc: k = sech η、f = tanh η は k′ = −f k を満たす

name: bps_f
stmt: theorem bps_f (η : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun η => sinh η / cosh η) (((cosh η)⁻¹) ^ 2) η
doc: f = tanh η = sinh/cosh は f′ = k² = sech² η を満たす

name: coeff_I
stmt: theorem coeff_I (G g Rm2 : ℝ) (hg : g ≠ 0) : 16 * π * G * (Rm2 / (8 * g ^ 2)) = (4 * π * G / g ^ 2) / 2 * Rm2
doc: Hamilton 拘束 R = 16πG ρ に ρ = |Rm|²/(8g²) を入れると R = (ℓ*²/2)|Rm|²、ℓ*² = 4πG/g²

name: rm2_3d
doc:
3 次元では Rm は断面曲率 K₁₂, K₁₃, K₂₃ で決まり、Ricci 固有値は
    λ₁ = K₁₂ + K₁₃ などになる。このとき |Rm|² = 4ΣK² = 4|Ric|² − R²

name: ric2_of_I
stmt: theorem ric2_of_I (R Ric2 l : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hI : R = l ^ 2 / 2 * (4 * Ric2 - R ^ 2)) : Ric2 = R / (2 * l ^ 2) + R ^ 2 / 4
doc: (I) を |Ric|² について解く:|Ric|² = R/(2ℓ²) + R²/4。R が一定なら |Ric|² も一定

name: trace_II
stmt: theorem trace_II (divRic dR : ℝ) (hBianchi : divRic = dR / 2) (hII : divRic - dR = 0) : dR = 0
doc:
(II) のトレース部分:縮約 Bianchi divRic = ½∇R のもとで
    g^{cd}(∇_c Ric_bd − ∇_b Ric_cd) = −½ ∇_b R。よって (II) ⇒ ∇R = 0

name: eq_of_sq_eq
stmt: private lemma eq_of_sq_eq {a l : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hl : 0 < l) (h : a ^ 2 = l ^ 2) : a = l

name: satI_flat
stmt: theorem satI_flat (l : ℝ) : SatI l .flat

name: satI_sphere
stmt: theorem satI_sphere (l a : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (ha : 0 < a) : SatI l (.sphere a) ↔ a = l

name: not_satI_hyp
stmt: theorem not_satI_hyp (l a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) : ¬ SatI l (.hyp a)

name: satI_sphProd
stmt: theorem satI_sphProd (l a : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (ha : 0 < a) : SatI l (.sphProd a) ↔ a = l

name: not_satI_hypProd
stmt: theorem not_satI_hypProd (l a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) : ¬ SatI l (.hypProd a)

name: three_phases
stmt: theorem three_phases (l : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (M : Model) (hpos : ∀ a, (M = .sphere a ∨ M = .hyp a ∨ M = .sphProd a ∨ M = .hypProd a) → 0 < a) (h : SatI l M) : M = .flat ∨ M = .sphere l ∨ M = .sphProd l
doc: α-II.2 のまとめ:CIS の候補のうち (I) を満たすのは平坦、S³(ℓ)、S²(ℓ)×ℝ だけ

name: kappa_sym
stmt: theorem kappa_sym (l1 l2 l3 : ℝ) : let s1
doc: κ = Σ_{i<j} (λᵢ + λⱼ − R/2)(λᵢ − λⱼ)² = σ₁³ − 4σ₁σ₂ + 9σ₃(R = σ₁)

name: kappa_closed
stmt: theorem kappa_closed (sR t l C c1 c2 c3 : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (he1 : c1 + c2 + c3 = 0) (he2 : c1 * c2 + c2 * c3 + c3 * c1 = -3 / 4) (he3 : c1 * c2 * c3 = C / 4) (ht : t ^ 2 = 12 - 2 * sR ^ 2 * l ^ 2) : let R
doc:
固有値の角度表示 λᵢ = R/3 + q cᵢ(Σcᵢ = 0、Σ_{i<j}cᵢcⱼ = −3/4、Πcᵢ = cos3θ/4)と
    (I) から決まる q = √R·√(12 − 2Rℓ²)/(6ℓ) のもとで
    κ = (6 − Rℓ²) R^{3/2}/(48ℓ³) · [2ℓ√R + √(12 − 2Rℓ²) cos3θ]

name: window
stmt: theorem window (x c : ℝ) (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx6 : x < 6) (hc : -1 ≤ c) (hneg : 2 * √x + √(12 - 2 * x) * c < 0) : x < 2
doc:
窓定理:0 < x = Rℓ² < 6、cos3θ ≥ −1、かつ κ の角括弧
    2√x + √(12 − 2x) cos3θ が負なら x < 2

name: window_cos
doc:
窓定理の後半:κ < 0 の条件 cos3θ < −√(2x/(6−x)) は、
    角括弧を負にする条件と同値(0 < x < 6)

name: br_lapse_d1
stmt: theorem br_lapse_d1 (l s : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun s => cosh (s / l)) (sinh (s / l) / l) s

name: br_lapse_d2
stmt: theorem br_lapse_d2 (l s : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun s => sinh (s / l) / l) (cosh (s / l) / l ^ 2) s
doc: N = cosh(s/ℓ) について N″ = N/ℓ²

name: israel_jump
doc:
キャップ(輻射 FRW)の ρ_c = 3/(8πGℓ²)、p_c = ρ_c/3、首の ρ_B = 2/(16πGℓ²) のとき
    [T_nn] = −ρ_B − p_c = −1/(4πGℓ²)

name: israel_impossible
stmt: theorem israel_impossible (G l : ℝ) (hG : 0 < G) (hl : l ≠ 0) : -(2 / (16 * π * G * l ^ 2)) - (3 / (8 * π * G * l ^ 2)) / 3 ≠ 0
doc: したがって [T_nn] ≠ 0 で、時間対称な Israel 接合(σ = 0 には [T_nn] = 0 が必要)は不可能

name: integrand_nonneg
stmt: theorem integrand_nonneg (ρ J rp rK : ℝ) (hJ : |J| ≤ ρ) (hu : |rK| ≤ rp) : 0 ≤ ρ * rp - J * rK
doc: 点ごとの評価:|J| ≤ ρ、|rK| ≤ r′ なら ρ r′ − J (r K) ≥ 0

name: penrose_spherical
stmt: theorem penrose_spherical (r rp KT ρ J M : ℝ → ℝ) (s0 s1 : ℝ) (hM : ∀ s, M s = r s * (1 - rp s ^ 2 + r s ^ 2 * KT s ^ 2)) (hD : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc s0 s1, HasDerivAt M (r s ^ 2 * (ρ s * rp s - J s * (r s * KT s))) s) (hunt : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc s0 s1, |r s * KT s| ≤ rp s) (hdec : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc s0 s1, |J s| ≤ ρ s) (hmarg : rp s0 ^ 2 = r s0 ^ 2 * KT s0 ^ 2) : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc s0 s1, r s0 ≤ M s
doc: 定理 Z0:境界球面から捕捉されない外側へ進むと M₂ ≥ r₀

name: no_flat_exterior
stmt: theorem no_flat_exterior (r rp KT ρ J M : ℝ → ℝ) (s0 s1 : ℝ) (hM : ∀ s, M s = r s * (1 - rp s ^ 2 + r s ^ 2 * KT s ^ 2)) (hD : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc s0 s1, HasDerivAt M (r s ^ 2 * (ρ s * rp s - J s * (r s * KT s))) s) (hunt : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc s0 s1, |r s * KT s| ≤ rp s) (hdec : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc s0 s1, |J s| ≤ ρ s) (hmarg : rp s0 ^ 2 = r s0 ^ 2 * KT s0 ^ 2) (hr0 : 0 < r s0) : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc s0 s1, M s ≠ 0
doc: 系:r₀ > 0 なら、その外側に M₂ = 0(平坦)の点はない

name: M2_cap
stmt: theorem M2_cap (a χ : ℝ) : a * sin χ * (1 - cos χ ^ 2 + (a * sin χ) ^ 2 * 0 ^ 2) = a * sin χ ^ 3
doc: Q のキャップ(半径 a、r = a sin χ、r′ = cos χ、K = 0):M₂ = a sin³χ

name: M2_equator
stmt: theorem M2_equator (a : ℝ) : a * sin (π / 2) ^ 3 = a
doc: 赤道 χ = π/2 では M₂ = a(しかも r′ = 0、K = 0 なので境界球面)

name: M2_neck
stmt: theorem M2_neck (l : ℝ) : l * (1 - 0 ^ 2 + l ^ 2 * 0 ^ 2) = l
doc: 首(r = ℓ、r′ = 0、K = 0):M₂ = ℓ で、すべての球面が境界球面

name: neck_marginal
stmt: theorem neck_marginal (l : ℝ) : (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 = l ^ 2 * 0 ^ 2

name: M2_flat
stmt: theorem M2_flat (s : ℝ) : s * (1 - 1 ^ 2 + s ^ 2 * 0 ^ 2) = 0

name: a_eq_l
stmt: theorem a_eq_l (a l : ℝ) (hcont : a * sin (π / 2) ^ 3 = l * (1 - 0 ^ 2 + l ^ 2 * 0 ^ 2)) : a = l
doc: 接合で M₂ が連続なら、キャップの半径は a = ℓ

name: schw_R
stmt: theorem schw_R (μ : ℝ) : (-2 * μ) + μ + μ = 0
doc:
空間的 Schwarzschild 断面:Ricci 固有値 (−2μ, μ, μ)。断面曲率は
    K₁₂ = K₁₃ = −μ、K₂₃ = 2μ で、R = 0、|Rm|² = 24μ²

name: schw_consistent
stmt: theorem schw_consistent (μ : ℝ) : (-μ) + (-μ) = -2 * μ ∧ (-μ) + 2 * μ = μ
doc: 断面曲率と Ricci 固有値の関係の確認:λ₁ = K₁₂ + K₁₃ = −2μ、λ₂ = K₁₂ + K₂₃ = μ

name: schw_not_I
doc: μ ≠ 0、ℓ ≠ 0 なら (I) R = (ℓ²/2)|Rm|² は成り立たない

name: cap_newton
stmt: theorem cap_newton (G a χ : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) (ha : a ≠ 0) : (4 * π / 3) * (3 / (8 * π * G * a ^ 2)) * (a * sin χ) ^ 3 = a * sin χ ^ 3 / (2 * G)
doc: R = 6/a² = 16πGρ から ρ = 3/(8πGa²)。このとき (4π/3)ρ(a sin χ)³ = a sin³χ/(2G) = M₂/(2G)

name: flat_mass_rate

name: eq_of_sq_eq

name: min_mass

name: codazzi_s

name: hamiltonian_K

name: glue_C1
stmt: theorem glue_C1 (a l sj : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hl : 0 < l) (hr1 : cos (sj / a) = 0) (hr : a * sin (sj / a) = l) : a = l

name: glue_EYM

name: no_flat_from_constraints
stmt: theorem no_flat_from_constraints (r rp rpp a KT KTp ρ J M : ℝ → ℝ) (s0 s1 : ℝ) (hM : ∀ s, M s = r s * (1 - rp s ^ 2 + r s ^ 2 * KT s ^ 2)) (hr0 : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, r s ≠ 0) (d1 : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, HasDerivAt r (rp s) s) (d2 : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, HasDerivAt rp (rpp s) s) (d3 : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, HasDerivAt KT (KTp s) s) (hH : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, 2 * (1 - rp s ^ 2 - 2 * r s * rpp s) / r s ^ 2 + 4 * a s * KT s + 2 * KT s ^ 2 = 2 * ρ s) (hMom : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, 2 * (rp s / r s) * (a s - KT s) - 2 * KTp s = J s) (hunt : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, |r s * KT s| ≤ rp s) (hdec : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, |J s| ≤ ρ s) (hmarg : rp s0 ^ 2 = r s0 ^ 2 * KT s0 ^ 2) (hpos : 0 < r s0) : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, M s ≠ 0
doc: 首は平坦へ開けない(拘束方程式から)

name: junction_marginal

name: trh_self

name: trh_linear

name: israel_trace
stmt: theorem israel_trace (G : ℝ) (h J : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hd : IsUnit h.det) : trh h (surfS G h J) = (n - 1) * trh h J / (8 * Real.pi * G)

name: israel_inverse
stmt: theorem israel_inverse (G : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) (h J : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hd : IsUnit h.det) (hn : (n : ℝ) ≠ 1) : J = (-(8 * Real.pi * G)) • (surfS G h J - (trh h (surfS G h J) / (n - 1)) • h)
doc: 逆向き:[K_ab] = −8πG(S_ab − h_ab·tr(h⁻¹S)/(n − 1))

name: israel_no_shell
stmt: theorem israel_no_shell (G : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) (h J : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hd : IsUnit h.det) (hn : (n : ℝ) ≠ 1) : surfS G h J = 0 ↔ J = 0
doc: 殻がない ⇔ 外曲率が連続

name: israel_inverse_three
stmt: theorem israel_inverse_three (G : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) (h J : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hd : IsUnit h.det) : J = (-(8 * Real.pi * G)) • (surfS G h J - ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * trh h (surfS G h J)) • h)
doc: n = 3(4 次元時空の中の超曲面)では [K_ab] = −8πG(S_ab − ½ h_ab S)

name: sphere_consistency
stmt: theorem sphere_consistency (G r₀ jump : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) (hr : r₀ ≠ 0) : -(2 * jump / r₀) / (8 * Real.pi * G) = -jump / (4 * Real.pi * G * r₀)
doc:
空間的な切り口の中の球面 r = r₀(外曲率 K = (r′/r)h、平均曲率 H = 2r′/r)では
  表面密度 σ = −[H]/(8πG) が AlphaIII_Junction の σ = −[r′]/(4πG r₀) と一致

name: classify_null
stmt: theorem classify_null : classify 0 = Kind.null

name: weak_second_derivative
stmt: theorem weak_second_derivative {a s₀ b : ℝ} (has : a ≤ s₀) (hsb : s₀ ≤ b) {pm pp rm rp φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ} (hpm : ∀ x ∈ Icc a s₀, HasDerivWithinAt pm (rm x) (Icc a s₀) x) (hpp : ∀ x ∈ Icc s₀ b, HasDerivWithinAt pp (rp x) (Icc s₀ b) x) (hφm : ∀ x ∈ Icc a s₀, HasDerivWithinAt φ (φ' x) (Icc a s₀) x) (hφp : ∀ x ∈ Icc s₀ b, HasDerivWithinAt φ (φ' x) (Icc s₀ b) x) (hrm : IntervalIntegrable rm MeasureTheory.volume a s₀) (hrp : IntervalIntegrable rp MeasureTheory.volume s₀ b) (hφ'm : IntervalIntegrable φ' MeasureTheory.volume a s₀) (hφ'p : IntervalIntegrable φ' MeasureTheory.volume s₀ b) (ha : φ a = 0) (hb : φ b = 0) : -((∫ x in a..s₀, pm x * φ' x) + ∫ x in s₀..b, pp x * φ' x) = (∫ x in a..s₀, rm x * φ x) + (∫ x in s₀..b, rp x * φ x) + (pp s₀ - pm s₀) * φ s₀
doc: r″ の弱い形:両側で部分積分すると −∫ r′φ′ = ∫ r″_正則 φ + [r′] φ(s₀)

name: shell_density
stmt: theorem shell_density (G r₀ jump σ : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) (hr : r₀ ≠ 0) (h : 2 * (-(2 * r₀ * jump)) / r₀ ^ 2 = 16 * π * G * σ) : σ = -jump / (4 * π * G * r₀)
doc: 拘束 ³R = 16πG(ρ_正則 + σ δ) の δ の係数:−4[r′]/r₀ = 16πG σ ⇒ σ = −[r′]/(4πG r₀)

name: no_shell_iff
stmt: theorem no_shell_iff (G r₀ jump : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) (hr : r₀ ≠ 0) : -jump / (4 * π * G * r₀) = 0 ↔ jump = 0
doc: 殻がない ⇔ [r′] = 0

name: constraint_form
stmt: theorem constraint_form (r rp rpp : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) : scalR r rp rpp / 2 = (1 - rp ^ 2 - 2 * r * rpp) / r ^ 2
doc: 時間対称な切り口の拘束は ρ = ³R/(16πG) で、Z5 のハミルトン拘束(ham)と同じ形

name: tent_deriv
stmt: theorem tent_deriv (a b u : ℝ) (s : Set ℝ) : HasDerivWithinAt (fun u => (u - a) * (b - u)) ((b - u) - (u - a)) s u
doc: 試験関数 φ = (u − a)(b − u) の微分

name: null_shell_from_weak
stmt: theorem null_shell_from_weak {a u₀ b G r₀ μ : ℝ} (hau : a < u₀) (hub : u₀ < b) (hG : G ≠ 0) (hr : r₀ ≠ 0) {pm pp qm qp Sm Sp : ℝ → ℝ} (hpm : ∀ x ∈ Icc a u₀, HasDerivWithinAt pm (qm x) (Icc a u₀) x) (hpp : ∀ x ∈ Icc u₀ b, HasDerivWithinAt pp (qp x) (Icc u₀ b) x) (hqm : IntervalIntegrable qm MeasureTheory.volume a u₀) (hqp : IntervalIntegrable qp MeasureTheory.volume u₀ b) -- 各側の uu 方程式(r_uu = 2σ_u r_u − 4πG r T_正則 =: S) (sideM : ∀ x ∈ Icc a u₀, qm x = Sm x) (sideP : ∀ x ∈ Icc u₀ b, qp x = Sp x) -- 分布としての方程式(すべての試験関数で) (weak : ∀ φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x ∈ Icc a u₀, HasDerivWithinAt φ (φ' x) (Icc a u₀) x) → (∀ x ∈ Icc u₀ b, HasDerivWithinAt φ (φ' x) (Icc u₀ b) x) → Continuous φ' → φ a = 0 → φ b = 0 → -((∫ x in a..u₀, pm x * φ' x) + ∫ x in u₀..b, pp x * φ' x) = (∫ x in a..u₀, Sm x * φ x) + (∫ x in u₀..b, Sp x * φ x) - 4 * π * G * r₀ * μ * φ u₀) : μ = -(pp u₀ - pm u₀) / (4 * π * G * r₀)
doc: 分布としての uu 方程式から、ヌルな殻の面密度 μ = −[r_u]/(4πG r₀)

name: null_no_shell_iff
stmt: theorem null_no_shell_iff (G r₀ jump : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) (hr : r₀ ≠ 0) : -jump / (4 * π * G * r₀) = 0 ↔ jump = 0
doc: 殻なし ⇔ [r_u] = 0

name: null_ruu_jump
stmt: theorem null_ruu_jump (G r₀ su ru Tp Tm ruup ruum : ℝ) (hp : ruup = 2 * su * ru - 4 * π * G * r₀ * Tp) (hm : ruum = 2 * su * ru - 4 * π * G * r₀ * Tm) : ruup - ruum = -(4 * π * G * r₀) * (Tp - Tm)
doc: 殻なし(r_u 連続)なら、各側の uu 方程式から [r_uu] = −4πG r₀ [T_uu]

name: null_ruu_jump_ym
stmt: theorem null_ruu_jump_ym (r₀ su ru Wup Wum ruup ruum : ℝ) (hr : r₀ ≠ 0) (hp : ruup = 2 * su * ru - r₀ * (2 * Wup ^ 2 / r₀ ^ 2)) (hm : ruum = 2 * su * ru - r₀ * (2 * Wum ^ 2 / r₀ ^ 2)) : ruup - ruum = -(2 / r₀) * (Wup ^ 2 - Wum ^ 2)
doc: YM の 4πG T_uu = 2W_u²/r²(AlphaIV の単位)で [r_uu] = −(2/r₀)[W_u²]

name: null_front

name: cap_slope
stmt: theorem cap_slope (l s : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun t => l * sin (t / l)) (cos (s / l)) s

name: cap_slope_ends
stmt: theorem cap_slope_ends (l : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : cos (0 / l) = 1 ∧ cos ((π * l / 2) / l) = 0

name: band_cap
stmt: theorem band_cap (l s1 s2 : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : ∫ s in s1..s2, 2 * π * (l * sin (s / l)) = 2 * π * l ^ 2 * (cos (s1 / l) - cos (s2 / l))

name: band_neck
stmt: theorem band_neck (l s1 s2 : ℝ) : ∫ _s in s1..s2, 2 * π * l = 2 * π * l * (s2 - s1)

name: cap_volume
stmt: theorem cap_volume (l : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) : ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(π * l / 2), 4 * π * (l * sin (s / l)) ^ 2 = π ^ 2 * l ^ 3

name: gauss_bonnet_dumbbell
stmt: theorem gauss_bonnet_dumbbell (l : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) : 2 * (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(π * l / 2), (1 / l ^ 2) * (2 * π * (l * sin (s / l)))) + 0 = 4 * π ∧ cos ((π * l / 2) / l) / sin ((π * l / 2) / l) = 0

name: junction_mots
stmt: theorem junction_mots (r : ℝ) : (2 / r) * (0 + r * 0) = 0 ∧ (2 / r) * (-0 + r * 0) = 0

name: junction_schwarzschild

name: junction_entropy
stmt: theorem junction_entropy (G l : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) : 4 * π * l ^ 2 / (4 * G) = π * l ^ 2 / G

name: normal_stress
doc: 動径の応力:帽子 +ρ_cap/3、首 −ρ_neck、跳び −1/(4πGℓ²)

name: ms_from_constraints
stmt: theorem ms_from_constraints (r rp rpp a b bp ρ J : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hH : 2 * (1 - rp ^ 2 - 2 * r * rpp) / r ^ 2 + 4 * a * b + 2 * b ^ 2 = 2 * ρ) (hM : 2 * (rp / r) * (a - b) - 2 * bp = J) : rp * (1 - rp ^ 2 + r ^ 2 * b ^ 2) + r * (-(2 * rp * rpp) + (2 * r * rp * b ^ 2 + r ^ 2 * (2 * b * bp))) = r ^ 2 * (ρ * rp - J * (r * b))
doc: 一点での代数:拘束のもとで M′ = r²(ρ r′ − J r b)

name: penrose_from_constraints
stmt: theorem penrose_from_constraints (r rp rpp a KT KTp ρ J M : ℝ → ℝ) (s0 s1 : ℝ) (hM : ∀ s, M s = r s * (1 - rp s ^ 2 + r s ^ 2 * KT s ^ 2)) (hr0 : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, r s ≠ 0) (d1 : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, HasDerivAt r (rp s) s) (d2 : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, HasDerivAt rp (rpp s) s) (d3 : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, HasDerivAt KT (KTp s) s) (hH : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, 2 * (1 - rp s ^ 2 - 2 * r s * rpp s) / r s ^ 2 + 4 * a s * KT s + 2 * KT s ^ 2 = 2 * ρ s) (hMom : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, 2 * (rp s / r s) * (a s - KT s) - 2 * KTp s = J s) (hunt : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, |r s * KT s| ≤ rp s) (hdec : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, |J s| ≤ ρ s) (hmarg : rp s0 ^ 2 = r s0 ^ 2 * KT s0 ^ 2) : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, r s0 ≤ M s

name: spin_torsion_free

name: spin_antisymmetric

name: s3_spin_connection
stmt: theorem s3_spin_connection : (∀ a i j, -2 * eps a i j + (-eps a j i) - (-eps a i j) = 0) ∧ (∀ a b c, -eps a b c = -(-eps b a c))
doc:
左不変な枠で de^a = −ε_abc e^b∧e^c、成分 (de^a)_{bc} = −2ε_abc;ω^a_{b,c} = −ε_abc。
    捩れ (de^a)_{ij} + ω^a_{b,i}δ^b_j − ω^a_{b,j}δ^b_i = 0

name: lambda_zero
stmt: theorem lambda_zero (l k Λ : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hcap : 6 / l ^ 2 = 3 * k / l ^ 4 + 2 * Λ) (hneck : 2 / l ^ 2 = k / l ^ 4 + 2 * Λ) : Λ = 0 ∧ k = 2 * l ^ 2

name: junction_ghy
stmt: theorem junction_ghy (l θ : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : -- 帽子側(N = 1、N′ = 0、r = ℓ sin(π/2)、r′ = cos(π/2)) (-(1 : ℝ) * 0 = 0 ∧ l * Real.sin (Real.pi / 2) * Real.cos (Real.pi / 2) = 0 ∧ 0 / 1 + 2 * Real.cos (Real.pi / 2) / (l * Real.sin (Real.pi / 2)) = 0) ∧ -- 首側(N = cosh 0、N′ = sinh 0 / ℓ、r = ℓ、r′ = 0) (-(Real.cosh 0) * (Real.sinh 0 / l) = 0 ∧ l * 0 * Real.sin θ ^ 2 = 0 ∧ (Real.sinh 0 / l) / Real.cosh 0 + 2 * 0 / l = 0) ∧ -- lapse の C¹ 接続 (Real.cosh 0 = 1 ∧ Real.sinh 0 / l = 0)
doc:
計量 −N²dt² + ds² + r²dΩ² の面 s = 一定(法線 ∂_s)の外曲率は K_tt = −NN′、K_θθ = rr′、K_φφ = rr′sin²θ、
    跡 K = N′/N + 2r′/r。接合 s = πℓ/2(首側は s′ = 0):帽子は測地的な時間 N = 1、首は N = cosh(s′/ℓ)。
    両側で N = 1、N′ = 0、r′ = 0 なので K_ab = 0 と K = 0:GHY 項の寄与は 0、
    二つの側の GHY 項から出る Israel 条件は [K_ab] = 0(殻なし)。lapse も C¹ でつながる

name: coupling_size
stmt: theorem coupling_size (G g l lP α : ℝ) (hg : g ≠ 0) (hl : l ^ 2 = 4 * Real.pi * G / g ^ 2) (hP : lP ^ 2 = G) (hα : α = g ^ 2 / (4 * Real.pi)) : α * l ^ 2 = lP ^ 2
doc: ℓ² = 4πG/g²、ℓ_P² = G(ħ = c = 1)、α = g²/(4π) なら α·ℓ² = ℓ_P²:結合定数 = (ℓ_P/ℓ)²

name: strong_or_classical
stmt: theorem strong_or_classical (α l lP α0 L : ℝ) (h : α * l ^ 2 = lP ^ 2) (hα0 : 0 < α0) (hL : 0 < L) : (α0 ≤ α → l ^ 2 ≤ lP ^ 2 / α0) ∧ (L ^ 2 ≤ l ^ 2 → 0 ≤ α → α ≤ lP ^ 2 / L ^ 2)
doc:
強い結合(α ≥ α₀ > 0)なら ℓ² ≤ ℓ_P²/α₀(Planck 長さ程度)、
    古典的に大きい(ℓ² ≥ L² > 0)なら α ≤ ℓ_P²/L²(弱い結合):二つは同時に成り立たない

name: deriv_zero_of_const

name: flow_e2

name: ym_stress
stmt: theorem ym_stress (g W W1 r : ℝ) (hg : g ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0) : rho g W W1 r = (W1 ^ 2 / r ^ 2 + (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 / (2 * r ^ 4)) / g ^ 2 ∧ pr g W W1 r = (W1 ^ 2 / r ^ 2 - (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 / (2 * r ^ 4)) / g ^ 2 ∧ pT g W W1 r = (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 / (2 * r ^ 4) / g ^ 2 ∧ -rho g W W1 r + pr g W W1 r + 2 * pT g W W1 r = 0

name: cap_stress

name: neck_stress

name: riem_identity

name: geometric_constraint

name: Rtt_deriv
stmt: theorem Rtt_deriv (K : ℝ) (r r1 r2 n n1 : ℝ → ℝ) (r3 n2 : ℝ → ℝ) (s : ℝ) (hr : r s ≠ 0) (d0 : HasDerivAt r (r1 s) s) (d1 : HasDerivAt r1 (r2 s) s) (d2 : HasDerivAt r2 (r3 s) s) (e0 : HasDerivAt n (n1 s) s) (e1 : HasDerivAt n1 (n2 s) s) : HasDerivAt (fun t => Rtt K (r t) (r1 t) (r2 t) (n t) (n1 t)) ((K * (n s) ^ 2 * (r1 s) * (-(r1 s) ^ 4 + 2 * (r1 s) ^ 2 - 1) + K * (n s) * (r s) * (2 * (n s) * (r1 s) ^ 3 * (r2 s) - 2 * (n s) * (r1 s) * (r2 s) + (n1 s) * (r1 s) ^ 4 - 2 * (n1 s) * (r1 s) ^ 2 + (n1 s)) + (n s) ^ 2 * (r s) ^ 2 * (r1 s) * (-K * (r2 s) ^ 2 - (r1 s) ^ 2 + 1) + 2 * (n s) * (n1 s) * (r s) ^ 3 * ((r1 s) ^ 2 - 1) + (r s) ^ 4 * ((n s) ^ 2 * (r3 s) + 3 * (n s) * (n1 s) * (r2 s) + (n1 s) ^ 2 * (r1 s))) / (r s) ^ 4 + (r1 s) * Att K (r s) (r1 s) (r2 s) (n s) (n2 s)) s

name: neck_any_lapse

name: frw_exact
stmt: theorem frw_exact (a χ : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hs : sin χ ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun x => a * (-(sin x)) / a) (a * (-(cos χ)) / a) χ ∧ a * (-(cos χ)) / a + a * a * cos χ * (1 - cos χ ^ 2) / (a * sin χ) ^ 2 = 0 ∧ a * cos χ / a = cos χ
doc:
帽子の FRW:共形時間で N = A = a、R = a sin χ、W = cos χ は YM 方程式
    ∂_χ(N W_χ/A) + NA W(1 − W²)/R² = 0 を任意の a で満たし、r′ = ∂_χ(a sin χ)/a = cos χ

name: static_W_trichotomy
stmt: theorem static_W_trichotomy (p q : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hr0 : ∀ s ∈ Ioo p q, r s ≠ 0) (hN0 : ∀ s ∈ Ioo p q, N s ≠ 0) (hr : ∀ s ∈ Ioo p q, HasDerivAt r (W s) s) (hW : ∀ s ∈ Ioo p q, HasDerivAt W (V s) s) (hN : ∀ s ∈ Ioo p q, HasDerivAt N (Np s) s) (ha : ∀ s ∈ Ioo p q, ham l (r s) (W s) (V s) = 0) (hb : ∀ s ∈ Ioo p q, 2 * W s * (Np s / N s) / r s + (W s^2 - 1) / r s^2 = prf l (r s) (W s) (V s)) (hd : ∀ s ∈ Ioo p q, HasDerivAt (fun s => N s * V s) (N s * W s * (W s^2 - 1) / r s^2) s) : ∀ s ∈ Ioo p q, W s = 0 ∨ W s^2 = 1

name: static_classification
stmt: theorem static_classification (p q : ℝ) (hpq : p < q) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hr0 : ∀ s ∈ Ioo p q, r s ≠ 0) (hN0 : ∀ s ∈ Ioo p q, N s ≠ 0) (hr : ∀ s ∈ Ioo p q, HasDerivAt r (W s) s) (hW : ∀ s ∈ Ioo p q, HasDerivAt W (V s) s) (hN : ∀ s ∈ Ioo p q, HasDerivAt N (Np s) s) (ha : ∀ s ∈ Ioo p q, ham l (r s) (W s) (V s) = 0) (hb : ∀ s ∈ Ioo p q, 2 * W s * (Np s / N s) / r s + (W s^2 - 1) / r s^2 = prf l (r s) (W s) (V s)) (hd : ∀ s ∈ Ioo p q, HasDerivAt (fun s => N s * V s) (N s * W s * (W s^2 - 1) / r s^2) s) : (∀ s ∈ Ioo p q, W s = 0 ∧ V s = 0 ∧ r s ^ 2 = l ^ 2) ∨ (∀ s ∈ Ioo p q, W s ^ 2 = 1 ∧ V s = 0 ∧ rho l (r s) (W s) (V s) = 0)

name: jump_const
stmt: theorem jump_const (Wp Wm r σ W : ℝ → ℝ) (hp : ∀ v, HasDerivAt Wp (FW (r v) (σ v) (W v)) v) (hm : ∀ v, HasDerivAt Wm (FW (r v) (σ v) (W v)) v) : ∀ v w, Wp v - Wm v = Wp w - Wm w

doc:

name: density_aux
stmt: theorem density_aux (N a b s l Nd ad bd add bdd iN ia ib : S) (hiN : N * iN = 1) (hia : a * ia = 1) (hib : b * ib = 1) : N * a * b ^ 8 * s * iN ^ 2 * ib ^ 7 * bdd * 4 - N ^ 3 * a * b ^ 5 * s * iN ^ 2 * ib ^ 7 * l ^ 2 * 2 + (N ^ 3 * a * b ^ 7 * s * iN ^ 2 * ib ^ 7 * 2 - N ^ 7 * a ^ 2 * b ^ 11 * s * Nd * bd * iN ^ 9 * ia * ib ^ 10 * 4) + N ^ 8 * a * b ^ 12 * s * iN ^ 9 * ia * ib ^ 10 * add * 2 + (N ^ 8 * a ^ 2 * b ^ 10 * s * bd ^ 2 * iN ^ 9 * ia * ib ^ 10 * 2 - N ^ 12 * a ^ 3 * b ^ 13 * s * ad * Nd * iN ^ 14 * ia ^ 3 * ib ^ 11 * 2) + N ^ 13 * a ^ 3 * b ^ 12 * s * ad * bd * iN ^ 14 * ia ^ 3 * ib ^ 11 * 4 = -(N ^ 5 * a * b ^ 3 * s * Nd * bd * iN ^ 7 * ib ^ 2 * 4) - N ^ 5 * b ^ 4 * s * ad * Nd * iN ^ 7 * ib ^ 2 * 2 + N ^ 6 * a * b ^ 2 * s * bd ^ 2 * iN ^ 7 * ib ^ 2 * 2 + N ^ 6 * a * b ^ 3 * s * iN ^ 7 * ib ^ 2 * bdd * 4 + N ^ 6 * b ^ 3 * s * ad * bd * iN ^ 7 * ib ^ 2 * 4 + N ^ 6 * b ^ 4 * s * iN ^ 7 * ib ^ 2 * add * 2 + (N ^ 8 * a * b ^ 2 * s * iN ^ 7 * ib ^ 2 * 2 - N ^ 8 * a * s * iN ^ 7 * ib ^ 2 * l ^ 2 * 2)
