doc: 【α-IV.12】Legendre 変換:H = p_a ȧ + p_b ḃ − L = N · Hfun(a, b, p_a, p_b)

name: L_N
stmt: theorem L_N (a b ad bd N c l : ℝ) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun n => Lfun a b ad bd n c l) (-Hfun a b (-2 * c * b * bd / N) (-2 * c * (a * bd + b * ad) / N) c l) N
doc: 【α-IV.12】∂L/∂N = −Hfun:N の運動方程式が Hamiltonian 拘束 Hfun = 0

name: deriv_inv
stmt: theorem deriv_inv (d : Derivation ℤ S S) (a : S) (ha : a ≠ 0) : d a⁻¹ = -(a⁻¹ ^ 2 * d a)
doc: 導分の逆元の公式

name: deriv_ofNat
stmt: theorem deriv_ofNat (d : Derivation ℤ S S) (n : ℕ) [n.AtLeastTwo] : d (OfNat.ofNat n : S) = 0

name: hamiltonian_propagation
stmt: theorem hamiltonian_propagation : dt (Hc dx A R Kx KT W P k) = 2 * (Kx + 2 * KT) * Hc dx A R Kx KT W P k - 4 * (Dx dx A R * R⁻¹) * Mc dx A R Kx KT W P k - 2 * Dx dx A (Mc dx A R Kx KT W P k)

name: momentum_propagation
stmt: theorem momentum_propagation : dt (Mc dx A R Kx KT W P k) = 2 * (Kx + KT) * Mc dx A R Kx KT W P k - 2⁻¹ * Dx dx A (Hc dx A R Kx KT W P k)

name: kext_divergence
stmt: theorem kext_divergence (N a b s : S) (hN : N ≠ 0) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hs : s ≠ 0) (hs0 : d 0 s = 0) : (N * a * b ^ 2 * s)⁻¹ * d 0 (N * a * b ^ 2 * s * N⁻¹) = Kext d N a b
doc: K は発散の公式 ∇_μ n^μ = (1/√−g) ∂_t(√−g n^t) と一致(√−g = N a b² s、n^t = 1/N、∂_t s = 0)

name: ghy_boundary
stmt: theorem ghy_boundary (N a b s : S) (hN : N ≠ 0) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hs0 : d 0 s = 0) : s * (2 * d 0 (d 0 a * b ^ 2 * N⁻¹) + 4 * d 0 (a * b * d 0 b * N⁻¹)) = 2 * d 0 (a * b ^ 2 * s * Kext d N a b)
doc: 境界項:密度の全微分の部分 = ∂_t(2 √h K)/1(√h = a b² s)

name: action_with_ghy
stmt: theorem action_with_ghy (N a b s c l : S) (H : SphD d N a b s c) (hN1 : d 1 N = 0) (ha1 : d 1 a = 0) (hb1 : d 1 b = 0) : N * a * b ^ 2 * s * (Rsc d (giD N a b s) (GD d N a b s c) - l ^ 2 * Fsq (giD N a b s) (FT d 0 s)) - 2 * d 0 (a * b ^ 2 * s * Kext d N a b) = s * (2 * (-(a * d 0 b ^ 2 + 2 * b * d 0 a * d 0 b) * N⁻¹ + N * a * (1 - l ^ 2 * b⁻¹ ^ 2)))
doc: 【α-IV.12】GHY の境界項を加えた作用の密度は 2 s L₀ に等しい(全微分は境界項で厳密に消える)

name: angular_integral
stmt: theorem angular_integral : ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..π, Real.sin θ = 2
doc: ∫₀^π sin θ dθ = 2

name: reduced_coefficient
stmt: theorem reduced_coefficient (G Lx : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) : 1 / (16 * π * G) * (Lx * (2 * π * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..π, 2 * Real.sin θ)) = Lx / (2 * G)
doc: 【α-IV.12】規格化:(1/16πG) · L_x · 2π · ∫₀^π 2 sin θ dθ = L_x/(2G)。縮約 Lagrangian の係数は c = L_x/(2G)

name: legendre_hessian
stmt: theorem legendre_hessian (a b N c : ℝ) : Matrix.det !![(0 : ℝ), -2 * c * b / N; -2 * c * b / N, -2 * c * a / N] = -(4 * c ^ 2 * b ^ 2 / N ^ 2)
doc: 速度 (ȧ, ḃ) から運動量 (p_a, p_b) への写像の行列(速度の Hessian ∂²L/∂q̇∂q̇)の行列式

name: legendre_hessian_ne
stmt: theorem legendre_hessian_ne (a b N c : ℝ) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) : Matrix.det !![(0 : ℝ), -2 * c * b / N; -2 * c * b / N, -2 * c * a / N] ≠ 0
doc: 【α-IV.12】N b c ≠ 0 なら Hessian は正則(Legendre 変換は可逆)

name: legendre_inverse
stmt: theorem legendre_inverse (a b N c ad bd : ℝ) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) : bd = -(N * (-2 * c * b * bd / N)) / (2 * c * b) ∧ ad = N / (2 * c) * (a * (-2 * c * b * bd / N) / b ^ 2 - (-2 * c * (a * bd + b * ad) / N) / b)
doc: 逆写像(左逆):運動量 p_a = −2cbḃ/N、p_b = −2c(aḃ + bȧ)/N から速度が戻る

name: legendre_onto
stmt: theorem legendre_onto (a b N c pa pb : ℝ) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) : -2 * c * b * (-(N * pa) / (2 * c * b)) / N = pa ∧ -2 * c * (a * (-(N * pa) / (2 * c * b)) + b * (N / (2 * c) * (a * pa / b ^ 2 - pb / b))) / N = pb
doc: 逆写像(右逆):任意の (p_a, p_b) はある速度の像(Legendre 写像は全単射)

name: supermetric_kinetic
stmt: theorem supermetric_kinetic (a b c ad bd N : ℝ) (hN : N ≠ 0) : -c * (a * bd ^ 2 + 2 * b * ad * bd) / N = 1 / (2 * N) * (2 * (-2 * c * b) * ad * bd + (-2 * c * a) * bd ^ 2)
doc: 超計量:L の運動項 −c(aḃ² + 2bȧḃ)/N = (1/2N) G_AB q̇^A q̇^B、G = [[0, −2cb], [−2cb, −2ca]]

name: supermetric_inverse
stmt: theorem supermetric_inverse (a b c : ℝ) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) : !![(0 : ℝ), -2 * c * b; -2 * c * b, -2 * c * a] * !![a / (2 * c * b ^ 2), -1 / (2 * c * b); -1 / (2 * c * b), 0] = 1
doc: 逆超計量 G^{AB}

name: hamiltonian_supermetric
stmt: theorem hamiltonian_supermetric (a b c pa pb : ℝ) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) : 1 / 2 * (a / (2 * c * b ^ 2) * pa ^ 2 + 2 * (-1 / (2 * c * b)) * pa * pb) = (a * pa ^ 2 - 2 * b * pa * pb) / (4 * c * b ^ 2)
doc: Hfun の運動量の項 (a p_a² − 2b p_a p_b)/(4cb²) = ½ G^{AB} p_A p_B

name: lb_coeff_a
stmt: theorem lb_coeff_a (a b c : ℝ) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun x => 2 * c * b * (x / (2 * c * b ^ 2))) (1 / b) a
doc:
Laplace–Beltrami の 1 階の係数(a 成分):∂_a(√G G^{aa}) = ∂_a(2cb · a/(2cb²)) = 1/b、
したがって v^a = (1/b)/(2cb) = 1/(2cb²)(∂_b(√G G^{ba}) = 0 は `lb_coeff_b`)

name: lb_coeff_b
stmt: theorem lb_coeff_b (b c : ℝ) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun y => 2 * c * y * (-1 / (2 * c * y))) 0 b
doc:
√G G^{ab} = 2cb · (−1/(2cb)) = −1 は b について一定:∂_b(√G G^{ab}) = 0、また G^{bb} = 0。
したがって v^b = 0

name: lb_operator
stmt: theorem lb_operator (hb a b c : ℂ) (Ψa Ψaa Ψab Ψbb Ψb : ℂ) (hb0 : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) : b ^ 2 * (-(hb ^ 2) / 2) * (a / (2 * c * b ^ 2) * Ψaa + 2 * (-1 / (2 * c * b)) * Ψab + 0 * Ψbb + 1 / (2 * c * b ^ 2) * Ψa + 0 * Ψb) = (1 / (4 * c)) * (-hb ^ 2 * a * Ψaa + 2 * hb ^ 2 * b * Ψab) - (1 / (4 * c)) * hb ^ 2 * Ψa
doc:
【α-VI.4 の順序】b² · (−ħ²/2) Δ_G Ψ を展開すると、運動項は (1/4c)(−ħ²(a Ψ_aa + Ψ_a) + 2ħ² b Ψ_ab)
(Δ_G = G^{aa}∂_a² + 2G^{ab}∂_a∂_b + G^{bb}∂_b² + v^a ∂_a + v^b ∂_b、G^{bb} = v^b = 0)

name: hasDerivAt_Psi_a
stmt: theorem hasDerivAt_Psi_a (a b : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun x => Psi κ A σ x b) (Psia κ A σ a b) a
doc: a についての微分

name: hasDerivAt_Psia_a
stmt: theorem hasDerivAt_Psia_a (a b : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun x => Psia κ A σ x b) (I * (σ b : ℂ) * (κ : ℂ) * (I * (σ b : ℂ) * (κ : ℂ) * Psi κ A σ a b)) a
doc: ∂_a²Ψ = (iσκ)² Ψ

name: hasDerivAt_Psi_b
stmt: theorem hasDerivAt_Psi_b (a b A' σ' : ℝ) (hA : HasDerivAt A A' b) (hσ : HasDerivAt σ σ' b) : HasDerivAt (fun y => Psi κ A σ a y) ((A' : ℂ) * exp (I * (a : ℂ) * (σ b : ℂ) * (κ : ℂ)) + (A b : ℂ) * (exp (I * (a : ℂ) * (σ b : ℂ) * (κ : ℂ)) * (I * (a : ℂ) * (σ' : ℂ) * (κ : ℂ)))) b
doc: b についての微分:∂_bΨ = A′ E + A E (i a σ′ κ)

name: hasDerivAt_Psia_b
stmt: theorem hasDerivAt_Psia_b (a b A' σ' : ℝ) (hA : HasDerivAt A A' b) (hσ : HasDerivAt σ σ' b) : HasDerivAt (fun y => Psia κ A σ a y) (I * (σ' : ℂ) * (κ : ℂ) * Psi κ A σ a b + I * (σ b : ℂ) * (κ : ℂ) * ((A' : ℂ) * exp (I * (a : ℂ) * (σ b : ℂ) * (κ : ℂ)) + (A b : ℂ) * (exp (I * (a : ℂ) * (σ b : ℂ) * (κ : ℂ)) * (I * (a : ℂ) * (σ' : ℂ) * (κ : ℂ))))) b
doc: 混合微分:∂_b(∂_aΨ) = iσ′κ Ψ + iσκ ∂_bΨ

name: wkb_identity
stmt: theorem wkb_identity (hb : ℝ) (hhb : hb * κ = 1) (a b A' σ' : ℝ) (hA : HasDerivAt A A' b) (hσ : HasDerivAt σ σ' b) (Daa Dab : ℂ) (hDaa : HasDerivAt (fun x => Psia κ A σ x b) Daa a) (hDab : HasDerivAt (fun y => Psia κ A σ a y) Dab b) : wdwOp c l hb a b (Psi κ A σ a b) Daa Dab = exp (I * (a : ℂ) * (σ b : ℂ) * (κ : ℂ)) * ((A b : ℂ) * ((1 / (4 * (c : ℂ))) * ((a : ℂ) * (σ b : ℂ) ^ 2 - 2 * (a : ℂ) * (b : ℂ) * (σ b : ℂ) * (σ' : ℂ)) - (c : ℂ) * (a : ℂ) * ((b : ℂ) ^ 2 - (l : ℂ) ^ 2)) + 2 * (1 / (4 * (c : ℂ))) * I * (hb : ℂ) * (b : ℂ) * ((σ b : ℂ) * (A' : ℂ) + (σ' : ℂ) * (A b : ℂ)))
doc:
【α-IV.12】WKB の展開は 1 次で終わる:Ĥ(A e^{iaσ/ħ}) = e^{iaσ/ħ}(A·HJ + (iħb/2c)(σA′ + σ′A))。
Ψ_aa、Ψ_ab は実際の偏微分(微分は一意なので、どの値をとっても同じ)。

name: hasDerivAt_Q
stmt: theorem hasDerivAt_Q (C b : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (Q c l C) (C - 8 * c ^ 2 * b) b

name: wdw_exact_sqrt
stmt: theorem wdw_exact_sqrt (hb : ℝ) (hhb : hb * κ = 1) (hc : c ≠ 0) (C a b : ℝ) (hQ : 0 < Q c l C b) (Daa Dab : ℂ) (hDaa : HasDerivAt (fun x => Psia κ (fun y => 1 / Real.sqrt (Q c l C y)) (fun y => Real.sqrt (Q c l C y)) x b) Daa a) (hDab : HasDerivAt (fun y => Psia κ (fun y => 1 / Real.sqrt (Q c l C y)) (fun y => Real.sqrt (Q c l C y)) a y) Dab b) : wdwOp c l hb a b (Psi κ (fun y => 1 / Real.sqrt (Q c l C y)) (fun y => Real.sqrt (Q c l C y)) a b) Daa Dab = 0
doc:
【α-IV.12、α-VI.4】Q(b) > 0 の点で、Ψ = e^{iaσ/ħ}/σ(σ = √Q)は WDW 方程式の厳密解。
作用素・定義域(Q > 0)・偏微分はすべて実際の関数について。

name: norm_Psi
stmt: theorem norm_Psi (a b : ℝ) : ‖Psi κ A σ a b‖ = |A b|
doc: |Ψ| = |A|:位相因子の絶対値は 1(焦線 Q → 0 では A = 1/√Q が発散する)

name: wdw_exact_of
stmt: theorem wdw_exact_of (A σ : ℝ → ℝ) (hb : ℝ) (hhb : hb * κ = 1) (hc : c ≠ 0) (C a b s σ' A' : ℝ) (hs : s ≠ 0) (hsq : s ^ 2 = Q c l C b) (hσb : σ b = s) (hAb : A b = s⁻¹) (hσ : HasDerivAt σ σ' b) (hA : HasDerivAt A A' b) (hσ' : s * σ' = (C - 8 * c ^ 2 * b) / 2) (hA' : A' = -σ' / s ^ 2) (Daa Dab : ℂ) (hDaa : HasDerivAt (fun x => Psia κ A σ x b) Daa a) (hDab : HasDerivAt (fun y => Psia κ A σ a y) Dab b) : wdwOp c l hb a b (Psi κ A σ a b) Daa Dab = 0
doc: 【α-VI.4】厳密解の一般形:σ(b) = s、s² = Q、sσ′ = Q′/2、A(b) = s⁻¹、A′ = −σ′/s²

name: wdw_exact_neg
stmt: theorem wdw_exact_neg (hb : ℝ) (hhb : hb * κ = 1) (hc : c ≠ 0) (C a b : ℝ) (hQ : 0 < Q c l C b) (Daa Dab : ℂ) (hDaa : HasDerivAt (fun x => Psia κ (fun y => (-Real.sqrt (Q c l C y))⁻¹) (fun y => -Real.sqrt (Q c l C y)) x b) Daa a) (hDab : HasDerivAt (fun y => Psia κ (fun y => (-Real.sqrt (Q c l C y))⁻¹) (fun y => -Real.sqrt (Q c l C y)) a y) Dab b) : wdwOp c l hb a b (Psi κ (fun y => (-Real.sqrt (Q c l C y))⁻¹) (fun y => -Real.sqrt (Q c l C y)) a b) Daa Dab = 0
doc: 【α-VI.4】負の枝:σ = −√Q、A = 1/σ でも Ψ は厳密解(古典の p_a = −√Q に対応)

name: wdwOp_linear
stmt: theorem wdwOp_linear (hb a b : ℝ) (α β Ψ₁ Ψ₂ D₁ D₂ E₁ E₂ : ℂ) : wdwOp c l hb a b (α * Ψ₁ + β * Ψ₂) (α * D₁ + β * D₂) (α * E₁ + β * E₂) = α * wdwOp c l hb a b Ψ₁ D₁ E₁ + β * wdwOp c l hb a b Ψ₂ D₂ E₂
doc: 重ね合わせ:wdwOp は (Ψ, Ψ_aa, Ψ_ab) について線形

name: wdw_exact_LB
stmt: theorem wdw_exact_LB (hb : ℝ) (hhb : hb * κ = 1) (hc : c ≠ 0) (C a b : ℝ) (hb0 : 0 < b) (hQ : 0 < Q c l C b) (Daa Dab : ℂ) (hDaa : HasDerivAt (fun x => Psia κ (fun y => Real.sqrt y / Real.sqrt (Q c l C y)) (fun y => Real.sqrt (Q c l C y)) x b) Daa a) (hDab : HasDerivAt (fun y => Psia κ (fun y => Real.sqrt y / Real.sqrt (Q c l C y)) (fun y => Real.sqrt (Q c l C y)) a y) Dab b) : wdwOpLB c l hb a b (Psi κ (fun y => Real.sqrt y / Real.sqrt (Q c l C y)) (fun y => Real.sqrt (Q c l C y)) a b) (Psia κ (fun y => Real.sqrt y / Real.sqrt (Q c l C y)) (fun y => Real.sqrt (Q c l C y)) a b) Daa Dab = 0
doc: 【α-VI.4】Laplace–Beltrami の順序でも、Ψ = √b e^{iaσ/ħ}/σ(σ = √Q、b > 0)は Q > 0 の各点で厳密解

name: wdw_exact_LB_of
stmt: theorem wdw_exact_LB_of (A σ : ℝ → ℝ) (hb : ℝ) (hhb : hb * κ = 1) (hc : c ≠ 0) (C a b s r σ' A' : ℝ) (hs : s ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hsq : s ^ 2 = Q c l C b) (hrsq : r ^ 2 = b) (hσb : σ b = s) (hAb : A b = r / s) (hσ : HasDerivAt σ σ' b) (hA : HasDerivAt A A' b) (hσ' : s * σ' = (C - 8 * c ^ 2 * b) / 2) (htr : s * A' + σ' * (r / s) = 1 / (2 * r)) (Daa Dab : ℂ) (hDaa : HasDerivAt (fun x => Psia κ A σ x b) Daa a) (hDab : HasDerivAt (fun y => Psia κ A σ a y) Dab b) : wdwOpLB c l hb a b (Psi κ A σ a b) (Psia κ A σ a b) Daa Dab = 0
doc:
【α-VI.4】Laplace–Beltrami の順序の厳密解の一般形:σ(b) = s、s² = Q、sσ′ = Q′/2、A(b) = r/s、
r² = b、輸送方程式 sA′ + σ′(r/s) = 1/(2r)(すなわち (σA)′ = (√b)′)

name: wdw_exact_LB_neg
stmt: theorem wdw_exact_LB_neg (hb : ℝ) (hhb : hb * κ = 1) (hc : c ≠ 0) (C a b : ℝ) (hb0 : 0 < b) (hQ : 0 < Q c l C b) (Daa Dab : ℂ) (hDaa : HasDerivAt (fun x => Psia κ (fun y => Real.sqrt y / (-Real.sqrt (Q c l C y))) (fun y => -Real.sqrt (Q c l C y)) x b) Daa a) (hDab : HasDerivAt (fun y => Psia κ (fun y => Real.sqrt y / (-Real.sqrt (Q c l C y))) (fun y => -Real.sqrt (Q c l C y)) a y) Dab b) : wdwOpLB c l hb a b (Psi κ (fun y => Real.sqrt y / (-Real.sqrt (Q c l C y))) (fun y => -Real.sqrt (Q c l C y)) a b) (Psia κ (fun y => Real.sqrt y / (-Real.sqrt (Q c l C y))) (fun y => -Real.sqrt (Q c l C y)) a b) Daa Dab = 0
doc: 【α-VI.4】Laplace–Beltrami の順序の負の枝:σ = −√Q、Ψ = √b e^{iaσ/ħ}/σ も厳密解

name: acc_le
stmt: theorem acc_le (l r rp W κ : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hk : l ^ 2 ≤ 2 * κ) (hW : κ ≤ W ^ 2 * r ^ 2) : acc l r rp W ≤ -1 / (2 * r)
doc: 類の中では加速度は −1/(2r) 以下

name: rp_nonpos
stmt: theorem rp_nonpos (hpos : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, 0 < r τ) (h2 : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, HasDerivAt rp (acc l (r τ) (rp τ) (W τ)) τ) (hk : l ^ 2 ≤ 2 * κ) (hW : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, κ ≤ W τ ^ 2 * r τ ^ 2) (h0 : rp τ1 = 0) : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, rp τ ≤ 0
doc: ṙ ≤ 0 が全区間で成り立つ

name: r_le
stmt: theorem r_le (h1 : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, HasDerivAt r (rp τ) τ) (hdown : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, rp τ ≤ 0) (hr1 : r τ1 = r1) : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, r τ ≤ r1
doc: r は単調減少で r ≤ r₁

name: rp_bound
stmt: theorem rp_bound (hpos : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, 0 < r τ) (h1 : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, HasDerivAt r (rp τ) τ) (h2 : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, HasDerivAt rp (acc l (r τ) (rp τ) (W τ)) τ) (hk : l ^ 2 ≤ 2 * κ) (hW : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, κ ≤ W τ ^ 2 * r τ ^ 2) (h0 : rp τ1 = 0) (hr1 : r τ1 = r1) : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, rp τ ≤ -(τ - τ1) / (4 * r1)
doc: τ > τ₁ では ṙ ≤ −(τ − τ₁)/(4r₁) < 0

name: r_lt
stmt: theorem r_lt (hpos : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, 0 < r τ) (h1 : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, HasDerivAt r (rp τ) τ) (h2 : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, HasDerivAt rp (acc l (r τ) (rp τ) (W τ)) τ) (hk : l ^ 2 ≤ 2 * κ) (hW : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, κ ≤ W τ ^ 2 * r τ ^ 2) (h0 : rp τ1 = 0) (hr1 : r τ1 = r1) : ∀ τ ∈ Ioc τ1 τ2, r τ < r1
doc: τ > τ₁ では r < r₁

name: energy_lower
stmt: theorem energy_lower (hpos : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, 0 < r τ) (h1 : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, HasDerivAt r (rp τ) τ) (h2 : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, HasDerivAt rp (acc l (r τ) (rp τ) (W τ)) τ) (hk : l ^ 2 ≤ 2 * κ) (hW : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, κ ≤ W τ ^ 2 * r τ ^ 2) (h0 : rp τ1 = 0) (hr1 : r τ1 = r1) (h12 : τ1 ≤ τ2) : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, r1 - r τ ≤ r τ * rp τ ^ 2
doc: エネルギー不等式の帰結:r ṙ² ≥ r₁ − r

name: psi_deriv
stmt: theorem psi_deriv (r1 x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < r1) : HasDerivAt (Psi r1) (-(√x / √(r1 - x))) x

name: psi_r1
stmt: theorem psi_r1 (r1 : ℝ) (hr1 : 0 < r1) : Psi r1 r1 = 0

name: psi_lt
stmt: theorem psi_lt (r1 x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hx1 : x ≤ r1) : Psi r1 x < π * r1 / 2
doc: 0 < x ≤ r₁ なら Ψ(x) < π r₁/2

name: z9_collapse
stmt: theorem z9_collapse (r rp W : ℝ → ℝ) (l κ τ1 τ2 r1 : ℝ) (h12 : τ1 < τ2) (hpos : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, 0 < r τ) (h1 : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, HasDerivAt r (rp τ) τ) (h2 : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, HasDerivAt rp (acc l (r τ) (rp τ) (W τ)) τ) (hk : l ^ 2 ≤ 2 * κ) (hW : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, κ ≤ W τ ^ 2 * r τ ^ 2) (h0 : rp τ1 = 0) (hr1 : r τ1 = r1) : τ2 - τ1 < π * r1 / 2
doc:
**Z9 の本定理**:転回点 r(τ₁) = r₁ から、類 (rW)² ≥ κ、2κ ≥ ℓ² の中で、正の解が [τ₁, τ₂] に
    存在するなら τ₂ − τ₁ < π r₁/2

name: z9_before_half_period
stmt: theorem z9_before_half_period (r rp W : ℝ → ℝ) (l κ τ1 τ2 r1 : ℝ) (h12 : τ1 < τ2) (hpos : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, 0 < r τ) (h1 : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, HasDerivAt r (rp τ) τ) (h2 : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, HasDerivAt rp (acc l (r τ) (rp τ) (W τ)) τ) (hk : l ^ 2 ≤ 2 * κ) (hW : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 τ2, κ ≤ W τ ^ 2 * r τ ^ 2) (h0 : rp τ1 = 0) (hr1 : r τ1 = r1) (hrl : r1 ≤ l) : τ2 - τ1 < π * l / 2
doc: 系(Z9-b):r₁ ≤ ℓ なら崩壊までの固有時は πℓ/2 より短い

name: z9_reaches_zero
stmt: theorem z9_reaches_zero (r rp W : ℝ → ℝ) (l κ τ1 r1 : ℝ) (hr1p : 0 < r1) (h1 : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 (τ1 + π * r1 / 2), HasDerivAt r (rp τ) τ) (h2 : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 (τ1 + π * r1 / 2), HasDerivAt rp (acc l (r τ) (rp τ) (W τ)) τ) (hk : l ^ 2 ≤ 2 * κ) (hW : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 (τ1 + π * r1 / 2), κ ≤ W τ ^ 2 * r τ ^ 2) (h0 : rp τ1 = 0) (hr1 : r τ1 = r1) : ∃ T ∈ Icc τ1 (τ1 + π * r1 / 2), r T = 0
doc: 系:解が区間 [τ₁, τ₁ + πr₁/2] 全体で(C¹ で)続くなら、その中で r は 0 になる

name: z44_from_z9
stmt: theorem z44_from_z9 (r rp W : ℝ → ℝ) (l κ r1 : ℝ) (hr1p : 0 < r1) (h1 : ∀ τ, HasDerivAt r (rp τ) τ) (h2 : ∀ τ, HasDerivAt rp (acc l (r τ) (rp τ) (W τ)) τ) (hk : l ^ 2 ≤ 2 * κ) (hW : ∀ τ, κ ≤ W τ ^ 2 * r τ ^ 2) (h0 : rp 0 = 0) (hr1 : r 0 = r1) (ε : ℝ → Fin 4 → ℝ × ℝ) (hε : ∀ t, ε t ≠ 0) (Ks : ℝ → ℝ) (hiso : ∀ t, (∑ a, ((ε t a).1 ^ 2 + (ε t a).2 ^ 2)) * rp t + Ks t * 0 = 0) : False
doc: Z44 の仮定 hcollapse を Z9 から供給する:中心の式の解で、喉に Killing スピノルはない

name: static_iff
stmt: theorem static_iff (l r W κ : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hW : W ^ 2 * r ^ 2 = κ) : acc l r 0 W = 0 ↔ r ^ 2 = l ^ 2 - 2 * κ
doc: (rW)² = κ のとき、静止した喉は r² = ℓ² − 2κ に限る

name: static_dichotomy
stmt: theorem static_dichotomy (l W κ : ℝ) : (l ^ 2 ≤ 2 * κ → ∀ r, 0 < r → W ^ 2 * r ^ 2 = κ → acc l r 0 W ≠ 0) ∧ (2 * κ < l ^ 2 → ∀ W', W' ^ 2 * (l ^ 2 - 2 * κ) = κ → acc l √(l ^ 2 - 2 * κ) 0 W' = 0)
doc: 2κ ≥ ℓ² なら静止した喉はない、2κ < ℓ² なら r = √(ℓ² − 2κ) が静止解

name: neck_frequency
stmt: theorem neck_frequency (l : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun r => -(1 - l ^ 2 / r ^ 2) / (2 * r)) (-1 / l ^ 2) l
doc: W = 0 の首 r = ℓ のまわりの線形化:F(r) = −(1 − ℓ²/r²)/(2r) の r = ℓ での微分は −1/ℓ²

name: ms_general
stmt: theorem ms_general (r N rp : ℝ) (hN : N ≠ 0) : r * (1 - ((-1 / N ^ 2) * (N * rp) ^ 2 + 1 * 0 ^ 2)) = r * (1 + rp ^ 2)
doc: Misner–Sharp:r(1 − h^{ab}∂_a r ∂_b r)、h = diag(−N², 1)、∂_t r = N ṙ、∂_s r = 0

name: rn_param
stmt: theorem rn_param (r E l : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) : r * (1 - (1 - E / r + l ^ 2 / r ^ 2)) + l ^ 2 / r = E
doc: RN:f = 1 − E/r + ℓ²/r² なら r(1 − f) + ℓ²/r = E(E は RN の質量母数 2GM)

name: rn_extremal
stmt: theorem rn_extremal (r l : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) : 1 - 2 * l / r + l ^ 2 / r ^ 2 = (1 - l / r) ^ 2
doc: 首の E = 2ℓ は極限 RN:f = (1 − ℓ/r)²

name: neck_E
stmt: theorem neck_E (l : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : l * (1 + 0 ^ 2) + l ^ 2 / l = 2 * l

name: ms_deriv
stmt: theorem ms_deriv (r rp W : ℝ → ℝ) (l τ : ℝ) (hr : r τ ≠ 0) (h1 : HasDerivAt r (rp τ) τ) (h2 : HasDerivAt rp (acc l (r τ) (rp τ) (W τ)) τ) : HasDerivAt (fun τ => r τ * (1 + rp τ ^ 2)) (rp τ * (l ^ 2 / r τ ^ 2 - 2 * W τ ^ 2)) τ
doc: 中心の式のもとで d(2Gm_MS)/dτ = ṙ(ℓ²/r² − 2W²)

name: ms_increases
stmt: theorem ms_increases (r rp W l : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hrp : rp ≤ 0) (hW : l ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (W ^ 2 * r ^ 2)) : 0 ≤ rp * (l ^ 2 / r ^ 2 - 2 * W ^ 2)
doc: 崩壊中で 2(rW)² ≥ ℓ² なら MS 質量の微分は 0 以上

name: throat_trapped
stmt: theorem throat_trapped (r rp : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hrp : rp < 0) : r ≤ r * (1 + rp ^ 2) ∧ (2 / r) * (0 + rp) < 0 ∧ (2 / r) * (-0 + rp) < 0
doc: 喉では 2Gm_MS ≥ r、null 膨張 θ± = (2/r)(±∂_s r + ṙ) は ∂_s r = 0 で同じ (2/r)ṙ

name: eta_const
stmt: theorem eta_const (μ ν : Fin 4) : D μ (eta ν : S) = 0

name: eta_const'
stmt: theorem eta_const' (ν : Fin 4) : δ (eta ν : S) = 0

name: d_quarter
stmt: theorem d_quarter (d : Derivation ℤ S S) : d (1/4 : S) = 0

name: first_variation
stmt: theorem first_variation (hc : ∀ μ ν x, D μ (D ν x) = D ν (D μ x)) (hδ : ∀ μ x, δ (D μ x) = D μ (δ x)) (hJ : ∀ ν, δ (J ν) = 0) : δ (Lag D A J) = ∑ ν, δ (A ν) * EL D A J ν - ∑ μ, D μ (∑ ν, Fu D A μ ν * δ (A ν))
doc: IX.1:第一変分

name: gauss
stmt: theorem gauss : EL D A J 0 = -(D 1 (Ef D A 1) + D 2 (Ef D A 2) + D 3 (Ef D A 3)) + J 0
doc: IX.2 Gauss の法則:EL₀ = 0 ⇔ ∇·E = ρ(ρ = J⁰)

name: ampere
stmt: theorem ampere : EL D A J 1 = D 0 (Ef D A 1) - (D 2 (B3 D A) - D 3 (B2 D A)) + J 1
doc: IX.2 Ampère–Maxwell(第 1 成分):EL₁ = ∂_tE₁ − (∇×B)₁ + J¹

name: bianchi_div
stmt: theorem bianchi_div : D 1 (B1 D A) + D 2 (B2 D A) + D 3 (B3 D A) = 0
doc: IX.3 ∇·B = 0(恒等式)

name: faraday
stmt: theorem faraday : (D 2 (Ef D A 3) - D 3 (Ef D A 2)) + D 0 (B1 D A) = 0
doc: IX.3 Faraday:(∇×E)₁ + ∂_tB₁ = 0(恒等式)

name: charge_conservation
stmt: theorem charge_conservation (hEL : ∀ ν, EL D A J ν = 0) : ∑ ν, D ν (J ν) = 0
doc: IX.3 電荷の保存:EL の式が成り立てば ∂_νJ^ν = 0

name: stress_divergence
stmt: theorem stress_divergence (ν : Fin 4) : ∑ μ, eta μ * D μ (T D A μ ν) = ∑ α, eta α * F D A ν α * ∑ μ, eta μ * D μ (F D A μ α)
doc: IX.6:Σ_μ η^μ ∂_μT_{μν} = Σ_α η^α F_{να}(Σ_μ η^μ ∂_μF_{μα})(恒等式)

name: dust_lorentz
stmt: theorem dust_lorentz (D : Fin 4 → Derivation ℤ S S) (ρ ρe : S) (u : Fin 4 → S) (Fmix : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → S) (ν : Fin 4) (hcont : ∑ μ, D μ (ρ * u μ) = 0) -- 全体の保存:∂_μ T_dust^{μν} = −∂_μ T_EM^{μν} = F^ν{}_λ J^λ、J = ρ_e u (hcons : ∑ μ, D μ (ρ * u μ * u ν) = ∑ k, Fmix ν k * (ρe * u k)) : ρ * ∑ μ, u μ * D μ (u ν) = ρe * ∑ k, Fmix ν k * u k
doc: IX.7:∂_μ(ρu^μu^ν) = (∂_μ(ρu^μ))u^ν + ρ(u·∂)u^ν。連続の式と全体の保存から Lorentz 力

name: particle_el
stmt: theorem particle_el (dτ : Derivation ℤ S S) (m q : S) (η u : Fin 4 → S) (Aw : Fin 4 → S) (dA : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → S) (hm : dτ m = 0) (hq : dτ q = 0) (hη : ∀ μ, dτ (η μ) = 0) (hchain : ∀ μ, dτ (Aw μ) = ∑ ν, u ν * dA μ ν) (μ : Fin 4) : dτ (m * η μ * u μ + q * Aw μ) - q * ∑ ν, u ν * dA ν μ = m * η μ * dτ (u μ) - q * ∑ ν, (dA ν μ - dA μ ν) * u ν
doc:
IX.8:粒子の EL の式。世界線の導分 dτ、u^μ = dτ x^μ、場の値 A_μ と偏微分 ∂_νA_μ =: dA μ ν
  (連鎖律 dτ A_μ = Σ_ν u^ν ∂_νA_μ は入力)。L = ½m Σ η_μ(u^μ)² + qΣA_μu^μ。
  EL_μ := dτ(∂L/∂u^μ) − ∂L/∂x^μ = dτ(mη_μu^μ + qA_μ) − qΣ_ν u^ν ∂_μA_ν = mη_μ u̇^μ − qΣ_ν F_{μν}u^ν

name: hamilton
stmt: theorem hamilton (dτ : Derivation ℤ S S) (m q : S) (η u : Fin 4 → S) (Aw : Fin 4 → S) (dA : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → S) (hm : dτ m = 0) (hq : dτ q = 0) (hη : ∀ μ, dτ (η μ) = 0) (hchain : ∀ μ, dτ (Aw μ) = ∑ ν, u ν * dA μ ν) (μ : Fin 4) : (dτ (m * η μ * u μ + q * Aw μ) = q * ∑ ν, u ν * dA ν μ) ↔ (m * η μ * dτ (u μ) = q * ∑ ν, (dA ν μ - dA μ ν) * u ν)
doc:
IX.9:Hamilton の式は EL の式と同値。p_μ = mη_μu^μ + qA_μ、H = (1/2m)Ση_μ(p_μ − qA_μ)²(η_μ² = 1)。
  dx^μ/dτ = ∂H/∂p_μ = η_μ(p_μ − qA_μ)/m = u^μ、dp_μ/dτ = −∂H/∂x^μ = qΣ_ν u^ν ∂_μA_ν。
  後者は m η_μ u̇^μ = qΣ_ν(∂_μA_ν − ∂_νA_μ)u^ν と同値

name: mass_shell
doc:
IX.9 質量殻:−(u⁰)² + |u|² = −1 なら、E_kin = m u⁰、p_kin = m u は E_kin² = m² + |p_kin|²、
  (m/E_kin)² + |p_kin/E_kin|² = 1(量子球面 Q の上の点、α-I.5)

name: gauss_integral
stmt: theorem gauss_integral (E ρ : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hE : ∀ r ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt (fun r => r ^ 2 * E r) (r ^ 2 * ρ r) r) (hρ : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => r ^ 2 * ρ r) MeasureTheory.volume a b) : 4 * Real.pi * (b ^ 2 * E b) - 4 * Real.pi * (a ^ 2 * E a) = 4 * Real.pi * ∫ r in a..b, r ^ 2 * ρ r
doc: IX.5:球対称な Gauss の法則の積分形。∂_r(r²E_r) = r²ρ なら Q(b) − Q(a) = 4π∫_a^b r²ρ

name: d_eta
stmt: theorem d_eta (i μ ν : Fin 4) : d i (eta μ ν : S) = 0

name: divT_expand
stmt: theorem divT_expand (ρ p : S) (u : Fin 4 → S) (ν : Fin 4) : divT d ρ p u ν = (∑ μ, d μ ((ρ + p) * u μ)) * u ν + (ρ + p) * (∑ μ, u μ * d μ (u ν)) + eta ν ν * d ν p
doc: 展開:∂_μT^{μν} = D u^ν + (ρ + p) u^μ∂_μu^ν + η^{νν}∂_ν p、D = Σ_μ ∂_μ((ρ + p)u^μ)

name: norm_deriv
stmt: theorem norm_deriv (u : Fin 4 → S) (hn : -(u 0) ^ 2 + u 1 ^ 2 + u 2 ^ 2 + u 3 ^ 2 = -1) (μ : Fin 4) : -(u 0) * d μ (u 0) + u 1 * d μ (u 1) + u 2 * d μ (u 2) + u 3 * d μ (u 3) = 0
doc: 規格化の微分:u·u = −1 なら u_ν∂_μu^ν = 0

name: fluid_energy
stmt: theorem fluid_energy (ρ p : S) (u : Fin 4 → S) (h : ∀ ν, divT d ρ p u ν = 0) (hn : -(u 0) ^ 2 + u 1 ^ 2 + u 2 ^ 2 + u 3 ^ 2 = -1) : ∑ μ, d μ ((ρ + p) * u μ) = ∑ μ, u μ * d μ p
doc: 【α-IX.16】連続の式:Σ_μ ∂_μ((ρ + p)u^μ) = u^μ∂_μ p

name: fluid_euler
stmt: theorem fluid_euler (ρ p : S) (u : Fin 4 → S) (h : ∀ ν, divT d ρ p u ν = 0) (hn : -(u 0) ^ 2 + u 1 ^ 2 + u 2 ^ 2 + u 3 ^ 2 = -1) (ν : Fin 4) : (ρ + p) * (∑ μ, u μ * d μ (u ν)) = -(eta ν ν * d ν p) - u ν * (∑ μ, u μ * d μ p)
doc: 【α-IX.16】相対論的 Euler 方程式 (ρ + p)u^μ∂_μu^ν = −η^{νν}∂_ν p − u^ν u^μ∂_μ p

name: cap_radiation
stmt: theorem cap_radiation (g l x L t : ℝ) (hg : g ≠ 0) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hx : sin x ≠ 0) (ht : t ^ 2 < L) : (-CFT.EYM.rho g (cos x) (-(sin x) / l) (l * sin x) + CFT.EYM.pr g (cos x) (-(sin x) / l) (l * sin x) + 2 * CFT.EYM.pT g (cos x) (-(sin x) / l) (l * sin x) = 0) ∧ CFT.EYM.pr g (cos x) (-(sin x) / l) (l * sin x) = CFT.EYM.rho g (cos x) (-(sin x) / l) (l * sin x) / 3 ∧ CFT.EYM.pT g (cos x) (-(sin x) / l) (l * sin x) = CFT.EYM.rho g (cos x) (-(sin x) / l) (l * sin x) / 3 ∧ (-t / Real.sqrt (L - t ^ 2)) ^ 2 + 1 = L / (Real.sqrt (L - t ^ 2)) ^ 2
doc: 【α-IX.17】YM の応力は跡ゼロ、帽子で p_r = p_T = ρ/3、a = √(L − t²) は Friedmann 方程式 ȧ² + 1 = L/a² の解

name: cyclic_zero
stmt: theorem cyclic_zero (w : Fin n → S) (l μ ν : Fin n) : D l (om D w μ ν) - D μ (om D w l ν) + D ν (om D w l μ) = 0
doc: dω = 0 の成分:∂_λ ω_{μν} − ∂_μ ω_{λν} + ∂_ν ω_{λμ} = 0

name: lie_two_form
stmt: theorem lie_two_form (w u : Fin n → S) (μ ν : Fin n) : lieOm D w u μ ν = D μ (iuOm D w u ν) - D ν (iuOm D w u μ)
doc: 【α-IX.18】Cartan の公式(dω = 0 のとき):L_u ω_{μν} = ∂_μ(i_uω)_ν − ∂_ν(i_uω)_μ

name: kelvin
stmt: theorem kelvin (w u : Fin n → S) (h : ∀ ν, iuOm D w u ν = 0) (μ ν : Fin n) : lieOm D w u μ ν = 0
doc: 【α-IX.18】Kelvin:i_u ω = 0 なら L_u ω = 0

name: flux_freezing
stmt: theorem flux_freezing (A u : Fin n → S) (h : ∀ ν, iuOm D A u ν = 0) (μ ν : Fin n) : lieOm D A u μ ν = 0
doc: 【α-IX.19】磁束凍結:F = dA、理想 MHD i_u F = 0 なら L_u F = 0

name: cross_is_commutator
stmt: theorem cross_is_commutator (v w : Quaternion ℝ) (hv : v.re = 0) (hw : w.re = 0) : (v * w - w * v).re = 0 ∧ (v * w - w * v).imI = 2 * (v.imJ * w.imK - v.imK * w.imJ) ∧ (v * w - w * v).imJ = 2 * (v.imK * w.imI - v.imI * w.imK) ∧ (v * w - w * v).imK = 2 * (v.imI * w.imJ - v.imJ * w.imI)
doc: 【α-IX.18】純虚四元数の交換子:[v, ω] = 2 v × ω(渦度方程式の外積)

name: helicity_balance
stmt: theorem helicity_balance : let B

name: reduction_identity
stmt: theorem reduction_identity (H : SphD d N A R s c) : N * A * R ^ 2 * Rsc d (giD N A R s) (GD d N A R s c) = N * A * (R ^ 2 * R2D d N A + 2 + 2 * (-(N⁻¹ ^ 2 * (d 0 R) ^ 2) + A⁻¹ ^ 2 * (d 1 R) ^ 2)) - 2 * DivD d N A R
doc: 【α-IX.10】N A R² R₄ = N A (Φ R₂ + 2 + (∇Φ)²/(2Φ)) − 2 Div(Φ = R²)

name: div_total
stmt: theorem div_total (hN : N ≠ 0) (hA : A ≠ 0) : DivD d N A R = d 0 (-(A * N⁻¹ * (2 * R * d 0 R))) + d 1 (N * A⁻¹ * (2 * R * d 1 R))
doc: 【α-IX.10】Div は全微分:Div = ∂_t(−A N⁻¹ ∂_t(R²)) + ∂_x(N A⁻¹ ∂_x(R²))

name: magnetic_F2
doc: YM の項(磁荷 1、W):F^a_{μν}F^{aμν} の磁気の部分 = 2(1 − W²)²/R⁴、W = 0 で 2/R⁴

name: U_deriv
stmt: theorem U_deriv (l Φ : ℝ) (hΦ : Φ ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (U l) (2 * l ^ 2 / Φ ^ 2) Φ

name: neck_exact
stmt: theorem neck_exact (l Φ R2 : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hΦ : Φ ≠ 0) (hU : U l Φ = 0) (hE : R2 + 2 * l ^ 2 / Φ ^ 2 = 0) : Φ = l ^ 2 ∧ R2 = -2 / l ^ 2
doc: 【α-IX.11】定数の Φ:計量の方程式 U(Φ) = 0 と Φ の方程式 R₂ + U′(Φ) = 0 の解は Φ = ℓ²、R₂ = −2/ℓ²

name: neck_metric_curvature
stmt: theorem neck_metric_curvature (l t : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hc : cos (t / l) ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun τ => cos (τ / l)) (-(sin (t / l)) * (1 / l)) t ∧ HasDerivAt (fun τ => -(sin (τ / l)) * (1 / l)) (-(cos (t / l)) * (1 / l) * (1 / l)) t ∧ 2 * (-(cos (t / l)) * (1 / l) * (1 / l)) / cos (t / l) = -2 / l ^ 2
doc: 【α-IX.11】a = cos(t/ℓ):ä = −a/ℓ²、したがって R₂ = 2ä/a = −2/ℓ²(半径 ℓ の AdS₂)

name: jt_expansion
stmt: theorem jt_expansion (l R φ : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hφ : 1 + φ ≠ 0) : l ^ 2 * (1 + φ) * R + U l (l ^ 2 * (1 + φ)) = l ^ 2 * R + φ * (l ^ 2 * R + 2) - 2 * φ ^ 2 / (1 + φ)
doc: 【α-IX.12】Φ = ℓ²(1 + φ):ΦR + U = ℓ²R + φ(ℓ²R + 2) − 2φ²/(1 + φ)(厳密)

name: jt_kinetic
stmt: theorem jt_kinetic (l φ dφ : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hφ : 1 + φ ≠ 0) : (l ^ 2 * dφ) ^ 2 / (2 * (l ^ 2 * (1 + φ))) = l ^ 2 * dφ ^ 2 / (2 * (1 + φ))
doc: 運動項:Φ = ℓ²(1 + φ)、∇Φ = ℓ²∇φ なら (∇Φ)²/(2Φ) = ℓ²(∇φ)²/(2(1 + φ))(φ の 2 次)

name: ground_entropy
doc: 【α-IX.13】S₀ = 4πℓ²/(4G) = πℓ²/G = 4π²/g² = ½·(8π²/g²)

name: schwarzian_energy
stmt: theorem schwarzian_energy (S0 C β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β) : HasDerivAt (logZ S0 C) (-(3 / (2 * β) + 2 * π ^ 2 * C / β ^ 2)) β
doc: 【α-IX.14】E = −∂_β log Z = 3/(2β) + 2π²C/β²

name: schwarzian_entropy
stmt: theorem schwarzian_entropy (S0 C β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β) : logZ S0 C β + β * (3 / (2 * β) + 2 * π ^ 2 * C / β ^ 2) = S0 + 4 * π ^ 2 * C * (1 / β) + 3 / 2 * Real.log (1 / β) + 3 / 2 * (1 + Real.log C)
doc: 【α-IX.14】S = log Z + βE = S₀ + 4π²CT + (3/2)log T + (3/2)(1 + log C)(T = 1/β)

name: schwarzian_heat_capacity
stmt: theorem schwarzian_heat_capacity (C T : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hT : 0 < T) : HasDerivAt (fun x => 3 / 2 * x + 2 * π ^ 2 * C * x ^ 2) (3 / 2 + 4 * π ^ 2 * C * T) T ∧ 0 < 3 / 2 + 4 * π ^ 2 * C * T
doc: 【α-IX.14】比熱 dE/dT = 3/2 + 4π²CT > 0(E = (3/2)T + 2π²CT²、C > 0、T > 0)

name: delta_roots
stmt: theorem delta_roots : let Δp : ℂ
doc: 【α-IX.15】Δ(Δ − 1) = m²ℓ² = −1 の根は Δ = ½ ± i√3/2(実の根はない)

name: neck_mode_below_BF
stmt: theorem neck_mode_below_BF : HasDerivAt (fun W : ℝ => W * (1 - W ^ 2)) 1 0 ∧ -(1 : ℝ) < -(1 / 4) ∧ ¬ ∃ α : ℝ, α ^ 2 - 1 * α - (-1) = 0
doc: 【α-IX.15】W のモードは m²ℓ² = −1 で BF 限界 −1/4 の下(実の Δ はない)

name: gaussian_negative_mode
stmt: theorem gaussian_negative_mode (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) : ¬ MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (a * x ^ 2))
doc: 【α-IX.15】負のモードの方向のガウス積分は収束しない:e^{a x²}(a ≥ 0)は ℝ で可積分でない

name: focusing
stmt: theorem focusing (θ θd : ℝ → ℝ) (Λ : ℝ) (hΛ : 0 ≤ Λ) (hθ : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 Λ, HasDerivAt θ (θd s) s) (hneg : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 Λ, θ s < 0) (hray : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 Λ, θd s ≤ -(θ s ^ 2 / 2)) : Λ < -2 / θ 0

name: hyperbolic_area
stmt: theorem hyperbolic_area (l A g : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : -1 / l ^ 2 * A = 2 * π * (2 - 2 * g) ↔ A = 4 * π * (g - 1) * l ^ 2
doc: 【α-IX.32】Gauss–Bonnet:(−1/ℓ²)A = 2π(2 − 2g) ⇔ A = 4π(g − 1)ℓ²

name: hawking_page
stmt: theorem hawking_page (rp L : ℝ) (hr : 0 < rp) (hL : 0 < L) : rp / 4 * (1 - rp ^ 2 / L ^ 2) < 0 ↔ L < rp
doc: 【α-IX.33】Hawking–Page 型:F = (r₊/4)(1 − r₊²/L²) < 0 ⇔ r₊ > L(r₊, L > 0)

name: hedgehog_charge
stmt: theorem hedgehog_charge : 4 * π * sin (π / 2) ^ 2 / (4 * π) = 1
doc: 【α-IX.34】帽子の赤道で磁束 4π sin²(π/2) = 4π、次数 = 磁束/4π = 1

name: expansion_cap
stmt: theorem expansion_cap (l χ η : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hs : sin χ ≠ 0) (hc : cos η ≠ 0) : (-(l * sin η) * sin χ + l * cos η * cos χ) / (l * cos η * sin χ) = cos χ / sin χ - sin η / cos η ∧ cos χ / sin χ - sin η / cos η = cos (χ + η) / (sin χ * cos η)
doc: 【α-XI.3】a = ℓ cos η:(a′ sin χ + a cos χ)/(a sin χ) = cot χ − tan η = cos(χ + η)/(sin χ cos η)

name: no_trapped_in_cap
stmt: theorem no_trapped_in_cap (χ η : ℝ) (hχ : 0 < χ) (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hfront : χ + η < π / 2) : 0 < cos χ / sin χ - sin η / cos η ∧ -(cos χ / sin χ) - sin η / cos η < 0
doc: 【α-XI.3】帽子の厳密な領域(0 < χ、0 ≤ η、χ + η < π/2)では θ₊ ∝ cot χ − tan η > 0、θ₋ ∝ −cot χ − tan η < 0

name: marginal_on_front
stmt: theorem marginal_on_front (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (hη2 : η < π / 2) : cos (π / 2 - η) / sin (π / 2 - η) - sin η / cos η = 0
doc: 【α-XI.3】波面 χ = π/2 − η の上で θ₊ = 0(周辺的に捕捉された球)

name: kms
stmt: theorem kms (t : ℂ) : Gc E β A B t = Hc E β A B (t + Complex.I * β)
doc: 【α-IX.26】KMS 条件 G_AB(t) = H_BA(t + iβ)

name: fdt
stmt: theorem fdt (β Em Ek : ℝ) : (exp (-β * Ek) + exp (-β * Em)) * sinh (β * (Em - Ek) / 2) = (exp (-β * Ek) - exp (-β * Em)) * cosh (β * (Em - Ek) / 2)
doc: 【α-IX.30】(p_k + p_m) sinh(βω/2) = (p_k − p_m) cosh(βω/2)、ω = E_m − E_k、p = e^{−βE}

name: detailed_balance
stmt: theorem detailed_balance (β Em Ek : ℝ) : exp (-β * Ek) = exp (β * (Em - Ek)) * exp (-β * Em)
doc: 詳細つり合い:p_k = e^{βω} p_m

name: bose_series
stmt: theorem bose_series (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (if n = 0 then (0 : ℂ) else 1) * ((rexp (-(n : ℝ) * t) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ((1 / (rexp t - 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: bose_integral
stmt: theorem bose_integral : ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), t ^ 3 / (rexp t - 1) = π ^ 4 / 15
doc: 【α-IX.28】∫₀^∞ t³/(eᵗ − 1) dt = π⁴/15

name: stefan_boltzmann
stmt: theorem stefan_boltzmann (T : ℝ) : 2 / (2 * π ^ 2) * T ^ 4 * (π ^ 4 / 15) = π ^ 2 / 15 * T ^ 4
doc: Stefan–Boltzmann:u = (2/(2π²))·T⁴·(π⁴/15) = (π²/15)T⁴

name: horizon_polar
stmt: theorem horizon_polar (f1 ρ : ℝ) (hf : f1 ≠ 0) (hρ : ρ ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun r => f1 * r ^ 2 / 4) (f1 * ρ / 2) ρ ∧ (f1 * ρ / 2) ^ 2 / (f1 * (f1 * ρ ^ 2 / 4)) = 1 ∧ f1 * (f1 * ρ ^ 2 / 4) = (f1 * ρ / 2) ^ 2
doc: 地平線の近く:x = f₁ρ²/4 なら dr/dρ = f₁ρ/2、(dr/dρ)²/f = 1、f = (f₁ρ/2)²

name: conical_period
stmt: theorem conical_period (f1 β : ℝ) (hf : 0 < f1) : f1 / 2 * β = 2 * π ↔ β = 4 * π / f1
doc: 円錐の特異点がない:角度 (f₁/2)τ が一周 2π ⇔ β = 4π/f₁、T = f₁/(4π) = κ/(2π)

name: rn_slope
stmt: theorem rn_slope (rp rm : ℝ) (hp : rp ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun r => (r - rp) * (r - rm) / r ^ 2) ((rp - rm) / rp ^ 2) rp
doc: RN:f = (r − r₊)(r − r₋)/r² の地平線での傾き f′(r₊) = (r₊ − r₋)/r₊²

name: extremal_cold
stmt: theorem extremal_cold (rp : ℝ) : (rp - rp) / (4 * π * rp ^ 2) = 0
doc: 極限 r₊ = r₋ で T = (r₊ − r₋)/(4πr₊²) = 0

name: euclid_neck_curvature
stmt: theorem euclid_neck_curvature (l x : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun y => cosh (y / l)) (sinh (x / l) * (1 / l)) x ∧ HasDerivAt (fun y => sinh (y / l) * (1 / l)) (cosh (x / l) * (1 / l) * (1 / l)) x ∧ -(cosh (x / l) * (1 / l) * (1 / l)) / cosh (x / l) = -1 / l ^ 2
doc: 【α-IX.22】N = cosh(x/ℓ):N″ = N/ℓ²、Gauss 曲率 −N″/N = −1/ℓ²

name: horizon_mass
stmt: theorem horizon_mass (rp Q M : ℝ) (hp : rp ≠ 0) : 1 - 2 * M / rp + Q ^ 2 / rp ^ 2 = 0 ↔ M = Mrn rp Q

name: first_law
stmt: theorem first_law (rp Q : ℝ) (hp : rp ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun r => Mrn r Q) ((rp - Q ^ 2 / rp) / (4 * π * rp ^ 2) * (2 * π * rp)) rp ∧ HasDerivAt (fun q => Mrn rp q) (Q / rp) Q
doc: 【α-IX.23】第一法則:∂M/∂r₊ = T ∂S/∂r₊(S = πr₊²、T = (r₊ − r₋)/(4πr₊²)、r₋ = Q²/r₊)、∂M/∂Q = Φ = Q/r₊

name: smarr
stmt: theorem smarr (rp Q : ℝ) (hp : rp ≠ 0) : Mrn rp Q = 2 * ((rp - Q ^ 2 / rp) / (4 * π * rp ^ 2)) * (π * rp ^ 2) + Q / rp * Q
doc: 【α-IX.23】Smarr:M = 2TS + ΦQ

name: euclid_action
stmt: theorem euclid_action (β M T S Φ Q : ℝ) (hsm : M = 2 * T * S + Φ * Q) (hβ : β * T = 1) : β * (M - Φ * Q) / 2 = β * (M - T * S - Φ * Q) ∧ β * (M - Φ * Q) - β * (M - Φ * Q) / 2 = S
doc:
【α-IX.24】I = β(M − ΦQ)/2(Gibbons–Hawking の評価)、Smarr M = 2TS + ΦQ、βT = 1 なら
I = β(M − TS − ΦQ)、S = β(M − ΦQ) − I

name: tolman
stmt: theorem tolman (a T N Td Nd : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hT : T ≠ 0) (hN : N ≠ 0) (h : 4 * a / 3 * T ^ 3 * Td = -(4 * a / 3 * T ^ 4 * Nd / N)) : Td * N + T * Nd = 0
doc: 【α-IX.25】(4a/3)T³T′ = −(4a/3)T⁴N′/N(dp/dr = −(ρ + p)N′/N、p = aT⁴/3、ρ = aT⁴)なら (TN)′ = 0

name: tolman_const
stmt: theorem tolman_const (T N : ℝ → ℝ) (Td Nd : ℝ → ℝ) (r0 r1 : ℝ) (hT : ∀ r ∈ Icc r0 r1, HasDerivAt T (Td r) r) (hN : ∀ r ∈ Icc r0 r1, HasDerivAt N (Nd r) r) (h : ∀ r ∈ Icc r0 r1, Td r * N r + T r * Nd r = 0) : ∀ r ∈ Icc r0 r1, T r * N r = T r0 * N r0
doc: (TN)′ = 0 が区間で成り立てば TN は一定

name: nr_bounds
stmt: theorem nr_bounds (m p : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hp : p ^ 2 ≤ 8 * m ^ 2) : m + p ^ 2 / (2 * m) - p ^ 4 / (8 * m ^ 3) ≤ Real.sqrt (m ^ 2 + p ^ 2) ∧ Real.sqrt (m ^ 2 + p ^ 2) ≤ m + p ^ 2 / (2 * m)
doc: 【α-IX.27】m + p²/2m − p⁴/8m³ ≤ √(m² + p²) ≤ m + p²/2m(m > 0、p² ≤ 8m²)

name: q_coordinate
stmt: theorem q_coordinate (m p : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) : 0 < m / Real.sqrt (m ^ 2 + p ^ 2) ∧ m / Real.sqrt (m ^ 2 + p ^ 2) ≤ 1
doc: Q の座標 m/E ∈ (0, 1]

name: laplace_exponent
stmt: theorem laplace_exponent (C β : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hβ : β ≠ 0) : (2 * π * Real.sqrt (2 * C)) ^ 2 / (4 * β) = 2 * π ^ 2 * C / β
doc: 【α-IX.29】Laplace 変換の指数:a = 2π√(2C) なら a²/(4β) = 2π²C/β(IX.14 の Z と同じ)

name: micro_macro
stmt: theorem micro_macro (S0 C T : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hT : 0 ≤ T) : S0 + 2 * π * Real.sqrt (2 * C * (2 * π ^ 2 * C * T ^ 2)) = S0 + 4 * π ^ 2 * C * T
doc: 【α-IX.29】微視的な S(E) = S₀ + 2π√(2CE) は E = 2π²CT² で S₀ + 4π²CT

name: micro_temperature
stmt: theorem micro_temperature (C T : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hT : 0 < T) : π * Real.sqrt (2 * C) / Real.sqrt (2 * π ^ 2 * C * T ^ 2) = 1 / T
doc: 【α-IX.29】dS/dE = π√(2C)/√E = 1/T(E = 2π²CT²、C, T > 0)

name: mass_function
stmt: theorem mass_function (M p β r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun x => M - p ^ 2 / (2 * x) + 4 * π * β * p ^ 4 / (5 * x ^ 5)) (4 * π * r ^ 2 * (p ^ 2 / (8 * π * r ^ 4) - β * p ^ 4 / r ^ 8)) r
doc: 質量関数 m(r) = M − p²/(2r) + 4πβp⁴/(5r⁵):m′ = 4πr²ρ、ρ = p²/(8πr⁴) − βp⁴/r⁸

name: horizon_iff
stmt: theorem horizon_iff (M p k r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) : 1 - 2 * M / r + p ^ 2 / r ^ 2 - k / r ^ 6 = 0 ↔ M = r / 2 * (1 + p ^ 2 / r ^ 2 - k / r ^ 6)
doc: M(r) = (r/2)(1 + p²/r² − k/r⁶):f(r) = 1 − 2M/r + p²/r² − k/r⁶ = 0 ⇔ M = M(r)

name: lighter_extremal
stmt: theorem lighter_extremal (p k : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hk : 0 < k) : p / 2 * (1 + p ^ 2 / p ^ 2 - k / p ^ 6) = p - k / (2 * p ^ 5) ∧ p - k / (2 * p ^ 5) < p
doc: 【α-XI.2】M(p) = p − k/(2p⁵) < p(k > 0):古典の極限 M = p より軽いブラックホールがある

name: dF_cov
stmt: theorem dF_cov (hδ : ∀ μ x, δ (D μ x) = D μ (δ x)) (a : Fin 3) (μ ν : Fin 4) : δ (Fa D A a μ ν) = Cov D A (fun b ρ => δ (A b ρ)) a μ ν - Cov D A (fun b ρ => δ (A b ρ)) a ν μ
doc: 補題 A:δF^a_{μν} = (∇_μ δA)^a_ν − (∇_ν δA)^a_μ

name: Fa_antisym
stmt: theorem Fa_antisym (a : Fin 3) (μ ν : Fin 4) : Fa D A a ν μ = -Fa D A a μ ν
doc: 反対称性 F^a_{νμ} = −F^a_{μν}

name: Fau_antisym
stmt: theorem Fau_antisym (a : Fin 3) (μ ν : Fin 4) : Fau D A a ν μ = -Fau D A a μ ν

name: antisym_sum
stmt: theorem antisym_sum (a : Fin 3) (X : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → S) : ∑ μ, ∑ ν, Fau D A a μ ν * (X μ ν - X ν μ) = 2 * ∑ μ, ∑ ν, Fau D A a μ ν * X μ ν
doc: 補題 C:Σ_{μν} F^{μν}(X_{μν} − X_{νμ}) = 2Σ F^{μν}X_{μν}

name: relabel
stmt: theorem relabel (Fv Av Xv : Fin 3 → S) : ∑ a, Fv a * ∑ b, ∑ c, CFT.S1.f3 a b c * Av b * Xv c = -∑ a, Xv a * ∑ b, ∑ c, CFT.S1.f3 a b c * Av b * Fv c
doc: 補題 E:構造定数の付け替え Σ_{abc} ε^{abc}F^a A^b X^c = −Σ_{abc} ε^{abc}X^a A^b F^c

name: Fau_diag
stmt: theorem Fau_diag (a : Fin 3) (μ : Fin 4) : Fau D A a μ μ = 0

name: ym_first_variation
stmt: theorem ym_first_variation (hc : ∀ μ ν x, D μ (D ν x) = D ν (D μ x)) (hδ : ∀ μ x, δ (D μ x) = D μ (δ x)) (hJ : ∀ a ν, δ (J a ν) = 0) : δ (LagYM D A J) = ∑ a, ∑ ν, δ (A a ν) * ELYM D A J a ν - ∑ μ, D μ (∑ a, ∑ ν, Fau D A a μ ν * δ (A a ν))

name: u1_projection
stmt: theorem u1_projection (h1 : ∀ μ, A 1 μ = 0) (h2 : ∀ μ, A 2 μ = 0) (ν : Fin 4) : ELYM D A J 0 ν = CFT.Classical.EL D (A 0) (J 0) ν
doc: U(1) ⊂ SU(2) への射影:A² = A³ = 0、J² = J³ = 0 なら a = 0 成分の EL の式は Maxwell の EL の式

name: curv_formula
stmt: theorem curv_formula (p : Fin 3 → ℂ) (a ap b bp : ℂ) : let s
doc: 曲率の一般形(k = 1, 2, 3 の各成分)

name: gram_trace
stmt: theorem gram_trace (p : Fin 3 → ℂ) (α β γ : ℂ) : let s
doc: Gram 不変量の和

name: gram_gauge
stmt: theorem gram_gauge (g X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (hg : IsUnit g.det) : trace ((g * X * g⁻¹) * (g * X * g⁻¹)) = trace (X * X)
doc: Gram 不変量はゲージ変換 X ↦ gXg⁻¹ で不変

name: wigner_coeffs
stmt: theorem wigner_coeffs (hm : 0 < m) (hE : 0 < E) : let a

name: berry_coeffs
stmt: theorem berry_coeffs (hm : 0 < m) (hE : 0 < E) : let a

name: fueter_coeffs
stmt: theorem fueter_coeffs (hE : 0 < E) : let a

name: berry_eq_wigner
stmt: theorem berry_eq_wigner (hm : 0 < m) (hE : 0 < E) : 1 / (2 * E * (E + m)) = -(m / E) * (-1 / (2 * m * (E + m)))
doc: Berry 接続 = −(m/E) × Wigner 接続(係数 a の関係)

name: ratio
doc: trG_B = (m/E)⁴ trG_W

name: trG_B_lt
stmt: theorem trG_B_lt (hm : 0 < m) (hEm : m < E) : 2 * m ^ 2 / E ^ 6 + 1 / E ^ 4 < 2 / (m ^ 2 * E ^ 2) + 1 / m ^ 4
doc: E > m > 0 なら trG_B < trG_W

name: wigner_deriv
stmt: theorem wigner_deriv (m s : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hs : 0 < m ^ 2 + s) : HasDerivAt (fun s => -1 / (2 * m * (Real.sqrt (m ^ 2 + s) + m))) (1 / (4 * m * Real.sqrt (m ^ 2 + s) * (Real.sqrt (m ^ 2 + s) + m) ^ 2)) s
doc: W:a(s) = −1/(2m(√(m²+s) + m)) の導関数は 1/(4mE(E+m)²)、E = √(m²+s)

name: berry_deriv
stmt: theorem berry_deriv (m s : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hs : 0 < m ^ 2 + s) : HasDerivAt (fun s => 1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (m ^ 2 + s) * (Real.sqrt (m ^ 2 + s) + m))) (-(2 * Real.sqrt (m ^ 2 + s) + m) / (4 * Real.sqrt (m ^ 2 + s) ^ 3 * (Real.sqrt (m ^ 2 + s) + m) ^ 2)) s
doc: B:a(s) = 1/(2E(E+m)) の導関数は −(2E+m)/(4E³(E+m)²)

name: berry_not_gauge_wigner
stmt: theorem berry_not_gauge_wigner (m E : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hEm : m < E) (p : Fin 3 → ℂ) (hs : p 0 ^ 2 + p 1 ^ 2 + p 2 ^ 2 = ((E ^ 2 - m ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) : let FW : Fin 3 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ

name: gam_i
stmt: theorem gam_i : (gam qi 0, gam qi 1, gam qi 2, gam qi 3) = (1, qi, -1, -qi)

name: gam_mk
stmt: theorem gam_mk : (gam (-qk) 0, gam (-qk) 1, gam (-qk) 2, gam (-qk) 3) = (1, -qk, -1, qk)

name: C_table
stmt: theorem C_table (r a : Fin 4) : C r a = e (r + a)
doc: C の成分表

name: right_kernel
stmt: theorem right_kernel (y : Fin 4 → ℍ[ℝ]) : (∀ r, ∑ a, C r a * y a = 0) ↔ ∃ q : ℍ[ℝ], ∀ a, y a = gam (-qk) a * q
doc: 右核:C y = 0 ⇔ y = γ(−k) q

name: left_kernel
stmt: theorem left_kernel (x : Fin 4 → ℍ[ℝ]) : (∀ a, ∑ r, x r * C r a = 0) ↔ ∃ q : ℍ[ℝ], ∀ r, x r = q * gam qi r
doc: 左核:x C = 0 ⇔ x = q γ(i)

name: rank_three
stmt: theorem rank_three : (∀ y : Fin 3 → ℍ[ℝ], (∀ r, C r 0 * y 0 + C r 1 * y 1 + C r 2 * y 2 = 0) → y = 0) ∧ (∀ r, C r 3 = C r 0 * qk + C r 1 - C r 2 * qk)
doc: 階数 3:列 0, 1, 2 は右一次独立、列 3 はその右一次結合

name: singular
stmt: theorem singular : ∃ y : Fin 4 → ℍ[ℝ], y ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ r, ∑ a, C r a * y a = 0
doc: 行列は特異(非自明な右核を持つ)

name: kerParam_injective
stmt: theorem kerParam_injective : Function.Injective kerParam

name: ker_eq_range
stmt: theorem ker_eq_range : LinearMap.ker Cmap = LinearMap.range kerParam

name: real_rank_twelve
stmt: theorem real_rank_twelve : Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range Cmap) = 12
doc: 実数化した写像の階数は 12(= 16 − 4)、四元数の右加群としての階数 3 に対応

name: dq_coord
stmt: theorem dq_coord (a b : Fin 4) : dq (d a) (ofR (x b)) = if a = b then 1 else 0

name: op_coord
stmt: theorem op_coord (c : Fin 4 → ℍ[R]) (b : Fin 4) : Op d c (ofR (x b)) = c b
doc: 係数の取り出し:Op c (x_b) = c_b

name: coefficient_extraction
stmt: theorem coefficient_extraction (m a : Fin 4) : Dm d m (ofR (x a)) = e (m + a)
doc: 族の係数行列は C_{ma} = e_{m+a}

name: coefficient_unique
stmt: theorem coefficient_unique (c c' : Fin 4 → ℍ[R]) (h : ∀ f, Op d c f = Op d c' f) : c = c'
doc: 係数は作用素から一意に決まる

name: dq_add
stmt: theorem dq_add (a : Fin 4) (f g : ℍ[R]) : dq (d a) (f + g) = dq (d a) f + dq (d a) g

name: dq_mul_const
stmt: theorem dq_mul_const (a : Fin 4) (f q : ℍ[R]) (hq : IsConst d q) : dq (d a) (f * q) = dq (d a) f * q

name: right_kernel_rows
stmt: theorem right_kernel_rows (m : Fin 4) : ∑ a, e (m + a) * (gamK a : ℍ[R]) = 0

name: left_kernel_cols
stmt: theorem left_kernel_cols (a : Fin 4) : ∑ m, (gamI m : ℍ[R]) * e (m + a) = 0

name: null_solution
stmt: theorem null_solution (q : ℍ[R]) (hq : IsConst d q) (m : Fin 4) : Dm d m (∑ b, ofR (x b) * gamK b * q) = 0
doc: 右核から作る一次関数 f = Σ_a x_a γ_a q はすべての D_m の解

name: operator_relation
stmt: theorem operator_relation (f : ℍ[R]) : ∑ m, (gamI m : ℍ[R]) * Dm d m f = 0
doc: 左核は作用素の関係を与える:Σ_m γ(i)_m D_m f = 0

name: h_radial
stmt: theorem h_radial (m P E : ℝ) (hm : m ≠ 0) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hE : E ^ 2 = m ^ 2 + P ^ 2) (hE0 : E ≠ 0) : (1 - (P * 1) ^ 2 / E ^ 2) / m ^ 2 = 1 / E ^ 2
doc: h_ij v^i v^j = (|v|² − (p·v)²/E²)/m² を動径方向 v = p/P で評価すると 1/E²

name: h_tangential
stmt: theorem h_tangential (m E v2 : ℝ) (hm : m ≠ 0) (hE0 : E ≠ 0) : (v2 - 0 ^ 2 / E ^ 2) / m ^ 2 = v2 / m ^ 2
doc: p に垂直な v(p·v = 0)では h(v, v) = |v|²/m²

name: h_rapidity
stmt: theorem h_rapidity (m η : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) : HasDerivAt (fun t => m * sinh t) (m * cosh η) η ∧ (m * cosh η) ^ 2 / (m ^ 2 + (m * sinh η) ^ 2) = 1 ∧ (m * sinh η) ^ 2 / m ^ 2 = sinh η ^ 2

name: warped_curvature
stmt: theorem warped_curvature : Om f1 f2 S C 1 0 0 1 = f2 ∧ Om f1 f2 S C 2 0 0 2 = f2 * S ∧ Om f1 f2 S C 2 1 1 2 = (f1 ^ 2 - 1) * S ∧ Om f1 f2 S C 1 0 0 2 = 0 ∧ Om f1 f2 S C 1 0 1 2 = 0 ∧ Om f1 f2 S C 2 0 0 1 = 0 ∧ Om f1 f2 S C 2 0 1 2 = 0 ∧ Om f1 f2 S C 2 1 0 1 = 0 ∧ Om f1 f2 S C 2 1 0 2 = 0

name: sectional
doc: 枠の成分に直す(e^s = ds、e^θ = f dθ、e^φ = fS dφ)と断面曲率は −f″/f、−f″/f、(1 − f′²)/f²

name: h3_curvature
stmt: theorem h3_curvature (η : ℝ) (hη : η ≠ 0) : -(sinh η / sinh η) = -1 ∧ (1 - cosh η ^ 2) / sinh η ^ 2 = -1 ∧ HasDerivAt sinh (cosh η) η ∧ HasDerivAt cosh (sinh η) η
doc: H³:f = sinh η で三つの断面曲率はすべて −1

name: cap_curvature
stmt: theorem cap_curvature (l x : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hx : sin x ≠ 0) : -((-(sin x) / l) / (l * sin x)) = 1 / l ^ 2 ∧ (1 - cos x ^ 2) / (l * sin x) ^ 2 = 1 / l ^ 2
doc: 検算:帽子 f = ℓ sin(s/ℓ) ではすべて +1/ℓ²

name: c10

name: c21

name: sum_nonneg'

name: En_pos

name: En_sq

name: qmap_bij

name: id_bog1
stmt: theorem id_bog1 {Z : ℝ → ℝ} {Z' x : ℝ} (hZ : HasDerivAt Z Z' x) (h0 : Z x ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun y => (Z y)⁻¹) (-Z' / Z x ^ 2) x

name: id_bog1_form
stmt: theorem id_bog1_form (Z Z' : ℝ) : -Z' / Z ^ 2 = -(Z⁻¹ * (Z' * Z⁻¹))
doc: −Z′/Z² = −(1/Z)(Z′/Z):W = 1/Z、h = Z′/Z なら W′ = −W h

name: id_bog2
stmt: theorem id_bog2 (Z Z' Z'' Zi xi : ℝ) (hZi : Z * Zi = 1) (hZ : Z * Z'' - Z' ^ 2 = (Z ^ 2 - 1) * xi ^ 2) : Z'' * Zi - Z' ^ 2 * Zi ^ 2 = (1 - Zi ^ 2) * xi ^ 2

name: id_Z_sinh
stmt: theorem id_Z_sinh (s c xi : ℝ) (hcs : c ^ 2 - s ^ 2 = 1) : (s * xi) * (s * xi - 2 * c * xi ^ 2 + 2 * s * xi ^ 3) - (c * xi - s * xi ^ 2) ^ 2 = ((s * xi) ^ 2 - 1) * xi ^ 2

name: id_tt_count
stmt: theorem id_tt_count (n : ℝ) : 2 * ((n + 2) * (n - 2)) = 2 * (n ^ 2 - 4)

name: id_parity
stmt: theorem id_parity (lam : ℝ) : 2 * (1 - lam) - 1 = -(2 * lam - 1)

name: id_even
stmt: theorem id_even (f : ℝ) : (1 - (-f) ^ 2) ^ 2 = (1 - f ^ 2) ^ 2

name: id_inv_kinetic
stmt: theorem id_inv_kinetic (a r ad rd l : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hl : l ≠ 0) : -(a * r / l) * (-(l ^ 2 * rd / r ^ 2)) ^ 2 - 2 * (l ^ 2 / r) * ((ad * r + a * rd) / l) * (-(l ^ 2 * rd / r ^ 2)) = -(l ^ 3 / r ^ 3) * (-a * rd ^ 2 - 2 * r * ad * rd)

name: id_inv_potential
stmt: theorem id_inv_potential (a r l : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hl : l ≠ 0) : (a * r / l) * (1 - l ^ 2 / (l ^ 2 / r) ^ 2) = -(r ^ 3 / l ^ 3) * (a * (1 - l ^ 2 / r ^ 2))

name: id_yamabe_k0
stmt: theorem id_yamabe_k0 (n : ℝ) : 0 * (0 + n - 1) - n = -n

name: id_Z_integral
stmt: theorem id_Z_integral (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) : (1 / 2) * ∫ u in (-1 : ℝ)..1, Real.exp (x * u) = Real.sinh x / x

name: cap_constraint
doc:
キャップの拘束:u = s/ℓ、S = sin u ≠ 0、C = cos u のとき
    r = ℓS、r′ = C、r″ = −S/ℓ、W = r′、W′ = −S/ℓ で両辺は 6/ℓ²

name: neck_constraint
doc: 首の拘束:r = ℓ、r′ = 0、r″ = 0、W = 0 で両辺は 2/ℓ²

name: cap_r_deriv
stmt: theorem cap_r_deriv (l s : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun s => l * sin (s / l)) (cos (s / l)) s
doc: キャップの r と r′ の導関数

name: cap_rp_deriv
stmt: theorem cap_rp_deriv (l s : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun s => cos (s / l)) (-sin (s / l) / l) s

name: junction_jumps
stmt: theorem junction_jumps (l : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : l - l * sin (π * l / 2 / l) = 0 ∧ (0 : ℝ) - cos (π * l / 2 / l) = 0 ∧ (0 : ℝ) - (-sin (π * l / 2 / l) / l) = 1 / l
doc: 接合 s = πℓ/2 での跳び(首 − キャップ):[r] = 0、[r′] = 0、[r″] = 1/ℓ

name: cap_energy
stmt: theorem cap_energy (l : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) : ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(π * l / 2), ((-sin (s / l) / l) ^ 2 + (1 - cos (s / l) ^ 2) ^ 2 / (2 * (l * sin (s / l)) ^ 2)) = 3 * π / (8 * l)
doc: キャップの YM エネルギー ∫₀^{πℓ/2} [r″² + (1 − r′²)²/(2r²)] ds = 3π/(8ℓ)

name: neck_energy
doc: 首の YM エネルギー:∫₀^L (1/(2ℓ²)) ds = L/(2ℓ²)

name: endpoint_F
stmt: theorem endpoint_F (κ s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) : HasDerivAt (fun s => s ^ (-κ)) (-κ * s ^ (-κ - 1)) s ∧ -κ * s ^ (-κ - 1) + κ / s * s ^ (-κ) = 0
doc: F = s^{−κ} は F′ + (κ/s)F = 0 を満たす(s > 0)

name: endpoint_G
stmt: theorem endpoint_G (κ s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) : HasDerivAt (fun s => s ^ κ) (κ * s ^ (κ - 1)) s ∧ -(κ * s ^ (κ - 1)) + κ / s * s ^ κ = 0
doc: G = s^{κ} は −G′ + (κ/s)G = 0 を満たす(s > 0)

name: not_L2_half
stmt: theorem not_L2_half : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => ∫ s in ε..1, s⁻¹) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop

name: not_L2_gt
