name: ii
stmt: private lemma ii (n : ℕ) (a b : ℝ) : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ n) MeasureTheory.volume a b

name: beta23
stmt: theorem beta23 : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, x * (1 - x) ^ 2 = 1 / 12
doc: Beta(2,3) の正規化:∫₀¹ x(1 − x)² dx = 1/12(= B(2,3))

name: beta23_m1
doc: E[X] = 12 ∫₀¹ x · x(1 − x)² dx = 2/5

name: beta23_m2
doc: E[X²] = 12 ∫₀¹ x² · x(1 − x)² dx = 1/5

name: z28d_coefficient
stmt: theorem z28d_coefficient : let m1 : ℚ

name: ju_location
stmt: theorem ju_location (l x : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < π * l) : l * sin (x / l) = l ↔ x = π * l / 2
doc: つなぐ場所:帽子の面積半径 ℓ sin(x/ℓ) が首の ℓ に等しいのは赤道だけ

name: ju_C1_auto
stmt: theorem ju_C1_auto (l x : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (h : x = π * l / 2) : cos (x / l) = 0
doc: 赤道では帽子の r′ = cos(x/ℓ) = 0。首の r′ = 0 と一致する(C¹ は自動)

name: ju_cap_second
stmt: theorem ju_cap_second (l : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun x => cos (x / l)) (-1 / l) (π * l / 2)
doc: 帽子の r″(r′ = cos(x/ℓ) の微分)は赤道で −1/ℓ

name: ju_jump_fixed
stmt: theorem ju_jump_fixed {v0 v1 l : ℝ} (hl : 0 < l) {Wup Wum Wuvp Wuvm Gf : ℝ → ℝ} (hp : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt Wup (Wuvp v) (Icc v0 v1) v) (hm : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt Wum (Wuvm v) (Icc v0 v1) v) (sP : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, Wuvp v = Gf v) (sM : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, Wuvm v = Gf v) (cP : Wup v0 = 1 / (Real.sqrt 2 * l)) (cM : Wum v0 = 0) : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, Wup v - Wum v = 1 / (Real.sqrt 2 * l) ∧ Wup v - Wum v ≠ 0
doc: 跳びの大きさ:角で帽子 W_u = 1/(√2ℓ)、首 W_u = 0 なら、前線の上のすべての点で [W_u] = 1/(√2ℓ) ≠ 0

name: ju_theorem_A
stmt: theorem ju_theorem_A (l x τ : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < π * l) (hτ : τ ≠ 0) (hτl : τ ^ 2 ≤ l ^ 2) : (l * sin (x / l) = l ↔ x = π * l / 2) ∧ (x = π * l / 2 → cos (x / l) = 0) ∧ HasDerivAt (fun x => cos (x / l)) (-1 / l) (π * l / 2) ∧ (-1 / l ≠ (0 : ℝ)) ∧ (∀ y : ℝ, 2 * l ^ 2 * y ^ 2 + 2 * l * y + l ^ 2 * (1 - 0 ^ 2) ^ 2 / l ^ 2 - (1 - 0 ^ 2) = 0 ↔ y = 0 ∨ y = -1 / l) ∧ Real.sqrt (l ^ 2 - τ ^ 2) ≠ l
doc:
定理 A(切り口の部分):場所は赤道だけ、C¹ は自動、r″ は −1/ℓ と 0 で一致せず、拘束の根はこの二つだけ、
  時間的な管ではつなげない

name: ks_hamiltonian
stmt: theorem ks_hamiltonian (a r ad rd Wd c l : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hl : l ≠ 0) : -(-2 * c * r * rd) * (-2 * c * (a * rd + r * ad)) / (2 * r) + a * (-2 * c * r * rd) ^ 2 / (4 * r ^ 2) + (4 * c * l ^ 2 * a * Wd) ^ 2 / (8 * l ^ 2 * a) = c ^ 2 * (-a * rd ^ 2 - 2 * r * ad * rd + 2 * l ^ 2 * a * Wd ^ 2)

name: ks_inversion_theta
stmt: theorem ks_inversion_theta (r l : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hl : l ≠ 0) : -(l ^ 2 / r + l ^ 2 / (l ^ 2 / r)) / 2 = -(r + l ^ 2 / r) / 2

name: ks_inversion_sigma
stmt: theorem ks_inversion_sigma (a r l : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hl : l ≠ 0) : (a * r / l) ^ 2 * (l ^ 2 / r) / 2 = a ^ 2 * r / 2

name: ks_fold_id
stmt: theorem ks_fold_id (r l : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) : r + l ^ 2 / r - 2 * l = (r - l) ^ 2 / r

name: ks_fold_le
stmt: theorem ks_fold_le (r l : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) : -(r + l ^ 2 / r) / 2 ≤ -l

name: ks_fold_eq
stmt: theorem ks_fold_eq (r l : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (h : -(r + l ^ 2 / r) / 2 = -l) : r = l

name: ks_inverted
stmt: theorem ks_inverted (W l : ℝ) : l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 = l ^ 2 - 2 * l ^ 2 * W ^ 2 + l ^ 2 * W ^ 4

name: oc_raychaudhuri
stmt: theorem oc_raychaudhuri (r Om ru ruu Omu Wu : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hO : Om ≠ 0) (hC : ruu - Omu / Om * ru + 2 * Wu ^ 2 / r = 0) : (ruu * Om - ru * Omu) / Om ^ 2 = -(2 * Wu ^ 2 / (r * Om))
doc: 拘束 C_u = r_uu − (Ω_u/Ω) r_u + 2W_u²/r = 0 から (r_u/Ω)_u = (r_uu Ω − r_u Ω_u)/Ω² = −2W_u²/(rΩ)

name: oc_raychaudhuri_sign
stmt: theorem oc_raychaudhuri_sign (r Om Wu : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hO : 0 < Om) : -(2 * Wu ^ 2 / (r * Om)) ≤ 0
doc: 右辺は r > 0、Ω > 0 で 0 以下

name: oc_trapped
stmt: theorem oc_trapped {g g' : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : ∀ x, HasDerivAt g (g' x) x) (hneg : ∀ x, g' x ≤ 0) (h0 : g 0 = 0) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : g x ≤ 0
doc: 微分が 0 以下で初めに 0 なら、以後 0 以下(g = r_u/Ω を波面から測る)

name: oc_attractor
stmt: theorem oc_attractor (p q x : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (hx : 0 < x) : 2 * p * q ≤ p ^ 2 / x + q ^ 2 * x ∧ (p ^ 2 / x + q ^ 2 * x = 2 * p * q ↔ x = p / q)
doc: 有効ポテンシャル p²/x + q²x(x = e^{2φ} > 0)は 2pq 以上で、等号は x = p/q(アトラクター)

name: oc_EB
stmt: theorem oc_EB (p q r : ℝ) (hp : p ≠ 0) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0) : p * q / r ^ 4 ≠ 0
doc: E·B ∝ pq/r⁴ は p, q ≠ 0 なら 0 でない

name: oc_higgs_vev
stmt: theorem oc_higgs_vev (W v r lam : ℝ) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0) (h : -2 * W ^ 2 * v / r ^ 2 - lam * (v ^ 2 - v ^ 2) * v = 0) : W = 0
doc: Higgs の方程式の一様な解 h = v(真空の値)は −2W²v/r² − λ(v² − v²)v = 0、つまり W = 0 を要求する

name: oc_higgs_sym
stmt: theorem oc_higgs_sym (lam v : ℝ) : lam / 4 * (0 ^ 2 - v ^ 2) ^ 2 = lam * v ^ 4 / 4
doc: 対称な相 h = 0 のポテンシャルエネルギー (λ/4)(h² − v²)² = λv⁴/4(宇宙定数として加わる)

name: oc_ads_global
stmt: theorem oc_ads_global (η χ : ℝ) : -(cos η) ^ 2 - (sin η) ^ 2 + (cos χ) ^ 2 = -(sin χ) ^ 2
doc:
首 AdS₂ の大域座標の埋め込み(sin χ をかけた形):X₀ = cos η/sin χ、X₁ = sin η/sin χ、X₂ = cos χ/sin χ は
  −X₀² − X₁² + X₂² = −1 をみたす

name: oc_ads_sync
stmt: theorem oc_ads_sync (t z : ℝ) : -(cos t * cosh z) ^ 2 - (sin t) ^ 2 + (cos t * sinh z) ^ 2 = -1
doc: 同期座標 −dt² + cos²t dz² の埋め込み:X₀ = cos t cosh z、X₁ = sin t、X₂ = cos t sinh z

name: oc_focus
stmt: theorem oc_focus (l t z η χ : ℝ) (ht : cos t = 0) (h0 : cos t * cosh z * sin χ = cos η) (h2 : cos t * sinh z * sin χ = cos χ) : cos η = 0 ∧ cos χ = 0 ∧ l * cos η = 0
doc:
同期座標の焦点 cos t = 0(t = π/2)では X₀ = X₂ = 0、つまり cos η = 0、cos χ = 0:
  焦点は η = π/2、χ = π/2 の一点。同じ η で帽子の倍率 ℓ cos η も 0(崩壊)

name: oc_omega_level
stmt: theorem oc_omega_level (M l : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hM : M ≠ 0) : M / 2 * l ^ 2 = n + 1 / 2 ↔ l ^ 2 = (2 * n + 1) / M
doc: Ω の振動子(質量 M、振動数 1):古典のエネルギー (M/2)ℓ² を n + ½ とおくと ℓ² = (2n + 1)/M

name: oc_well
doc:
一様な YM のポテンシャル V = K(1 − f²)²:障壁の頂上 f = 0 で V = K(帽子のエネルギー)、
  井戸の底 f = 1 で V″ = K(12f² − 4) = 8K、質量 2K なので振動数の 2 乗は 4(振動数 2)

name: oc_parity
stmt: theorem oc_parity (m n : ℕ) : (2 * (m : ℝ) + 1) ≠ n + 1 / 2
doc: 弱結合の YM の準位 2m + 1 は、Ω の準位 n + ½ と一致しない

name: oc_discrete_casimir
stmt: theorem oc_discrete_casimir (h : ℝ) : -1 / 4 ≤ h * (h - 1) ∧ h * (h - 1) ≠ -1
doc: 実のウェイト h の表現(離散系列)の Casimir h(h − 1) は −1/4 以上で、−1 にはならない

name: oc_principal
stmt: theorem oc_principal : -(1 / 4 : ℝ) - (Real.sqrt 3 / 2) ^ 2 = -1
doc: 首の W(m²ℓ² = −1)のウェイト Δ = ½ ± iν、ν = √3/2:Δ(Δ − 1) の実部 −¼ − ν² = −1(主系列)

name: oc_node_spacing
stmt: theorem oc_node_spacing : Real.sqrt 3 / 2 * (2 * π / Real.sqrt 3) = π
doc: 喉の中のモード e^{−s/2}cos(√3 s/2) の節の間隔は 2π/√3(位相 √3 s/2 が π 進む)

name: oc_invariant_not_regular
stmt: theorem oc_invariant_not_regular (r : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ) (hconst : ∀ χ, r χ = a) (h0 : r 0 = 0) : ∀ χ, r χ = 0
doc:
sl(2,ℝ) で不変な配位は r = Ω sin χ が定数(oq_neck_unique)。極で r = 0 なら恒等的に 0:
  正則な(両極で閉じた)宇宙は対称性で不変になれない

name: ol_ym_energy
stmt: theorem ol_ym_energy {f f1 : ℝ → ℝ} (η : ℝ) (hf : HasDerivAt f (f1 η) η) (hf1 : HasDerivAt f1 (2 * f η * (1 - f η * f η)) η) : HasDerivAt (fun η => f1 η * f1 η + (1 - f η * f η) * (1 - f η * f η)) 0 η
doc: 一様な YM 場 f(η) の方程式 f″ = 2f(1 − f²) のもとで、エネルギー f′² + (1 − f²)² は保存する

name: ol_sphaleron_rate
stmt: theorem ol_sphaleron_rate (e : ℝ) : Real.sqrt 2 * (Real.sqrt 2 * e) = 2 * e
doc: 障壁の頂上 f = 0 のまわりの線形化 δf″ = 2δf:e^{√2η} の 2 階微分の係数は (√2)² = 2(成長率 √2)

name: ol_geometry_rigid
stmt: theorem ol_geometry_rigid (a η η0 : ℝ) : (-(a * sin (η - η0))) ^ 2 + (a * cos (η - η0)) ^ 2 = a ^ 2
doc: 幾何は変わらない:Ω = a cos(η − η₀)(Ω″ = −Ω の解)では Ω′² + Ω² = a²(η によらない)

name: ol_hp_sign
stmt: theorem ol_hp_sign (r L G : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hL : 0 < L) (hG : 0 < G) : r / (4 * G) * (1 - r ^ 2 / L ^ 2) < 0 ↔ L < r
doc: 自由エネルギーの差 F = (r/4G)(1 − r²/L²) が負になるのは、地平線の半径が r > L のとき

name: ol_hp_temperature
stmt: theorem ol_hp_temperature (L : ℝ) (hL : L ≠ 0) : (1 + 3 * L ^ 2 / L ^ 2) / (4 * π * L) = 1 / (π * L)
doc: 温度 T = (1 + 3r²/L²)/(4πr) は r = L で 1/(πL)

name: ol_ps_W
stmt: theorem ol_ps_W (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hs : sinh x ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun x => x / sinh x) (-(x / sinh x) * (cosh x / sinh x - 1 / x)) x
doc: W = x/sinh x は W′ = −W·h(h = coth x − 1/x)をみたす

name: ol_ps_h
stmt: theorem ol_ps_h (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hs : sinh x ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun x => cosh x / sinh x - x⁻¹) ((1 - (x / sinh x) ^ 2) / x ^ 2) x
doc: h = coth x − 1/x は h′ = (1 − W²)/x² をみたす

name: ol_reduced_action
stmt: theorem ol_reduced_action (S Ω0 Bx ree rcc : ℝ) (hw : ree - rcc = -S * (Bx - Ω0)) : S ^ 2 * (6 * Ω0 ^ 2 - 6 * Ω0 * Bx) = 6 * (Ω0 * S) * (ree - rcc)
doc: sin²χ(6Ω² − 6Ω□̂Ω) = 6r(r_ηη − r_χχ)、r = Ω sin χ(oq_radius_wave の関係 hw を使う)

name: ol_gauge_k2
stmt: theorem ol_gauge_k2 (χ : ℝ) : cos χ * sin χ = sin (2 * χ) / 2
doc: ゲージの摂動 f = cos χ cos 2η は r = f sin χ = ½ sin 2χ cos 2η(k = 2 のモード)

name: ol_gauge_count
stmt: theorem ol_gauge_count : 2 * 3 = 2 + 2 + 2
doc: 3 つの生成子が除く位相空間の次元 2 × 3 = 6 は、3 つの振動子(Ω の k = 1、k = 2、W の n = 0)の 2 + 2 + 2

name: oq_M_superpos
doc:
Ω = A c + B w(c = cos η、s = sin η、w = 1/sin u、t = cot u、w² = 1 + t²)。
  Ω_ηη = −A c、Ω_uu = B w(2w² − 1)、Ω_η = −A s、Ω_u = −B w t を入れた kl 成分

name: oq_D
doc: (1 − W²)² = sin⁴u·M/2 = A²S⁴ + 2ABcS + B²

name: oq_product
stmt: theorem oq_product (A B c s S C W We Wu D : ℝ) (h1 : -4 * (W * (1 - W ^ 2)) * We = -2 * A * B * s * S) (h2 : -4 * (W * (1 - W ^ 2)) * Wu = 4 * A ^ 2 * S ^ 3 * C + 2 * A * B * c * C) (h3 : We * Wu * S = A * B * s * C) (hD : (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 = D) : A * B * s * C * (4 * W ^ 2 * D + S ^ 2 * (2 * A ^ 2 * S ^ 3 + A * B * c)) = 0
doc: D = (1 − W²)² を η と u で微分した式(h1、h2)と W_η W_u·S = AB s C(h3、N₊ − N₋ から)を合わせる

name: oq_cubic_no_four
doc: 2 次の項と定数項だけをもつ 3 次式 k r³ + a r² + e(k ≠ 0)は、相異なる 4 点で 0 になれない

name: oq_no_superposition
stmt: theorem oq_no_superposition (A B S σ : ℝ) (c r : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hσ : σ ≠ 0) (hr : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → r i ≠ r j) (hD : ∀ i, r i ^ 2 = A ^ 2 * S ^ 4 + 2 * A * B * c i * S + B ^ 2) (hrel : ∀ i, -(S ^ 2 * (2 * A ^ 2 * S ^ 3 + A * B * c i)) = 4 * (1 - σ * r i) * r i ^ 2) : False
doc:
α-XIV.8:S = sin u を止め、cos η の 4 つの値 cᵢ で r_i = √D_i が相異なるとする(AB ≠ 0 なら可能)。
  各点で −S²(2A²S³ + ABcᵢ) = 4W²D、W² = 1 − σrᵢ、rᵢ² = Dᵢ が成り立つことはない

name: oq_osc_unique
stmt: theorem oq_osc_unique {y y1 : ℝ → ℝ} {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) (hy : ∀ x, HasDerivAt y (y1 x) x) (hy1 : ∀ x, HasDerivAt y1 (-(κ * y x)) x) (h0 : y 0 = 0) (h1 : y1 0 = 0) : ∀ x, y x = 0

name: oq_osc_solution
stmt: theorem oq_osc_solution {q q1 : ℝ → ℝ} (hq : ∀ x, HasDerivAt q (q1 x) x) (hq1 : ∀ x, HasDerivAt q1 (-(q x)) x) : ∀ x, q x = q 0 * cos x + q1 0 * sin x
doc: q″ = −q の解は q(0)cos η + q′(0)sin η だけ

name: oq_fc_over_sin
stmt: theorem oq_fc_over_sin {Fc Fcc : ℝ → ℝ} (χ : ℝ) (hFc : HasDerivAt Fc (Fcc χ) χ) (hS : sin χ ≠ 0) (hode : Fcc χ * sin χ - cos χ * Fc χ = 0) : HasDerivAt (fun χ => Fc χ / sin χ) 0 χ
doc: f_χχ sin χ = cos χ f_χ(rr_chi_ode の結論)なら、f_χ/sin χ の χ 微分は 0

name: oq_testfield
doc:
δW = S²u(x)(x = C = cos χ、S = sin χ)。δW_χχ = 2(C² − S²)u − 5S²C u′ + S⁴u″ を入れると
  δW_χχ + (1 − 3C²)u = S²[(1 − C²)u″ − 5C u′ − u]

name: oq_spectrum
doc:
Gegenbauer の方程式 (1 − x²)u″ − 5xu′ + n(n + 4)u = 0 の解では固有値は −(n² + 4n + 1) < 0:
  g″ = −(n² + 4n + 1)g で、すべてのモードが振動する(n = 0 は共形 Killing のゲージモード、振動数 1)

name: oq_action_quadratic
stmt: theorem oq_action_quadratic (Ω Bx : ℝ) (hΩ : Ω ≠ 0) : Ω ^ 4 * ((6 - 6 * Bx / Ω) / Ω ^ 2) = 6 * Ω ^ 2 - 6 * Ω * Bx
doc: 共形の枠の Einstein–Hilbert の密度:√g R = Ω⁴·(6 − 6□̂Ω/Ω)/Ω² = 6Ω² − 6Ω□̂Ω(Ω の 2 次式)

name: oq_radius_wave
stmt: theorem oq_radius_wave (S C Ω0 Ωc Ωcc Ωee : ℝ) (hS : S ≠ 0) : Ωee * S - (Ωcc * S + 2 * Ωc * C - Ω0 * S) = -S * (-Ωee + Ωcc + 2 * (C / S) * Ωc - Ω0)
doc:
面積半径 r = Ω sin χ:r_ηη = Ω_ηη S、r_χχ = Ω_χχ S + 2Ω_χ C − Ω S。
  r_ηη − r_χχ = −S·(−Ω_ηη + Ω_χχ + 2(C/S)Ω_χ − Ω):トレースの方程式 ⇔ r は 2 次元の波動方程式の解

name: oq_periodic
stmt: theorem oq_periodic (F : ℝ → ℝ) (hpole : ∀ η, F (η + π) - F (η - π) = 0) : ∀ x, F (x + 2 * π) = F x
doc: r = F(η + χ) − F(η − χ) がもう一方の極 χ = π でも 0 なら、F は周期 2π

name: oq_antipodal
stmt: theorem oq_antipodal (F : ℝ → ℝ) (hper : ∀ x, F (x + 2 * π) = F x) (η χ : ℝ) : F ((η + π) + (π - χ)) - F ((η + π) - (π - χ)) = -(F (η + χ) - F (η - χ))
doc:
対蹠の写像 (η, χ) ↦ (η + π, π − χ) で r ↦ −r(sin(π − χ) = sin χ なので Ω ↦ −Ω、計量 Ω²ĝ は不変):
  Ω = 0 の面(始まりと終わり)を越えると、宇宙は対蹠の像として繰り返す

name: oq_cap_dalembert
stmt: theorem oq_cap_dalembert (l η χ : ℝ) : l * cos η * sin χ = l / 2 * sin (η + χ) - l / 2 * sin (η - χ)
doc: 帽子:ℓ cos η sin χ = F(η + χ) − F(η − χ)、F = (ℓ/2) sin

name: oq_energy_coeff
stmt: theorem oq_energy_coeff (G : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) : 1 / (16 * π * G) * 6 * (2 * π ^ 2) = 3 * π / (4 * G)
doc: 一様なモードの作用の係数:(1/(16πG))·6·(S³ の体積 2π²) = 3π/(4G)

name: oq_classical_scale
stmt: theorem oq_classical_scale (G g l : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) : 3 * π / (4 * G) * l ^ 2 = 3 * π ^ 2 / g ^ 2 ↔ l ^ 2 = 4 * π * G / g ^ 2
doc: 拘束(全エネルギー 0):(3π/(4G))ℓ² = 3π²/g² ⇔ ℓ² = 4πG/g²

name: oq_quantized_scale
doc:
振動数 1 の調和振動子として両方のエネルギーを n + ½ とおくと(ℏ = 1)
  ℓ²/G = 4(n + ½)/(3π)、g²/(4π) = 3π/(4n + 2)

name: oq_sl2_bracket
doc:
共形 Killing ベクトル ξ₁ = (sC, cS)、ξ₂ = (cC, −sS)((η, χ) 成分、c = cos η、s = sin η、C = cos χ、S = sin χ)の
  交換子:[ξ₁, ξ₂] = −∂_η。∂_η との交換子 [∂_η, ξ₁] = ξ₂、[∂_η, ξ₂] = −ξ₁ と合わせて so(2,1) ≅ sl(2,ℝ)
  (偏微分は手で入れた:∂_η(sC) = cC、∂_χ(sC) = −sS など)

name: oq_neck_invariant
stmt: theorem oq_neck_invariant (l c s C S : ℝ) (hS : S ≠ 0) : (c * S) * (-(l * C / S ^ 2)) + (c * C) * (l / S) = 0 ∧ (-(s * S)) * (-(l * C / S ^ 2)) + (-(s * C)) * (l / S) = 0
doc:
首 Ω = ℓ/sin χ、W = 0 は三つの生成子すべてで不変:δΩ = ξ(Ω) + ψΩ = 0(ξ₁:ψ = cC、ξ₂:ψ = −sC)。
  帽子のゲージの対称性(静的宇宙の共形 Killing)は、ちょうど首 AdS₂ の等長変換

name: oq_neck_unique
stmt: theorem oq_neck_unique {Ω Ωc : ℝ → ℝ} (χ : ℝ) (hΩ : HasDerivAt Ω (Ωc χ) χ) (hinv : sin χ * Ωc χ + cos χ * Ω χ = 0) : HasDerivAt (fun χ => Ω χ * sin χ) 0 χ
doc: 逆:静的で ξ₁ で不変(sin χ Ω_χ + cos χ Ω = 0)なら Ω sin χ は定数、つまり Ω = 定数/sin χ(首だけ)

name: oq_potential_shift
stmt: theorem oq_potential_shift (S C : ℝ) (hS : S ≠ 0) (h : S ^ 2 + C ^ 2 = 1) : (1 - 3 * C ^ 2) / S ^ 2 = (1 - 3 * 1 ^ 2) / S ^ 2 + 3
doc:
帽子の上の YM のポテンシャルは、真空(W = ±1)の上のポテンシャル −2/sin²χ に定数 3 を足したもの。
  真空の上の振動数 n + 2(整数)に対し、帽子の上では ω² = (n + 2)² − 3

name: os_area_linear
stmt: theorem os_area_linear (r ru rv ruv Om W l : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (h : ruv = 2⁻¹ * Om * (l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 / r ^ 2 - 1) / r - ru * rv / r) : 2 * r * ruv + 2 * ru * rv = Om / r ^ 2 * (l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 - r ^ 2)
doc: 面積 R = r² の式:R_uv = 2 r r_uv + 2 r_u r_v = (Ω/r²)(ℓ²(1 − W²)² − r²)

name: os_Q_eq
stmt: theorem os_Q_eq (r ru rv ruv Om Omu Omv Omuv W l : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hO : Om ≠ 0) (h1 : ruv = 2⁻¹ * Om * (l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 / r ^ 2 - 1) / r - ru * rv / r) (h2 : Omuv = Omu * Omv / Om - 2 * Om * ruv / r - Om ^ 2 * l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 / r ^ 4) : (Omuv / Om - Omu * Omv / Om ^ 2) - 2 * (ruv / r - ru * rv / r ^ 2) = 6 * ru * rv / r ^ 2 - 3 * Om * l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 / r ^ 4 + 2 * Om / r ^ 2
doc: Q = ln(Ω/r²) の式:Q_uv = (ln Ω)_uv − 2(ln r)_uv = 6 r_u r_v/r² − 3Ωℓ²(1 − W²)²/r⁴ + 2Ω/r²

name: os_backreaction
stmt: theorem os_backreaction (Om l r W : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun W : ℝ => -3 * Om * l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 / r ^ 4) (12 * Om * l ^ 2 * W * (1 - W ^ 2) / r ^ 4) W
doc: Q の源の W についての微分

name: os_backreaction_ne
stmt: theorem os_backreaction_ne (Om l r W : ℝ) (hO : Om ≠ 0) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hW : W ≠ 0) (h1 : 1 - W ^ 2 ≠ 0) : 12 * Om * l ^ 2 * W * (1 - W ^ 2) / r ^ 4 ≠ 0
doc: 反作用は一次で避けられない:W ≠ 0、W² ≠ 1 なら源の微分は 0 でない

name: os_graviton
stmt: theorem os_graviton (a a' a'' h h' h'' n : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : a'' = -a) (hh : h'' = -(2 * (a' / a) * h') - (n ^ 2 - 1) * h) : a'' * h + 2 * a' * h' + a * h'' = -n ^ 2 * (a * h)
doc: 帽子の上の重力波:a″ = −a、h″ = −2(a′/a)h′ − (n² − 1)h なら (a h)″ = −n²(a h)

name: os_graviton_count
stmt: theorem os_graviton_count : 2 * (3 ^ 2 - 4) = (10 : ℕ)
doc: 縮退度 2(n² − 4) は最低の n = 3 で 10

name: os_yamabe_factor
stmt: theorem os_yamabe_factor (k n : ℝ) : k * (k + n - 1) - n = (k - 1) * (k + n)
doc: 共形の方向の第二変分の係数:k(k + n − 1) − n = (k − 1)(k + n)

name: os_yamabe_l1
stmt: theorem os_yamabe_l1 (n : ℝ) : 1 * (1 + n - 1) - n = 0

name: os_yamabe_l2
stmt: theorem os_yamabe_l2 (n : ℝ) : 2 * (2 + n - 1) - n = n + 2

name: os_shape_S9
doc: S⁹:k = 2 の係数は 11、k = 2 の調和関数の個数は 10·11/2 − 1 = 54

name: cap_box
stmt: theorem cap_box (l η : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun e => l * cos e) (-(l * sin η)) η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun e => -(l * sin e)) (-(l * cos η)) η ∧ -(-(l * cos η)) = l * cos η
doc: 【柱 3】帽子 Ω = ℓ cos η:□̂Ω = −Ω̈ = Ω

name: neck_derivs
stmt: theorem neck_derivs (l u : ℝ) (hs : sin u ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun v => l / sin v) (-(l * cos u) / sin u ^ 2) u ∧ HasDerivAt (fun v => -(l * cos v) / sin v ^ 2) (l * (1 + cos u ^ 2) / sin u ^ 3) u
doc: 首 Ω = ℓ/sin u の 1 階と 2 階の微分

name: neck_box
stmt: theorem neck_box (l u : ℝ) (hs : sin u ≠ 0) : l * (1 + cos u ^ 2) / sin u ^ 3 + 2 * (cos u / sin u) * (-(l * cos u) / sin u ^ 2) = l / sin u
doc: 【柱 3】首 Ω = ℓ/sin u:□̂Ω = Ω″ + 2 cot u Ω′ = Ω

name: static_general
stmt: theorem static_general (A B u : ℝ) (hs : sin u ≠ 0) : ((A + B * u) * sin u ^ 2 - 2 * cos u * (B * sin u - (A + B * u) * cos u)) / sin u ^ 3 + 2 * (cos u / sin u) * ((B * sin u - (A + B * u) * cos u) / sin u ^ 2) = (A + B * u) / sin u
doc:
【柱 3】静的な Ω = f/sin u(f = A + Bu)は □̂Ω = Ω をみたす:
Ω′ = (B sin u − f cos u)/sin²u、Ω″ = (f sin²u − 2cos u(B sin u − f cos u))/sin³u

name: static_general_deriv
stmt: theorem static_general_deriv (A B u : ℝ) (hs : sin u ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun v => (A + B * v) / sin v) ((B * sin u - (A + B * u) * cos u) / sin u ^ 2) u
doc: 静的な一般解の 1 階微分

name: junction_seam
stmt: theorem junction_seam (l : ℝ) : l / sin (π / 2) = l ∧ -(l * cos (π / 2)) / sin (π / 2) ^ 2 = 0 ∧ l * (1 + cos (π / 2) ^ 2) / sin (π / 2) ^ 3 = l
doc:
【柱 3】接合の跳び = 倍率の縫い目:u = π/2 で首は Ω = ℓ、Ω′ = 0、Ω″ = ℓ、帽子(時間対称)は Ω = ℓ、
Ω′ = Ω″ = 0

name: r_prime_conformal
stmt: theorem r_prime_conformal (l u : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hs : sin u ≠ 0) : ((-(l * cos u) / sin u ^ 2) * sin u + l / sin u * cos u) / (l / sin u) = 0 ∧ (0 * sin u + l * cos u) / l = cos u
doc: 【柱 3】物理の W = r′(r = Ω sin u、dρ = Ω du):r′ = (Ω′ sin u + Ω cos u)/Ω。首では 0、帽子では cos u

name: eta_neck
stmt: theorem eta_neck (G g l u : ℝ) (hg : g ≠ 0) (hs : sin u ≠ 0) : (l / sin u) ^ 2 + (-(l * cos u) / sin u ^ 2) ^ 2 = l ^ 2 / sin u ^ 4 ∧ (l ^ 2 / sin u ^ 4 = 8 * π * G * (1 / (2 * g ^ 2 * sin u ^ 4)) ↔ l ^ 2 = 4 * π * G / g ^ 2)
doc: 【柱 3】Einstein の ηη 成分(首):Ω² + Ω′² = ℓ²/sin⁴u、8πG·1/(2g²sin⁴u) と一致 ⇔ ℓ² = 4πG/g²

name: eta_cap
doc: 【柱 3】Einstein の ηη 成分(帽子):3(Ω² + Ω̇²) = 3ℓ²、8πG·3/(2g²) と一致 ⇔ ℓ² = 4πG/g²

name: periodic
stmt: theorem periodic (A B η : ℝ) : A * cos (η + 2 * π) + B * sin (η + 2 * π) = A * cos η + B * sin η
doc: 【柱 3】Ω̈ = −Ω の解 Ω = A cos η + B sin η は周期 2π(巡回)

name: cap_energy
stmt: theorem cap_energy (G l η : ℝ) : -(3 * π / (4 * G)) * ((-(l * sin η)) ^ 2 + (l * cos η) ^ 2) = -(3 * π / (4 * G)) * l ^ 2
doc: 【柱 3】Ω のエネルギー H_Ω = −(3π/4G)(Ω̇² + Ω²) は帽子 Ω = ℓ cos η で −(3π/4G)ℓ²(一定)

name: energy_balance
stmt: theorem energy_balance (G g l : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) : -(3 * π / (4 * G)) * l ^ 2 + 3 * π ^ 2 / g ^ 2 = 0 ↔ l ^ 2 = 4 * π * G / g ^ 2
doc: 【柱 3】ハミルトン拘束 H_Ω + E_YM = 0(E_YM = 3π²/g²、帽子の YM の S³ 上のエネルギー)⇔ ℓ² = 4πG/g²

name: ground_state
stmt: theorem ground_state (M x : ℝ) (hM : M ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun y => rexp (-(M * y ^ 2) / 2)) (-(M * x) * rexp (-(M * x ^ 2) / 2)) x ∧ HasDerivAt (fun y => -(M * y) * rexp (-(M * y ^ 2) / 2)) ((M ^ 2 * x ^ 2 - M) * rexp (-(M * x ^ 2) / 2)) x ∧ -(1 / (2 * M)) * ((M ^ 2 * x ^ 2 - M) * rexp (-(M * x ^ 2) / 2)) + M / 2 * x ^ 2 * rexp (-(M * x ^ 2) / 2) = 1 / 2 * rexp (-(M * x ^ 2) / 2)
doc:
【柱 3】量子化:基底状態 ψ = e^{−MΩ²/2} は −(1/2M)ψ″ + (M/2)Ω²ψ = ½ψ(ħ = 1、振動数 1)。
負のエネルギーの振動子なので H_Ω の準位は −(n + ½)(外部:調和振動子の準位)

name: quantized
doc: 【柱 3】拘束の量子化(半古典):3π²/g² = n + ½ なら ℓ² = 4πG/g² = (4G/3π)(n + ½)、α = g²/4π = 3π/(4n + 2)

name: neck_coordinate
stmt: theorem neck_coordinate (l u : ℝ) (h0 : 0 < u) (h1 : u < π) : HasDerivAt (fun v => l * Real.log (Real.tan (v / 2))) (l / Real.sin u) u
doc:
【柱 3】首の座標 x = ℓ log tan(u/2) で dx/du = ℓ/sin u:円柱 dx² + ℓ²dΩ² = (ℓ²/sin²u)(du² + sin²u dΩ²)、
x → ±∞ は u → 0、π(S³ の極)

name: extremal_limit
stmt: theorem extremal_limit (r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) : 1 - 2 * (1 - (2 * r)⁻¹) / r = (1 - 1 / r) ^ 2 ∧ HasDerivAt (fun x => 1 - (2 * x)⁻¹) ((1 - (0 : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ 2 / (2 * r ^ 2)) r
doc:
【柱 3】滑らかな道の行き先:単位磁荷の極限 RN(W = 0)は m(r) = 1 − 1/(2r)、N = 1 − 2m/r = (1 − 1/r)²
で、r = 1(= ℓ)に縮退した地平線(AdS₂ × S² の喉)をもつ。m′ = (1 − W²)²/(2r²) をみたす。
Bartnik–McKinnon 解の列はこの喉へ近づく(外部:Breitenlohner–Forgács–Maison 1993、数値で再現)

name: ch2
stmt: theorem ch2 (X : M2) : X * X = X.trace • X - X.det • (1 : M2)
doc: Cayley–Hamilton(2×2):X² = (tr X)X − (det X)·1

name: det_add_one
stmt: theorem det_add_one (X : M2) : (X + 1).det = X.det + X.trace + 1

name: trace_add_one
stmt: theorem trace_add_one (X : M2) : (X + 1).trace = X.trace + 2

name: trace_sq
stmt: theorem trace_sq (X : M2) : (X * X).trace = X.trace ^ 2 - 2 * X.det

name: trace_gram
stmt: theorem trace_gram (M : M2) : (Mᴴ * M).trace = ((Complex.normSq (M 0 0) + Complex.normSq (M 1 0) + Complex.normSq (M 0 1) + Complex.normSq (M 1 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)
doc: tr(M†M) = Σ|M_ij|²(実数)

name: det_gram
stmt: theorem det_gram (M : M2) (hM : M.det = 1) : (Mᴴ * M).det = 1

name: gram_herm
stmt: theorem gram_herm (M : M2) : (Mᴴ * M)ᴴ = Mᴴ * M

name: polar_exists
stmt: theorem polar_exists (M : M2) (hM : M.det = 1) : ∃ U B : M2, Uᴴ * U = 1 ∧ U.det = 1 ∧ Bᴴ = B ∧ B.det = 1 ∧ (∃ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ ∧ B.trace = τ) ∧ U * B = M
doc: 【柱 1】極分解の存在:det M = 1 なら M = U·B(U は SU(2)、B は正の Hermite で det 1)

name: boost_from_square
stmt: theorem boost_from_square (B : M2) (hdet : B.det = 1) (τ : ℝ) (hτ : B.trace = τ) (hτ0 : 0 < τ) : B = (τ : ℂ)⁻¹ • (B * B + 1) ∧ (τ : ℂ) ^ 2 = (B * B).trace + 2
doc: 正の Hermite で det 1 の B は B² だけで決まる:B = (B² + 1)/tr B、(tr B)² = tr(B²) + 2

name: polar_unique
stmt: theorem polar_unique (U1 U2 B1 B2 : M2) (hU1 : U1ᴴ * U1 = 1) (hU2 : U2ᴴ * U2 = 1) (hB1 : B1ᴴ = B1) (hB2 : B2ᴴ = B2) (hd1 : B1.det = 1) (hd2 : B2.det = 1) (τ1 τ2 : ℝ) (ht1 : B1.trace = τ1) (ht2 : B2.trace = τ2) (h1 : 0 < τ1) (h2 : 0 < τ2) (h : U1 * B1 = U2 * B2) : B1 = B2 ∧ U1 = U2
doc: 【柱 1】極分解の一意性

name: sphere_meets_hyperboloid
stmt: theorem sphere_meets_hyperboloid (U : M2) (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1) (hh : Uᴴ = U) (hd : U.det = 1) (τ : ℝ) (ht : U.trace = τ) (hτ : 0 < τ) : U = 1
doc:
【柱 1】球面と双曲面の交わり:回転(U†U = 1)でありブースト(U† = U、det 1、tr > 0)でもあるのは
恒等変換(頂点 = 静止)だけ

name: curvature_real
stmt: theorem curvature_real (ad : ℝ) : (1 + I * ad) ^ 2 - 2 * (1 + I * ad) = -((1 + ad ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
doc: 【柱 2】曲率の係数 c² − 2c は c = 1 + iȧ で実数 −(1 + ȧ²)

name: norm_c
stmt: theorem norm_c (ad : ℝ) : Complex.normSq (1 + I * ad) = 1 + ad ^ 2
doc: |c|² = 1 + ȧ²

name: friedmann_selfdual
stmt: theorem friedmann_selfdual (G ρ a ad : ℝ) (h : ad ^ 2 + 1 = 8 * Real.pi * G / 3 * ρ * a ^ 2) : -((1 + I * ad) ^ 2 - 2 * (1 + I * ad)) = ((8 * Real.pi * G / 3 * ρ * a ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧ Complex.normSq (1 + I * ad) = 8 * Real.pi * G / 3 * ρ * a ^ 2
doc: 【柱 2】Friedmann の式 ⇒ −(c² − 2c) = |c|² = (8πG/3)ρa²(一方向)

name: phase_lemma
stmt: theorem phase_lemma (θ : ℝ) (hc : Real.cos θ ≠ 0) : (1 + I * ((-(Real.sin θ / Real.cos θ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) * (Real.cos θ : ℂ) = Complex.exp (-(θ : ℂ) * I)
doc: 【柱 2】位相:(1 − i tan θ)·cos θ = e^{−iθ}(帽子では θ = η。首で θ = t/ℓ と読むのは解釈)

name: cap_hubble
stmt: theorem cap_hubble (l η : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hc : Real.cos η ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun e => l * Real.cos e) (l * -Real.sin η) η ∧ (l * -Real.sin η) / (l * Real.cos η) = -(Real.sin η / Real.cos η)
doc: 【柱 2】帽子 a = ℓ cos η(共形時間)の宇宙時間の膨張率 ȧ = (da/dη)/a = −tan η

name: cap_modulus
stmt: theorem cap_modulus (l η : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hc : Real.cos η ≠ 0) : 1 + (-(Real.sin η / Real.cos η)) ^ 2 = l ^ 2 / (l * Real.cos η) ^ 2
doc: 【柱 2】帽子:|c|² = 1 + tan²η = 1/cos²η = ℓ²/a²(a = ℓ cos η)

name: cap_rhs
stmt: theorem cap_rhs (G g l a : ℝ) (hg : g ≠ 0) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hℓ : l ^ 2 = 4 * Real.pi * G / g ^ 2) : 8 * Real.pi * G / 3 * (3 / (2 * g ^ 2 * a ^ 4)) * a ^ 2 = l ^ 2 / a ^ 2
doc: 【柱 2】帽子の Friedmann の右辺:ρ = 3/(2g²a⁴)、ℓ² = 4πG/g² なら (8πG/3)ρa² = ℓ²/a²

name: neck_extrinsic
stmt: theorem neck_extrinsic (l t : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hc : Real.cos (t / l) ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun s => Real.cos (s / l) ^ 2) (2 * Real.cos (t / l) * (-Real.sin (t / l) * (1 / l))) t ∧ 1 / 2 * (2 * Real.cos (t / l) * (-Real.sin (t / l) * (1 / l))) / Real.cos (t / l) ^ 2 = -(Real.sin (t / l) / Real.cos (t / l)) / l
doc: 【柱 2】首:g_zz = cos²(t/ℓ) の外曲率 K^z_z = ½(∂_t g_zz)/g_zz = −tan(t/ℓ)/ℓ

name: neck_constraint
stmt: theorem neck_constraint (k R3 G ρ : ℝ) : R3 + k ^ 2 - k ^ 2 = 16 * Real.pi * G * ρ ↔ R3 = 16 * Real.pi * G * ρ
doc: 【柱 2】首の拘束:K が一つの向き(K^z_z = k)だけなら K² − K_abK^ab = 0、拘束は ³R = 16πGρ

name: end_phase
stmt: theorem end_phase : Complex.exp (-(0 : ℂ) * I) = 1 ∧ Complex.exp (-((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) = -I
doc: 【柱 2】始まりと終わり:位相 0 で c = 1(純粋な回転 = 頂点)、位相 π/2 で e^{−iπ/2} = −i(純粋なブースト)

name: real_part
stmt: theorem real_part (Γ K : ℝ) : ((Γ : ℂ) + I * K).re = Γ
doc: 【柱 2、テスト B】YM 場 = 自己双対接続の実部(回転の部分):Re(Γ + iK) = Γ

name: cap_real_part
stmt: theorem cap_real_part (a χ : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun x => a * Real.sin x) (a * Real.cos χ) χ ∧ a * Real.cos χ / a = Real.cos χ
doc:
【柱 2、テスト B】帽子:r = a sin χ、ds = a dχ のスピン接続の W = r′ = cos χ は半径 a によらない。
したがって YM の解 W = cos χ と、帽子のすべての時刻で一致する

name: mass_shell
stmt: theorem mass_shell (ζ : ℝ) : Complex.normSq (1 + I * ((-Real.sinh ζ : ℝ) : ℂ)) = Real.cosh ζ ^ 2 ∧ (1 / Real.cosh ζ) ^ 2 + (-Real.sinh ζ / Real.cosh ζ) ^ 2 = 1 ∧ Real.cosh ζ ^ 2 - (-Real.sinh ζ) ^ 2 = 1
doc:
【柱 2】ȧ = −sinh ζ と書くと:|c|² = cosh²ζ(エネルギー E/m)、c/|c| = (sech ζ, −tanh ζ) は単位円の上
(量子半球 Q = (m/E, p/E))、(|c|, Im c) = (cosh ζ, −sinh ζ) は単位双曲線の上(質量殻 (E/m, p/m))。
Re c = 1(スピン接続 Γ)が質量、Im c = ȧ(外曲率 K)が運動量の役

name: gudermann_phase
stmt: theorem gudermann_phase (θ ζ : ℝ) (hc : 0 < Real.cos θ) (ht : Real.sin θ / Real.cos θ = Real.sinh ζ) : Real.cos θ = 1 / Real.cosh ζ
doc:
【柱 2】位相と Gudermann:tan θ = sinh ζ、cos θ > 0 なら cos θ = 1/cosh ζ(量子半球の高さ m/E)。
帽子では θ = η、ȧ = −tan η = −sinh ζ、a/ℓ = cos η = 1/cosh ζ = m/E:
帽子の一生(a = ℓ から a → 0)は、量子半球を頂点(静止)から赤道(光速)へたどることと同じ

name: no_static_throat
doc: 【柱 4】静的な喉はない:r′ = 0 の点で、tt 成分と ss 成分(r′ = 0 での拘束)から r″ = −2W′²/r ≤ 0

name: cylinder_family
doc:
【柱 4】円柱の族:W = 0、r = R、r′ = r″ = 0、ν′ = k(定数)。tt 成分 0 = 1 − R²(1/R⁴ + Λ) と
θθ 成分 k² = 1/R⁴ − Λ ⇔ Λ = 1/R² − 1/R⁴、k² = (2 − R²)/R⁴
(k² > 0:AdS₂ × S²、k = 0:平坦 × S²。dS₂ × S² は ν′ が定数の形では表せず、この定理の範囲外)

name: cylinder_max
doc: 【柱 4】円柱が存在する Λ の上限:1/R² − 1/R⁴ ≤ 1/4、等号 ⇔ R² = 2(平坦 × S²、半径 √2 ℓ)

name: esu_ym
doc:
【柱 4】静的宇宙 + YM:a² = 2、r = a sin x、W = cos x(x = s/a)、ν = 0、Λ = 3/4。
r′ = cos x、r″ = −sin x/a、W′ = −sin x/a、W″ = −cos x/a² を入れると tt・ss・θθ・YM の式が成り立つ

name: throat_mode
doc: 【柱 4】AdS₂ の喉の中の YM:W(s) = e^{−s/2}cos(√3 s/2) は W″ + W′ + W = 0 をみたす

name: bf_violation
doc:
【柱 4】BF 下限を下回る:喉での有効質量 −1 は −1/4 より小さく、振動数 √(1 − 1/4) = √3/2。
節の間隔 π/(√3/2) の間に振幅は e^{−(1/2)·π/(√3/2)} = e^{−π/√3} 倍

name: superpos_null
doc:
【柱 4】帽子と首の倍率の足し算 Ω = Ac + Bw(c = cos η、s = sin η、w = 1/sin u、t = cot u、
t² + 1 = w²)の null-null 成分:Ω_η = −As、Ω_ηη = −Ac、Ω_u = −Bwt、Ω_uu = Bw(w² + t²) から
N± = 4A² + ABc(8 − 4w²)w ± 8ABswt

name: cylinder_mode
stmt: theorem cylinder_mode (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun t => cos (t / √2)) (-(sin (s / √2)) / √2) s ∧ HasDerivAt (fun t => -(sin (t / √2)) / √2) (-(cos (s / √2)) / 2) s ∧ -(cos (s / √2)) / 2 + cos (s / √2) / 2 = 0
doc:
【柱 4】臨界の円柱(R² = 2、Λ = 1/4、ν′ = 0:超冷極限 Minkowski₂ × S²)の上の線形の YM:W″ + W/2 = 0。
解 W = cos(s/√2) は静的宇宙 + YM の W(`esu_ym`、a = √2)と同じ関数。節の間隔は π√2

name: qs_kuchar_Lambda
stmt: theorem qs_kuchar_Lambda (r r1 L PL F PM : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hL : L ≠ 0) (hF0 : F ≠ 0) (hF : F = r1 ^ 2 / L ^ 2 - PL ^ 2 / r ^ 2) (hPM : PM = L * PL / (r * F)) : r1 ^ 2 / F - F * PM ^ 2 = L ^ 2

name: qs_kuchar_cross
stmt: theorem qs_kuchar_cross (r L PL F PM : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hL : L ≠ 0) (hF0 : F ≠ 0) (hPM : PM = L * PL / (r * F)) : PL / (r * L) = F * PM / L ^ 2

name: qs_neck_F
stmt: theorem qs_neck_F (L r : ℝ) : (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 / L ^ 2 - (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 / r ^ 2 = 0

name: qs_cap_Hx
stmt: theorem qs_cap_Hx (Om Oe s c : ℝ) : (-2 * Oe * s) * (Om * c) - Om * (-2 * Oe * s * c) = 0

name: qs_dtheta
stmt: theorem qs_dtheta (k κ σ θ : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun θ => cos (k * σ + κ * θ)) (-κ * sin (k * σ + κ * θ)) θ

name: qs_dsigma
stmt: theorem qs_dsigma (k κ σ θ : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun σ => -κ * sin (k * σ + κ * θ)) (-(k * κ) * cos (k * σ + κ * θ)) σ

name: qs_planewave_flat
stmt: theorem qs_planewave_flat (k κ σ θ : ℝ) : Complex.abs (Complex.exp (((k * σ + κ * θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) = 1

name: qs_length_pair
stmt: theorem qs_length_pair (pa a Lx : ℝ) (hLx : Lx ≠ 0) : pa / Lx * (a * Lx) = pa * a

name: qs_length_momentum
stmt: theorem qs_length_momentum (r rd Lx : ℝ) (hLx : Lx ≠ 0) : -2 * (Lx / 2) * r * rd / Lx = -(r * rd)

name: rj_weak_of_pieces
stmt: theorem rj_weak_of_pieces {a x0 b : ℝ} {pm pp qm qp : ℝ → ℝ} (hpm : ∀ x, HasDerivAt pm (qm x) x) (hpp : ∀ x, HasDerivAt pp (qp x) x) (cqm : Continuous qm) (cqp : Continuous qp) : ∀ φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x, HasDerivAt φ (φ' x) x) → Continuous φ' → φ a = 0 → φ b = 0 → -((∫ x in a..x0, pm x * φ' x) + ∫ x in x0..b, pp x * φ' x) = (∫ x in a..x0, qm x * φ x) + (∫ x in x0..b, qp x * φ x) + (pp x0 - pm x0) * φ x0
doc:
部分積分:各側で C¹ の流束 p(導関数 q)をとると、弱い形の方程式が δ の係数 [p] = p₊(x₀) − p₋(x₀) で
  成り立つ(最終定理の仮定が空でないことを示す道具)

name: rj_delta_coeff_one
stmt: theorem rj_delta_coeff_one {a x0 b m : ℝ} (hax : a < x0) (hxb : x0 < b) {pm pp qm qp Sm Sp : ℝ → ℝ} (hpm : ∀ x ∈ Icc a x0, HasDerivWithinAt pm (qm x) (Icc a x0) x) (hpp : ∀ x ∈ Icc x0 b, HasDerivWithinAt pp (qp x) (Icc x0 b) x) (cqm : ContinuousOn qm (Icc a x0)) (cqp : ContinuousOn qp (Icc x0 b)) (sideM : ∀ x ∈ Icc a x0, qm x = Sm x) (sideP : ∀ x ∈ Icc x0 b, qp x = Sp x) (weak : ∀ φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x, HasDerivAt φ (φ' x) x) → Continuous φ' → φ a = 0 → φ b = 0 → -((∫ x in a..x0, pm x * φ' x) + ∫ x in x0..b, pp x * φ' x) = (∫ x in a..x0, Sm x * φ x) + (∫ x in x0..b, Sp x * φ x) + m * φ x0) : m = pp x0 - pm x0
doc: δ の係数(κ = 1):各側で p′ = 源、弱い形 ∂p = 源 + m δ_{x₀} なら m = [p]

name: rj_capW_hasDeriv
stmt: theorem rj_capW_hasDeriv (l x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun x => cos (x / l)) (-sin (x / l) * (1 / l)) x

name: rj_capFlux_hasDeriv
stmt: theorem rj_capFlux_hasDeriv (l s x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (capFlux l s) (capFluxD l s x) x

name: rj_capFluxD_cont
stmt: theorem rj_capFluxD_cont (l s : ℝ) : Continuous (capFluxD l s)

name: rj_color_dumbbell
stmt: theorem rj_color_dumbbell {l s a b j : ℝ} (hl : 0 < l) (hs : s ≠ 0) (ha : a < l * π / 2) (hb : l * π / 2 < b) (weak : ∀ φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x, HasDerivAt φ (φ' x) x) → Continuous φ' → φ a = 0 → φ b = 0 → -((∫ x in a..l * π / 2, capFlux l s x * φ' x) + ∫ x in (l * π / 2)..b, (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) x * φ' x) = (∫ x in a..l * π / 2, capFluxD l s x * φ x) + (∫ x in (l * π / 2)..b, (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) x * φ x) + j * φ (l * π / 2)) : j = s / l ∧ j ≠ 0
doc:
α-III.1(ゲージ場):帽子(左、W = cos(x/ℓ))と首(右、W = 0)を赤道 x₀ = ℓπ/2 でつないだ時間対称な切り口。
  分布としての YM 方程式の δ の係数(表面の色の流れ)j は s/ℓ で、0 になれない

name: rj_color_nonempty
stmt: theorem rj_color_nonempty (l s a b : ℝ) : ∃ j : ℝ, ∀ φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x, HasDerivAt φ (φ' x) x) → Continuous φ' → φ a = 0 → φ b = 0 → -((∫ x in a..l * π / 2, capFlux l s x * φ' x) + ∫ x in (l * π / 2)..b, (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) x * φ' x) = (∫ x in a..l * π / 2, capFluxD l s x * φ x) + (∫ x in (l * π / 2)..b, (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) x * φ x) + j * φ (l * π / 2)
doc: 非空性:上の弱い形の方程式は j = [流束] で実際に成り立つ(部分積分)

name: rj_cap_tube_radius
stmt: theorem rj_cap_tube_radius (l η : ℝ) (hl : 0 ≤ l) (hη : 0 ≤ cos η) : l * cos η = Real.sqrt (l ^ 2 - (l * sin η) ^ 2)
doc: 帽子の赤道の管 χ = π/2 の面積半径 ℓ cos η を、管に沿う固有時間 τ = ℓ sin η で書くと √(ℓ² − τ²)

name: rj_tube_mismatch
stmt: theorem rj_tube_mismatch (l τ : ℝ) (hτ : τ ≠ 0) (hτl : τ ^ 2 ≤ l ^ 2) : Real.sqrt (l ^ 2 - τ ^ 2) ≠ l
doc:
首の管の面積半径は ℓ のまま。τ ≠ 0 では √(ℓ² − τ²) ≠ ℓ:管の第一基本形式は τ = 0 の瞬間を除いて
  連続にならず、時間的な管は接合面になれない(Israel 接合の第一条件)

name: rj_capR_hasDeriv
stmt: theorem rj_capR_hasDeriv (l x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (capR l) (capR1 l x) x

name: rj_capR1_hasDeriv
stmt: theorem rj_capR1_hasDeriv (l x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (capR1 l) (capR2 l x) x

name: rj_capR2_cont
stmt: theorem rj_capR2_cont (l : ℝ) : Continuous (capR2 l)

name: rj_slice_dumbbell
stmt: theorem rj_slice_dumbbell {l a b m G σ : ℝ} (hl : 0 < l) (hG : G ≠ 0) (ha : a < l * π / 2) (hb : l * π / 2 < b) (weak : ∀ φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x, HasDerivAt φ (φ' x) x) → Continuous φ' → φ a = 0 → φ b = 0 → -((∫ x in a..l * π / 2, capR1 l x * φ' x) + ∫ x in (l * π / 2)..b, (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) x * φ' x) = (∫ x in a..l * π / 2, capR2 l x * φ x) + (∫ x in (l * π / 2)..b, (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) x * φ x) + m * φ (l * π / 2)) (hσ : 8 * π * G * σ = -2 / l * m) : m = 0 ∧ σ = 0 ∧ scal3 (capR l (l * π / 2)) (capR1 l (l * π / 2)) (capR2 l (l * π / 2)) = 6 / l ^ 2 ∧ scal3 l 0 0 = 2 / l ^ 2
doc:
α-III.9:帽子(R = ℓ sin(x/ℓ))と首(R = ℓ)を赤道でつないだ時間対称な切り口。R″ の弱い形の δ の係数は
  [R′] = 0 で、ハミルトン拘束の面密度 σ(8πGσ = −(2/ℓ)·m)は 0(殻なし)。一方、断面のスカラー曲率は
  帽子側 6/ℓ²、首側 2/ℓ² で跳ぶ(エネルギー密度の段差)

name: rj_slice_nonempty
stmt: theorem rj_slice_nonempty (l a b : ℝ) : ∃ m : ℝ, ∀ φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x, HasDerivAt φ (φ' x) x) → Continuous φ' → φ a = 0 → φ b = 0 → -((∫ x in a..l * π / 2, capR1 l x * φ' x) + ∫ x in (l * π / 2)..b, (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) x * φ' x) = (∫ x in a..l * π / 2, capR2 l x * φ x) + (∫ x in (l * π / 2)..b, (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) x * φ x) + m * φ (l * π / 2)
doc: 非空性:上の弱い形の方程式は m = [R′] で実際に成り立つ

name: rj_null_real
stmt: theorem rj_null_real {v0 v1 a u0 b G : ℝ} (hau : a < u0) (hub : u0 < b) (hG : G ≠ 0) {Rum Rup Ruum Ruup Sm Sp : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {m r rv ruvp ruvm F μ : ℝ → ℝ} (hRum : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, ∀ u ∈ Icc a u0, HasDerivWithinAt (Rum v) (Ruum v u) (Icc a u0) u) (hRup : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, ∀ u ∈ Icc u0 b, HasDerivWithinAt (Rup v) (Ruup v u) (Icc u0 b) u) (cRum : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, ContinuousOn (Ruum v) (Icc a u0)) (cRup : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, ContinuousOn (Ruup v) (Icc u0 b)) (sM : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, ∀ u ∈ Icc a u0, Ruum v u = Sm v u) (sP : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, ∀ u ∈ Icc u0 b, Ruup v u = Sp v u) (weak : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, ∀ φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x, HasDerivAt φ (φ' x) x) → Continuous φ' → φ a = 0 → φ b = 0 → -((∫ x in a..u0, Rum v x * φ' x) + ∫ x in u0..b, Rup v x * φ' x) = (∫ x in a..u0, Sm v x * φ x) + (∫ x in u0..b, Sp v x * φ x) + m v * φ u0) (hr : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt r (rv v) (Icc v0 v1) v) (hup : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt (fun v => Rup v u0) (ruvp v) (Icc v0 v1) v) (hum : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt (fun v => Rum v u0) (ruvm v) (Icc v0 v1) v) (sideP : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, r v * ruvp v + Rup v u0 * rv v = F v) (sideM : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, r v * ruvm v + Rum v u0 * rv v = F v) (h0 : Rup v0 u0 = Rum v0 u0) (hpos : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, r v ≠ 0) (hμ : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, 8 * π * G * μ v = -2 / r v * m v) : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, μ v = 0
doc:
α-III.2:二重ヌル座標 (u, v)、波面 u = u₀。各 v で横断方向の r_u(左 Rum v、右 Rup v)が古典的な
  uu 方程式 ∂_u(r_u) = 源 をみたし、分布としての式の δ の係数が m(v)(面密度 μ:8πGμ = −(2/r)m)。
  波面に沿って両側の混合成分の式 r r_uv + r_u r_v = F(F は波面の共通の値)、角 v₀ で [r_u] = 0、r ≠ 0。
  このとき波面全体で μ = 0(殻なし)

name: rj_front_tangential
stmt: theorem rj_front_tangential {v0 v1 : ℝ} (hv : v0 < v1) {Wp Wm Wvp Wvm : ℝ → ℝ} (heq : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, Wp v = Wm v) (hp : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt Wp (Wvp v) (Icc v0 v1) v) (hm : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt Wm (Wvm v) (Icc v0 v1) v) (s : ℝ) : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, Wvp v ^ 2 - Wvm v ^ 2 = 0 ∧ -(s * Wvp v) - -(s * Wvm v) = 0
doc:
α-III.2(接線成分):波面に沿って W が連続なら、接線微分 W_v も一致する。よって [T_vv] ∝ [W_v²] = 0、
  YM の表面流 [−s W_v] = 0(k^μ[T_μν] = 0 の接線成分。横断成分 T_uu は有限の段差をもってよい)

name: rj_null_witness
stmt: theorem rj_null_witness {G : ℝ} (hG : G ≠ 0) : ∀ v ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) v = 0
doc: 非空性:rj_null_real の仮定はすべて満たせる(両側が同じ滑らかな解の場合)

name: rj_Wu_transport
stmt: theorem rj_Wu_transport {v0 v1 : ℝ} {Wup Wum Wuvp Wuvm Gf : ℝ → ℝ} (hp : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt Wup (Wuvp v) (Icc v0 v1) v) (hm : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt Wum (Wuvm v) (Icc v0 v1) v) (sP : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, Wuvp v = Gf v) (sM : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, Wuvm v = Gf v) : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, Wup v - Wum v = Wup v0 - Wum v0
doc:
α-IV.2:両側の W_uv が波面の共通の値 G(v)(= Ω W(1 − W²)/(2r²) の共通の跡)で決まるなら、
  [W_u] は波面に沿って一定(角での値のまま運ばれる)

name: rj_capWu_corner
stmt: theorem rj_capWu_corner (l : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun u => sin (u / (Real.sqrt 2 * l))) (1 / (Real.sqrt 2 * l)) 0
doc: α-IV.2(角の値):帽子の初期データ W_C(u) = sin(u/(√2ℓ))(v = 0 の上)の u 微分は角 u = 0 で 1/(√2ℓ)

name: rj_ruu_corner
stmt: theorem rj_ruu_corner (l σu Wup Wum rupp rumm : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hP : rupp - 2 * σu * 0 + 2 * l ^ 2 * Wup ^ 2 / l = 0) (hM : rumm - 2 * σu * 0 + 2 * l ^ 2 * Wum ^ 2 / l = 0) (hWp : Wup = 1 / (Real.sqrt 2 * l)) (hWm : Wum = 0) : rupp - rumm = -1 / l
doc:
α-IV.2(角での [r_uu]):拘束 C_u = r_uu − 2σ_u r_u + 2ℓ²W_u²/r = 0 を両側で使い、角(r = ℓ、r_u = 0)で
  帽子 W_u = 1/(√2ℓ)、首 W_u = 0 なら [r_uu] = −1/ℓ(帽子の r = ℓcos²(u/(√2ℓ)) の 2 階微分と一致)

name: rr_ms_deriv
stmt: theorem rr_ms_deriv {R R1 R2 : ℝ → ℝ} {G : ℝ} (x : ℝ) (hR : HasDerivAt R (R1 x) x) (hR1 : HasDerivAt R1 (R2 x) x) : HasDerivAt (fun x => msMass G (R x) (R1 x)) ((R1 x * (1 - R1 x * R1 x) - 2 * R x * R1 x * R2 x) / (2 * G)) x
doc: m の微分(連鎖律)

name: rr_ms_constraint
stmt: theorem rr_ms_constraint (G R R1 R2 ρ : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) (hR : R ≠ 0) (ham : 2 * (1 - R1 ^ 2 - 2 * R * R2) / R ^ 2 = 16 * π * G * ρ) : (R1 * (1 - R1 * R1) - 2 * R * R1 * R2) / (2 * G) = 4 * π * R ^ 2 * ρ * R1
doc: ハミルトン拘束 2(1 − R′² − 2RR″)/R² = 16πGρ を使うと m′ = 4πR²ρR′

name: rr_closed_total_zero
stmt: theorem rr_closed_total_zero {R R1 R2 : ℝ → ℝ} {G L : ℝ} (hR : ∀ x, HasDerivAt R (R1 x) x) (hR1 : ∀ x, HasDerivAt R1 (R2 x) x) (hc : Continuous fun x => (R1 x * (1 - R1 x * R1 x) - 2 * R x * R1 x * R2 x) / (2 * G)) (h0 : R 0 = 0) (hL : R L = 0) : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..L, (R1 x * (1 - R1 x * R1 x) - 2 * R x * R1 x * R2 x) / (2 * G) = 0
doc: 両端が極(R = 0)の閉じた切り口では ∫₀^L m′ dx = m(L) − m(0) = 0(全エネルギー 0)

name: rr_cap_mass
stmt: theorem rr_cap_mass (G l y : ℝ) : msMass G (l * sin y) (cos y) = l * sin y ^ 3 / (2 * G) ∧ msMass G l 0 = l / (2 * G)
doc: 帽子 R = ℓ sin y(y = x/ℓ)、R′ = cos y の質量は ℓ sin³y/(2G)。極 y = 0 で 0、赤道で ℓ/(2G) = 首の質量

name: rr_extremal_rprime_deriv
stmt: theorem rr_extremal_rprime_deriv {Ω Ωc Ωcc : ℝ → ℝ} (hΩ : HasDerivAt Ω (Ωc (π / 2)) (π / 2)) (hΩc : HasDerivAt Ωc (Ωcc (π / 2)) (π / 2)) (hne : Ω (π / 2) ≠ 0) (hc0 : Ωc (π / 2) = 0) : HasDerivAt (fun χ => (Ωc χ * sin χ + Ω χ * cos χ) / Ω χ) ((Ωcc (π / 2) - Ω (π / 2)) / Ω (π / 2)) (π / 2)
doc:
時間対称な切り口(η = 0)で r = Ω sin χ、ds = Ω dχ。r′ = (Ω_χ sin χ + Ω cos χ)/Ω の χ 微分は、
  χ = π/2 で Ω_χ = 0(極値球面)なら (Ω_χχ − Ω)/Ω

name: rr_hessian_char
stmt: theorem rr_hessian_char (Ω0 Ωcc Ωηη : ℝ) (hne : Ω0 ≠ 0) (htrace : -Ωηη + Ωcc = Ω0) : (Ωcc - Ω0) / Ω0 / Ω0 = Ωηη / Ω0 ^ 2
doc:
r″ = (dr′/dχ)/Ω = (Ω_χχ − Ω)/Ω²。χ = π/2 では cot χ = 0 なのでトレースの方程式は −Ω_ηη + Ω_χχ = Ω、
  よって r″ = Ω_ηη/Ω²

name: rr_two_roots
doc:
W = r′ 型のハミルトン拘束 P(r, r′, r″) = 2ℓ²r″² + 2rr″ + ℓ²(1 − r′²)²/r² − (1 − r′²) の r = ℓ、r′ = 0 での根は
  r″ = 0 と r″ = −1/ℓ だけ

name: rr_conformal_two_values
stmt: theorem rr_conformal_two_values (l Ω0 Ωcc Ωηη : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hne : Ω0 ≠ 0) (htrace : -Ωηη + Ωcc = Ω0) (hP : 2 * l ^ 2 * ((Ωcc - Ω0) / Ω0 / Ω0) ^ 2 + 2 * l * ((Ωcc - Ω0) / Ω0 / Ω0) + l ^ 2 * (1 - 0 ^ 2) ^ 2 / l ^ 2 - (1 - 0 ^ 2) = 0) : Ωηη / Ω0 ^ 2 = 0 ∨ Ωηη / Ω0 ^ 2 = -1 / l
doc:
したがって(W = r′ 型、共形平坦、時間対称な切り口、半径 ℓ の極値球面)Ω_ηη/Ω² ∈ {0, −1/ℓ}:
  一つの Ω の中で帽子(−1/ℓ)と首(0)を連続につなぐことはできない

name: rr_general_W_rpp
doc:
極値球面(r = ℓ、r′ = 0)でのハミルトン拘束(r² をかけた形)−4rr″ + 2(1 − r′²) = 4ℓ²(W′² + (1 − W²)²/(2r²))
  から r″ = (W² − W⁴/2 − ℓ²W′²)/ℓ

name: rr_general_W_any
stmt: theorem rr_general_W_any (l y : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (hy : y ≤ 0) : ∃ Wp : ℝ, (0 ^ 2 - 0 ^ 4 / 2 - l ^ 2 * Wp ^ 2) / l = y
doc: W = 0(首の値)のとき、任意の r″ ≤ 0 は W′ を選べば実現できる(連続的な値の帯)

name: rr_mode0
stmt: theorem rr_mode0 (c s C S : ℝ) : LinSol c s C S (-s) (-c) 0 s 0 0 0 0 0
doc: ∂_η が生む摂動:f = −sin η、δW = 0(以下 c² + s² = 1、cos 2η = c² − s²、sin 2η = 2sc)

name: rr_mode1
doc:
ξ₁ = sin η cos χ ∂_η + cos η sin χ ∂_χ が生む摂動:f = cos χ cos 2η、δW = −cos η sin²χ
  (cos 2η = c² − s²、sin 2η = 2sc)

name: rr_mode2
doc: ξ₂ = cos η cos χ ∂_η − sin η sin χ ∂_χ が生む摂動:f = −cos χ sin 2η、δW = sin η sin²χ

name: rr_dW_eta_deriv
stmt: theorem rr_dW_eta_deriv {F Fc Fe Fec Fee : ℝ → ℝ} (C S η : ℝ) (hF : HasDerivAt F (Fe η) η) (hFc : HasDerivAt Fc (Fec η) η) (hFe : HasDerivAt Fe (Fee η) η) : HasDerivAt (fun η => -(S ^ 2 / (2 * C)) * ((F η - C / S * Fc η) * cos η - Fe η * sin η)) (-(S ^ 2 / (2 * C)) * ((Fe η - C / S * Fec η) * cos η - (F η - C / S * Fc η) * sin η - Fee η * sin η - Fe η * cos η)) η
doc: (C) と (T) から代数的に決まる δW(χ を固定した η の関数)の η 微分

name: rr_eta_integrability
stmt: theorem rr_eta_integrability (c s C S f fe fc fee fec : ℝ) (hC : C ≠ 0) (hS : S ≠ 0) : -(S ^ 2 / (2 * C)) * ((fe - C / S * fec) * c - (f - C / S * fc) * s - fee * s - fe * c) - S / 2 * (c * fec + 2 * s * fc) = S * s / (2 * C) * (S * (fee + f) - 3 * C * fc)
doc: η 方向の可積分性:∂_η(δW) − δW_η = (sin χ sin η/(2cos χ))·L[f]、L[f] = sin χ(f_ηη + f) − 3cos χ f_χ

name: rr_chi_ode
stmt: theorem rr_chi_ode (C S f fc fee fcc : ℝ) (hL : S * (fee + f) - 3 * C * fc = 0) (hT : (-fee + fcc - f) * S + 2 * C * fc = 0) : fcc * S - C * fc = 0
doc: L[f] = 0 と (T) から χ 方向の常微分方程式 f_χχ sin χ − f_χ cos χ = 0(f_χ/sin χ が χ によらない)

name: rr_cos_mode_excluded
stmt: theorem rr_cos_mode_excluded (χ : ℝ) (hC : cos χ ≠ 0) (hS : sin χ ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun χ => -(sin χ * sin χ / (2 * cos χ))) (-sin χ - sin χ ^ 3 / (2 * cos χ ^ 2)) χ ∧ -sin χ - sin χ ^ 3 / (2 * cos χ ^ 2) ≠ -sin χ
doc:
振幅の変化 f = cos η は除かれる:代数的に決まる δW = −sin²χ/(2cos χ) の χ 微分は
  −sin χ − sin³χ/(2cos²χ) で、(A)(B) が要求する δW_χ = −sin χ と一致しない

name: rr_cos_mode_Wchi
stmt: theorem rr_cos_mode_Wchi (η S : ℝ) : -(S / 4) * ((3 * cos η - -cos η - 0) * cos η - 4 * (-sin η) * sin η) = -S
doc: f = cos η のとき (A)(B) から δW_χ = −(sin χ/4)((3f − f_ηη − f_χχ)cos η − 4f_η sin η) = −sin χ

name: rr_higgs_cap_residual
stmt: theorem rr_higgs_cap_residual (Ω m h χ : ℝ) (hS : sin χ ≠ 0) : -0 + -cos χ + cos χ * (1 - cos χ ^ 2) / sin χ ^ 2 - Ω ^ 2 * m ^ 2 * h ^ 2 * cos χ = -(Ω ^ 2 * m ^ 2 * h ^ 2 * cos χ)
doc:
共形の枠の YM 方程式 −W_ηη + W_χχ + W(1 − W²)/sin²χ に随伴 Higgs の質量項 −Ω²m²h²W が加わる
  (Higgs は共形不変でない)。W = cos χ(W_ηη = 0、W_χχ = −cos χ)では残差は −Ω²m²h² cos χ で、
  Ω m h cos χ ≠ 0 なら 0 にならない:Higgs があると帽子の解は変わる

name: rr_higgs_cap_nonzero
stmt: theorem rr_higgs_cap_nonzero (Ω m h χ : ℝ) (hΩ : Ω ≠ 0) (hm : m ≠ 0) (hh : h ≠ 0) (hc : cos χ ≠ 0) : -(Ω ^ 2 * m ^ 2 * h ^ 2 * cos χ) ≠ 0

name: rr_dyon_bf
stmt: theorem rr_dyon_bf (x : ℝ) : (-1 : ℝ) - x ^ 2 < -1 / 4
doc:
AdS₂(半径 ℓ)の一様な電場 E の中の電荷 q の場の有効質量は m²ℓ² − (qEℓ²)²(外部:Pioline–Troost 2005)。
  首の W は m²ℓ² = −1(IX.15)なので、電場を加えても BF 限界 −1/4 を下回ったまま(不安定性は消えない)

name: det_M
stmt: theorem det_M (z0 z1 z2 z3 : ℂ) : (M z0 z1 z2 z3).det = z0 ^ 2 + z1 ^ 2 + z2 ^ 2 + z3 ^ 2
doc: 【根幹 2】det M(z) = z₀² + z₁² + z₂² + z₃²(一つの複素 2 次形式)

name: real_slice_unitary
stmt: theorem real_slice_unitary (x0 x1 x2 x3 : ℝ) : (M x0 x1 x2 x3)ᴴ * M x0 x1 x2 x3 = ((x0 ^ 2 + x1 ^ 2 + x2 ^ 2 + x3 ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
doc: 【根幹 2】実の切り口:M(x)†M(x) = |x|²·1(SU(2) の定数倍、|x| = 1 で S³ = SU(2))

name: imag_slice_hermitian
stmt: theorem imag_slice_hermitian (x0 y1 y2 y3 : ℝ) : M x0 (-I * y1) (-I * y2) (-I * y3) = !![(x0 + y3 : ℂ), y1 - I * y2; y1 + I * y2, x0 - y3] ∧ (M x0 (-I * y1) (-I * y2) (-I * y3)).det = ((x0 ^ 2 - y1 ^ 2 - y2 ^ 2 - y3 ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
doc: 【根幹 2】虚の切り口:z₀ = x₀、z_k = −i y_k で M は Hermite(Minkowski の点)、det = x₀² − |y|²

name: wick_path
doc: 【根幹 2】回転でつなぐ:z_k = c·x_k なら det = x₀² + c²|x|²。c = 1 で球、c = −i で双曲面

name: curvature_flip
stmt: theorem curvature_flip (R : ℝ) (hR : R ≠ 0) : 1 / (-(R ^ 2)) = -(1 / R ^ 2)
doc: 【根幹 2】曲率の符号:半径 R の球の曲率 1/R² は R² ↦ −R² で −1/R²(双曲面)になる

name: hemisphere_on_sphere
stmt: theorem hemisphere_on_sphere (η : ℝ) : (1 / Real.cosh η) ^ 2 + (Real.sinh η / Real.cosh η) ^ 2 = 1 ∧ 0 < 1 / Real.cosh η
doc: 【根幹 2】量子半球は相対双曲面の半球模型:Q = (sech η, tanh η) は単位円(球)の上で Q₀ > 0

name: hemisphere_deriv
stmt: theorem hemisphere_deriv (η : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun e => 1 / Real.cosh e) (-(Real.sinh η) / Real.cosh η ^ 2) η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun e => Real.sinh e / Real.cosh e) (1 / Real.cosh η ^ 2) η
doc: Q₀ = 1/cosh η、Q₁ = sinh η/cosh η の η 微分

name: hemisphere_conformal
stmt: theorem hemisphere_conformal (η : ℝ) : (-(Real.sinh η) / Real.cosh η ^ 2) ^ 2 + (1 / Real.cosh η ^ 2) ^ 2 = (1 / Real.cosh η) ^ 2 * 1 ∧ Real.sinh η / Real.cosh η = (1 / Real.cosh η) * Real.sinh η
doc:
【根幹 2】共形:|dQ/dη|² = sech²η = Q₀²·(双曲面の動径の速さ 1)、角度方向 tanh η = Q₀·sinh η。
したがって半球の計量 = Q₀² × 双曲面の計量(Q₀ = m/E)

name: equator_at_infinity
stmt: theorem equator_at_infinity (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 ≤ η) : 1 / Real.cosh η ≤ 2 / (η + 1)
doc: 【根幹 2】半球の赤道は双曲面の無限遠:Q₀ = 1/cosh η ≤ 2/(η + 1)(η ≥ 0)で、η → ∞ で 0

name: curvature_jump
stmt: theorem curvature_jump (l : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : R3 l 0 (-1 / l) = 6 / l ^ 2 ∧ R3 l 0 0 = 2 / l ^ 2
doc: 【根幹 1】接合で曲率が跳ぶ:帽子の赤道(r = ℓ、r′ = 0、r″ = −1/ℓ)で ³R = 6/ℓ²、首(r″ = 0)で 2/ℓ²

name: stress_jump
stmt: theorem stress_jump (g l : ℝ) (hg : g ≠ 0) (hl : l ≠ 0) : CFT.EYM.rho g (cos (π / 2)) (-(sin (π / 2)) / l) (l * sin (π / 2)) = 3 / (2 * g ^ 2 * l ^ 4) ∧ CFT.EYM.pr g (cos (π / 2)) (-(sin (π / 2)) / l) (l * sin (π / 2)) = 1 / (2 * g ^ 2 * l ^ 4) ∧ CFT.EYM.rho g 0 0 l = 1 / (2 * g ^ 2 * l ^ 4) ∧ CFT.EYM.pr g 0 0 l = -(1 / (2 * g ^ 2 * l ^ 4))
doc:
【根幹 1】エネルギー密度と半径方向の圧力の跳び:帽子の赤道 ρ = 3/(2g²ℓ⁴)、p_r = 1/(2g²ℓ⁴)、
首 ρ = 1/(2g²ℓ⁴)、p_r = −1/(2g²ℓ⁴)

name: hamC_quadratic
stmt: theorem hamC_quadratic (K r0 r1 r2 : ℝ) (hr : r0 ≠ 0) : CFT.EYM.hamC K r0 r1 r2 ↔ K * r2 ^ 2 + 2 * r0 * r2 + (K * (1 - r1 ^ 2) ^ 2 / (2 * r0 ^ 2) - (1 - r1 ^ 2)) = 0
doc: 【根幹 1】ハミルトン拘束は r″ の 2 次式:K r″² + 2rr″ + (Ku²/(2r²) − u) = 0(u = 1 − r′²)

name: junction_two_values
stmt: theorem junction_two_values (l r2 : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : CFT.EYM.hamC (2 * l ^ 2) l 0 r2 ↔ r2 = 0 ∨ r2 = -1 / l
doc: 【根幹 1】接合の点 (ℓ, 0) では拘束をみたす r″ はちょうど二つ:0(首)と −1/ℓ(帽子)(K = 2ℓ²)

name: no_C2_junction
stmt: theorem no_C2_junction (l s0 : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (r r2 : ℝ → ℝ) (hr : ContinuousAt r s0) (h0 : r s0 = l) (hc : ContinuousAt r2 s0) (hleft : ∀ s < s0, r2 s = -(r s / l ^ 2)) (hright : ∀ s > s0, r2 s = 0) : False
doc:
【根幹 1】C² の接合はない:r″ が s₀ で連続で、左(帽子)では r″ = −r/ℓ²、右(首)では r″ = 0、
r(s₀) = ℓ(r は連続)なら矛盾

name: symProd_expand
stmt: theorem symProd_expand (c : Fin 4 → ℍ[ℝ]) (ξ : Fin 4 → ℝ) : symProd c ξ = ∑ a, ∑ b, ((ξ a * ξ b : ℝ) : ℍ[ℝ]) * (star (c a) * c b)

name: factorization_iff
stmt: theorem factorization_iff (c : Fin 4 → ℍ[ℝ]) : (∀ ξ : Fin 4 → ℝ, symProd c ξ = ((∑ a, ξ a ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℍ[ℝ])) ↔ ∀ a b, star (c a) * c b + star (c b) * c a = ((if a = b then 2 else 0 : ℝ) : ℍ[ℝ])
doc: 記号の因数分解 ⇔ 係数の正規直交性

name: cyclic_factorizes
stmt: theorem cyclic_factorizes (m : Fin 4) : ∀ a b, star ((CFT.FueterC.e (m + a))) * CFT.FueterC.e (m + b) + star (CFT.FueterC.e (m + b)) * CFT.FueterC.e (m + a) = ((if a = b then 2 else 0 : ℝ) : ℍ[ℝ])
doc: 巡回族の各作用素の係数 e_{m+a} は正規直交:D̄_m D_m = Δ(v6 の命題 8.2)

name: klein_family_regular
stmt: theorem klein_family_regular (y : Fin 4 → ℍ[ℝ]) (h : ∀ r, ∑ a, kleinRow r a * y a = 0) : y = 0
doc: Klein の族は正則:右核は 0(共通の解がない)

name: maxwell_mass
stmt: theorem maxwell_mass (a b m2 : ℝ) : (∀ k ξ (t : ℝ), vecQ a b k (fun i => ξ i + t * k i) + m2 * dot (fun i => ξ i + t * k i) (fun i => ξ i + t * k i) = vecQ a b k ξ + m2 * dot ξ ξ) ↔ (a + b = 0 ∧ m2 = 0)
doc: 質量項を含めた記号:ゲージ不変 ⇔ a + b = 0 かつ m² = 0

name: ym_coupling
stmt: theorem ym_coupling (hc : ∀ μ ν x, D μ (D ν x) = D ν (D μ x)) (hcc : ∀ μ, D μ c = 0) (a : Fin 3) (μ ν : Fin 4) : dFc D A ε c a μ ν = ∑ b, ∑ e, f3 a b e * Fc D A c b μ ν * ε e + (c - 1) * Yrem D A ε a μ ν

name: ym_coupling_forced
stmt: theorem ym_coupling_forced (hc : ∀ μ ν x, D μ (D ν x) = D ν (D μ x)) (hcc : ∀ μ, D μ c = 0) (x : Fin 4 → S) (hx : ∀ a b, D a (x b) = if a = b then 1 else 0) (H : ∀ (A : Fin 3 → Fin 4 → S) (ε : Fin 3 → S), dFc D A ε c 0 0 1 = ∑ b, ∑ e, f3 0 b e * Fc D A c b 0 1 * ε e) : c = 1
doc: 共変性がすべての配位で成り立つなら c = 1

name: ghy_spherical
stmt: theorem ghy_spherical (hN : N ≠ 0) (hA : A ≠ 0) (hc : ∀ f, dt (dx f) = dx (dt f)) : sqrtgR dt dx N A R = L1 dt dx N A R + dt (2 * hKt dt N A R) + dx (-(2 * hKx dx N A R))

name: right_linear_is_left_mul
stmt: theorem right_linear_is_left_mul (T : ℍ[ℝ] → ℍ[ℝ]) (hT : ∀ x q, T (x * q) = T x * q) (x : ℍ[ℝ]) : T x = T 1 * x
doc: 右 ℍ 線形な写像は左からの積:T x = T 1 · x

name: gauge_group
stmt: theorem gauge_group (T : ℍ[ℝ] → ℍ[ℝ]) (hT : ∀ x q, T (x * q) = T x * q) (hn : ∀ x, normSq (T x) = normSq x) : normSq (T 1) = 1 ∧ ∀ x, T x = T 1 * x
doc: さらにノルムを保てば、係数は単位四元数

name: unit_left_mul
stmt: theorem unit_left_mul (u : ℍ[ℝ]) (hu : normSq u = 1) : (∀ x q, u * (x * q) = (u * x) * q) ∧ ∀ x, normSq (u * x) = normSq x
doc: 逆に、単位四元数 u の左積は右 ℍ 線形でノルムを保つ

name: su_two_bracket
stmt: theorem su_two_bracket : let i : ℍ[ℝ]
doc: su(2) = Im ℍ の構造定数:[i/2, j/2] = k/2 など(ε_{abc})

name: maxwell_symbol
stmt: theorem maxwell_symbol (a b : ℝ) : (∀ k ξ (t : ℝ), vecQ a b k (fun i => ξ i + t * k i) = vecQ a b k ξ) ↔ a + b = 0
doc: ゲージ不変性(純ゲージ ξ → ξ + t k)⇔ a + b = 0

name: maxwell_is_F2
stmt: theorem maxwell_is_F2 (a : ℝ) (k ξ : Fin 4 → ℝ) : vecQ a (-a) k ξ = (a / 2) * ∑ μ, ∑ ν, eta μ * eta ν * (k μ * ξ ν - k ν * ξ μ) ^ 2
doc: a + b = 0 のとき記号は (a/2)F_{μν}F^{μν}、F_{μν} = k_μξ_ν − k_νξ_μ

name: ym_covariance
stmt: theorem ym_covariance (hc : ∀ μ ν x, D μ (D ν x) = D ν (D μ x)) (a : Fin 3) (μ ν : Fin 4) : dF D A ε a μ ν = ∑ b, ∑ c, f3 a b c * F D A b μ ν * ε c

name: ym_invariance
stmt: theorem ym_invariance (μ ν : Fin 4) : ∑ a, F D A a μ ν * (∑ b, ∑ c, f3 a b c * F D A b μ ν * ε c) = 0

name: theta_total_derivative
stmt: theorem theta_total_derivative (hc : ∀ μ ν x, D μ (D ν x) = D ν (D μ x)) (B : Fin 4 → S) : ∑ μ, ∑ ν, ∑ ρ, ∑ σ, (eps4 μ ν ρ σ : S) * Fab D B μ ν * Fab D B ρ σ = 4 * ∑ μ, D μ (∑ ν, ∑ ρ, ∑ σ, (eps4 μ ν ρ σ : S) * B ν * D ρ (B σ))

name: fierz_pauli

stmt: theorem min_mass_from_constraints (r rp rpp a KT KTp ρ J M : ℝ → ℝ) (s0 s1 G g l : ℝ) (hG : 0 < G) (hg : 0 < g) (hlpos : 0 < l) (hneckR : r s0 = l) (hneckEYM : 16 * π * G * (1 / (2 * g ^ 2 * l ^ 4)) = 2 / l ^ 2) (hM : ∀ s, M s = r s * (1 - rp s ^ 2 + r s ^ 2 * KT s ^ 2)) (hr0 : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, r s ≠ 0) (d1 : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, HasDerivAt r (rp s) s) (d2 : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, HasDerivAt rp (rpp s) s) (d3 : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, HasDerivAt KT (KTp s) s) (hH : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, 2 * (1 - rp s ^ 2 - 2 * r s * rpp s) / r s ^ 2 + 4 * a s * KT s + 2 * KT s ^ 2 = 2 * ρ s) (hMom : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, 2 * (rp s / r s) * (a s - KT s) - 2 * KTp s = J s) (hunt : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, |r s * KT s| ≤ rp s) (hdec : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, |J s| ≤ ρ s) (hmarg : rp s0 ^ 2 = r s0 ^ 2 * KT s0 ^ 2) : ∀ s ∈ Icc s0 s1, √π * (1 / √G) / g ≤ M s / (2 * G)

stmt: theorem ymD_02 (W N A R s c : S) (H : SphD d N A R s c) (W2 : d 2 W = 0) (W3 : d 3 W = 0) : YMeq d (giD N A R s) (N * A * R ^ 2 * s) (Aym W s c) (FT d W s) 0 2 = (-1 : S) * A * N * W ^ 3 * R⁻¹ ^ 2 * s + (1 : S) * A * N * W * R⁻¹ ^ 2 * s + (1 : S) * A * (d 0 N) * (d 0 W) * N⁻¹ ^ 2 * s + (-1 : S) * A * (d 0 (d 0 W)) * N⁻¹ * s + (-1 : S) * (d 0 A) * (d 0 W) * N⁻¹ * s + (-1 : S) * (d 1 A) * N * (d 1 W) * A⁻¹ ^ 2 * s + (1 : S) * N * (d 1 (d 1 W)) * A⁻¹ * s + (1 : S) * (d 1 N) * (d 1 W) * A⁻¹ * s
doc: 対角の計量での YM 方程式の (1, θ) 成分

name: ymD_split
stmt: theorem ymD_split (W N A R s c : S) (H : SphD d N A R s c) (W2 : d 2 W = 0) (W3 : d 3 W = 0) : YMeq d (giD N A R s) (N * A * R ^ 2 * s) (Aym W s c) (FT d W s) 0 2 = d 1 (N * s * (d 1 W * A⁻¹)) + d 0 (-(A * s * (d 0 W * N⁻¹))) + A * N * s * W * (1 - W ^ 2) * R⁻¹ ^ 2
doc:
流束の形:YM 方程式 = ∂_x(N s W_x/A) + ∂_t(−A s W_t/N) + A N s W(1 − W²)/R²。
  x の 2 階微分は流束 √−g F^{1xθ} = N s W_x/A(ym_flux_tube)の ∂_x にだけ入る

name: nn_eq_eval
stmt: theorem nn_eq_eval (W N A R s c l : S) (H : SphD d N A R s c) (ev : S →+* ℝ) (hE : Ein d (gD N A R s) (giD N A R s) (GD d N A R s c) 1 1 = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tym (gD N A R s) (giD N A R s) (FT d W s) 1 1) : CFT.S4J.Gnn (ev N) (ev R) (ev (d 0 N)) (ev (d 0 R)) (ev (d 0 (d 0 R))) (ev (d 1 N) * (ev A)⁻¹) (ev (d 1 R) * (ev A)⁻¹) = 2 * (ev l) ^ 2 * CFT.S4J.Tnn (ev R) (ev W) (ev (d 0 W) * (ev N)⁻¹) (ev (d 1 W) * (ev A)⁻¹)
doc:
評価への受け渡し:各側で nn 成分の Einstein 方程式 G_xx = 2ℓ² T̂_xx が成り立てば、接合点の値で
  Gnn(…) = 2ℓ² Tnn(…)(ev は滑らかな関数をその点の値に送る環準同型)

name: delta_coeff_weighted
stmt: theorem delta_coeff_weighted {a x0 b m : ℝ} (hax : a < x0) (hxb : x0 < b) {pm pp qm qp Sm Sp κ km kp : ℝ → ℝ} (hpm : ∀ x ∈ Icc a x0, HasDerivWithinAt pm (qm x) (Icc a x0) x) (hpp : ∀ x ∈ Icc x0 b, HasDerivWithinAt pp (qp x) (Icc x0 b) x) (hκm : ∀ x ∈ Icc a x0, HasDerivWithinAt κ (km x) (Icc a x0) x) (hκp : ∀ x ∈ Icc x0 b, HasDerivWithinAt κ (kp x) (Icc x0 b) x) (cqm : ContinuousOn qm (Icc a x0)) (cqp : ContinuousOn qp (Icc x0 b)) (ckm : ContinuousOn km (Icc a x0)) (ckp : ContinuousOn kp (Icc x0 b)) (sideM : ∀ x ∈ Icc a x0, κ x * qm x = Sm x) (sideP : ∀ x ∈ Icc x0 b, κ x * qp x = Sp x) (weak : ∀ φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x, HasDerivAt φ (φ' x) x) → Continuous φ' → φ a = 0 → φ b = 0 → -((∫ x in a..x0, pm x * (km x * φ x + κ x * φ' x)) + ∫ x in x0..b, pp x * (kp x * φ x + κ x * φ' x)) = (∫ x in a..x0, Sm x * φ x) + (∫ x in x0..b, Sp x * φ x) + m * φ x0) : m = κ x0 * (pp x0 - pm x0)
doc:
重みつきの δ の係数:κ が連続で各側で C¹(導関数 km、kp)、⟨κ∂g, φ⟩ := −⟨g, ∂(κφ)⟩ の弱い形で
  κ∂g = S_正則 + m δ_{x₀} なら m = κ(x₀)[g]

name: slice_shell
stmt: theorem slice_shell {G R0 σ jump : ℝ} (hG : G ≠ 0) (hR : R0 ≠ 0) (h : 8 * π * G * σ = -2 / R0 * jump) : σ = -jump / (4 * π * G * R0)
doc:
α-III.9:時間対称な切り口のハミルトン拘束(slice_hamiltonian、A = 1)G_nn = −(2/R)R_xx + (1 − R_x²)/R² = 8πGρ。
  κ = −2/R で delta_coeff_weighted から 8πG σ = −(2/R₀)[R_x]、σ = −[R_x]/(4πG R₀)

name: trace_deriv_eq
stmt: theorem trace_deriv_eq {v0 v1 : ℝ} (hv : v0 < v1) {fp fm dp dm : ℝ → ℝ} (heq : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, fp v = fm v) (hp : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt fp (dp v) (Icc v0 v1) v) (hm : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt fm (dm v) (Icc v0 v1) v) : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, dp v = dm v
doc: 面の上でトレースが一致すれば接線微分も一致する(ヌルな面の [r_v] = [Ω_v] = [W_v] = 0)

name: timelike_two_sided
stmt: theorem timelike_two_sided (l N R Nt Rt Rtt k1 k2 W wp wm : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hR : R ≠ 0) (eP : CFT.S4J.Gnn N R Nt Rt Rtt k1 k2 = 2 * l ^ 2 * CFT.S4J.Tnn R W 0 wp) (eM : CFT.S4J.Gnn N R Nt Rt Rtt k1 k2 = 2 * l ^ 2 * CFT.S4J.Tnn R W 0 wm) : wp ^ 2 = wm ^ 2
doc:
α-III.1 の両側の合成:両側で nn 方程式(nn_eq_eval の値の形)、内部の量(N, R, N_t, R_t, R_tt, W)と
  K(k₁ = N_x/A、k₂ = R_x/A)が連続、時間対称 W_t = 0 なら [w²] = 0

name: timelike_dumbbell
stmt: theorem timelike_dumbbell (G l N A R Nt Rt Rtt Nxp Nxm Rxp Rxm W Stt Sang : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hA : A ≠ 0) (hR : R ≠ 0) (htt : 8 * π * G * Stt = -(2 * N ^ 2 * A⁻¹ ^ 2 * R⁻¹) * (Rxp - Rxm)) (hang : 8 * π * G * Sang = R ^ 2 * A⁻¹ ^ 2 * N⁻¹ * (Nxp - Nxm)) (eP : CFT.S4J.Gnn N R Nt Rt Rtt (Nxp * A⁻¹) (Rxp * A⁻¹) = 2 * l ^ 2 * CFT.S4J.Tnn R W 0 (-1 / l)) (eM : CFT.S4J.Gnn N R Nt Rt Rtt (Nxm * A⁻¹) (Rxm * A⁻¹) = 2 * l ^ 2 * CFT.S4J.Tnn R W 0 0) : ¬ (Stt = 0 ∧ Sang = 0)
doc:
α-III.1 の全体の合成(ダンベル):重みつきの δ の係数(tube_tt_form、tube_ang_form と
  delta_coeff_weighted)で殻なし(S_tt = S_ang = 0)なら [R_x] = [N_x] = 0、A は連続なので
  K は連続。両側の nn 方程式(nn_eq_eval)と W_t = 0 から [w²] = 0。帽子 w = −1/ℓ、首 w = 0 では
  成り立たないので、殻なしの時間的な接合はない

name: tube_color_current
stmt: theorem tube_color_current {a x0 b j : ℝ} (hax : a < x0) (hxb : x0 < b) {pm pp qm qp Sm Sp : ℝ → ℝ} (hpm : ∀ x ∈ Icc a x0, HasDerivWithinAt pm (qm x) (Icc a x0) x) (hpp : ∀ x ∈ Icc x0 b, HasDerivWithinAt pp (qp x) (Icc x0 b) x) (hqm : IntervalIntegrable qm MeasureTheory.volume a x0) (hqp : IntervalIntegrable qp MeasureTheory.volume x0 b) (sideM : ∀ x ∈ Icc a x0, qm x = Sm x) (sideP : ∀ x ∈ Icc x0 b, qp x = Sp x) (weak : ∀ φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x ∈ Icc a x0, HasDerivWithinAt φ (φ' x) (Icc a x0) x) → (∀ x ∈ Icc x0 b, HasDerivWithinAt φ (φ' x) (Icc x0 b) x) → Continuous φ' → φ a = 0 → φ b = 0 → -((∫ x in a..x0, pm x * φ' x) + ∫ x in x0..b, pp x * φ' x) = (∫ x in a..x0, Sm x * φ x) + (∫ x in x0..b, Sp x * φ x) + j * φ x0) (N s wp wm : ℝ) (hfp : pp x0 = N * s * wp) (hfm : pm x0 = N * s * wm) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hs : s ≠ 0) : j = N * s * (wp - wm) ∧ (j = 0 ↔ wp = wm)
doc:
時間的な管の YM の表面流:ymD_split で流束 g = N s W_x/A の ∂_x だけが x の 2 階微分を持つので、
  弱い形 −∫ g φ′ = ∫ S φ + j φ(x₀) から j = [g](delta_coeff)

name: dumbbell_color_needed
stmt: theorem dumbbell_color_needed (N s l : ℝ) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hs : s ≠ 0) (hl : l ≠ 0) : N * s * (0 - -1 / l) ≠ 0
doc: ダンベルの接合球を通る時間的な面には色の表面流が要る(帽子 w = −1/ℓ、首 w = 0)

name: null_color_current
stmt: theorem null_color_current {v0 v1 : ℝ} (hv : v0 < v1) {Wp Wm Wvp Wvm : ℝ → ℝ} (s : ℝ) (heq : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, Wp v = Wm v) (hp : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt Wp (Wvp v) (Icc v0 v1) v) (hm : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt Wm (Wvm v) (Icc v0 v1) v) : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, -(s * Wvp v) - -(s * Wvm v) = 0
doc:
ヌルな面 u = 一定 を横切る YM の流束は −s W_v(ym_flux_null)。W のトレースが一致すれば
  W_v も一致し(trace_deriv_eq)、表面流は 0

name: null_uu_shell
stmt: theorem null_uu_shell {G r0 μ jump : ℝ} (hG : G ≠ 0) (hr : r0 ≠ 0) (h : 8 * π * G * μ = -2 / r0 * jump) : μ = -jump / (4 * π * G * r0)
doc:
α-III.2:uu 成分 G_uu = −(2/r)r_uu + (2Ω_u/(Ωr)) r_u(uu_form)。κ = −2/r で delta_coeff_weighted から
  8πG μ = −(2/r₀)[r_u]。殻なし ⇔ [r_u] = 0

name: null_front_weak
stmt: theorem null_front_weak {v0 v1 G : ℝ} (hG : G ≠ 0) {r rv rup rum ruvp ruvm F μ : ℝ → ℝ} (hr : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt r (rv v) (Icc v0 v1) v) (hup : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt rup (ruvp v) (Icc v0 v1) v) (hum : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt rum (ruvm v) (Icc v0 v1) v) (sideP : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, r v * ruvp v + rup v * rv v = F v) (sideM : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, r v * ruvm v + rum v * rv v = F v) (h0 : rup v0 = rum v0) (hpos : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, r v ≠ 0) (hδ : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, 8 * π * G * μ v = -2 / r v * (rup v - rum v)) : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, μ v = 0
doc:
α-III.2 の合成:各 v で δ の係数から 8πG μ(v) = −(2/r(v))[r_u](v)(null_uu_shell)、
  両側の混合成分の式(mixed_eq)、角での [r_u] = 0 から、波面全体で μ = 0

name: RealLine.cont
stmt: theorem RealLine.cont {S : Type*} [Field S] {dd : Derivation ℤ S S} {ev : ℝ → S →+* ℝ} {I : Set ℝ} (L : RealLine dd ev I) (f : S) : ContinuousOn (fun y => ev y f) I

name: shell_coeff
stmt: theorem shell_coeff {S₁ S₂ : Type*} [Field S₁] [Field S₂] {d₁ : Derivation ℤ S₁ S₁} {d₂ : Derivation ℤ S₂ S₂} {ev₁ : ℝ → S₁ →+* ℝ} {ev₂ : ℝ → S₂ →+* ℝ} {a x0 b m : ℝ} (hax : a < x0) (hxb : x0 < b) (L₁ : RealLine d₁ ev₁ (Icc a x0)) (L₂ : RealLine d₂ ev₂ (Icc x0 b)) (κ₁ g₁ src₁ : S₁) (κ₂ g₂ src₂ : S₂) (e₁ : κ₁ * d₁ g₁ = src₁) (e₂ : κ₂ * d₂ g₂ = src₂) (hκ : ev₁ x0 κ₁ = ev₂ x0 κ₂) (weak : ∀ φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x, HasDerivAt φ (φ' x) x) → Continuous φ' → φ a = 0 → φ b = 0 → -((∫ x in a..x0, ev₁ x g₁ * (ev₁ x (d₁ κ₁) * φ x + ev₁ x κ₁ * φ' x)) + ∫ x in x0..b, ev₂ x g₂ * (ev₂ x (d₂ κ₂) * φ x + ev₂ x κ₂ * φ' x)) = (∫ x in a..x0, ev₁ x src₁ * φ x) + (∫ x in x0..b, ev₂ x src₂ * φ x) + m * φ x0) : m = ev₁ x0 κ₁ * (ev₂ x0 g₂ - ev₁ x0 g₁)
doc: 両側の実現と古典的な方程式から、分布としての方程式の δ の係数 m = κ(x₀)[g]

name: tt_side
stmt: theorem tt_side (W N A R s c l : S) (H : SphD d N A R s c) (E00 : Ein d (gD N A R s) (giD N A R s) (GD d N A R s c) 0 0 = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tym (gD N A R s) (giD N A R s) (FT d W s) 0 0) : -(2 * N ^ 2 * A⁻¹ ^ 2 * R⁻¹) * d 1 (d 1 R) = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tym (gD N A R s) (giD N A R s) (FT d W s) 0 0 - P00 d N A R
doc: tt 成分の Einstein 方程式 ⇒ κ_tt ∂_x(R_x) = 2ℓ²T̂_tt − P00

name: ang_side
stmt: theorem ang_side (W N A R s c l : S) (H : SphD d N A R s c) (E00 : Ein d (gD N A R s) (giD N A R s) (GD d N A R s c) 0 0 = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tym (gD N A R s) (giD N A R s) (FT d W s) 0 0) (E22 : Ein d (gD N A R s) (giD N A R s) (GD d N A R s c) 2 2 = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tym (gD N A R s) (giD N A R s) (FT d W s) 2 2) : R ^ 2 * A⁻¹ ^ 2 * N⁻¹ * d 1 (d 1 N) = 2 * l ^ 2 * (Tym (gD N A R s) (giD N A R s) (FT d W s) 2 2 + R ^ 2 * N⁻¹ ^ 2 / 2 * Tym (gD N A R s) (giD N A R s) (FT d W s) 0 0) - P22 d N A R
doc: θθ と tt 成分の Einstein 方程式 ⇒ κ_ang ∂_x(N_x) = 2ℓ²(T̂_θθ + (R²/2N²)T̂_tt) − P22

name: ym_side
stmt: theorem ym_side (W N A R s c : S) (H : SphD d N A R s c) (W2 : d 2 W = 0) (W3 : d 3 W = 0) (hY : YMeq d (giD N A R s) (N * A * R ^ 2 * s) (Aym W s c) (FT d W s) 0 2 = 0) : 1 * d 1 (N * s * (d 1 W * A⁻¹)) = -(d 0 (-(A * s * (d 0 W * N⁻¹))) + A * N * s * W * (1 - W ^ 2) * R⁻¹ ^ 2)
doc: YM 方程式 = 0 ⇒ ∂_x(N s W_x/A) = −∂_t(−A s W_t/N) − A N s W(1 − W²)/R²

name: uu_side
stmt: theorem uu_side (Om r s c W l : S) (H : SphN d Om r s c) (E : Ein d (gN Om r s) (giN Om r s) (GN d Om r s c) 0 0 = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tym (gN Om r s) (giN Om r s) (FT d W s) 0 0) : -(2 * r⁻¹) * d 0 (d 0 r) = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tym (gN Om r s) (giN Om r s) (FT d W s) 0 0 - 2 * d 0 Om * Om⁻¹ * r⁻¹ * d 0 r
doc: uu 成分の Einstein 方程式 ⇒ κ_uu ∂_u(r_u) = 2ℓ²T̂_uu − (2Ω_u/(Ωr)) r_u(κ_uu = −2/r)

name: fymD

stmt: theorem slice_hamiltonian (N A R s c : S) (H : SphD d N A R s c) (hRt : d 0 R = 0) (hAt : d 0 A = 0) : Ein d (gD N A R s) (giD N A R s) (GD d N A R s c) 0 0 * N⁻¹ ^ 2 = (1 - (d 1 R * A⁻¹) ^ 2 - 2 * R * (d 1 (d 1 R) * A⁻¹ ^ 2 - d 1 A * d 1 R * A⁻¹ ^ 3)) * R⁻¹ ^ 2
doc: 時間対称な切り口のハミルトン拘束の幾何:G_tt/N² = (1 − (DR)² − 2R·DDR)/R² = ½ ³R(D = A⁻¹∂_x)

name: tnn_tube
stmt: theorem tnn_tube (W s N A R : S) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hA : A ≠ 0) (hR : R ≠ 0) (hs : s ≠ 0) : Tym (gD N A R s) (giD N A R s) (FT d W s) 1 1 * A⁻¹ ^ 2 = Tnn R W (d 0 W * N⁻¹) (d 1 W * A⁻¹)

name: rho_tube
stmt: theorem rho_tube (W s N A R : S) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hA : A ≠ 0) (hR : R ≠ 0) (hs : s ≠ 0) : Tym (gD N A R s) (giD N A R s) (FT d W s) 0 0 * N⁻¹ ^ 2 = Rho R W (d 0 W * N⁻¹) (d 1 W * A⁻¹)

name: flux_tube
stmt: theorem flux_tube (W s N A R : S) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hA : A ≠ 0) (hR : R ≠ 0) (hs : s ≠ 0) : Tym (gD N A R s) (giD N A R s) (FT d W s) 0 1 * (N⁻¹ * A⁻¹) = 2 * (d 0 W * N⁻¹) * (d 1 W * A⁻¹) * R⁻¹ ^ 2

name: ym_flux_tube
stmt: theorem ym_flux_tube (W s N A R : S) (hA : A ≠ 0) (hR : R ≠ 0) : (N * A * R ^ 2 * s) * giD N A R s 1 1 * giD N A R s 2 2 * FT d W s 0 1 2 = N * s * (d 1 W * A⁻¹)
doc: YM 方程式の x 方向の流束:√−g g^{xx} g^{θθ} F^1_{xθ} = N s W_x/A(√−g = N A R² s)

name: uu_form
stmt: theorem uu_form (Om r s c : S) (H : SphN d Om r s c) : Ein d (gN Om r s) (giN Om r s) (GN d Om r s c) 0 0 = -(2 * r⁻¹) * (d 0 (d 0 r) - d 0 Om * Om⁻¹ * d 0 r)
doc: ヌルな面の uu 成分:G_uu = −(2/r)(r_uu − (Ω_u/Ω) r_u)

name: mixed_eq
stmt: theorem mixed_eq (W Om r s c l : S) (H : SphN d Om r s c) : Ein d (gN Om r s) (giN Om r s) (GN d Om r s c) 0 1 = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tym (gN Om r s) (giN Om r s) (FT d W s) 0 1 ↔ r * d 0 (d 1 r) + d 0 r * d 1 r = Om / 2 * (l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 * r⁻¹ ^ 2 - 1)
doc: uv 成分の Einstein 方程式 ⇔ r r_uv + r_u r_v = (Ω/2)(ℓ²(1 − W²)²/r² − 1)

name: ym_flux_null
stmt: theorem ym_flux_null (W s Om r : S) (hO : Om ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0) : (Om * r ^ 2 * s) * giN Om r s 0 1 * giN Om r s 2 2 * FT d W s 0 1 2 = -(s * d 1 W)
doc: ヌルな面 u = 一定 を横切る YM の流束:√−g g^{uv} g^{θθ} F^1_{vθ} = −s W_v(√−g = Ω r² s)

name: null_tangential_stress
stmt: theorem null_tangential_stress (W s Om r : S) (hO : Om ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hs : s ≠ 0) : Tym (gN Om r s) (giN Om r s) (FT d W s) 1 1 = 2 * (d 1 W) ^ 2 * r⁻¹ ^ 2 ∧ Tym (gN Om r s) (giN Om r s) (FT d W s) 0 1 = Om * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 * r⁻¹ ^ 4 / 2 ∧ Tym (gN Om r s) (giN Om r s) (FT d W s) 1 2 = 0 ∧ Tym (gN Om r s) (giN Om r s) (FT d W s) 1 3 = 0
doc: 生成子 k = ∂_v の方向の応力:T̂_vv、T̂_uv、T̂_vθ、T̂_vφ は W, W_v, r, Ω だけで決まる

name: delta_coeff
stmt: theorem delta_coeff {a u₀ b m : ℝ} (hau : a < u₀) (hub : u₀ < b) {pm pp qm qp Sm Sp : ℝ → ℝ} (hpm : ∀ x ∈ Icc a u₀, HasDerivWithinAt pm (qm x) (Icc a u₀) x) (hpp : ∀ x ∈ Icc u₀ b, HasDerivWithinAt pp (qp x) (Icc u₀ b) x) (hqm : IntervalIntegrable qm MeasureTheory.volume a u₀) (hqp : IntervalIntegrable qp MeasureTheory.volume u₀ b) (sideM : ∀ x ∈ Icc a u₀, qm x = Sm x) (sideP : ∀ x ∈ Icc u₀ b, qp x = Sp x) (weak : ∀ φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x ∈ Icc a u₀, HasDerivWithinAt φ (φ' x) (Icc a u₀) x) → (∀ x ∈ Icc u₀ b, HasDerivWithinAt φ (φ' x) (Icc u₀ b) x) → Continuous φ' → φ a = 0 → φ b = 0 → -((∫ x in a..u₀, pm x * φ' x) + ∫ x in u₀..b, pp x * φ' x) = (∫ x in a..u₀, Sm x * φ x) + (∫ x in u₀..b, Sp x * φ x) + m * φ u₀) : m = pp u₀ - pm u₀
doc: 横断線の上の弱い形:−∫ g φ′ = ∫ S φ + m φ(u₀) がすべての試験関数で成り立てば、δ の係数 m = [g]

name: tube_israel
stmt: theorem tube_israel (G N A R jR jN Stt Sang : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hA : A ≠ 0) (hR : R ≠ 0) (htt : -(2 * N ^ 2 * A⁻¹ ^ 2 * R⁻¹) * jR = 8 * π * G * Stt) (hang : R ^ 2 * A⁻¹ ^ 2 * N⁻¹ * jN = 8 * π * G * Sang) : (Stt = 0 ∧ Sang = 0) ↔ (jR = 0 ∧ jN = 0)
doc:
球対称な管の Israel 条件:tt 成分と角度の組み合わせの δ の係数(tube_tt_form、tube_ang_form と
  delta_coeff)が 8πG S なら、殻なし ⇔ [R_x] = [N_x] = 0

name: tube_K_jump
stmt: theorem tube_K_jump (N A R Nxp Nxm Rxp Rxm : ℝ) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hA : A ≠ 0) (hR : R ≠ 0) : (-(N * (Nxp * A⁻¹)) - -(N * (Nxm * A⁻¹)) = 0 ∧ R * (Rxp * A⁻¹) - R * (Rxm * A⁻¹) = 0) ↔ (Nxp - Nxm = 0 ∧ Rxp - Rxm = 0)
doc:
N, A, R が連続なら、外曲率の跳び [K_tt] = −N[N_x]/A、[K_θθ] = R[R_x]/A は
  [N_x] = [R_x] = 0 と同値

name: timelike_no_go
stmt: theorem timelike_no_go (l N R Nt Rt Rtt k1 k2 W wp wm : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hR : R ≠ 0) (eP : Gnn N R Nt Rt Rtt k1 k2 = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tnn R W 0 wp) (eM : Gnn N R Nt Rt Rtt k1 k2 = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tnn R W 0 wm) : wp ^ 2 = wm ^ 2
doc:
殻なしの時間的な接合([K] = 0、内部の量は連続)と両側の nn 方程式 G_nn = 2ℓ² T̂_nn から、
  時間対称な瞬間(W_t = 0)に [w²] = 0(w = W_x/A)

name: boosted_jump
stmt: theorem boosted_jump (R W wp wm β γ2 : ℝ) : γ2 * ((Tnn R W 0 wp - Tnn R W 0 wm) + 2 * β * (2 * 0 * wp * R⁻¹ ^ 2 - 2 * 0 * wm * R⁻¹ ^ 2) + β ^ 2 * (Rho R W 0 wp - Rho R W 0 wm)) = γ2 * (1 + β ^ 2) * (wp ^ 2 - wm ^ 2) * R⁻¹ ^ 2
doc:
管が速さ β(|β| < 1、γ² = 1/(1 − β²))で動いていても、W_t = 0 の瞬間の法線応力の跳びは
  [T(n,n)] = γ²(1 + β²)[w²]/R²(n = γ(e_x + β e_t))

name: color_current
stmt: theorem color_current (N s wp wm j : ℝ) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hs : s ≠ 0) (hj : j = N * s * wp - N * s * wm) : j = 0 ↔ wp = wm
doc: YM の表面流:流束 √−g F^{1xθ} = N s w の δ の係数(delta_coeff)は N s [w]。なしなら [w] = 0

name: cap_slope
stmt: theorem cap_slope (l : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun x => cos (x / l)) (-1 / l) (π * l / 2)
doc: 帽子 W = cos(s/ℓ)(W = r′)の赤道 s = πℓ/2 での傾き −1/ℓ

name: dumbbell_timelike
stmt: theorem dumbbell_timelike (l : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≠ (-1 / l) ^ 2 ∧ (0 : ℝ) ≠ -1 / l
doc:
ダンベルの接合球:帽子側 w = −1/ℓ、首側 w = 0(A = 1、W_t = 0)。
  殻なしの時間的な接合は [w²] = 0 を要し(timelike_no_go)、YM の表面流なしは [w] = 0 を要する
  (color_current)。どちらも成り立たない:どの速さで動く時間的な面にも、重力の殻と YM の表面流の
  両方が必要(boosted_jump で [T(n,n)] = γ²(1 + β²)(−1/ℓ²)/ℓ² ≠ 0)

name: dumbbell_no_shellfree_timelike
stmt: theorem dumbbell_no_shellfree_timelike (G l N A R Nt Rt Rtt k1p k1m k2p k2m W jR jN Stt Sang : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hA : A ≠ 0) (hR : R ≠ 0) (htt : -(2 * N ^ 2 * A⁻¹ ^ 2 * R⁻¹) * jR = 8 * π * G * Stt) (hang : R ^ 2 * A⁻¹ ^ 2 * N⁻¹ * jN = 8 * π * G * Sang) (hjR : jR = (k2p - k2m) * A) (hjN : jN = (k1p - k1m) * A) (eP : Gnn N R Nt Rt Rtt k1p k2p = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tnn R W 0 (-1 / l)) (eM : Gnn N R Nt Rt Rtt k1m k2m = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tnn R W 0 0) : ¬ (Stt = 0 ∧ Sang = 0)
doc:
α-III.1 の合成:ダンベルの接合球(帽子側 w = −1/ℓ、首側 w = 0、W_t = 0)を通る時間的な面は殻なしに
  なれない。Israel の δ の係数(tube_israel)、K の跳び([R_x] = A[k₂]、[N_x] = A[k₁]、A 連続)、
  両側の nn 方程式 G_nn = 2ℓ² T̂_nn(gauss_tube、tnn_tube)を合わせる

name: dumbbell_color_current
stmt: theorem dumbbell_color_current (N s l : ℝ) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hs : s ≠ 0) (hl : l ≠ 0) : N * s * 0 - N * s * (-1 / l) ≠ 0
doc: YM の側の合成:同じ接合球で、表面の色の流れなしの時間的な面はない(j = N s [w] = N s/ℓ ≠ 0)

name: jump_mixed
stmt: theorem jump_mixed (r rv rup rum ruvp ruvm F : ℝ) (hp : r * ruvp + rup * rv = F) (hm : r * ruvm + rum * rv = F) : r * (ruvp - ruvm) + rv * (rup - rum) = 0
doc: 混合成分の式の差:両側で r r_uv + r_u r_v = F(r, Ω, W の値が共通)なら r[r_uv] + r_v[r_u] = 0

name: jump_transport
stmt: theorem jump_transport {v0 v1 : ℝ} {r rv q q' : ℝ → ℝ} (hr : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt r (rv v) (Icc v0 v1) v) (hq : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt q (q' v) (Icc v0 v1) v) (heq : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, r v * q' v + rv v * q v = 0) (h0 : q v0 = 0) (hpos : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, r v ≠ 0) : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, q v = 0
doc: 跳びの輸送:r q′ + r_v q = 0、q(v₀) = 0、r ≠ 0 なら区間の上で q = 0((r q)′ = 0)

name: initial_jump
stmt: theorem initial_jump (α rtp rtm rxp rxm : ℝ) (htp : rtp = 0) (htm : rtm = 0) (hx : rxp = rxm) : α * (rtp - rxp) - α * (rtm - rxm) = 0
doc:
角での初期値:∂_u = α(e_t − e_x) の向き(α は両側で共通)で、時間対称(r_t = 0)と
  C¹ の空間接合([r_x] = 0)なら [r_u] = 0

name: null_front_no_shell
stmt: theorem null_front_no_shell {v0 v1 G : ℝ} {r rv q q' μ : ℝ → ℝ} (hr : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt r (rv v) (Icc v0 v1) v) (hq : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt q (q' v) (Icc v0 v1) v) (heq : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, r v * q' v + rv v * q v = 0) (h0 : q v0 = 0) (hpos : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, r v ≠ 0) (hμ : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, μ v = -q v / (4 * π * G * r v)) : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, μ v = 0
doc:
波面全体で殻なし:面密度 μ(v) = −[r_u](v)/(4πG r(v))(AlphaIII_Null の null_shell_from_weak を
  各 v で)と、跳びの輸送から μ = 0

name: null_front_from_mixed
stmt: theorem null_front_from_mixed {v0 v1 G : ℝ} {r rv rup rum ruvp ruvm F μ : ℝ → ℝ} (hr : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt r (rv v) (Icc v0 v1) v) (hup : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt rup (ruvp v) (Icc v0 v1) v) (hum : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt rum (ruvm v) (Icc v0 v1) v) (sideP : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, r v * ruvp v + rup v * rv v = F v) (sideM : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, r v * ruvm v + rum v * rv v = F v) (h0 : rup v0 = rum v0) (hpos : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, r v ≠ 0) (hμ : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, μ v = -(rup v - rum v) / (4 * π * G * r v)) : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, μ v = 0
doc:
α-III.2 の合成:両側の混合成分の式 r r_uv± + r_u± r_v = F(mixed_eq、F は r, Ω, W の共通の値)、
  角での [r_u] = 0(initial_jump)、r > 0 から、波面全体で面密度 μ = −[r_u]/(4πG r) = 0

name: dumbbell_front
stmt: theorem dumbbell_front (α l r : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0) (rup rum OuOp OuOm ruup ruum : ℝ) (hup : rup = 0) (hum : rum = 0) (hp : ruup = OuOp * rup - 2 * l ^ 2 * (α * (0 - 0)) ^ 2 / r) (hm : ruum = OuOm * rum - 2 * l ^ 2 * (α * (0 - -1 / l)) ^ 2 / r) : α * (0 - 0) - α * (0 - -1 / l) ≠ 0 ∧ ruup - ruum = -(2 * l ^ 2 / r) * ((α * (0 - 0)) ^ 2 - (α * (0 - -1 / l)) ^ 2) ∧ ruup - ruum ≠ 0
doc:
ダンベルの接合から出る波面:W_u = α(W_t − w)、W_t = 0 で [W_u] = −α[w] = −α/ℓ ≠ 0、
  [T̂_uu] = 2[W_u²]/r² ≠ 0。角(両側で r_u = 0)では uu 方程式 r_uu = (Ω_u/Ω) r_u − 2ℓ² W_u²/r から
  [r_uu] = −(2ℓ²/r)[W_u²]:波面は殻ではなく弱い不連続を運ぶ

name: gD_diag
stmt: theorem gD_diag (N A R s : S) : (∀ i j, gD N A R s i j = if i = j then ![-N ^ 2, A ^ 2, R ^ 2, R ^ 2 * s ^ 2] i else 0) ∧ (∀ i j, giD N A R s i j = if i = j then ![-(N⁻¹ ^ 2), A⁻¹ ^ 2, R⁻¹ ^ 2, R⁻¹ ^ 2 * s⁻¹ ^ 2] i else 0)
doc: gD は対角で、成分は ![−N², A², R², R²s²](giD も同様)

name: kretD
doc: 一般の球対称な計量の Kretschmann スカラー

name: kret_cap
stmt: theorem kret_cap (a X Y s c l : S) (H : CapData d a X Y s c) (h00 : (d 0 a) ^ 2 + a ^ 2 = l ^ 2) (h22 : d 0 (d 0 a) = -a) : KretD d ![-a ^ 2, a ^ 2, (a * X) ^ 2, (a * X) ^ 2 * s ^ 2] ![-(a⁻¹ ^ 2), a⁻¹ ^ 2, (a * X)⁻¹ ^ 2, (a * X)⁻¹ ^ 2 * s⁻¹ ^ 2] (GD d a a (a * X) s c) = 24 * l ^ 4 * a⁻¹ ^ 8
doc: 帽子(閉じた放射 FRW):場の方程式のもとで K = 24ℓ⁴/a⁸

name: constraint_prop_from_eqs
stmt: theorem constraint_prop_from_eqs (W Om r s c l : S) (H : SphN d Om r s c) (W2 : d 2 W = 0) (W3 : d 3 W = 0) (dl : ∀ i, d i l = 0) (E01 : Ein d (gN Om r s) (giN Om r s) (GN d Om r s c) 0 1 = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tym (gN Om r s) (giN Om r s) (Fym d (Aym W s c)) 0 1) (E22 : Ein d (gN Om r s) (giN Om r s) (GN d Om r s c) 2 2 = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tym (gN Om r s) (giN Om r s) (Fym d (Aym W s c)) 2 2) (hY : YMeq d (giN Om r s) (Om * r ^ 2 * s) (Aym W s c) (Fym d (Aym W s c)) 0 2 = 0) : d 1 (Cu d Om r W l) = -(d 1 r * r⁻¹) * Cu d Om r W l ∧ d 0 (Cv d Om r W l) = -(d 0 r * r⁻¹) * Cv d Om r W l
doc:
α-IV.1 の合成:uv・θθ の Einstein 方程式と YM 方程式(F = dA + A∧A)から Goursat の形を出し
  (goursat_r、goursat_Om、goursat_W)、拘束の伝播 ∂_v C_u = −(r_v/r) C_u、∂_u C_v = −(r_u/r) C_v を得る

name: cap_cosmic
stmt: theorem cap_cosmic (l η : ℝ) : (l * cos η) ^ 2 = l ^ 2 - (l * sin η) ^ 2
doc: 固有時 τ = ℓ sin η で a = ℓ cos η は a² = ℓ² − τ²

name: kret_blowup
stmt: theorem kret_blowup (l : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) : Tendsto (fun η => 24 * l ^ 4 * ((l * cos η)⁻¹) ^ 8) (𝓝[<] (π / 2)) atTop
doc: η → π/2⁻ で K = 24ℓ⁴/(ℓ cos η)⁸ → ∞

name: center_limit
stmt: theorem center_limit (v : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ χ ∈ Ioo 0 π, f χ = v) : Tendsto f (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 v)
doc: K と ρ̂ は χ によらない(空間的に一様)ので、極座標の中心 χ → 0⁺ でも同じ値をとる

name: density_center
stmt: theorem density_center (a : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) : Tendsto (fun χ => CFT.S4J.Rho (a * sin χ) (cos χ) 0 (-(sin χ) / a)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (3 / (2 * a ^ 4)))

name: front_null
stmt: theorem front_null (a χ' : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) : -a ^ 2 + a ^ 2 * χ' ^ 2 = 0 ↔ χ' ^ 2 = 1
doc: 共形計量 a²(−dη² + dχ²) の曲線 η ↦ (η, χ(η)) がヌル ⇔ χ′² = 1

name: front_sign
stmt: theorem front_sign (χ' : ℝ → ℝ) (hc : Continuous χ') (h : ∀ η, χ' η ^ 2 = 1) (h0 : χ' 0 = -1) : ∀ η, χ' η = -1
doc: 連続な χ′ が至る所 χ′² = 1 で χ′(0) = −1 なら至る所 χ′ = −1(内向きの波面は向きを変えない)

name: front_inward
stmt: theorem front_inward (χ χ' : ℝ → ℝ) (hd : ∀ η, HasDerivAt χ (χ' η) η) (hc : Continuous χ') (hnull : ∀ η, χ' η ^ 2 = 1) (h0' : χ' 0 = -1) (h0 : χ 0 = π / 2) : ∀ η, χ η = π / 2 - η
doc: 接合 χ(0) = π/2 から内向きのヌルな波面は χ(η) = π/2 − η

name: front_hits_center
stmt: theorem front_hits_center (η : ℝ) : π / 2 - η = 0 ↔ η = π / 2
doc: 波面が中心 χ = 0 に着くのは η = π/2(崩壊の瞬間)だけ。それ以前の中心は波面の外(帽子の依存領域)

name: curv_length
doc:
曲率の長さ L(L⁴ = 1/K)は K = 24ℓ⁴/a⁸ で L⁴ = a⁸/(24ℓ⁴)、すなわち L² = a⁴/(√24 ℓ²)(L ~ a²/ℓ)。
  時間対称な初期面 a = ℓ ではすでに L⁴ = ℓ⁴/24

name: wgc_length
stmt: theorem wgc_length (G g l : ℝ) (hG : 0 < G) (hg : g ≠ 0) (hl : l ^ 2 = 4 * π * G / g ^ 2) : (1 / (g / √G)) ^ 2 = l ^ 2 / (4 * π)
doc:
WGC の磁気版のカットオフ Λ = g M_Pl = g/√G:ℓ² = 4πG/g² なら (1/Λ)² = G/g² = ℓ²/(4π)。
  帽子の曲率の長さ(初期面で ℓ/24^{1/4})と同じ桁:ダンベルは最初からカットオフの尺度にある

name: ymN_00
stmt: theorem ymN_00 (W Om r s c : S) (H : SphN d Om r s c) (W2 : d 2 W = 0) (W3 : d 3 W = 0) : YMeq d (giN Om r s) (Om * r ^ 2 * s) (Aym W s c) (FT d W s) 0 0 = 0

name: ymN_01
stmt: theorem ymN_01 (W Om r s c : S) (H : SphN d Om r s c) (W2 : d 2 W = 0) (W3 : d 3 W = 0) : YMeq d (giN Om r s) (Om * r ^ 2 * s) (Aym W s c) (FT d W s) 0 1 = 0

name: ymN_02

name: goursat_r
stmt: theorem goursat_r (W Om r s c l : S) (H : SphN d Om r s c) (hE : Ein d (gN Om r s) (giN Om r s) (GN d Om r s c) 0 1 = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tym (gN Om r s) (giN Om r s) (FT d W s) 0 1) : d 0 (d 1 r) = 2⁻¹ * Om * (l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 * r⁻¹ ^ 2 - 1) * r⁻¹ - d 0 r * d 1 r * r⁻¹

name: goursat_Om
stmt: theorem goursat_Om (W Om r s c l : S) (H : SphN d Om r s c) (hE : Ein d (gN Om r s) (giN Om r s) (GN d Om r s c) 2 2 = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tym (gN Om r s) (giN Om r s) (FT d W s) 2 2) : d 0 (d 1 Om) = d 0 Om * d 1 Om * Om⁻¹ - 2 * Om * d 0 (d 1 r) * r⁻¹ - Om ^ 2 * l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 * r⁻¹ ^ 4

name: goursat_W
stmt: theorem goursat_W (W Om r s c : S) (H : SphN d Om r s c) (W2 : d 2 W = 0) (W3 : d 3 W = 0) (hY : YMeq d (giN Om r s) (Om * r ^ 2 * s) (Aym W s c) (FT d W s) 0 2 = 0) : d 0 (d 1 W) = 2⁻¹ * Om * W * (1 - W ^ 2) * r⁻¹ ^ 2
doc: Goursat の形(W):YM 方程式から W_uv = ½ Ω W(1 − W²)/r²(Z8 の式)

name: constraint_prop_u
stmt: theorem constraint_prop_u (W Om r s c l : S) (H : SphN d Om r s c) (dl : ∀ i, d i l = 0) (hr : d 0 (d 1 r) = 2⁻¹ * Om * (l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 * r⁻¹ ^ 2 - 1) * r⁻¹ - d 0 r * d 1 r * r⁻¹) (hO : d 0 (d 1 Om) = d 0 Om * d 1 Om * Om⁻¹ - 2 * Om * d 0 (d 1 r) * r⁻¹ - Om ^ 2 * l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 * r⁻¹ ^ 4) (hW : d 0 (d 1 W) = 2⁻¹ * Om * W * (1 - W ^ 2) * r⁻¹ ^ 2) : d 1 (Cu d Om r W l) = -(d 1 r * r⁻¹) * Cu d Om r W l
doc: 拘束の伝播(u の拘束を v の方向に):Goursat の三つの式のもとで ∂_v C_u = −(r_v/r) C_u

name: constraint_prop_v
stmt: theorem constraint_prop_v (W Om r s c l : S) (H : SphN d Om r s c) (dl : ∀ i, d i l = 0) (hr : d 0 (d 1 r) = 2⁻¹ * Om * (l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 * r⁻¹ ^ 2 - 1) * r⁻¹ - d 0 r * d 1 r * r⁻¹) (hO : d 0 (d 1 Om) = d 0 Om * d 1 Om * Om⁻¹ - 2 * Om * d 0 (d 1 r) * r⁻¹ - Om ^ 2 * l ^ 2 * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 * r⁻¹ ^ 4) (hW : d 0 (d 1 W) = 2⁻¹ * Om * W * (1 - W ^ 2) * r⁻¹ ^ 2) : d 0 (Cv d Om r W l) = -(d 0 r * r⁻¹) * Cv d Om r W l
