name: cap_00
stmt: theorem cap_00 (a X Y s c l : S) (H : CapData d a X Y s c) : Ein d (gD a a (a * X) s) (giD a a (a * X) s) (GD d a a (a * X) s c) 0 0 = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tym (gD a a (a * X) s) (giD a a (a * X) s) (FT d Y s) 0 0 ↔ (d 0 a) ^ 2 + a ^ 2 = l ^ 2
doc: 帽子の tt 成分 ⇔ Friedmann の式 a′² + a² = ℓ²(閉じた放射 FRW、共形時間)

name: cap_11
stmt: theorem cap_11 (a X Y s c l : S) (H : CapData d a X Y s c) : Ein d (gD a a (a * X) s) (giD a a (a * X) s) (GD d a a (a * X) s c) 1 1 = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tym (gD a a (a * X) s) (giD a a (a * X) s) (FT d Y s) 1 1 ↔ 2 * a * d 0 (d 0 a) - (d 0 a) ^ 2 + a ^ 2 + l ^ 2 = 0
doc: 帽子の χχ 成分 ⇔ 2aa″ − a′² + a² + ℓ² = 0

name: cap_22
stmt: theorem cap_22 (a X Y s c l : S) (H : CapData d a X Y s c) : Ein d (gD a a (a * X) s) (giD a a (a * X) s) (GD d a a (a * X) s c) 2 2 = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tym (gD a a (a * X) s) (giD a a (a * X) s) (FT d Y s) 2 2 ↔ 2 * a * d 0 (d 0 a) - (d 0 a) ^ 2 + a ^ 2 + l ^ 2 = 0
doc: 帽子の θθ 成分 ⇔ 2aa″ − a′² + a² + ℓ² = 0(等方)

name: cap_01
stmt: theorem cap_01 (a X Y s c l : S) (H : CapData d a X Y s c) : Ein d (gD a a (a * X) s) (giD a a (a * X) s) (GD d a a (a * X) s c) 0 1 = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tym (gD a a (a * X) s) (giD a a (a * X) s) (FT d Y s) 0 1
doc: 帽子の tχ 成分は恒等的に成り立つ(W_η = 0)

name: neckSph
stmt: theorem neckSph (C Sn l s c : S) (H : NeckData d C Sn l s c) : SphD d 1 C l s c

name: neck_00
stmt: theorem neck_00 (C Sn l s c : S) (H : NeckData d C Sn l s c) : Ein d (gD 1 C l s) (giD 1 C l s) (GD d 1 C l s c) 0 0 = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tym (gD 1 C l s) (giD 1 C l s) (FT d 0 s) 0 0
doc: 首(AdS₂ × S² の同期座標 −dt² + cos²(t/ℓ)dz² + ℓ²dΩ²)は EYM の (0,0) 成分を満たす

name: neck_11
stmt: theorem neck_11 (C Sn l s c : S) (H : NeckData d C Sn l s c) : Ein d (gD 1 C l s) (giD 1 C l s) (GD d 1 C l s c) 1 1 = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tym (gD 1 C l s) (giD 1 C l s) (FT d 0 s) 1 1
doc: 首(AdS₂ × S² の同期座標 −dt² + cos²(t/ℓ)dz² + ℓ²dΩ²)は EYM の (1,1) 成分を満たす

name: neck_22
stmt: theorem neck_22 (C Sn l s c : S) (H : NeckData d C Sn l s c) : Ein d (gD 1 C l s) (giD 1 C l s) (GD d 1 C l s c) 2 2 = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tym (gD 1 C l s) (giD 1 C l s) (FT d 0 s) 2 2
doc: 首(AdS₂ × S² の同期座標 −dt² + cos²(t/ℓ)dz² + ℓ²dΩ²)は EYM の (2,2) 成分を満たす

name: neck_01
stmt: theorem neck_01 (C Sn l s c : S) (H : NeckData d C Sn l s c) : Ein d (gD 1 C l s) (giD 1 C l s) (GD d 1 C l s c) 0 1 = 2 * l ^ 2 * Tym (gD 1 C l s) (giD 1 C l s) (FT d 0 s) 0 1
doc: 首(AdS₂ × S² の同期座標 −dt² + cos²(t/ℓ)dz² + ℓ²dΩ²)は EYM の (0,1) 成分を満たす

name: constraint_transport
stmt: theorem constraint_transport {v0 v1 : ℝ} {r rv C C' : ℝ → ℝ} (hr : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt r (rv v) (Icc v0 v1) v) (hC : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, HasDerivWithinAt C (C' v) (Icc v0 v1) v) (heq : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, C' v = -(rv v * (r v)⁻¹) * C v) (h0 : C v0 = 0) (hpos : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, r v ≠ 0) : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, C v = 0
doc: 拘束の輸送:∂_v C = −(r_v/r) C(constraint_prop_u)、初期の特性線で C = 0、r > 0 なら C ≡ 0

name: fw_eq
stmt: theorem fw_eq (r σ W : ℝ) : FW r σ W = 2⁻¹ * exp (2 * σ) * W * (1 - W ^ 2) * r⁻¹ ^ 2
doc: W_uv の右辺(AlphaIV の FW)は Ω = e^{2σ} で goursat_W の右辺と同じ

name: front_gd_inv
stmt: theorem front_gd_inv (l z : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : zfront l (l * gd (z / l)) = z
doc: z_ℓ(ℓ gd(z/ℓ)) = z(すべての z)

name: gd_front_inv
stmt: theorem gd_front_inv (l t : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (ht : |t| < π * l / 2) : l * gd (zfront l t / l) = t
doc: 主値の帯 |t| < πℓ/2 で ℓ gd(z_ℓ(t)/ℓ) = t:z_ℓ と t ↦ ℓ gd(·/ℓ) は互いに逆

name: cos_gd
stmt: theorem cos_gd (y : ℝ) : cos (gd y) = 1 / cosh y
doc: cos(gd y) = sech y

name: mercator
stmt: theorem mercator (y : ℝ) : HasDerivAt gd (cos (gd y)) y
doc: Mercator:gd′ = cos ∘ gd。したがって緯度 φ = gd(y) で球面の dφ² + cos²φ dλ² = sech²y (dy² + dλ²)

name: neck_mercator
stmt: theorem neck_mercator (l y : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun y => l * gd (y / l)) (cos (l * gd (y / l) / l)) y
doc:
首の Mercator 座標:t(y) = ℓ gd(y/ℓ) は dt/dy = cos(t/ℓ)。したがって
  −dt² + cos²(t/ℓ)dz² = cos²(t/ℓ)(−dy² + dz²)(同じ Gudermann 写像が首の 2 次元の計量を共形平坦にする)

name: null_curve_unique
stmt: theorem null_curve_unique (l : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (T T' : ℝ → ℝ) (hT : ∀ z, HasDerivAt T (T' z) z) (hnull : ∀ z, T' z = cos (T z / l)) (hstrip : ∀ z, |T z| < π * l / 2) (h0 : T 0 = 0) : ∀ z, T z = l * gd (z / l)
doc:
原点を通る未来向き・右向きのヌル曲線(dt/dz = cos(t/ℓ)、主値の帯の中)は t = ℓ gd(z/ℓ) に限る。
  台帳 Z10 の t/ℓ* = gd(z/ℓ*)。これは Mercator 座標での 45° の航程線 y = z の像:座標の対応であって、
  球面(K = +1)と首の 2 次元部分(K = −1/ℓ²、AdS₂)の力学的な同値ではない

name: fronts_meet_iff
stmt: theorem fronts_meet_iff (l L t : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (ht : |t| < π * l / 2) : -(L / 2) + zfront l t = L / 2 - zfront l t ↔ t = l * gd (L / (2 * l))
doc:
長さ L の首の両端からの波面 z_L = −L/2 + z_ℓ(t)、z_R = L/2 − z_ℓ(t) が出会うのは t = ℓ gd(L/(2ℓ)) のときに限る
  (上界でなく等式。t* < πℓ/2 は fronts_meet_before)

name: cap_accel
stmt: theorem cap_accel (a a1 a2 l : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (h00 : a1 ^ 2 + a ^ 2 = l ^ 2) (h22 : 2 * a * a2 - a1 ^ 2 + a ^ 2 + l ^ 2 = 0) : a2 = -a
doc: 帽子の加速度:tt 成分 a′² + a² = ℓ² と θθ 成分 2aa″ − a′² + a² + ℓ² = 0 から a″ = −a

name: cap_unique
stmt: theorem cap_unique (l : ℝ) (A A' : ℝ → ℝ) (h1 : ∀ η, HasDerivAt A (A' η) η) (h2 : ∀ η, HasDerivAt A' (-A η) η) (h0 : A 0 = l) (h0' : A' 0 = 0) : ∀ η, A η = l * cos η
doc: 時間対称な初期値 a(0) = ℓ、a′(0) = 0 で a″ = −a の解は a = ℓ cos η だけ

name: cap_proper_time
stmt: theorem cap_proper_time (l η : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun η => l * sin η) (l * cos η) η ∧ l * sin (π / 2) = l
doc: 中心の固有時 t(η) = ∫₀^η a = ℓ sin η(dt = a dη)、崩壊 η = π/2 で t = ℓ

name: cap_density
stmt: theorem cap_density (a X Y : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hX : X ≠ 0) (hXY : X ^ 2 + Y ^ 2 = 1) : CFT.S4J.Rho (a * X) Y 0 (-X / a) = 3 / (2 * a ^ 4)
doc: 帽子の YM のエネルギー密度(rho_tube の Rho、W = cos χ、W_χ/A = −sin χ/a)は ρ̂ = 3/(2a⁴)

name: cap_crunch
stmt: theorem cap_crunch (l : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) : Tendsto (fun η => 3 / (2 * (l * cos η) ^ 4)) (𝓝[<] (π / 2)) atTop
doc: 崩壊:a = ℓ cos η → 0(η → π/2⁻)で ρ̂ = 3/(2a⁴) → ∞(中心の測地線に沿って曲率の不変量が発散)

name: t_sing_lt
stmt: theorem t_sing_lt (l : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) : l < π * l / 2
doc: t_sing = ℓ < πℓ/2(Z9 の目標)

name: center_before_front
stmt: theorem center_before_front (η : ℝ) (h : η < π / 2) : (0 : ℝ) < π / 2 - η
doc:
接合から帽子へ向かう波面は共形座標で χ = π/2 − η(dχ = −dη)。η < π/2 なら中心 χ = 0 はまだ波面の外
  (厳密な FRW の領域)にある。波面が中心に着く η = π/2 は崩壊の瞬間に一致する

name: flat_clock
stmt: theorem flat_clock (z : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun l : ℝ => l * gd (z / l)) atTop (𝓝 z)
doc: 平坦極限:到着時計 ℓ gd(z/ℓ) → z(ℓ → ∞)

name: front_deriv_zero
stmt: theorem front_deriv_zero : HasDerivAt (fun x => arsinh (tan x)) 1 0
doc: arsinh ∘ tan の 0 での微分は 1

name: flat_front
stmt: theorem flat_front (t : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun l : ℝ => zfront l t) atTop (𝓝 t)
doc: 平坦極限:波面 ℓ arsinh(tan(t/ℓ)) → t

name: flat_metric
stmt: theorem flat_metric (t z : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun l : ℝ => cos (t / l) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1) ∧ Tendsto (fun l : ℝ => 1 / cosh (z / l)) atTop (𝓝 1)
doc: 平坦極限:計量の係数 cos²(t/ℓ) → 1、時計の速さ sech(z/ℓ) → 1

name: z9_maximal
stmt: theorem z9_maximal (r rp W : ℝ → ℝ) (l κ τ1 T r1 : ℝ) (hT : τ1 < T) (hpos : ∀ τ ∈ Ico τ1 T, 0 < r τ) (h1 : ∀ τ ∈ Ico τ1 T, HasDerivAt r (rp τ) τ) (h2 : ∀ τ ∈ Ico τ1 T, HasDerivAt rp (CFT.Z9.acc l (r τ) (rp τ) (W τ)) τ) (hk : l ^ 2 ≤ 2 * κ) (hW : ∀ τ ∈ Ico τ1 T, κ ≤ W τ ^ 2 * r τ ^ 2) (h0 : rp τ1 = 0) (hr1 : r τ1 = r1) : T - τ1 ≤ π * r1 / 2
doc: Z9 の正しい形:正の解が [τ₁, T) で類の条件を満たすなら T − τ₁ ≤ πr₁/2(最大の存在区間の長さ)

name: z9_reaches_zero_vacuous
stmt: theorem z9_reaches_zero_vacuous (r rp W : ℝ → ℝ) (l κ τ1 r1 : ℝ) (hr1p : 0 < r1) (hκ : 0 < κ) (h1 : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 (τ1 + π * r1 / 2), HasDerivAt r (rp τ) τ) (h2 : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 (τ1 + π * r1 / 2), HasDerivAt rp (CFT.Z9.acc l (r τ) (rp τ) (W τ)) τ) (hk : l ^ 2 ≤ 2 * κ) (hW : ∀ τ ∈ Icc τ1 (τ1 + π * r1 / 2), κ ≤ W τ ^ 2 * r τ ^ 2) (h0 : rp τ1 = 0) (hr1 : r τ1 = r1) : False
doc:
旧 z9_reaches_zero の仮定は κ > 0 では両立しない(r = 0 の点で κ ≤ W²r² = 0 が破れる)。
  したがってその結論は空虚で、正しい形は z9_collapse、z9_maximal

name: wave_jump_final
stmt: theorem wave_jump_final {S₁ S₂ : Type*} [Field S₁] [CharZero S₁] [Field S₂] [CharZero S₂] (d₁ : Fin 4 → Derivation ℤ S₁ S₁) (d₂ : Fin 4 → Derivation ℤ S₂ S₂) (Om₁ r₁ s₁ c₁ W₁ : S₁) (Om₂ r₂ s₂ c₂ W₂ : S₂) (H₁ : SphN d₁ Om₁ r₁ s₁ c₁) (H₂ : SphN d₂ Om₂ r₂ s₂ c₂) (W2₁ : d₁ 2 W₁ = 0) (W3₁ : d₁ 3 W₁ = 0) (W2₂ : d₂ 2 W₂ = 0) (W3₂ : d₂ 3 W₂ = 0) (Y₁ : YMeq d₁ (giN Om₁ r₁ s₁) (Om₁ * r₁ ^ 2 * s₁) (Aym W₁ s₁ c₁) (Fym d₁ (Aym W₁ s₁ c₁)) 0 2 = 0) (Y₂ : YMeq d₂ (giN Om₂ r₂ s₂) (Om₂ * r₂ ^ 2 * s₂) (Aym W₂ s₂ c₂) (Fym d₂ (Aym W₂ s₂ c₂)) 0 2 = 0) {v0 v1 : ℝ} {fv₁ : ℝ → S₁ →+* ℝ} {fv₂ : ℝ → S₂ →+* ℝ} (F₁ : RealLine (d₁ 1) fv₁ (Icc v0 v1)) (F₂ : RealLine (d₂ 1) fv₂ (Icc v0 v1)) (cr : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, fv₁ v r₁ = fv₂ v r₂) (cO : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, fv₁ v Om₁ = fv₂ v Om₂) (cW : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, fv₁ v W₁ = fv₂ v W₂) : ∀ v ∈ Icc v0 v1, fv₂ v (d₂ 0 W₂) - fv₁ v (d₁ 0 W₁) = fv₂ v0 (d₂ 0 W₂) - fv₁ v0 (d₁ 0 W₁)

doc: 二階微分 V″ = 2q²/w³ > 0(最小点は非退化)

name: veff_magnetic_runaway
stmt: theorem veff_magnetic_runaway (p : ℝ) (hp : p ≠ 0) : (∀ w > 0, 0 < veff p 0 w) ∧ Tendsto (fun w => veff p 0 w) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
doc: 【α-VIII.3】磁荷だけ:V = wp² > 0 だが w → 0 で 0 に近づき、最小点はない(ディラトンの逃走)

name: neck_condition
stmt: theorem neck_condition (p q l : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (hpq : 0 < p * q) : Real.sqrt (2 * p * q) = l ↔ 2 * p * q = l ^ 2
doc: 首との一致:√v₂ = ℓ* ⇔ 2pq = ℓ*²(ℓ* > 0、pq > 0)

name: quat_bracket
stmt: theorem quat_bracket : let i : Quaternion ℝ

name: eps_contract
stmt: theorem eps_contract (a b : Fin 3) : ∑ c, ∑ d, eps a c d * eps b c d = 2 * (if a = b then 1 else 0)

name: s3_ricci
stmt: theorem s3_ricci (R x : ℝ) (hR : R ≠ 0) (hx : sin x ≠ 0) : -((-(sin x) / R) / (R * sin x)) = 1 / R ^ 2 ∧ (1 - cos x ^ 2) / (R * sin x) ^ 2 = 1 / R ^ 2 ∧ 1 / R ^ 2 + 1 / R ^ 2 = 2 / R ^ 2
doc: S³(R):f = R sin(s/R) の断面曲率はすべて 1/R²

name: parallelizing_torsion
stmt: theorem parallelizing_torsion (R : ℝ) (hR : R ≠ 0) (a b : Fin 3) : (1 / 4) * ∑ c, ∑ d, (2 / R * eps a c d) * (2 / R * eps b c d) = 2 / R ^ 2 * (if a = b then 1 else 0)

name: s3_volume
stmt: theorem s3_volume (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) : ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(π * R), 4 * π * (R * sin (s / R)) ^ 2 = 2 * π ^ 2 * R ^ 3

name: flux
stmt: theorem flux (R : ℝ) (hR : R ≠ 0) : 2 / R * (2 * π ^ 2 * R ^ 3) = 4 * π ^ 2 * R ^ 2

name: level
stmt: theorem level (R α' k : ℝ) (hα : α' ≠ 0) : 4 * π ^ 2 * R ^ 2 / (4 * π ^ 2 * α') = k ↔ R ^ 2 = k * α'
doc: ∫H/(4π²α′) = k ⇔ R² = kα′

name: ell_sq_eq
stmt: theorem ell_sq_eq (G g c α' : ℝ) (hg : g ≠ 0) (hG : G = c * (g ^ 2 / (4 * π)) * α') : 4 * π * G / g ^ 2 = c * α'
doc: ℓ*² = 4πG/g² に G = c (g²/4π) α′ を入れると ℓ*² = c α′

name: ell_ledger
stmt: theorem ell_ledger (G g α' : ℝ) (hg : g ≠ 0) (hG : G = (1 / 8) * (g ^ 2 / (4 * π)) * α') : 4 * π * G / g ^ 2 = α' / 8

name: ell_witten
stmt: theorem ell_witten (G g α' : ℝ) (hg : g ≠ 0) (hG : G = (1 / 4) * (g ^ 2 / (4 * π)) * α') : 4 * π * G / g ^ 2 = α' / 4

name: kaplunovsky
stmt: theorem kaplunovsky (G g κ α' : ℝ) (hα : α' ≠ 0) (hκ : κ ^ 2 = 8 * π * G) (hgk : g ^ 2 = 4 * κ ^ 2 / α') : G = (1 / 8) * (g ^ 2 / (4 * π)) * α'
doc: g² = 4κ²/α′、κ² = 8πG ⇒ G = (1/8)(g²/4π)α′

name: wzw_level
stmt: theorem wzw_level (k c α' : ℝ) (hα : α' ≠ 0) (h : k * α' = c * α') : k = c
doc: R² = kα′ と R = ℓ*(R² = c α′)から k = c

name: wzw_obstruction
stmt: theorem wzw_obstruction (c : ℝ) (h0 : 0 < c) (h1 : c < 1) : ¬ ∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧ (m : ℝ) = c
doc: 0 < c < 1 なら k = c は正の整数でない

name: wzw_obstruction_values
stmt: theorem wzw_obstruction_values : (¬ ∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧ (m : ℝ) = 1 / 8) ∧ (¬ ∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧ (m : ℝ) = 1 / 4)

name: entropy_from_action
stmt: theorem entropy_from_action (G g p v1 v2 : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) (h1 : v1 ≠ 0) (h2 : v2 ≠ 0) : 2 * π * (0 - fLag G g p v1 v2) = E G g p v1 v2
doc: 作用からの導出:ℰ = 2π(0·e − f) が台帳の式

name: z41_deriv_v1
stmt: theorem z41_deriv_v1 (G g p v1 v2 : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun x => E G g p x v2) (-(π / G) + 4 * π ^ 2 * p ^ 2 / g ^ 2 / v2) v1

name: z41_deriv_v2
stmt: theorem z41_deriv_v2 (G g p v1 v2 : ℝ) (h2 : v2 ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun x => E G g p v1 x) (π / G - 4 * π ^ 2 * p ^ 2 / g ^ 2 * v1 / v2 ^ 2) v2

name: z41_critical
doc: 臨界点は v₁ = v₂ = p²ℓ*² だけ(ℓ*² = 4πG/g²)

name: z41_entropy
doc: 臨界値:ℰ = 4π²p²/g² = 面積/(4G)

name: z41_neck
stmt: theorem z41_neck (G g : ℝ) : (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 * (4 * π * G / g ^ 2) = 4 * π * G / g ^ 2
doc: p = 1:近地平線の半径² = ℓ*²(首の半径 r₀ = ℓ*)

name: killing_time_pos
stmt: theorem killing_time_pos (ε : Fin 4 → ℝ × ℝ) (hε : ε ≠ 0) : 0 < ∑ a, ((ε a).1 ^ 2 + (ε a).2 ^ 2)
doc: K^t = ε†ε = Σ|ε_a|² > 0(ε ≠ 0、成分を実部・虚部の組で書く)

name: causal_time_ne_zero
stmt: theorem causal_time_ne_zero (Kt : ℝ) (Kx : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hK : (Kt, Kx) ≠ (0, 0)) (hcausal : -Kt ^ 2 + (Kx 0 ^ 2 + Kx 1 ^ 2 + Kx 2 ^ 2) ≤ 0) : Kt ≠ 0
doc: 0 でない因果的なベクトルの時間成分は 0 でない

name: throat_static
stmt: theorem throat_static (r r' Kt Ks : ℝ → ℝ) (hr : ∀ t, HasDerivAt r (r' t) t) (hKt : ∀ t, Kt t ≠ 0) (hiso : ∀ t, Kt t * r' t + Ks t * 0 = 0) : ∀ t, r t = r 0
doc: 首の喉で Killing ベクトルがあれば半径は時間によらない

name: no_killing_spinor
stmt: theorem no_killing_spinor (r r' : ℝ → ℝ) (hr : ∀ t, HasDerivAt r (r' t) t) (hcollapse : 0 < r 0 ∧ ∃ T, r T = 0) (ε : ℝ → Fin 4 → ℝ × ℝ) (hε : ∀ t, ε t ≠ 0) (Ks : ℝ → ℝ) (hiso : ∀ t, (∑ a, ((ε t a).1 ^ 2 + (ε t a).2 ^ 2)) * r' t + Ks t * 0 = 0) : False
doc: 崩壊するダンベル(Z9)には Killing スピノルがない

name: cap_unique
stmt: theorem cap_unique (l : ℝ) (a ad : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ η, HasDerivAt a (ad η) η) (had : ∀ η, HasDerivAt ad (-a η) η) (h0 : a 0 = l) (hd0 : ad 0 = 0) : ∀ η, a η = l * cos η
doc: 【α-VIII.7】帽子の ODE の解は一つ:a″ = −a、a(0) = ℓ、a′(0) = 0 ⇒ a = ℓ cos η

name: kret_hasDeriv
stmt: theorem kret_hasDeriv (l η : ℝ) (hc : l * cos η ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun s => 24 * l ^ 4 * ((l * cos s) ^ 8)⁻¹) (24 * l ^ 4 * (-(8 * (l * cos η) ^ 7 * (l * -sin η)) / ((l * cos η) ^ 8) ^ 2)) η
doc: 曲率の不変量 K(η) = 24ℓ⁴/(ℓ cos η)⁸ の η 微分

name: kret_deriv_ne
stmt: theorem kret_deriv_ne (l η : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (h1 : 0 < η) (h2 : η < π / 2) : 24 * l ^ 4 * (-(8 * (l * cos η) ^ 7 * (l * -sin η)) / ((l * cos η) ^ 8) ^ 2) ≠ 0
doc: 【α-VIII.7】0 < η < π/2、ℓ > 0 で ∂_η K ≠ 0(帽子の曲率は単調に増え、時間によらない形にならない)

name: no_killing_spinor_cap
stmt: theorem no_killing_spinor_cap (l : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (a ad : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ η, HasDerivAt a (ad η) η) (had : ∀ η, HasDerivAt ad (-a η) η) (h0 : a 0 = l) (hd0 : ad 0 = 0) (Kr : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (hKr : ∀ η χ, Kr η χ = 24 * l ^ 4 * ((a η) ^ 8)⁻¹) (Kη Kχ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℝ → ℝ → Fin 4 → ℝ × ℝ) (hε : ∀ η χ, ε η χ ≠ 0) (hKη : ∀ η χ, Kη η χ = (∑ i, ((ε η χ i).1 ^ 2 + (ε η χ i).2 ^ 2)) / a η) (dKη dKχ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (hdη : ∀ η χ, HasDerivAt (fun s => Kr s χ) (dKη η χ) η) (hdχ : ∀ η χ, HasDerivAt (fun s => Kr η s) (dKχ η χ) χ) (hKill : ∀ η ∈ Ioo 0 (π / 2), ∀ χ, Kη η χ * dKη η χ + Kχ η χ * dKχ η χ = 0) : False
doc:
【α-VIII.7】帽子に Killing スピノルはない。
  入力:帽子の ODE(IV.5)、曲率の不変量 K(η, χ) = 24ℓ⁴/a(η)⁸(`kret_cap`)、
  外部の事実:K^η = ε†ε/a(Killing スピノルの双線形)、K^η ∂_η K + K^χ ∂_χ K = 0(Killing ベクトルはスカラーを保つ)

name: throat_ds_zero
stmt: theorem throat_ds_zero (f : ℝ → ℝ) (d : ℝ) (hd : HasDerivAt f d 0) (hsym : ∀ s, f s = f (-s)) : d = 0
doc: 偶関数の原点での微分は 0

name: no_killing_spinor_sym
stmt: theorem no_killing_spinor_sym (r : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (rt rs : ℝ → ℝ) (hds : ∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun s => r t s) (rs t) 0) (hsym : ∀ t s, r t s = r t (-s)) (hdt : ∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun τ => r τ 0) (rt t) t) (ε : ℝ → Fin 4 → ℝ × ℝ) (hε : ∀ t, ε t ≠ 0) (Ks : ℝ → ℝ) (hKill : ∀ t, (∑ a, ((ε t a).1 ^ 2 + (ε t a).2 ^ 2)) * rt t + Ks t * rs t = 0) (hcollapse : 0 < r 0 0 ∧ ∃ T, r T 0 = 0) : False
doc: 鏡映対称なダンベルで喉が崩壊するなら Killing スピノルはない

name: z44_full
stmt: theorem z44_full (r : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (rt rs rtt W : ℝ → ℝ) (l κ r1 : ℝ) (hr1p : 0 < r1) (hds : ∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun s => r t s) (rs t) 0) (hsym : ∀ t s, r t s = r t (-s)) (hdt : ∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun τ => r τ 0) (rt t) t) (hdtt : ∀ t, HasDerivAt rt (CFT.Z9.acc l (r t 0) (rt t) (W t)) t) (hk : l ^ 2 ≤ 2 * κ) (hW : ∀ t, κ ≤ W t ^ 2 * r t 0 ^ 2) (h0 : rt 0 = 0) (hr1 : r 0 0 = r1) (ε : ℝ → Fin 4 → ℝ × ℝ) (hε : ∀ t, ε t ≠ 0) (Ks : ℝ → ℝ) (hKill : ∀ t, (∑ a, ((ε t a).1 ^ 2 + (ε t a).2 ^ 2)) * rt t + Ks t * rs t = 0) : False
doc: Z9 と合わせる:喉の半径が中心の式に従えば、崩壊は定理として出て、Killing スピノルはない

name: decomposition
stmt: theorem decomposition (F n : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hn : dot n n = 1) : F = fun i => dot F n * n i + cross n (cross F n) i
doc: 分解 F = (F·n)n + n × (F × n)(n·n = 1)

name: cross_zero_parallel
stmt: theorem cross_zero_parallel (F n : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hn : dot n n = 1) (h : cross F n = 0) : F = fun i => dot F n * n i
doc: F × n = 0 なら F は n に平行

name: abelian_projection
stmt: theorem abelian_projection (F : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (n : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hn : dot n n = 1) (commD : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (ricci : ∀ μ ν, commD μ ν = cross (F μ ν) n) (covconst : ∀ μ ν, commD μ ν = 0) : ∀ μ ν, F μ ν = fun i => dot (F μ ν) n * n i
doc: Abelian 射影:D n = 0 と Ricci の恒等式 [D_μ, D_ν] n = F_{μν} × n から F_{μν} = (n·F_{μν}) n

name: stabilizer_iff
stmt: theorem stabilizer_iff (ω n : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hn : dot n n = 1) : cross ω n = 0 ↔ ω = fun i => dot ω n * n i
doc:
安定化群:無限小回転 v ↦ ω × v が n を動かさない ⇔ ω = (ω·n) n。
  n の安定化部分代数は n が張る一次元(可換、u(1))で、SU(2) は D n = 0 の上で U(1) に還元される

name: stabilizer_abelian
stmt: theorem stabilizer_abelian (s t : ℝ) (n : Fin 3 → ℝ) : cross (fun i => s * n i) (fun i => t * n i) = 0
doc: 安定化部分代数は可換:n に平行な二つの生成子の括弧は 0

name: bl_commute_color
stmt: theorem bl_commute_color (d : Fin 4 → ℚ) (h01 : diagonal d * P01 = P01 * diagonal d) (h12 : diagonal d * P12 = P12 * diagonal d) : d 0 = d 1 ∧ d 1 = d 2
doc: 色の入れ替えと可換 ⇒ 3 色で値が等しい

name: bl_direction
stmt: theorem bl_direction (d : Fin 4 → ℚ) (h01 : diagonal d * P01 = P01 * diagonal d) (h12 : diagonal d * P12 = P12 * diagonal d) (htr : (diagonal d).trace = 0) : d = fun i => d 0 * ![1, 1, 1, -3] i
doc: 跡ゼロも課すと d = a·(1, 1, 1, −3):向きは一意

name: bl_normalization
stmt: theorem bl_normalization (a : ℚ) (hnu : (1 / 2 : ℚ) + 0 + (a * (-3)) / 2 = 0) : a * (-3) = -1 ∧ a * 1 = 1 / 3
doc: ν_L が中性(1/2 + 0 + X_lep/2 = 0)なら、レプトン −1、クォーク 1/3

name: bl_charges
doc: 規格化した B−L から電荷 Q = T₃L + T₃R + (B−L)/2 を計算すると一世代の値になる

name: bl_anomaly_linear
stmt: theorem bl_anomaly_linear : (blWeyl16.map fun f => f.1 * f.2).sum = 0

name: bl_anomaly_cubic
stmt: theorem bl_anomaly_cubic : (blWeyl16.map fun f => f.1 * f.2 ^ 3).sum = 0

name: bl_anomaly_needs_nuR
stmt: theorem bl_anomaly_needs_nuR : ((blWeyl16.take 5).map fun f => f.1 * f.2 ^ 3).sum ≠ 0
doc: 右手のニュートリノを除くと相殺しない

name: bl_anomaly_without_nuR
stmt: theorem bl_anomaly_without_nuR : ((blWeyl16.take 5).map fun f => f.1 * f.2).sum = -1 ∧ ((blWeyl16.take 5).map fun f => f.1 * f.2 ^ 3).sum = -1
doc: 右手のニュートリノがないと、一世代あたり Σ(B−L) = −1(重力混合)、Σ(B−L)³ = −1(U(1)_{B−L}³)

name: bl_anomaly_three_generations
stmt: theorem bl_anomaly_three_generations : 3 * ((blWeyl16.take 5).map fun f => f.1 * f.2 ^ 3).sum = -3
doc: 三世代では −3

name: dirac_difference
stmt: theorem dirac_difference (N θ : ℝ) : aN N θ - aS N θ = N

name: dirac_quantization
stmt: theorem dirac_quantization (N : ℝ) : Complex.exp (Complex.I * N * (2 * π)) = 1 ↔ ∃ n : ℤ, N = n
doc: 遷移関数 e^{iNφ} が φ ↦ φ + 2π で一価 ⇔ N ∈ ℤ

name: curvature_N
stmt: theorem curvature_N (N θ : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (aN N) (N / 2 * sin θ) θ
doc: 曲率 f = ∂_θ a_φ dθ∧dφ(北)

name: curvature_S
stmt: theorem curvature_S (N θ : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (aS N) (N / 2 * sin θ) θ
doc: 曲率(南)。両方の座標で同じ 2 形式

name: chern_number
stmt: theorem chern_number (N : ℝ) : (1 / (2 * π)) * ((2 * π) * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..π, N / 2 * sin θ) = N
doc: c₁ = (1/2π) ∫₀^{2π} ∫₀^π (N/2) sin θ dθ dφ = N

name: chern_eq_two_q
stmt: theorem chern_eq_two_q (q : ℝ) : (1 / (2 * π)) * ((2 * π) * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..π, (2 * q) / 2 * sin θ) = 2 * q
doc: 単極子の電荷 q = N/2 なら c₁ = 2q

name: gauss_bonnet_round
stmt: theorem gauss_bonnet_round (r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) : (2 * π) * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..π, (1 / r ^ 2) * (r ^ 2 * sin θ) = 2 * π * 2
doc: Gauss–Bonnet(半径 r の球面):∫∫ K dA = 4π = 2π χ(S²)

name: ym_formula
stmt: theorem ym_formula (lam : ℝ) (b : Fin 3) : YM lam b = (8 * I * lam * (1 - lam) * (2 * lam - 1)) • s b

name: ym_roots
stmt: theorem ym_roots (lam : ℝ) : (∀ b, YM lam b = 0) ↔ lam = 0 ∨ lam = 1 / 2 ∨ lam = 1
doc: 一様な場の YM 方程式の解は λ = 0、1/2(メロン)、1 だけ

name: hypercharge_commutant
stmt: theorem hypercharge_commutant (c : Fin 5 → ℚ) : (dot c rootC1 = 0 ∧ dot c rootC2 = 0 ∧ dot c rootL = 0) ↔ ∀ e, act c e = (2 * c 3) * T3R e + (-(3 / 2) * c 0) * BL e
doc: SU(3)_C × SU(2)_L と可換な Cartan の元は T₃R と B − L の一次結合

name: charge_unique
stmt: theorem charge_unique (a b : ℚ) : (Q a b nuL = 0 ∧ Q a b nuc = 0) ↔ (a = 1 ∧ b = 1 / 2)
doc: 二つの中性条件で係数が一意に決まる

name: charge_all_solutions
stmt: theorem charge_all_solutions (a b : ℚ) : ((Q a b nuL = 0 ∨ Q a b eL = 0) ∧ (Q a b nuc = 0 ∨ Q a b ec = 0)) ↔ ((a = 1 ∧ b = 1 / 2) ∨ (a = -1 ∧ b = 1 / 2) ∨ (a = 1 ∧ b = -1 / 2) ∨ (a = -1 ∧ b = -1 / 2))
doc: 名前を付けずに「各レプトン二重項に中性の成分がある」だけを要求すると、解は 4 つ

name: charge_formula
stmt: theorem charge_formula (e : Fin 5 → ℚ) : 6 * Q 1 (1 / 2) e = 3 * e 3 - (e 0 + e 1 + e 2)
doc: a = 1、b = ½ の Q は 16 の重みで 6Q = 3e₃ − (e₀ + e₁ + e₂)(AlphaVII_SO10 の charges の第 1 成分)

name: charge_components
stmt: theorem charge_components (e : Fin 5 → ℚ) : 3 * BL e = -(e 0 + e 1 + e 2) ∧ 4 * T3L e = e 3 + e 4 ∧ 4 * T3R e = e 3 - e 4
doc: 同じく B − L、T₃L、T₃R も charges の残りの成分と一致

name: generation_from_neutrality
stmt: theorem generation_from_neutrality (a b : ℚ) (h : Q a b nuL = 0 ∧ Q a b nuc = 0) : (∀ e, 6 * Q a b e = 3 * e 3 - (e 0 + e 1 + e 2)) ∧ (CFT.SO10.signs.map CFT.SO10.charges).Perm CFT.SO10.oneGeneration
doc: まとめ:二つの中性条件 ⇒ 16 の電荷の表(並べ替えを除いて一世代)

name: jr_unique
stmt: theorem jr_unique (m M f : ℝ → ℝ) (hM : ∀ y, HasDerivAt M (m y) y) (hf : ∀ y, HasDerivAt f (-(m y) * f y) y) (y : ℝ) : f y = f 0 * exp (M 0 - M y)
doc: ゼロモードの一意性:f′ = −m f、M′ = m なら f(y) = f(0)·exp(M(0) − M(y))

name: kink_plus
stmt: theorem kink_plus (y : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun x => 1 / cosh x) (-(sinh y / cosh y) * (1 / cosh y)) y
doc: m = sinh/cosh で f₊ = 1/cosh は f′ = −m f

name: kink_minus
stmt: theorem kink_minus (y : ℝ) : HasDerivAt cosh ((sinh y / cosh y) * cosh y) y
doc: f₋ = cosh は f′ = +m f

name: tanh_deriv
stmt: theorem tanh_deriv (y : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun x => sinh x / cosh x) ((1 / cosh y) ^ 2) y

name: norm_plus
stmt: theorem norm_plus (R : ℝ) : ∫ y in (-R)..R, (1 / cosh y) ^ 2 = 2 * (sinh R / cosh R)
doc: ∫_{−R}^{R} f₊² = 2 sinh R/cosh R

name: norm_plus_lt
stmt: theorem norm_plus_lt (R : ℝ) : ∫ y in (-R)..R, (1 / cosh y) ^ 2 < 2
doc: 有界:2 sinh R/cosh R < 2

name: norm_minus
stmt: theorem norm_minus (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) : 2 * R ≤ ∫ y in (-R)..R, cosh y ^ 2

name: shell_unit
doc: U(p) の四元数 (m/E, −p/E) は単位

name: shell_sign
stmt: theorem shell_sign (m E : ℝ) (hE : 0 < E) : 0 < m / E ↔ 0 < m

name: shell_equator
stmt: theorem shell_equator (m E : ℝ) (hE : E ≠ 0) : m / E = 0 ↔ m = 0

name: shell_celestial
stmt: theorem shell_celestial (m : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun P : ℝ => m / sqrt (m ^ 2 + P ^ 2)) atTop (𝓝 0)
doc: |p| → ∞ で Re U = m/√(m²+P²) → 0:赤道は質量殻の無限遠(光的な方向の球面)

name: helicity_chern
doc: 赤道 S² のヘリシティの線束:Chern 数は 2h、質量のある状態の和は 0

name: chiral_protected
stmt: theorem chiral_protected (Extends : ℝ → Prop) (c1 : ℝ → ℝ) (hext : ∀ h, Extends h → c1 h = 0) (hc : c1 (1 / 2) = 1) : ¬ Extends (1 / 2)
doc: 半球に延びる束の Chern 数は 0(外部定理 hext)なら、Chern 数 ±1 の束は延びない

name: rs_coefficients
stmt: theorem rs_coefficients {H₀ V W : E →ₗ[ℝ] E} (hH : H₀.IsSymmetric) {ψ₀ ψ₁ ψ₂ : E} {E₀ E₁ E₂ : ℝ} (hn : ⟪ψ₀, ψ₀⟫ = 1) (h0 : H₀ ψ₀ = E₀ • ψ₀) (h1 : H₀ ψ₁ + V ψ₀ = E₀ • ψ₁ + E₁ • ψ₀) (h2 : H₀ ψ₂ + V ψ₁ + W ψ₀ = E₀ • ψ₂ + E₁ • ψ₁ + E₂ • ψ₀) (hnorm : ⟪ψ₀, ψ₁⟫ = 0) : E₁ = ⟪ψ₀, V ψ₀⟫ ∧ E₂ = ⟪ψ₀, W ψ₀⟫ + ⟪ψ₀, V ψ₁⟫
doc: 一次と二次の係数

name: rs_single_level
stmt: theorem rs_single_level {H₀ V W : E →ₗ[ℝ] E} (hH : H₀.IsSymmetric) (hV : V.IsSymmetric) {ψ₀ ψ₁ ψ₂ u : E} {E₀ E₁ E₂ L : ℝ} (hn : ⟪ψ₀, ψ₀⟫ = 1) (h0 : H₀ ψ₀ = E₀ • ψ₀) (h1 : H₀ ψ₁ + V ψ₀ = E₀ • ψ₁ + E₁ • ψ₀) (h2 : H₀ ψ₂ + V ψ₁ + W ψ₀ = E₀ • ψ₂ + E₁ • ψ₁ + E₂ • ψ₀) (hnorm : ⟪ψ₀, ψ₁⟫ = 0) (hsimple : ∀ x, H₀ x = E₀ • x → ∃ c : ℝ, x = c • ψ₀) (hu : V ψ₀ - E₁ • ψ₀ = u) (hexc : H₀ u = (E₀ + L) • u) (hL : L ≠ 0) : ψ₁ = -(1 / L) • u ∧ E₂ = ⟪ψ₀, W ψ₀⟫ - ⟪u, u⟫ / L
doc: 励起準位が一つだけの場合:ψ₁ = −u/L、E₂ = ⟨Wψ₀⟩ − ‖u‖²/L

name: z28d_from_rs

name: rs_first
stmt: theorem rs_first (Ev : Fin (n + 1) → K) (V : Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → K) (ψ1 : Fin (n + 1) → K) (e1 : K) (hnorm : ψ1 0 = 0) (h1 : ∀ i, Ev i * ψ1 i + V i 0 = Ev 0 * ψ1 i + e1 * (if i = 0 then 1 else 0)) (hgap : ∀ m : Fin n, Ev 0 ≠ Ev m.succ) : e1 = V 0 0 ∧ ∀ m : Fin n, ψ1 m.succ = V m.succ 0 / (Ev 0 - Ev m.succ)
doc: 一次の式:成分 0 から e₁ = V₀₀、成分 m から (ψ₁)_m

name: rs_second
stmt: theorem rs_second (Ev : Fin (n + 1) → K) (V W : Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → K) (ψ1 ψ2 : Fin (n + 1) → K) (e1 e2 : K) (hn1 : ψ1 0 = 0) (h1 : ∀ i, Ev i * ψ1 i + V i 0 = Ev 0 * ψ1 i + e1 * (if i = 0 then 1 else 0)) (h2 : ∀ i, Ev i * ψ2 i + (∑ j, V i j * ψ1 j) + W i 0 = Ev 0 * ψ2 i + e1 * ψ1 i + e2 * (if i = 0 then 1 else 0)) (hgap : ∀ m : Fin n, Ev 0 ≠ Ev m.succ) : e2 = W 0 0 + ∑ m : Fin n, V 0 m.succ * V m.succ 0 / (Ev 0 - Ev m.succ)
doc: 二次の式:e₂ = W₀₀ + Σ_{m≠0} V_{0m}V_{m0}/(E₀ − E_m)

name: rs_second_hermitian
stmt: theorem rs_second_hermitian (Ev : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) (V W : Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) (ψ1 ψ2 : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) (e1 e2 : ℂ) (hn1 : ψ1 0 = 0) (h1 : ∀ i, Ev i * ψ1 i + V i 0 = Ev 0 * ψ1 i + e1 * (if i = 0 then 1 else 0)) (h2 : ∀ i, Ev i * ψ2 i + (∑ j, V i j * ψ1 j) + W i 0 = Ev 0 * ψ2 i + e1 * ψ1 i + e2 * (if i = 0 then 1 else 0)) (hgap : ∀ m : Fin n, Ev 0 ≠ Ev m.succ) (herm : ∀ m : Fin n, V 0 m.succ = (starRingEnd ℂ) (V m.succ 0)) : e2 = W 0 0 + ∑ m : Fin n, (Complex.normSq (V m.succ 0) : ℂ) / (Ev 0 - Ev m.succ)
doc: エルミートな V(V_{0m} = conj V_{m0})では e₂ = W₀₀ + Σ |V_{m0}|²/(E₀ − E_m)

name: chern_eq_euler

doc: 【α-VII.1 Z24】c₁(TS²) = χ(S²):|N| = 2 の単極子の束の c₁ と Gauss–Bonnet の χ が一致

name: J_sq
stmt: theorem J_sq (n v : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hn : dot n n = 1) (hv : dot n v = 0) : cross n (cross n v) = -v
doc:
【α-VII.1 Z24】破れずに残る U(1) の生成子 ad_n = n × · は、n に直交する成分(荷電した W)の上で
複素構造:n·v = 0、|n| = 1 なら n × (n × v) = −v。
ハリネズミ n(x) = x(単位球面の点)では n^⊥ = {v : x·v = 0} は接平面 T_x S² そのもので、
J = n × · は向きに合った 90° の回転(`J_tangent`、`J_isometry`)。したがって荷電した W の束
(n^⊥、複素構造 J)は接束 TS² と同じ複素線束で、c₁ = c₁(TS²) = χ(S²) = 2(`chern_eq_euler`)。

name: J_tangent

doc: J は n^⊥ を保つ:n · (n × v) = 0

name: J_isometry
stmt: theorem J_isometry (n v : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hn : dot n n = 1) (hv : dot n v = 0) : dot (cross n v) (cross n v) = dot v v
doc: J は長さを保つ:|n × v|² = |v|²(|n| = 1、n·v = 0)。J は n^⊥ の上の 90° の回転

name: ricci

name: connection_decomp
stmt: theorem connection_decomp (n : Fin 3 → R) (hn : dot n n = 1) (μ : Fin 4) (hD : ∀ i, Dcov d g A μ n i = 0) (i : Fin 3) : g * A μ i = g * dot (A μ) n * n i - cross n (fun j => d μ (n j)) i

name: thooft_identity

stmt: theorem clifford_hessian (H : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) (hH : ∀ i j, H i j = H j i) : ∑ i, ∑ j, H i j • (e i * e j) = -(∑ i, H i i) • (1 : 𝒜)

name: dirac_killing
stmt: theorem dirac_killing (c : ℝ) (ψ : 𝒜) (v : Fin n → ℝ) (H : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) (hH : ∀ i j, H i j = H j i) : (∑ i, e i * (c • (e i * ψ)) = (-(n : ℝ) * c) • ψ) ∧ (∑ i, e i * ((∑ j, H i j • e j) * ψ + (∑ j, v j • e j) * (c • (e i * ψ))) = (-(∑ i, H i i)) • ψ + (c * ((n : ℝ) - 2)) • ((∑ j, v j • e j) * ψ))
doc: Killing スピノルと Leibniz 則からの Dirac 作用素の値(スピノルは 𝒜 の元、Clifford 積は左からの積)

name: dirac_input
stmt: theorem dirac_input (ψ : 𝒜) (v : Fin n → ℝ) (H : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) (hH : ∀ i j, H i j = H j i) (L fv : ℝ) (hΔ : -(∑ i, H i i) = L * fv) : (∑ i, e i * ((-1 / 2 : ℝ) • (e i * ψ)) = ((n : ℝ) / 2) • ψ) ∧ (∑ i, e i * ((∑ j, H i j • e j) * ψ + (∑ j, v j • e j) * ((-1 / 2 : ℝ) • (e i * ψ))) = L • (fv • ψ) - (((n : ℝ) - 2) / 2) • ((∑ j, v j • e j) * ψ))
doc: c = −½(Dψ = (n/2)ψ)、Δf = −tr Hess f = L·f のとき:D(df·ψ) = L fψ − ((n−2)/2) df·ψ(入力 (i))

name: skew_cross
stmt: theorem skew_cross (T : E → E) (hT : ∀ x y, @inner ℝ E _ (T x) y = -@inner ℝ E _ x (T y)) (x : E) : @inner ℝ E _ x (T x) = 0
doc: 歪対称な T では ⟨x, Tx⟩ = 0(交差項 ⟨fψ, df·ψ⟩ = 0 の各点の形)

name: killing_inner_const
stmt: theorem killing_inner_const (T : E → E) (hT : ∀ x y, @inner ℝ E _ (T x) y = -@inner ℝ E _ x (T y)) (c : ℝ) (ψ φ : E) : @inner ℝ E _ (c • T ψ) φ + @inner ℝ E _ ψ (c • T φ) = 0
doc: 同じ定数 c の Killing スピノル:∂⟨ψ, φ⟩ = ⟨c Xψ, φ⟩ + ⟨ψ, c Xφ⟩ = 0(⟨ψ, φ⟩ は定数)

name: join_metric
stmt: theorem join_metric (θ dθ : ℝ) (ω dω : E₁) (η dη : E₂) (hω : ‖ω‖ = 1) (hη : ‖η‖ = 1) (hω' : @inner ℝ E₁ _ ω dω = 0) (hη' : @inner ℝ E₂ _ η dη = 0) : ‖(-sin θ * dθ) • ω + cos θ • dω‖ ^ 2 + ‖(cos θ * dθ) • η + sin θ • dη‖ ^ 2 = dθ ^ 2 + cos θ ^ 2 * ‖dω‖ ^ 2 + sin θ ^ 2 * ‖dη‖ ^ 2
doc: y = (cos θ ω, sin θ η) の線素:|dy|² = dθ² + cos²θ|dω|² + sin²θ|dη|²

name: join_volume
stmt: theorem join_volume (θ : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ θ) (h1 : θ ≤ π / 2) : √(cos θ ^ 6 * sin θ ^ 10) = cos θ ^ 3 * sin θ ^ 5
doc: 体積要素 √det = cos³θ sin⁵θ(0 ≤ θ ≤ π/2)

name: beta_substitution
stmt: theorem beta_substitution (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : Continuous g) : ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), g (cos θ ^ 2) * (cos θ ^ 3 * sin θ ^ 5) = (1 / 2) * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, g x * (x * (1 - x) ^ 2)
doc: X = cos²θ への変数変換:∫₀^{π/2} g(cos²θ) cos³θ sin⁵θ dθ = ½∫₀¹ g(x) x(1 − x)² dx

name: sphere_moments
stmt: theorem sphere_moments : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), cos θ ^ 3 * sin θ ^ 5) = 1 / 24 ∧ 24 * (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), cos θ ^ 2 * (cos θ ^ 3 * sin θ ^ 5)) = 2 / 5 ∧ 24 * (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), (cos θ ^ 2) ^ 2 * (cos θ ^ 3 * sin θ ^ 5)) = 1 / 5
doc: 正規化した S⁹ の上の期待値:E[g(X)] = 12 ∫₀¹ g(x) x(1 − x)² dx(全体の質量 ∫cos³ sin⁵ = 1/24)

name: mean_variance
doc: f = X − 2/5 は平均 0、分散 1/25 = A(入力 ⟨fψ, k⟩ = 0 と ⟨fψ, fψ⟩ = A の出所)

name: local_min_of_quadratic
stmt: theorem local_min_of_quadratic (f : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hf : (fun t => f t - f 0 - c * t ^ 2) =o[𝓝 0] (fun t => t ^ 2)) : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 0, f 0 ≤ f t
doc: f(t) = f(0) + c t² + o(t²)、c > 0 なら t = 0 の近くで f(t) ≥ f(0)

name: z28d_local_min
stmt: theorem z28d_local_min (Λ : ℝ → ℝ) (hΛ : (fun t => Λ t - Λ 0 - (99 / 250) * t ^ 2) =o[𝓝 0] (fun t => t ^ 2)) : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 0, Λ 0 ≤ Λ t
doc: Z28-d:正規化した最低固有値の二次係数 99/250 > 0 なので、ρ = 1(t = 0)は楕円体族に沿った局所最小

name: ellipsoid_tangent
stmt: theorem ellipsoid_tangent {m : ℕ} (y : Fin 4 → ℝ) (dyy Hy Hsq : Fin 4 → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) (g : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) (hsphere : ∀ a, Hy a = -(y a) • g) (hleib : ∀ a, Hsq a = dyy a + y a • Hy a) : ∑ a, dyy a = ∑ a, Hsq a + (∑ a, y a ^ 2) • g
doc:
楕円体 (ρ y_H, y₆)(ρ = 1 + t)の誘導計量の一次の変化は h = 2Σ_{a∈H} dy_a ⊗ dy_a。
  球面の座標関数は Hess y_a = −y_a g(入力、S⁹ ⊂ R¹⁰ の第二基本形式)、Leibniz 則
  Hess(y_a²/2) = dy_a ⊗ dy_a + y_a Hess y_a のもとで
    Σ dy_a ⊗ dy_a = Hess(X/2) + X g = ½ L_{∇X/2} g + (f + 2/5) g(X = |y_H|²、f = X − 2/5)。
  つまり一次では、楕円体族の接方向 = 微分同相(Lie 微分)+ 共形変形 f + 全体のスケール 2/5。
  二次係数が共形族と一致することは、規格化した固有値の汎関数が丸い S⁹ で臨界的で微分同相で
  不変であることから従う(台帳の論証、ここでは扱わない)

name: resolvent_formula
stmt: theorem resolvent_formula (D : E →ₗ[ℝ] E) (a n L : ℝ) (u w : E) (hL : L ≠ 0) (ha : a = n / 2) (hu : D u = a • u + w) (hw : D w = L • u - ((n - 2) / 2) • w) : D (((n - 1) / L) • u + (1 / L) • w) - a • (((n - 1) / L) • u + (1 / L) • w) = u
doc: (D − a)⁻¹ u の明示形

name: z28d_first
stmt: theorem z28d_first (a l1 : ℝ) (ψ φ1 : E) (hn : ⟪ψ, ψ⟫ = 1) (hψ : D ψ = a • ψ) (hPfP : ⟪ψ, M ψ⟫ = 0) (hnorm : ⟪ψ, φ1⟫ = 0) (h1 : D φ1 = a • φ1 + a • M ψ + l1 • ψ) : l1 = 0
doc: 一次:λ₁ = 0

name: z28d_second
stmt: theorem z28d_second (a n L A l2 : ℝ) (ψ φ1 φ2 w : E) (hL : L ≠ 0) (ha : a = n / 2) (hn : ⟪ψ, ψ⟫ = 1) (hψ : D ψ = a • ψ) (hu : D (M ψ) = a • M ψ + w) (hw : D w = L • M ψ - ((n - 2) / 2) • w) (hcross : ⟪M ψ, w⟫ = 0) (hker : ∀ k, D k = a • k → ⟪M ψ, k⟫ = 0) (hA : ⟪M ψ, M ψ⟫ = A) (h1 : D φ1 = a • φ1 + a • M ψ) (h2 : D φ2 = a • φ2 + a • M φ1 + (a / 2) • M (M ψ) + l2 • ψ) : l2 = -(a ^ 2 * ((n - 1) / L) * A) - (a / 2) * A
doc: 二次:λ₂ = −a²(n−1)/L·A − (a/2)A

name: vol_root_deriv
stmt: theorem vol_root_deriv : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (1 / 9 : ℝ)) (1 / 9) 1
doc: 体積の正規化:x ↦ x^{1/9} の x = 1 での微分は 1/9

name: vol_coefficient
stmt: theorem vol_coefficient (A : ℝ) : (1 / 9 : ℝ) * (81 / 2 * A) = 9 / 2 * A

name: z28d_normalized
doc: 正規化した不変量の二次係数

name: affine_group_law
stmt: theorem affine_group_law (κ α β τ σ : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hβ : 0 < β) (ψ : ℝ → ℂ) : U κ α τ (U κ β σ ψ) = U κ (α * β) (τ + α * σ) ψ
doc: 【α-VI.6】群の法則:U(α, τ)U(β, σ) = U(αβ, τ + ασ)(α, β > 0)

name: affine_unitary
stmt: theorem affine_unitary (κ α τ : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (ψ : ℝ → ℂ) : ∫ k in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ‖U κ α τ ψ k‖ ^ 2 = ∫ k in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ‖ψ k‖ ^ 2
doc: 【α-VI.6】ユニタリ:U(α, τ) は L²((0, ∞), dk) のノルムを保つ

name: affine_commutator
stmt: theorem affine_commutator (hb K0 k : ℝ) (ψ : ℝ → ℂ) (ψ' : ℂ) (hψ : HasDerivAt ψ ψ' k) : HasDerivAt (fun x => ((K0 + x : ℝ) : ℂ) * ψ x) (ψ k + ((K0 + k : ℝ) : ℂ) * ψ') k ∧ I * hb * ((k : ℂ) * (ψ k + ((K0 + k : ℝ) : ℂ) * ψ') + 1 / 2 * (((K0 + k : ℝ) : ℂ) * ψ k)) - ((K0 + k : ℝ) : ℂ) * (I * hb * ((k : ℂ) * ψ' + 1 / 2 * ψ k)) = I * hb * ((k : ℂ) * ψ k)
doc:
【α-VI.6】交換関係:K̂ψ = (K₀ + k)ψ、D̂ψ = iħ(kψ′ + ½ψ) について
D̂(K̂ψ) − K̂(D̂ψ) = iħ(K̂ − K₀)ψ(各点 k で、ψ′ = ψ の微分)

name: K_positive
stmt: theorem K_positive (ψ : ℝ → ℂ) : 0 ≤ ∫ k in Ioi (0 : ℝ), k * ‖ψ k‖ ^ 2
doc: 【α-VI.6】K̂ − K₀ は正:⟨ψ, (K̂ − K₀)ψ⟩ = ∫₀^∞ k|ψ|² dk ≥ 0

name: sector_sign
stmt: theorem sector_sign (a b pa : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : (0 < a * b / (2 * pa) ↔ 0 < pa)
doc: 【α-VI.6】セクター:a, b > 0 なら T = ab/(2p_a) の符号は p_a の符号

name: bracket_TH
stmt: theorem bracket_TH (a b pa pb c l : ℝ) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hpa : pa ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) : Ta b pa * Hpa a b pa pb c + Tb a pa * Hpb b pa c - Tpa a b pa * Ha b pa c l - Tpb * Hb a b pa pb c l = b / (2 * pa ^ 2) * Hfun a b pa pb c l
doc: 【α-VI.8】T は拘束面の上で Dirac 観測量:{T, H} = (b/2p_a²) · Hfun

name: bracket_TH_weak
stmt: theorem bracket_TH_weak (a b pa pb c l : ℝ) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hpa : pa ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hH : Hfun a b pa pb c l = 0) : Ta b pa * Hpa a b pa pb c + Tb a pa * Hpb b pa c - Tpa a b pa * Ha b pa c l - Tpb * Hb a b pa pb c l = 0
doc: 拘束面 Hfun = 0 の上で {T, H} = 0

name: K_eigen
stmt: theorem K_eigen (κ hb : ℝ) (hhb : hb * κ = 1) (c l C : ℝ) (A σ : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hb0 : b ≠ 0) (hσ2 : σ b ^ 2 = C * b - 4 * c ^ 2 * (b ^ 2 + l ^ 2)) (Daa : ℂ) (hDaa : HasDerivAt (fun x => CFT.WKB.Psia κ A σ x b) Daa a) : (-(hb : ℂ) ^ 2 * Daa + 4 * (c : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((b : ℂ) ^ 2 + (l : ℂ) ^ 2) * CFT.WKB.Psi κ A σ a b) / b = (C : ℂ) * CFT.WKB.Psi κ A σ a b
doc:
【α-VI.6】K̂ = (−ħ²∂_a² + 4c²(b² + ℓ²))/b について K̂Ψ_C = C Ψ_C(σ² = Cb − 4c²(b² + ℓ²) のとき)。
Ψ_aa は実際の a についての 2 階微分。

name: domain_nonempty_iff
stmt: theorem domain_nonempty_iff (c l C : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) : (∃ b, 0 < CFT.WKB.Q c l C b) ↔ 64 * c ^ 4 * l ^ 2 < C ^ 2
doc: Q(b) > 0 となる b が存在する ⇔ C² > 64c⁴ℓ²(16c²Q(b) = C² − 64c⁴ℓ² − (8c²b − C)²)

name: dS_dC
stmt: theorem dS_dC (a b c l C : ℝ) (hQ : 0 < CFT.WKB.Q c l C b) : HasDerivAt (fun C' => a * Real.sqrt (CFT.WKB.Q c l C' b)) (a * b / (2 * Real.sqrt (CFT.WKB.Q c l C b))) C
doc: 【α-VI.8】∂S/∂C = T:S_C = a√(Cb − 4c²(b² + ℓ²)) の C 微分は ab/(2σ) = T(a, b, p_a = σ)

name: phys_inner_nonneg
stmt: theorem phys_inner_nonneg (c l : ℝ) (f : Hphys c l) : 0 ≤ RCLike.re (inner f f : ℂ)
doc: 【α-VI.6】物理的な内積は正値:⟨f, f⟩ ≥ 0

name: phys_inner_eq_zero
stmt: theorem phys_inner_eq_zero (c l : ℝ) (f : Hphys c l) : (inner f f : ℂ) = 0 ↔ f = 0
doc: 【α-VI.6】⟨f, f⟩ = 0 ⇔ f = 0(内積は非退化)

name: physical_branch
stmt: theorem physical_branch (c l C : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hl : 0 < l) : (∃ b, 0 < b ∧ 0 < Q c l C b) ↔ 8 * c ^ 2 * l < C
doc: 【α-VI.6】物理的な枝:c, ℓ > 0 のとき、Q_C(b) > 0 となる b > 0 がある ⇔ C > 8c²ℓ

name: K_minus_min
stmt: theorem K_minus_min (b pa c l : ℝ) (hb : b ≠ 0) : (pa ^ 2 + 4 * c ^ 2 * (b ^ 2 + l ^ 2)) / b - 8 * c ^ 2 * l = (pa ^ 2 + 4 * c ^ 2 * (b - l) ^ 2) / b
doc: K − 8c²ℓ = (p_a² + 4c²(b − ℓ)²)/b

name: K_gt_min
stmt: theorem K_gt_min (b pa c l : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (hpa : pa ≠ 0) : 8 * c ^ 2 * l < (pa ^ 2 + 4 * c ^ 2 * (b ^ 2 + l ^ 2)) / b
doc: 【α-VI.6】b > 0、p_a ≠ 0 なら K > K₀ = 8c²ℓ(簡約位相空間は半平面)

name: affine_bracket
stmt: theorem affine_bracket (a b pa c l K K0 T : ℝ) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hpa : pa ≠ 0) : (Ka * T + (K - K0) * Ta b pa) * Kpa b pa - (Kpa b pa * T + (K - K0) * Tpa a b pa) * Ka + (Kb b pa c l * T + (K - K0) * Tb a pa) * Kpb - (Kpb * T + (K - K0) * Tpb) * Kb b pa c l = K - K0
doc:
【α-VI.6】affine の括弧:D = (K − K₀)T の勾配を Leibniz 則で作ると {D, K} = K − K₀
({T, K} = 1 は AlphaVI `bracket_TK`)

name: translation_norm
stmt: theorem translation_norm (ψ : ℝ → ℂ) (τ κ k : ℝ) : ‖Complex.exp (((τ * k * κ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * ψ k‖ = ‖ψ k‖
doc: 平行移動 ψ ↦ e^{iτk/ħ}ψ は各点で絶対値を保つ

name: dilation_isometry
stmt: theorem dilation_isometry (ψ : ℝ → ℂ) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) : ∫ k in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ‖(Real.sqrt α : ℂ) * ψ (α * k)‖ ^ 2 = ∫ k in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ‖ψ k‖ ^ 2
doc: 【α-VI.6】拡大 ψ(k) ↦ √α ψ(αk)(α > 0)は L²((0, ∞), dk) のノルムを保つ

name: hasDerivAt_Q_C
stmt: theorem hasDerivAt_Q_C (c l b C : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun C' => Q c l C' b) b C
doc: Q の C についての微分は b

name: d2S_dC2
stmt: theorem d2S_dC2 (a b c l C : ℝ) (hQ : 0 < Q c l C b) : HasDerivAt (fun C' => a * b / (2 * Real.sqrt (Q c l C' b))) (-(a * b ^ 2) / (4 * Real.sqrt (Q c l C b) ^ 3)) C
doc: 【α-VI.8】∂_C²(aσ_C) = ∂_C(ab/(2σ_C)) = −ab²/(4σ_C³)

name: stationary_nondegenerate
stmt: theorem stationary_nondegenerate (a b c l C : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hQ : 0 < Q c l C b) : -(a * b ^ 2) / (4 * Real.sqrt (Q c l C b) ^ 3) ≠ 0
doc: 【α-VI.8】非退化:a, b ≠ 0 なら停留点での 2 階微分は 0 でない

name: domain_Ioi
stmt: theorem domain_Ioi (b c l : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) : {C | 0 < Q c l C b} = Ioi (4 * c ^ 2 * (b ^ 2 + l ^ 2) / b)
doc: 定義域 {C : Q_C(b) > 0} は半直線 (4c²(b² + ℓ²)/b, ∞)(b > 0)

name: T_strictAnti
stmt: theorem T_strictAnti (a b c l : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : StrictAntiOn (fun C => a * b / (2 * Real.sqrt (Q c l C b))) {C | 0 < Q c l C b}
doc: 【α-VI.8】a, b > 0 なら T(C) = ab/(2σ_C) は定義域で狭義単調減少

name: stationary_unique
stmt: theorem stationary_unique (a b c l C₁ C₂ : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (h1 : 0 < Q c l C₁ b) (h2 : 0 < Q c l C₂ b) (h : a * b / (2 * Real.sqrt (Q c l C₁ b)) = a * b / (2 * Real.sqrt (Q c l C₂ b))) : C₁ = C₂
doc: 【α-VI.8】停留点は高々一つ:T(C₁) = T(C₂) = T₀ なら C₁ = C₂

name: cosh_ne
stmt: theorem cosh_ne (x : ℝ) : cosh x ≠ 0

name: sinh_sq

name: hasDerivAt_th

doc: tanh′ = sech²

name: th_sq
stmt: theorem th_sq (x : ℝ) : th x ^ 2 = 1 - (cosh x)⁻¹ ^ 2

name: hasDerivAt_F
stmt: theorem hasDerivAt_F (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt F ((cosh x)⁻¹ ^ 4) x
doc: F′ = sech⁴

name: th_eq
stmt: theorem th_eq (x : ℝ) : th x = (1 - exp (-x) ^ 2) / (1 + exp (-x) ^ 2)

name: th_neg

name: sech4_cont
stmt: theorem sech4_cont : Continuous fun x : ℝ => (cosh x)⁻¹ ^ 4

name: integrable_sech4
stmt: theorem integrable_sech4 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (cosh x)⁻¹ ^ 4)

name: integral_sech4
