name: integral_two_sech4
stmt: theorem integral_two_sech4 : ∫ x : ℝ, 2 * (cosh x)⁻¹ ^ 4 = 8 / 3
doc: 【α-VI.8】∫_ℝ 2 sech⁴ x dx = 8/3

name: instanton_action_integral
stmt: theorem instanton_action_integral : 3 * π ^ 2 * (∫ x : ℝ, 2 * (cosh x)⁻¹ ^ 4) = 8 * π ^ 2
doc: 【α-VI.8】インスタントンの作用:3π² · ∫ 2 sech⁴ = 8π²

name: Q_pos_iff
stmt: theorem Q_pos_iff (c l b C : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) : 0 < Q c l C b ↔ Cmin c l b < C
doc: b > 0 なら Q_C(b) > 0 ⇔ C > C_min(b)

name: Cmin_ge
stmt: theorem Cmin_ge (c l b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) : 8 * c ^ 2 * l ≤ Cmin c l b
doc: C_min(b) ≥ 8c²ℓ = K₀(相加相乗平均)

name: support_condition
stmt: theorem support_condition (c l b C₁ C : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (h1 : Cmin c l b < C₁) (hC : C₁ ≤ C) : 0 < Q c l C b
doc: 【α-VI.8】台の条件:C ≥ C₁ > C_min(b) なら Q_C(b) > 0

name: stationary_point
stmt: theorem stationary_point (a b c l T0 : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hT : 0 < T0) : Q c l (Cmin c l b + a ^ 2 * b / (4 * T0 ^ 2)) b = (a * b / (2 * T0)) ^ 2 ∧ 0 < Q c l (Cmin c l b + a ^ 2 * b / (4 * T0 ^ 2)) b ∧ a * b / (2 * Real.sqrt (Q c l (Cmin c l b + a ^ 2 * b / (4 * T0 ^ 2)) b)) = T0
doc: 【α-VI.8】停留点の存在:C* = C_min(b) + a²b/(4T₀²) で Q = (ab/(2T₀))²、∂_C(a√Q) = T₀

name: trace_einD
stmt: theorem trace_einD (N A R s : S) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hA : A ≠ 0) (hR : R ≠ 0) (hs : s ≠ 0) (Γ : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → S) : giD N A R s 0 0 * Ein d (gD N A R s) (giD N A R s) Γ 0 0 + giD N A R s 1 1 * Ein d (gD N A R s) (giD N A R s) Γ 1 1 + giD N A R s 2 2 * Ein d (gD N A R s) (giD N A R s) Γ 2 2 + giD N A R s 3 3 * Ein d (gD N A R s) (giD N A R s) Γ 3 3 = -Rsc d (giD N A R s) Γ
doc: 対角の計量では Einstein テンソルの跡は −R:Σ_a g^{aa} G_aa = −R

name: rsc_static_S3
stmt: theorem rsc_static_S3 (l σ κ s c : S) (H : SphD d 1 l (l * σ) s c) (hl : ∀ i, d i l = 0) (hσ0 : d 0 σ = 0) (hσ1 : d 1 σ = κ) (hκ1 : d 1 κ = -σ) (pyth : σ ^ 2 + κ ^ 2 = 1) : Rsc d (giD 1 l (l * σ) s) (GD d 1 l (l * σ) s c) = 6 * l⁻¹ ^ 2
doc: 超静的な S³ のスカラー曲率は 6/ℓ²

name: static_S3_impossible
stmt: theorem static_S3_impossible (l σ κ s c κG : S) (H : SphD d 1 l (l * σ) s c) (hl : ∀ i, d i l = 0) (hσ0 : d 0 σ = 0) (hσ1 : d 1 σ = κ) (hκ1 : d 1 κ = -σ) (pyth : σ ^ 2 + κ ^ 2 = 1) (T : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → S) (E : ∀ a, Ein d (gD 1 l (l * σ) s) (giD 1 l (l * σ) s) (GD d 1 l (l * σ) s c) a a = κG * T a a) (traceless : giD 1 l (l * σ) s 0 0 * T 0 0 + giD 1 l (l * σ) s 1 1 * T 1 1 + giD 1 l (l * σ) s 2 2 * T 2 2 + giD 1 l (l * σ) s 3 3 * T 3 3 = 0) : False
doc:
【α-VI.3】超静的な S³(半径 ℓ)は、跡ゼロの物質(YM 場・輻射)と Einstein 方程式
G_aa = κ_G T_aa を同時にはみたせない。
計算:跡をとると −R = κ_G Σ g^{aa}T_aa = 0、一方 R = 6/ℓ² ≠ 0。

name: tym_traceless
stmt: theorem tym_traceless (N A R s : S) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hA : A ≠ 0) (hR : R ≠ 0) (hs : s ≠ 0) (F : Fin 3 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → S) : giD N A R s 0 0 * Tym (gD N A R s) (giD N A R s) F 0 0 + giD N A R s 1 1 * Tym (gD N A R s) (giD N A R s) F 1 1 + giD N A R s 2 2 * Tym (gD N A R s) (giD N A R s) F 2 2 + giD N A R s 3 3 * Tym (gD N A R s) (giD N A R s) F 3 3 = 0
doc:
【α-VI.3 の物質側】4 次元の YM の応力は跡ゼロ:対角の計量で Σ_m g^{mm} T̂_mm = 0。
F は任意の成分の表(ゲージ場の具体形によらない)。g^{mm} g_mm = 1 と 4 次元(¼ · 4 = 1)だけを使う。

name: static_S3_YM_impossible
stmt: theorem static_S3_YM_impossible (l σ κ s c κG : S) (H : SphD d 1 l (l * σ) s c) (hl : ∀ i, d i l = 0) (hσ0 : d 0 σ = 0) (hσ1 : d 1 σ = κ) (hκ1 : d 1 κ = -σ) (pyth : σ ^ 2 + κ ^ 2 = 1) (F : Fin 3 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → S) (E : ∀ a, Ein d (gD 1 l (l * σ) s) (giD 1 l (l * σ) s) (GD d 1 l (l * σ) s c) a a = κG * Tym (gD 1 l (l * σ) s) (giD 1 l (l * σ) s) F a a) : False
doc:
【α-VI.3】Einstein–Yang–Mills:超静的な S³ に YM の応力 T̂(任意の F)を置いた Einstein 方程式
G_aa = κ_G T̂_aa は解をもたない(跡ゼロの YM 応力を `static_S3_impossible` に代入)。

name: I_cubed
stmt: theorem I_cubed : I ^ 3 = -I

name: curvature_formula
stmt: theorem curvature_formula (lam : ℝ) (a b : Fin 3) : F lam a b = (4 * I * lam * (1 - lam)) • ∑ c, eps a b c • s c

name: curvature_traceless
stmt: theorem curvature_traceless (lam : ℝ) (a b : Fin 3) : trace (F lam a b) = 0

name: EF_eq
stmt: theorem EF_eq (lam : ℝ) : EF lam = (I * (4 * I * lam * (1 - lam))) • Msum

name: trace_Msum_sq
stmt: theorem trace_Msum_sq : trace (Msum * Msum) = 3

name: trace_EF_sq
stmt: theorem trace_EF_sq (lam : ℝ) : trace (EF lam * EF lam) = 48 * (lam : ℂ)^2 * (1 - lam)^2

name: trace_Omega_sq
stmt: theorem trace_Omega_sq (lam : ℝ) : ∑ a, ∑ b, trace (((1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) ⊗ₖ F lam a b) * ((1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) ⊗ₖ F lam a b)) = -96 * (lam : ℂ)^2 * (1 - lam)^2
doc: Ω のゲージ部分 1 ⊗ F_ab の二乗の跡の和

name: integrand
stmt: theorem integrand (lam : ℝ) : 180 * trace (EF lam * EF lam) + 30 * (∑ a, ∑ b, trace (((1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) ⊗ₖ F lam a b) * ((1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) ⊗ₖ F lam a b))) = 5760 * (lam : ℂ)^2 * (1 - lam)^2

name: a4_value
stmt: theorem a4_value : (1 / 360 : ℝ) * (1 / (8 * Real.pi * Real.sqrt Real.pi)) * (2 * Real.pi ^ 2) * 5760 = 4 * Real.sqrt Real.pi

name: four_pi_three_halves
stmt: theorem four_pi_three_halves : (4 * Real.pi) ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 2) = 8 * Real.pi * Real.sqrt Real.pi

name: beta_from_anomaly
stmt: theorem beta_from_anomaly (hb aE β u X : ℝ) (huX : u * X ≠ 0) (h : β * (12 * u * X) = -(hb * aE / (16 * π ^ 2)) * (2 * (12 * u * X))) : β = -(hb * aE / (8 * π ^ 2))
doc: 【α-V.7】β の決定:β · 12uX = −(ħa_E/16π²) · 2 · 12uX(uX ≠ 0)⇒ β = −ħa_E/(8π²)

name: kappa2_pos
stmt: theorem kappa2_pos (hb aE X : ℝ) (hhb : 0 < hb) (haE : 0 < aE) : -(-(hb * aE / (8 * π ^ 2))) * (3 * X ^ 2) = hb * (3 * aE / (8 * π ^ 2)) * X ^ 2 ∧ 0 < 3 * aE / (8 * π ^ 2)
doc: 【α-V.7】ρ_anom = −β·⁽³⁾H⁰₀ = (3ħa_E/8π²) X²、a_E > 0 なら κ₂ = 3a_E/(8π²) > 0

name: rho_q_conserved
stmt: theorem rho_q_conserved (κ1 k : ℝ) (a ad : ℝ → ℝ) (add t : ℝ) (ha : HasDerivAt a (ad t) t) (had : HasDerivAt ad add t) (ha0 : a t ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (rhoq κ1 k a ad) (-(ad t / a t) * (4 * rhoq κ1 k a ad t + (-4 * k * (add / a t) * Xf a ad t))) t
doc: 【α-V.7】ρ_q は保存則 ρ̇ = −(ȧ/a)(4ρ + tr) をみたす。跡は tr = −4k u X(= −(ħa_E/16π²)·24uX)

name: rho_unique
stmt: theorem rho_unique (κ1 k : ℝ) (a ad add ρ tr : ℝ → ℝ) (t0 t1 : ℝ) (ha : ∀ t ∈ Icc t0 t1, HasDerivAt a (ad t) t) (had : ∀ t ∈ Icc t0 t1, HasDerivAt ad (add t) t) (ha0 : ∀ t ∈ Icc t0 t1, a t ≠ 0) (hρ : ∀ t ∈ Icc t0 t1, HasDerivAt ρ (-(ad t / a t) * (4 * ρ t + tr t)) t) (htr : ∀ t ∈ Icc t0 t1, tr t = -4 * k * (add t / a t) * Xf a ad t) : ∀ t ∈ Icc t0 t1, a t ^ 4 * (ρ t - rhoq κ1 k a ad t) = a t0 ^ 4 * (ρ t0 - rhoq κ1 k a ad t0)
doc:
【α-V.7】一意性:同じ跡 tr をもち保存則をみたす等方な ρ は、ρ_q と κ/a⁴ の差しかない
(区間 [t₀, t₁] の上で a⁴(ρ − ρ_q) は一定)

name: quad_solvable
stmt: theorem quad_solvable (γ A L : ℝ) (hγ : γ ≠ 0) : (∃ x : ℝ, γ * x ^ 2 - A * x + L = 0) ↔ 4 * γ * L ≤ A ^ 2
doc: 二次方程式 γx² − Ax + L = 0 の実数解の存在 ⇔ 判別式 ≥ 0

name: small_branch
stmt: theorem small_branch (γ a2 L : ℝ) (hγ : γ ≠ 0) (hD : 4 * γ * L ≤ a2 ^ 2) (ha : 0 < a2) : (a2 - Real.sqrt (a2 ^ 2 - 4 * γ * L)) / (2 * γ) = 2 * L / (a2 + Real.sqrt (a2 ^ 2 - 4 * γ * L))
doc: 小さい γ の枝:x = (a² − s)/(2γ) = 2L/(a² + s)(s = √(a⁴ − 4γL))

name: cap_friedmann
stmt: theorem cap_friedmann (L t : ℝ) (ht : t ^ 2 < L) : HasDerivAt (fun τ => Real.sqrt (L - τ ^ 2)) (-t / Real.sqrt (L - t ^ 2)) t ∧ (-t / Real.sqrt (L - t ^ 2)) ^ 2 + 1 = L / (Real.sqrt (L - t ^ 2)) ^ 2
doc:
帽子 a = √(L − t²)(L = ℓ² + 繰り込みの項)は閉じた輻射 FRW の Friedmann 方程式
ȧ² + 1 = L/a² をみたす

name: continuity_radiation
stmt: theorem continuity_radiation (K : ℝ) (a : ℝ → ℝ) (a' t : ℝ) (ha : HasDerivAt a a' t) (ha0 : a t ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun τ => K / a τ ^ 4) (-4 * (a' / a t) * (K / a t ^ 4)) t
doc: 保存則:ρ = K/a⁴(p = ρ/3)は ρ̇ = −4(ȧ/a)ρ をみたす

name: esu_backreaction
stmt: theorem esu_backreaction {S : Type*} [Field S] [CharZero S] (d : Fin 4 → Derivation ℤ S S) (l σ κ s c κG : S) (H : CFT.S4.SphD d 1 l (l * σ) s c) (hl : ∀ i, d i l = 0) (hσ0 : d 0 σ = 0) (hσ1 : d 1 σ = κ) (hκ1 : d 1 κ = -σ) (pyth : σ ^ 2 + κ ^ 2 = 1) (Tcl Tq : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → S) (E : ∀ a, CFT.S4.Ein d (CFT.S4.gD 1 l (l * σ) s) (CFT.S4.giD 1 l (l * σ) s) (CFT.S4.GD d 1 l (l * σ) s c) a a = κG * (Tcl a a + Tq a a)) (tcl : CFT.S4.giD 1 l (l * σ) s 0 0 * Tcl 0 0 + CFT.S4.giD 1 l (l * σ) s 1 1 * Tcl 1 1 + CFT.S4.giD 1 l (l * σ) s 2 2 * Tcl 2 2 + CFT.S4.giD 1 l (l * σ) s 3 3 * Tcl 3 3 = 0) (tq : CFT.S4.giD 1 l (l * σ) s 0 0 * Tq 0 0 + CFT.S4.giD 1 l (l * σ) s 1 1 * Tq 1 1 + CFT.S4.giD 1 l (l * σ) s 2 2 * Tq 2 2 + CFT.S4.giD 1 l (l * σ) s 3 3 * Tq 3 3 = 0) : False
doc:
【α-V.7】伝播と反作用の区別:固定した ℝ × S³ 上で ⟨T⟩_ren が跡ゼロ(アノマリーが消える)なら、
古典の跡ゼロの応力 T_cl と合わせても、静的な S³ は Einstein 方程式をみたさない(宇宙定数が必要)。

name: xy_system
stmt: theorem xy_system (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (F' G' : ℝ) (hF : HasDerivAt F F' s) (hG : HasDerivAt G G' s) (eF : F' = -(κ / s) * F s + p s * G s) (eG : G' = (κ / s) * G s - q s * F s) : HasDerivAt (fun s => s ^ κ * F s) (p s * (s ^ κ * G s)) s ∧ HasDerivAt (fun s => s ^ κ * G s) ((2 * κ / s) * (s ^ κ * G s) - q s * (s ^ κ * F s)) s
doc: x = s^κ F、y = s^κ G の満たす方程式

name: norm_deriv_ge
stmt: theorem norm_deriv_ge (x y pv qv s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hpB : |pv| ≤ B) (hqB : |qv| ≤ B) : -(2 * B) * (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) ≤ 2 * x * (pv * y) + 2 * y * ((2 * κ / s) * y - qv * x)
doc: N′ ≥ −2B N の形の評価(各点の代数)

name: norm_bound
stmt: theorem norm_bound (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Ioc 0 δ) : xf κ F s ^ 2 + xf κ G s ^ 2 ≤ exp (2 * B * (δ - s)) * (xf κ F δ ^ 2 + xf κ G δ ^ 2)
doc: すべての解で x² + y² ≤ e^{2B(δ − s)}(x(δ)² + y(δ)²)

name: large_solution
stmt: theorem large_solution (hB : B * δ ≤ 1 / 8) (hx1 : xf κ F δ = 1) (hy0 : xf κ G δ = 0) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Ioc 0 δ) : 3 / 4 ≤ xf κ F s
doc: 大きい解:x(δ) = 1、y(δ) = 0、Bδ ≤ 1/8 なら全区間で x ≥ 3/4

name: large_not_L2
stmt: theorem large_not_L2 (hB : B * δ ≤ 1 / 8) (hx1 : xf κ F δ = 1) (hy0 : xf κ G δ = 0) : Tendsto (fun ε => ∫ s in ε..δ, F s ^ 2) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop
doc: κ ≥ 1/2 なら、大きい解は L² でない:∫_ε^δ F² → ∞(ε → 0+)

name: frw_subs
stmt: theorem frw_subs (a σ κ s c : S) (H : SphD d 1 a (a * σ) s c) (ha1 : d 1 a = 0) (hσ0 : d 0 σ = 0) (hσ1 : d 1 σ = κ) (hκ1 : d 1 κ = -σ) : d 0 (a * σ) = d 0 a * σ ∧ d 0 (d 0 a * σ) = d 0 (d 0 a) * σ ∧ d 1 (a * σ) = a * κ ∧ d 1 (a * κ) = -(a * σ) ∧ d 0 (a * κ) = d 0 a * κ ∧ d 0 (1 : S) = 0 ∧ d 1 (1 : S) = 0
doc: 閉じた FRW の置き換え:R = a σ(σ = sin χ、κ = cos χ)

name: frw_r0
stmt: theorem frw_r0 (a σ κ s c : S) (H : SphD d 1 a (a * σ) s c) (ha1 : d 1 a = 0) (hσ0 : d 0 σ = 0) (hσ1 : d 1 σ = κ) (hκ1 : d 1 κ = -σ) (pyth : σ ^ 2 + κ ^ 2 = 1) : giD 1 a (a * σ) s 0 0 * Ric d (GD d 1 a (a * σ) s c) 0 0 = 3 * d 0 (d 0 a) * a⁻¹

name: frw_r1
stmt: theorem frw_r1 (a σ κ s c : S) (H : SphD d 1 a (a * σ) s c) (ha1 : d 1 a = 0) (hσ0 : d 0 σ = 0) (hσ1 : d 1 σ = κ) (hκ1 : d 1 κ = -σ) (pyth : σ ^ 2 + κ ^ 2 = 1) : giD 1 a (a * σ) s 1 1 * Ric d (GD d 1 a (a * σ) s c) 1 1 = d 0 (d 0 a) * a⁻¹ + 2 * ((d 0 a ^ 2 + 1) * a⁻¹ ^ 2)

name: frw_r2
stmt: theorem frw_r2 (a σ κ s c : S) (H : SphD d 1 a (a * σ) s c) (ha1 : d 1 a = 0) (hσ0 : d 0 σ = 0) (hσ1 : d 1 σ = κ) (hκ1 : d 1 κ = -σ) (pyth : σ ^ 2 + κ ^ 2 = 1) : giD 1 a (a * σ) s 2 2 * Ric d (GD d 1 a (a * σ) s c) 2 2 = d 0 (d 0 a) * a⁻¹ + 2 * ((d 0 a ^ 2 + 1) * a⁻¹ ^ 2)

name: frw_r3
stmt: theorem frw_r3 (a σ κ s c : S) (H : SphD d 1 a (a * σ) s c) (ha1 : d 1 a = 0) (hσ0 : d 0 σ = 0) (hσ1 : d 1 σ = κ) (hκ1 : d 1 κ = -σ) (pyth : σ ^ 2 + κ ^ 2 = 1) : giD 1 a (a * σ) s 3 3 * Ric d (GD d 1 a (a * σ) s c) 3 3 = d 0 (d 0 a) * a⁻¹ + 2 * ((d 0 a ^ 2 + 1) * a⁻¹ ^ 2)

name: frw_ric01
stmt: theorem frw_ric01 (a σ κ s c : S) (H : SphD d 1 a (a * σ) s c) (ha1 : d 1 a = 0) (hσ0 : d 0 σ = 0) (hσ1 : d 1 σ = κ) (hκ1 : d 1 κ = -σ) (pyth : σ ^ 2 + κ ^ 2 = 1) : Ric d (GD d 1 a (a * σ) s c) 0 1 = 0
doc: 非対角 R_01 = 0

name: frw_rsc
stmt: theorem frw_rsc (a σ κ s c : S) (H : SphD d 1 a (a * σ) s c) (ha1 : d 1 a = 0) (hσ0 : d 0 σ = 0) (hσ1 : d 1 σ = κ) (hκ1 : d 1 κ = -σ) (pyth : σ ^ 2 + κ ^ 2 = 1) : Rsc d (giD 1 a (a * σ) s) (GD d 1 a (a * σ) s c) = 6 * d 0 (d 0 a) * a⁻¹ + 6 * ((d 0 a ^ 2 + 1) * a⁻¹ ^ 2)

name: frw_G00
stmt: theorem frw_G00 (a σ κ s c : S) (H : SphD d 1 a (a * σ) s c) (ha1 : d 1 a = 0) (hσ0 : d 0 σ = 0) (hσ1 : d 1 σ = κ) (hκ1 : d 1 κ = -σ) (pyth : σ ^ 2 + κ ^ 2 = 1) : giD 1 a (a * σ) s 0 0 * Ein d (gD 1 a (a * σ) s) (giD 1 a (a * σ) s) (GD d 1 a (a * σ) s c) 0 0 = -3 * ((d 0 a ^ 2 + 1) * a⁻¹ ^ 2)
doc: 【α-V.7】Einstein テンソル:G^0_0 = R^0_0 − R/2 = −3X

name: h3_frw
doc: 【α-V.7】閉じた FRW(r = (3u, u + 2X, u + 2X, u + 2X))で ⁽³⁾H^0_0 = 3X²、⁽³⁾H^i_i = 4uX − X²、跡 12uX

name: ricci_sq_identity
stmt: theorem ricci_sq_identity (r : Fin 4 → S) : (∑ i, r i ^ 2) - (∑ i, r i) ^ 2 / 3 = -∑ m, H3mix r m
doc: 跡と Ricci の二乗:R_μνR^μν − R²/3 = −Σ ⁽³⁾H^μ_μ(任意の対角な Ricci)

name: esu_trace_zero
stmt: theorem esu_trace_zero (X : S) : ∑ m, H3mix ![3 * 0, 0 + 2 * X, 0 + 2 * X, 0 + 2 * X] m = 0
doc: 【α-V.7】ESU(u = 0):⁽³⁾H の跡は 0(Euler 密度 E = 2·跡 = 0)

name: h3_conserved
stmt: theorem h3_conserved (a ad : ℝ → ℝ) (add t : ℝ) (ha : HasDerivAt a (ad t) t) (had : HasDerivAt ad add t) (ha0 : a t ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun τ => -3 * (Xf a ad τ * Xf a ad τ)) (-3 * (ad t / a t) * (-3 * (Xf a ad t * Xf a ad t) + (4 * (add / a t) * Xf a ad t - Xf a ad t * Xf a ad t))) t
doc:
【α-V.7】⁽³⁾H の項は保存する:ρ = −3X²、p = 4uX − X²(β を除いた形)で
ρ̇ = −3(ȧ/a)(ρ + p)(u = ä/a)

name: friedmann_quadratic
stmt: theorem friedmann_quadratic (X a L γ : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (h : X = L / a ^ 4 + γ * X ^ 2) : γ * (a ^ 2 * X) ^ 2 - a ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 * X) + L = 0
doc: 【α-V.7】半古典的な Friedmann 方程式 X = L/a⁴ + γX² ⇔ x = a²X について γx² − a²x + L = 0

name: cap_semiclassical
stmt: theorem cap_semiclassical (L t : ℝ) (ht : t ^ 2 < L) : ((-t / Real.sqrt (L - t ^ 2)) ^ 2 + 1) / (Real.sqrt (L - t ^ 2)) ^ 2 = L / (Real.sqrt (L - t ^ 2)) ^ 4
doc: 【α-V.7】主要な次数(γ = 0):帽子 a = √(L − t²) は X = L/a⁴(3X = 8πGρ、ρ ∝ 1/a⁴)をみたす

name: fw_exact
stmt: theorem fw_exact (m E px py pz : ℂ) (hE : E ^ 2 = m ^ 2 + px ^ 2 + py ^ 2 + pz ^ 2) : let Ap

name: bb'
stmt: theorem bb' (z : A) : b * (b * z) = z

name: bX'
stmt: theorem bX' (z : A) : b * (X * z) = -(X * (b * z))

name: bY'
stmt: theorem bY' (z : A) : b * (Y * z) = Y * (b * z)

name: ad_beta
stmt: theorem ad_beta (c m : ℂ) : ad (c • (b * X)) (m • b) = (-(2 * m * c)) • X
doc: ad_T(m b) = −2mc X(T = c bX)

name: ad_odd
stmt: theorem ad_odd (c : ℂ) : ad (c • (b * X)) X = (2 * c) • (b * (X * X))
doc: ad_T X = 2c bX²

name: ad_even
stmt: theorem ad_even (c : ℂ) : ad (c • (b * X)) Y = c • (b * (X * Y - Y * X))
doc: ad_T Y = c b[X, Y]

name: fw_hadamard3
doc: 【Z17】Hadamard の和の 3 次までの正確な形(b は右端にまとめた)

name: fw_order2
doc:
【Z17】c = 1/(2m)(2mc = 1)での次数の分類:
偶 m b + Y + c X²b − (c²/2)[X, [X, Y]](1/m² まで)、奇 c(YX − XY)b − (4/3)c²X³、残り c³ R₃

name: odd1_factor
stmt: theorem odd1_factor (c : ℂ) : c • (Y * (X * b) - X * (Y * b)) - (4 / 3 * c ^ 2) • (X * (X * X)) = c • odd1' b X Y c

name: odd1_odd
stmt: theorem odd1_odd (c : ℂ) : b * odd1' b X Y c = -(odd1' b X Y c * b)
doc: O₁′ は奇:b O₁′ = −O₁′ b

name: even1_even
doc: 1 回目の後の偶の部分 Y₁ = Y + c X²b − (c²/2)[X, [X, Y]] は偶:b Y₁ = Y₁ b

name: block_rel
stmt: theorem block_rel (S Φ : R) : let b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R
doc:
【Z17】β = diag(1, −1)、O = [[0, S], [S, 0]]、E = diag(Φ, Φ) は FW の仮定をみたし、
O² = diag(S², S²)、XXY − 2XYX + YXX = diag(SSΦ − 2SΦS + ΦSS)

name: II
stmt: theorem II (x : R) : Complex.I • Complex.I • x = -x

name: pauli_nc
stmt: theorem pauli_nc (π : Fin 3 → R) : sdR π * sdR π = dg (π 0 * π 0 + π 1 * π 1 + π 2 * π 2) + Complex.I • sdR (crossR π)
doc: 【Z17】(σ·π)² = π² + iσ·(π×π)

name: pauli_minimal
stmt: theorem pauli_minimal (π B : Fin 3 → R) (e : ℂ) (hcr : crossR π = fun l => Complex.I • (e • B l)) : sdR π * sdR π = dg (π 0 * π 0 + π 1 * π 1 + π 2 * π 2) - e • sdR B
doc: 【Z17】最小結合 [π_j, π_k] = ie ε_jkl B_l なら (σ·π)² = π² − eσ·B

name: double_comm
stmt: theorem double_comm (π : Fin 3 → R) (φ : R) : sdR π * (sdR π * dg φ - dg φ * sdR π) - (sdR π * dg φ - dg φ * sdR π) * sdR π = dg (ff (π 0) (π 0) φ + ff (π 1) (π 1) φ + ff (π 2) (π 2) φ) + Complex.I • sdR ![ff (π 1) (π 2) φ - ff (π 2) (π 1) φ, ff (π 2) (π 0) φ - ff (π 0) (π 2) φ, ff (π 0) (π 1) φ - ff (π 1) (π 0) φ]
doc: 【Z17】二重交換子 [S, [S, φ]] = Σ_k f_kk + iσ·L、L_l = f_jk − f_kj

name: so_form
stmt: theorem so_form (a c φ : R) : ff a c φ - ff c a φ = -((a * c - c * a) * φ - φ * (a * c - c * a)) + 2 * (a * (c * φ - φ * c) - c * (a * φ - φ * a))
doc: 【Z17】スピン軌道の形:f_jk − f_kj = −[[π_j, π_k], φ] + 2(π_j g_k − π_k g_j)、g_k = [π_k, φ]

name: darwin_form
stmt: theorem darwin_form (a φ : R) : ff a a φ = a * (a * φ - φ * a) - (a * φ - φ * a) * a
doc: 【Z17】Darwin の形:f_kk = [π_k, [π_k, φ]]

name: gauss_normal
stmt: theorem gauss_normal (r1 z1 : ℝ) (h : r1 ^ 2 + z1 ^ 2 = 1) : (-z1) ^ 2 + r1 ^ 2 = 1 ∧ r1 * (-z1) + z1 * r1 = 0

name: gauss_angle
stmt: theorem gauss_angle (r1 z1 : ℝ) (h : r1 ^ 2 + z1 ^ 2 = 1) : (-z1) ^ 2 = 1 - r1 ^ 2
doc: cos χ = N_z = r′、sin²χ = 1 − cos²χ = 1 − r′²

name: gauss_mass
stmt: theorem gauss_mass (r r1 : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) : 1 - r1 ^ 2 = (r * (1 - r1 ^ 2)) / r
doc: sin²χ = 2Gm/r(2Gm = r(1 − r′²))

name: gauss_schwarzschild
stmt: theorem gauss_schwarzschild (m r : ℝ) (h : 2 * m / r ≤ 1) : 1 - (√(1 - 2 * m / r)) ^ 2 = 2 * m / r

name: gauss_marginal
stmt: theorem gauss_marginal (r r1 : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) : (1 - r1 ^ 2 = 1 ↔ r1 = 0) ∧ (r * (1 - r1 ^ 2) = r ↔ r1 = 0)
doc: 赤道 ⇔ r′ = 0 ⇔ 2Gm = r

name: gauss_cap
stmt: theorem gauss_cap (l s : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (h0 : 0 ≤ s / l) (h1 : s / l ≤ π / 2) : arccos (cos (s / l)) = s / l ∧ 1 - cos (s / l) ^ 2 = sin (s / l) ^ 2
doc: 帽子:cos χ = r′ = cos(s/ℓ) なので χ = s/ℓ(0 ≤ s/ℓ ≤ π/2 で)

name: gauss_neck
stmt: theorem gauss_neck (l : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : arccos 0 = π / 2 ∧ cos ((π * l / 2) / l) = 0
doc: 首:r′ = 0 で χ = π/2(赤道)、接合 s = πℓ/2 でも赤道

name: ip_smul_left
stmt: theorem ip_smul_left (c : ℝ) (v w : Fin 3 → ℝ) : ip (fun i => c * v i) w = c * ip v w

name: ip_smul_right
stmt: theorem ip_smul_right (c : ℝ) (v w : Fin 3 → ℝ) : ip v (fun i => c * w i) = c * ip v w

name: ip_comm
stmt: theorem ip_comm (v w : Fin 3 → ℝ) : ip v w = ip w v

name: X_deriv
stmt: theorem X_deriv (r z : ℝ → ℝ) (r1 z1 : ℝ) (s : ℝ) (hr : HasDerivAt r r1 s) (hz : HasDerivAt z z1 s) (n : Fin 3 → ℝ) : (∀ i, HasDerivAt (fun s => (X (r s) (z s) n).1 i) ((Ts r1 z1 n).1 i) s) ∧ HasDerivAt (fun s => (X (r s) (z s) n).2) (Ts r1 z1 n).2 s
doc: X は s について微分でき、∂_sX = Ts(各成分)

name: embed_exists
stmt: theorem embed_exists (r1 : ℝ → ℝ) (hc : Continuous r1) (hb : ∀ s, r1 s ^ 2 ≤ 1) (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..s, √(1 - r1 x ^ 2)) (√(1 - r1 s ^ 2)) s ∧ r1 s ^ 2 + (√(1 - r1 s ^ 2)) ^ 2 = 1
doc:
高さ関数 z(s)=∫₀ˢ√(1−r′(x)²) の導関数と速度恒等式。
    これ単独では profileMap の大域的な単射性・位相的埋め込み性を主張しない。

name: profileMap_injective
stmt: theorem profileMap_injective (r r1 : ℝ → ℝ) (hz : StrictMono (zProfile r1)) (hr : ∀ s, r s ≠ 0) : Function.Injective (profileMap r r1)
doc:
z が狭義単調かつ r が消えなければ、プロフィール写像は単射。
    「局所的な等長浸入データ」と「大域的な単射性」を分離して明示する。

name: embed_metric
stmt: theorem embed_metric (r r1 z1 : ℝ) (n t t' : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hn : ip n n = 1) (hnt : ip n t = 0) (hu : r1 ^ 2 + z1 ^ 2 = 1) : ip4 (Ts r1 z1 n) (Ts r1 z1 n) = 1 ∧ ip4 (Ts r1 z1 n) (Ta r t) = 0 ∧ ip4 (Ta r t) (Ta r t') = r ^ 2 * ip t t'
doc: 誘導計量は ds² + r² dΩ²

name: profile_immersion_data
stmt: theorem profile_immersion_data (r r1 : ℝ → ℝ) (hc : Continuous r1) (hb : ∀ u, r1 u ^ 2 ≤ 1) (s : ℝ) (hr : HasDerivAt r (r1 s) s) (n t t' : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hn : ip n n = 1) (hnt : ip n t = 0) : (∀ i, HasDerivAt (fun u => (profileMap r r1 (u, n)).1 i) (r1 s * n i) s) ∧ HasDerivAt (fun u => (profileMap r r1 (u, n)).2) (√(1 - r1 s ^ 2)) s ∧ ip4 (Ts (r1 s) (√(1 - r1 s ^ 2)) n) (Ts (r1 s) (√(1 - r1 s ^ 2)) n) = 1 ∧ ip4 (Ts (r1 s) (√(1 - r1 s ^ 2)) n) (Ta (r s) t) = 0 ∧ ip4 (Ta (r s) t) (Ta (r s) t') = (r s) ^ 2 * ip t t'
doc:
微分・誘導計量を一つにまとめたプロフィール定理。
    高さ z の導関数と X の微分、動径方向の単位長、球面方向の計量を同時に接続する。
    これにより「点ごとの代数公式」だけでなく、実際に定義した profileMap の微分と計量を対応させる。

name: normal_unit
stmt: theorem normal_unit (r1 z1 : ℝ) (n : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hn : ip n n = 1) (hu : r1 ^ 2 + z1 ^ 2 = 1) : ip4 (Nrm r1 z1 n) (Nrm r1 z1 n) = 1
doc: N は単位

name: normal_orth
stmt: theorem normal_orth (r r1 z1 : ℝ) (n t : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hn : ip n n = 1) (hnt : ip n t = 0) : ip4 (Nrm r1 z1 n) (Ts r1 z1 n) = 0 ∧ ip4 (Nrm r1 z1 n) (Ta r t) = 0
doc: N はすべての接ベクトルに直交

name: normal_unique
stmt: theorem normal_unique (r r1 z1 : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (n : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hn : ip n n = 1) (hu : r1 ^ 2 + z1 ^ 2 = 1) (Y : (Fin 3 → ℝ) × ℝ) (hY : ip4 Y Y = 1) (hs : ip4 Y (Ts r1 z1 n) = 0) (ha : ∀ t, ip n t = 0 → ip4 Y (Ta r t) = 0) : Y = Nrm r1 z1 n ∨ Y = (fun i => -(Nrm r1 z1 n).1 i, -(Nrm r1 z1 n).2)
doc: 法線の一意性:すべての接ベクトルに直交する単位ベクトル Y は ±N(r ≠ 0)

name: gauss_cos
stmt: theorem gauss_cos (r1 z1 : ℝ) (n : Fin 3 → ℝ) : ip4 (Nrm r1 z1 n) ((fun _ => 0), 1) = r1
doc: 北極 e₄ = (0, 1) との内積:cos χ = r′

name: gauss_sin_mass
stmt: theorem gauss_sin_mass (r r1 z1 G m : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hu : r1 ^ 2 + z1 ^ 2 = 1) (hm : 2 * G * m = r * (1 - r1 ^ 2)) : 1 - r1 ^ 2 = 2 * G * m / r ∧ z1 ^ 2 = 2 * G * m / r
doc: Misner–Sharp 質量(時間対称な切り口、|∇r|² = r′²)2Gm = r(1 − r′²) で sin²χ = 1 − cos²χ = 2Gm/r

name: gauss_equator
stmt: theorem gauss_equator (r r1 G m : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hm : 2 * G * m = r * (1 - r1 ^ 2)) : (r1 = 0 ↔ 2 * G * m = r)
doc: 赤道 χ = π/2 ⇔ cos χ = r′ = 0 ⇔ 2Gm = r(周縁的捕捉面)

name: neck_ricci
stmt: theorem neck_ricci (N l s c : S) (H : SphD d N 1 l s c) (hN0 : d 0 N = 0) (hNxx : d 1 (d 1 N) = N * l⁻¹ ^ 2) (hl0 : d 0 l = 0) (hl1 : d 1 l = 0) : -(N⁻¹ ^ 2) * Ric d (GD d N 1 l s c) 0 0 = -(l⁻¹ ^ 2) ∧ (1 : S)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Ric d (GD d N 1 l s c) 1 1 = -(l⁻¹ ^ 2) ∧ l⁻¹ ^ 2 * Ric d (GD d N 1 l s c) 2 2 = l⁻¹ ^ 2 ∧ l⁻¹ ^ 2 * s⁻¹ ^ 2 * Ric d (GD d N 1 l s c) 3 3 = l⁻¹ ^ 2
doc: 【α-V.7-N】首 −N²dt² + dx² + ℓ²dΩ²(∂_t N = 0、N″ = N/ℓ²)の Ricci の混合成分

name: neck_H3
stmt: theorem neck_H3 (k : S) : (∀ m, CFT.FRW.H3mix ![-k, -k, k, k] m = -k ^ 2) ∧ ∑ m, CFT.FRW.H3mix ![-k, -k, k, k] m = -4 * k ^ 2
doc: 【α-V.7-N】固有値 (−k, −k, k, k) で ⁽³⁾H^μ_μ = −k²(各成分)、跡 −4k²

name: neck_curvature_invariants
stmt: theorem neck_curvature_invariants (k : S) : let K
doc: 【α-V.7-N】K = 8k²、Ric² = 4k²、R = 0 なら C² = K − 2Ric² + R²/3 = 0、E₄ = K − 4Ric² + R² = −8k² = 2 tr ⁽³⁾H

name: neck_trace_consistent
stmt: theorem neck_trace_consistent (hb aE k : ℝ) : -4 * (-(hb * aE / (8 * π ^ 2))) * k ^ 2 = -(hb * aE / (16 * π ^ 2)) * (-8 * k ^ 2)
doc: 【α-V.7-N】跡の整合:β ⁽³⁾H の跡 −4βk² = −(ħa_E/16π²)E₄(β = −ħa_E/(8π²)、E₄ = −8k²)

name: neck_backreaction
stmt: theorem neck_backreaction (l ε : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) : let x
doc:
【α-V.7-N】Einstein 方程式の解:x = (1 + √(1 + 4ε))/(2ℓ²) は ℓ²x² − x − ε/ℓ² = 0、
y := ℓ²x² + ε/ℓ² = x + 2ε/ℓ²

name: neck_radius_bounds
stmt: theorem neck_radius_bounds (l ε : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) : let x
doc: 【α-V.7-N】半径の評価:ℓ²/(1 + ε) ≤ r² = 1/x ≤ ℓ²(球は縮む)、y ≥ x(L ≤ r)

name: epsilon_value
stmt: theorem epsilon_value (G hb g aE l : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) (hb0 : hb ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) (hl : l ^ 2 = 4 * π * G * hb / g ^ 2) : G * hb * aE / (π * l ^ 2) = aE * g ^ 2 / (4 * π ^ 2)
doc: ε = Għa_E/(πℓ²) = a_E g²/(4π²)(ℓ² = 4πGħ/g²)

name: cap_F2
doc: 帽子の磁場:純粋に磁気的なら F² = 2ΣB² = 4g²ρ、ρ = 3/(2g²a⁴) で F² = 6/a⁴

name: rho_beta_conserved
stmt: theorem rho_beta_conserved (κ c : ℝ) (a : ℝ → ℝ) (ad t : ℝ) (ha : HasDerivAt a ad t) (hpos : 0 < a t) : HasDerivAt (rhoB κ c a) (-(ad / a t) * (4 * rhoB κ c a t + 6 * c / a t ^ 4)) t
doc: 【α-V.7′】ρ_β は保存則 ρ̇ = −(ȧ/a)(4ρ + 6c/a⁴) をみたす(a > 0)

name: rho_beta_unique
stmt: theorem rho_beta_unique (κ c : ℝ) (a ad ρ : ℝ → ℝ) (t0 t1 : ℝ) (ha : ∀ t ∈ Icc t0 t1, HasDerivAt a (ad t) t) (hpos : ∀ t ∈ Icc t0 t1, 0 < a t) (hρ : ∀ t ∈ Icc t0 t1, HasDerivAt ρ (-(ad t / a t) * (4 * ρ t + 6 * c / a t ^ 4)) t) : ∀ t ∈ Icc t0 t1, a t ^ 4 * (ρ t - rhoB κ c a t) = a t0 ^ 4 * (ρ t0 - rhoB κ c a t0)
doc: 【α-V.7′】一意性:同じ跡の解は ρ_β と κ′/a⁴ の差しかない(a⁴(ρ − ρ_β) は一定)

name: running_coupling
stmt: theorem running_coupling (g b0 a : ℝ) (hg : g ≠ 0) (ha : 0 < a) : 3 / (2 * g ^ 2 * a ^ 4) + (0 - 6 * (b0 / (32 * π ^ 2)) * Real.log a) / a ^ 4 = 3 / (2 * a ^ 4) * (1 / g ^ 2 + b0 / (8 * π ^ 2) * Real.log (1 / a))
doc:
【α-V.7′】走る結合定数:κ = 0、c = b₀/(32π²)(ħ = 1)なら
3/(2g²a⁴) + ρ_β = (3/(2a⁴))(1/g² + (b₀/8π²) log(1/a))

name: lie_bracket
stmt: theorem lie_bracket (a b : Fin 3) : e a * e b - e b * e a = ∑ c, (2 * eps a b c) • e c
doc: 左不変なベクトル場の括弧 = Lie 代数の括弧:e_a e_b − e_b e_a = Σ_c 2ε_abc e_c

name: koszul
stmt: theorem koszul (a b c : Fin 3) : (2 * eps a b c - 2 * eps b c a + 2 * eps c a b) / 2 = eps a b c
doc: Koszul:c_abc = 2ε_abc のとき ω_abc = ½(c_abc − c_bca + c_cab) = ε_abc

name: spin_term
stmt: theorem spin_term : (1 / 4 : ℂ) • ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, ((eps a b c : ℝ) : ℂ) • (σ a * σ b * σ c) = (3 / 2 * I) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
doc: スピン接続の定数項:¼ Σ ε_abc σ_a σ_b σ_c = (3i/2)·1

name: reduced_dirac
stmt: theorem reduced_dirac (lam : ℂ) : (-I) • (Matrix.kroneckerMap (· * ·) ((3 / 2 * I) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) + gaugeTerm lam) = (3 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 2 × Fin 2) (Fin 2 × Fin 2) ℂ) + lam • SS
doc: 【α-V.2】一様な断面の上で D = −i(スピン項 ⊗ 1 + ゲージ項) = 3/2 + λ Σσ⊗σ

name: level_singlet
stmt: theorem level_singlet (lam : ℂ) : ((-I) • (Matrix.kroneckerMap (· * ·) ((3 / 2 * I) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) + gaugeTerm lam)).mulVec singlet = (3 / 2 - 3 * lam) • singlet
doc: 【α-V.2】一重項の準位 3/2 − 3λ

name: level_triplet'
stmt: theorem level_triplet' (lam : ℂ) : ((-I) • (Matrix.kroneckerMap (· * ·) ((3 / 2 * I) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) + gaugeTerm lam)).mulVec upup = (3 / 2 + lam) • upup
doc: 【α-V.2】三重項の準位 3/2 + λ

name: frame_tangent
stmt: theorem frame_tangent (q : ℍ[ℝ]) (a : Fin 3) : (star q * (q * e a)).re = 0
doc: 枠 X_a(q) = q e_a は S³ に接する:Re(q̄ · q e_a) = 0(q に直交)

name: frame_orthonormal
stmt: theorem frame_orthonormal (q : ℍ[ℝ]) (a b : Fin 3) : (star (q * e a) * (q * e b)).re = (q.re ^ 2 + q.imI ^ 2 + q.imJ ^ 2 + q.imK ^ 2) * (if a = b then 1 else 0)
doc: 枠は正規直交:Re(conj(q e_a) · q e_b) = |q|² δ_ab(|q| = 1 なら正規直交)

name: frame_deriv
stmt: theorem frame_deriv (q v : ℍ[ℝ]) (b : Fin 3) : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (q + t • v) * e b) (v * e b) 0
doc: X_b は線形な場 q ↦ q e_b なので、方向 v の微分は v e_b(Lie 括弧の計算に使う)

name: frame_bracket
stmt: theorem frame_bracket (q : ℍ[ℝ]) (a b : Fin 3) : (q * e a) * e b - (q * e b) * e a = ∑ c, (2 * eps a b c) • (q * e c)
doc:
【α-V.2】ベクトル場の Lie 括弧:[X_a, X_b](q) = DX_b(q)[X_a(q)] − DX_a(q)[X_b(q)]
= (q e_a) e_b − (q e_b) e_a = Σ_c 2ε_abc X_c(q)(`frame_deriv` で DX_b(q)[v] = v e_b)

name: SS_dndn
stmt: theorem SS_dndn : SS.mulVec dndn = (1 : ℂ) • dndn

name: SS_tsym
stmt: theorem SS_tsym : SS.mulVec tsym = (1 : ℂ) • tsym

name: level_of
stmt: theorem level_of (lam μ : ℂ) (v : Fin 2 × Fin 2 → ℂ) (h : SS.mulVec v = μ • v) : ((3 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 2 × Fin 2) (Fin 2 × Fin 2) ℂ) + lam • SS).mulVec v = (3 / 2 + lam * μ) • v
doc: SS v = μ v なら (3/2 + λSS) v = (3/2 + λμ) v

name: decomp
stmt: theorem decomp (v : Fin 2 × Fin 2 → ℂ) : v = v (0, 0) • upup + v (1, 1) • dndn + ((v (0, 1) + v (1, 0)) / 2) • tsym + ((v (0, 1) - v (1, 0)) / 2) • singlet
doc: 4 次元の空間は三重項(upup, tsym, dndn)と一重項に分かれる:任意の v の分解

name: reduced_dirac_spectrum
stmt: theorem reduced_dirac_spectrum (lam : ℂ) (v : Fin 2 × Fin 2 → ℂ) : ((-I) • (Matrix.kroneckerMap (· * ·) ((3 / 2 * I) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) + gaugeTerm lam)).mulVec v = (3 / 2 + lam) • (v - ((v (0, 1) - v (1, 0)) / 2) • singlet) + (3 / 2 - 3 * lam) • (((v (0, 1) - v (1, 0)) / 2) • singlet)
doc:
【α-V.2】還元した Dirac 作用素のスペクトルの全体:任意の v について
D v = (3/2 + λ)(v − c·singlet) + (3/2 − 3λ) c·singlet、c = (v₀₁ − v₁₀)/2。
三重項(3 次元)の固有値は 3/2 + λ、一重項(1 次元)は 3/2 − 3λ で、これで尽きる。

name: metric_pullback
stmt: theorem metric_pullback (ρ : ℝ) : HasDerivAt gd (1 / cosh ρ) ρ ∧ (2 / cos (gd ρ) ^ 2) * (1 / 2) * (1 / cosh ρ) ^ 2 = 1 ∧ (2 / cos (gd ρ) ^ 2) * (1 / 2) * sin (gd ρ) ^ 2 = sinh ρ ^ 2
doc:
引き戻し:g^R = (2/cos²χ)·½(dχ² + sin²χ dΩ²) は χ = gd ρ で dρ² + sinh²ρ dΩ²。
dχ/dρ = 1/cosh ρ、動径の係数 1、角度の係数 sinh²ρ

name: conformal_factor
stmt: theorem conformal_factor (ρ : ℝ) : 2 / cos (gd ρ) ^ 2 = 2 * cosh ρ ^ 2
doc: 共形因子 2/cos²χ = 2cosh²ρ

name: gd_strictMono
stmt: theorem gd_strictMono : StrictMono gd

name: gd_lt
stmt: theorem gd_lt (ρ : ℝ) : gd ρ < π / 2

name: gd_nonneg
stmt: theorem gd_nonneg {ρ : ℝ} (h : 0 ≤ ρ) : 0 ≤ gd ρ

name: gd_surj
stmt: theorem gd_surj (χ : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ χ) (h1 : χ < π / 2) : ∃ ρ, 0 ≤ ρ ∧ gd ρ = χ
doc: [0, π/2) の各点は [0, ∞) の点の像

name: boundary_limit
stmt: theorem boundary_limit : Tendsto gd atTop (𝓝 (π / 2))
doc: 【Z14 境界】ρ → ∞ で χ = gd ρ → π/2(H³ の無限遠 ↦ 半球の赤道)

name: sd_mul_sd
stmt: theorem sd_mul_sd (a b : Fin 3 → ℂ) : sd a * sd b = dotc a b • (1 : M2) + Complex.I • sd (crossv a b)
doc: (σ·a)(σ·b) = (a·b) + iσ·(a×b)

name: cross_self
stmt: theorem cross_self (p : Fin 3 → ℂ) : crossv p p = 0

name: sd_zero
stmt: theorem sd_zero : sd (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ) = 0

name: dot_p_cross
stmt: theorem dot_p_cross (p v : Fin 3 → ℂ) : dotc p (crossv p v) = 0

name: dot_cross_p
stmt: theorem dot_cross_p (p v : Fin 3 → ℂ) : dotc (crossv p v) p = 0

name: sd_lin
stmt: theorem sd_lin (a b : ℂ) (x y : Fin 3 → ℂ) : sd (a • x - b • y) = a • sd x - b • sd y
doc: sd は線形

name: sd_cross_cross1
stmt: theorem sd_cross_cross1 (p v : Fin 3 → ℂ) : sd (crossv p (crossv p v)) = dotc p v • sd p - dotc p p • sd v

name: sd_cross_cross2
stmt: theorem sd_cross_cross2 (p v : Fin 3 → ℂ) : sd (crossv (crossv p v) p) = dotc p p • sd v - dotc p v • sd p

name: sd_ev
stmt: theorem sd_ev (i : Fin 3) : sd (ev i) = σ i

name: Av_ev
stmt: theorem Av_ev (p : Fin 3 → ℂ) (a b : ℂ) (i : Fin 3) : Av p (ev i) a b = A p a b i
doc: v = eᵢ のとき AlphaI_AW の Aᵢ と一致

name: si_sq
stmt: theorem si_sq : si ^ 2 * (2 * m * (E + m)) = 1

name: boost_inv
stmt: theorem boost_inv : boostInv m E si p * boost m E si p = 1 ∧ boost m E si p * boostInv m E si p = 1

name: boost_sq
stmt: theorem boost_sq : boost m E si p * boost m E si p = (2 * (E + m) * si ^ 2) • (E • (1 : M2) + sd p)
doc: L² = 2(E+m)s⁻²(E + σ·p)(= (E + σ·p)/m)

name: boost_det
stmt: theorem boost_det : (boost m E si p).det = 1

name: sd_herm
stmt: theorem sd_herm (q : Fin 3 → ℝ) : (sd (ofR q))ᴴ = sd (ofR q)

name: cross_ofR
stmt: theorem cross_ofR (q w : Fin 3 → ℝ) : crossv (ofR q) (ofR w) = ofR (crossr q w)

name: dotc_ofR
stmt: theorem dotc_ofR (q w : Fin 3 → ℝ) : dotc (ofR q) (ofR w) = ((q 0 * w 0 + q 1 * w 1 + q 2 * w 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: boost_herm
stmt: theorem boost_herm (m E si : ℝ) (q : Fin 3 → ℝ) : (boost m E si (ofR q))ᴴ = boost m E si (ofR q)

name: boostInv_herm
stmt: theorem boostInv_herm (m E si : ℝ) (q : Fin 3 → ℝ) : (boostInv m E si (ofR q))ᴴ = boostInv m E si (ofR q)

name: wigner_unitary
stmt: theorem wigner_unitary (Λ L1 L2 L2i : M2) (h1 : L1ᴴ = L1) (h2 : L2iᴴ = L2i) (hi : L2i * L2 = 1) (hi' : L2 * L2i = 1) (hΛ : Λ * (L1 * L1) * Λᴴ = L2 * L2) : (L2i * Λ * L1) * (L2i * Λ * L1)ᴴ = 1
doc: 【Z15】W = L₂⁻¹ Λ L₁ はユニタリ。条件:L₁、L₂⁻¹ はエルミート、Λ L₁² Λ† = L₂²(p₂ = Λp₁)

name: wigner_det
stmt: theorem wigner_det (Λ L1 L2i : M2) (h1 : L1.det = 1) (h2 : L2i.det = 1) (hΛ : Λ.det = 1) : (L2i * Λ * L1).det = 1

name: wigner_cocycle
stmt: theorem wigner_cocycle (L1 L2 L2i L3i Λ1 Λ2 : M2) (h : L2 * L2i = 1) : L3i * (Λ2 * Λ1) * L1 = (L3i * Λ2 * L2) * (L2i * Λ1 * L1)
doc: 【Z15 合成則】W(Λ₂Λ₁, p₁) = W(Λ₂, p₂) W(Λ₁, p₁)(p₂ = Λ₁p₁、L₂L₂⁻¹ = 1)

name: loop_conjugate
stmt: theorem loop_conjugate (L Li Λ : M2) (h : L * Li = 1) : L * (Li * Λ * L) * Li = Λ
doc: 【Z15 閉じた経路】Λp = p なら Λ = L W L⁻¹(小群 SU(2) の元に共役)

name: antiH_eq
stmt: theorem antiH_eq (Hm K : M2) (hH : Hmᴴ = Hm) (hK : Kᴴ = -K) : antiH (Hm + K) = K

name: wigner_connection
stmt: theorem wigner_connection (m E s si dE ds : ℂ) (p v : Fin 3 → ℂ) (hE : E ^ 2 = m ^ 2 + dotc p p) (hs : s ^ 2 = 2 * m * (E + m)) (hsi : s * si = 1) (hdE : E * dE = dotc p v) (hds : s * ds = m * dE) : boostInv m E si p * boostD m E si dE ds p v = (si ^ 2 * (E + m)) • sd v - (si ^ 2 * dE) • sd p + Av p v (-(si ^ 2)) 0
doc:
【Z15】L⁻¹ dL = s⁻²(E+m) σ·v − s⁻² dE σ·p + A(v)、A(v) = −s⁻² iσ·(p×v)。
仮定 E dE = p·v、s ds = m dE は E² = m² + |p|²、s² = 2m(E+m) を微分したもの(`E_deriv`、`s_deriv`)

name: wigner_AW
stmt: theorem wigner_AW (m E s si dE ds : ℝ) (q w : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hE : E ^ 2 = m ^ 2 + (q 0 * q 0 + q 1 * q 1 + q 2 * q 2)) (hs : s ^ 2 = 2 * m * (E + m)) (hsi : s * si = 1) (hdE : E * dE = q 0 * w 0 + q 1 * w 1 + q 2 * w 2) (hds : s * ds = m * dE) : antiH (boostInv m E si (ofR q) * boostD m E si dE ds (ofR q) (ofR w)) = Av (ofR q) (ofR w) (-(si ^ 2 : ℂ)) 0
doc: 【Z15】実の運動量では反エルミート部分が A_W(v) = −iσ·(p×v)/(2m(E+m))

name: wigner_coeff
stmt: theorem wigner_coeff (m E s si : ℂ) (hs : s ^ 2 = 2 * m * (E + m)) (hsi : s * si = 1) (hm : m ≠ 0) (hEm : E + m ≠ 0) : -(si ^ 2) = -1 / (2 * m * (E + m))
doc: s⁻² = 1/(2m(E+m)):A_W の係数は AlphaI_AW の a = −1/(2m(E+m))

name: MD.mul
stmt: theorem MD.mul {A B : ℝ → M2} {Ad Bd : M2} {t : ℝ} (hA : MD A Ad t) (hB : MD B Bd t) : MD (fun s => A s * B s) (Ad * B t + A t * Bd) t

name: MD.const
stmt: theorem MD.const (C : M2) (t : ℝ) : MD (fun _ => C) 0 t

name: MD.unique
stmt: theorem MD.unique {A : ℝ → M2} {Ad Ad' : M2} {t : ℝ} (h1 : MD A Ad t) (h2 : MD A Ad' t) : Ad = Ad'

name: MD.conjT
stmt: theorem MD.conjT {A : ℝ → M2} {Ad : M2} {t : ℝ} (h : MD A Ad t) : MD (fun s => (A s)ᴴ) Adᴴ t

name: unitary_deriv
stmt: theorem unitary_deriv {W : ℝ → M2} {Wd : M2} {t : ℝ} (hU : ∀ s, W s * (W s)ᴴ = 1) (hW : MD W Wd t) : Wd * (W t)ᴴ + W t * Wdᴴ = 0
doc: ユニタリ性 W W† = 1 を微分すると W′W† + W W′† = 0

name: inv_deriv
stmt: theorem inv_deriv {L Li : ℝ → M2} {Ld Lid : M2} {t : ℝ} (hinv : ∀ s, Li s * L s = 1) (hinv' : L t * Li t = 1) (hL : MD L Ld t) (hLi : MD Li Lid t) : Lid = -(Li t * Ld * Li t)
doc: 逆行列の微分:L⁻¹′ = −L⁻¹ L′ L⁻¹

name: transport
stmt: theorem transport {L Li g : ℝ → M2} {Ld Lid Z L0 : M2} {t : ℝ} (hinv : ∀ s, Li s * L s = 1) (hinv' : ∀ s, L s * Li s = 1) (hLh : ∀ s, (Li s)ᴴ = Li s) (hL0 : L0ᴴ = L0) (hshell : ∀ s, g s * (L0 * L0) * (g s)ᴴ = L s * L s) (hL : MD L Ld t) (hLi : MD Li Lid t) (hg : MD g (L t * Z * Li t * g t) t) (hZ : Zᴴ = Z) : ∃ Wd, MD (fun s => Li s * g s * L0) Wd t ∧ Wd * (Li t * g t * L0)ᴴ = -antiH (Li t * Ld)
doc:
【Z15 輸送方程式】静止系の純粋なブースト Z(エルミート)を積み重ねた運動 g′ = L Z L⁻¹ g について、
W(s) = L(s)⁻¹ g(s) L₀ は W′ W† = −antiH(L⁻¹ L′)。各 s で W がユニタリであることは `wigner_unitary`
(g(s) L₀² g(s)† = L(s)²、つまり p(s) = g(s) p₀)から従う

name: E_deriv
stmt: theorem E_deriv (m : ℝ) (r : ℝ → ℝ) (rd t : ℝ) (hr : HasDerivAt r rd t) (hpos : 0 < m ^ 2 + r t) : HasDerivAt (fun s => √(m ^ 2 + r s)) (rd / (2 * √(m ^ 2 + r t))) t ∧ √(m ^ 2 + r t) * (rd / (2 * √(m ^ 2 + r t))) = rd / 2
doc: E = √(m² + r) なら E Ė = ṙ/2(r = |p|²、ṙ = 2p·ṗ)

name: s_deriv
stmt: theorem s_deriv (m : ℝ) (E : ℝ → ℝ) (Ed t : ℝ) (hE : HasDerivAt E Ed t) (hpos : 0 < 2 * m * (E t + m)) : HasDerivAt (fun s => √(2 * m * (E s + m))) (2 * m * Ed / (2 * √(2 * m * (E t + m)))) t ∧ √(2 * m * (E t + m)) * (2 * m * Ed / (2 * √(2 * m * (E t + m)))) = m * Ed
doc: s = √(2m(E+m)) なら s ṡ = m Ė

name: n_deriv
stmt: theorem n_deriv (m : ℝ) (E : ℝ → ℝ) (Ed t : ℝ) (hE : HasDerivAt E Ed t) (hpos : 0 < 2 * E t * (E t + m)) : HasDerivAt (fun s => (√(2 * E s * (E s + m)))⁻¹) (-((√(2 * E t * (E t + m)))⁻¹) ^ 3 * Ed * (2 * E t + m)) t

name: cross_radial
stmt: theorem cross_radial (ρ ρd : ℂ) (n nd : Fin 3 → ℂ) : crossv (ρ • n) (ρd • n + ρ • nd) = ρ ^ 2 • crossv n nd
doc: p = ρn、ṗ = ρ̇n + ρṅ なら p × ṗ = ρ²(n × ṅ)

name: berry_half_angle
stmt: theorem berry_half_angle (m E ρ : ℝ) (hE : E ^ 2 = m ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2) (hE0 : E ≠ 0) (hEm : E + m ≠ 0) : ρ ^ 2 / (2 * E * (E + m)) = (1 - m / E) / 2
doc: A_B の係数:|p|²/(2E(E+m)) = ½(1 − m/E)(E² = m² + |p|²)

name: wigner_half_angle
stmt: theorem wigner_half_angle (m E ρ : ℝ) (hE : E ^ 2 = m ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2) (hm : m ≠ 0) (hEm : E + m ≠ 0) : -ρ ^ 2 / (2 * m * (E + m)) = -(E / m - 1) / 2
doc: A_W の係数:−|p|²/(2m(E+m)) = −½(E/m − 1)

name: half_rotation_sq
stmt: theorem half_rotation_sq (m E n : ℂ) (p : Fin 3 → ℂ) (hE : E ^ 2 = m ^ 2 + dotc p p) (hE0 : E ≠ 0) (hEm : E + m ≠ 0) (hn2 : n ^ 2 = 1 / (2 * E * (E + m))) : (n • ((E + m) • (1 : M2) - Complex.I • sd p)) * (n • ((E + m) • (1 : M2) - Complex.I • sd p)) = (1 / E) • (m • (1 : M2) - Complex.I • sd p)
doc: 半回転 V = n((E+m) − iσ·p)、n² = 1/(2E(E+m)) は V² = U = (m − iσ·p)/E

name: berry_fueter_gauge
stmt: theorem berry_fueter_gauge (m E n dn dE : ℂ) (p v : Fin 3 → ℂ) (hE0 : E ≠ 0) (hEm : E + m ≠ 0) (hE : E ^ 2 = m ^ 2 + dotc p p) (hdE : E * dE = dotc p v) (hn2 : n ^ 2 = 1 / (2 * E * (E + m))) (hdn : dn = -n ^ 3 * dE * (2 * E + m)) : (n • ((E + m) • (1 : M2) - Complex.I • sd p)) * Av p v (1 / (2 * E ^ 2)) (-m / (2 * E ^ 2)) - (n • (dE • (1 : M2) - Complex.I • sd v) + dn • ((E + m) • (1 : M2) - Complex.I • sd p)) = Av p v (1 / (2 * E * (E + m))) 0 * (n • ((E + m) • (1 : M2) - Complex.I • sd p))
doc:
【論文 G、新しい関係】V A_F − dV = A_B V(方向 v)。V = n((E+m) − iσ·p)、
A_F = ½U⁻¹dU(a = 1/(2E²)、b = −m/(2E²))、A_B(a = 1/(2E(E+m))、b = 0)。
仮定 E dE = p·v と dn = −n³ dE(2E+m) は微分の関係(`E_deriv`、`n_deriv`)

name: gauge_form
stmt: theorem gauge_form (V Vi dV dVi AF AB : M2) (h : V * AF - dV = AB * V) (hVi : V * Vi = 1) (hdVi : dVi = -(Vi * dV * Vi)) : V * AF * Vi + V * dVi = AB
doc:
ゲージ変換の形:V A_F − dV = A_B V、V V⁻¹ = 1、d(V⁻¹) = −V⁻¹ dV V⁻¹ なら
A_B = V A_F V⁻¹ + V d(V⁻¹)

name: wgc_W
stmt: theorem wgc_W (G g v l : ℝ) (hg : g ≠ 0) (hl : l ^ 2 = 4 * π * G / g ^ 2) : (g * v) ^ 2 * l ^ 2 = 4 * π * G * v ^ 2

name: wgc_monopole
stmt: theorem wgc_monopole (G g v : ℝ) (hg : g ≠ 0) (hG : G ≠ 0) : (4 * π * v / g) ^ 2 / ((4 * π / g) ^ 2 / (4 * π * G)) = 4 * π * G * v ^ 2

name: wgc_window
stmt: theorem wgc_window (k v : ℝ) (hk : 0 < k) : (3 / (4 * k) ≤ v ^ 2 ∧ v ^ 2 ≤ 1 / k) ↔ (3 / 4 ≤ k * v ^ 2 ∧ k * v ^ 2 ≤ 1)

name: wgc_window_nonempty
stmt: theorem wgc_window_nonempty : ∃ x : ℝ, 3 / 4 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 1

name: wgc_lambda
stmt: theorem wgc_lambda (R l : ℝ) (hR : R ≠ 0) (hl : l ≠ 0) : 1 / R ^ 2 - l ^ 2 / R ^ 4 ≤ 1 / (4 * l ^ 2)

name: wgc_lambda_eq
stmt: theorem wgc_lambda_eq (l : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (R : ℝ) (hR : R ^ 2 = 2 * l ^ 2) : 1 / R ^ 2 - l ^ 2 / R ^ 4 = 1 / (4 * l ^ 2)

name: wgc_lambda_g
stmt: theorem wgc_lambda_g (G g l : ℝ) (hg : g ≠ 0) (hG : G ≠ 0) (hl : l ^ 2 = 4 * π * G / g ^ 2) : 1 / (4 * l ^ 2) = g ^ 2 / (16 * π * G)

name: wgc_fl
stmt: theorem wgc_fl (x lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ≤ 1 / 4) (hx : 3 / 4 ≤ x) : Real.sqrt lam ≤ x

name: neck_rho
stmt: theorem neck_rho (g lam v r : ℝ) : rhoH g lam v 0 0 v 0 r = CFT.EYM.rho g 0 0 r
doc: 【α-XI.4】首(W = 0、H = v)で ρ は純粋な EYM の首の値と同じ

name: higgs_stress_zero
stmt: theorem higgs_stress_zero (gmn kin V : ℝ) (DmuDnu : ℝ) (hD : DmuDnu = 0) (hk : kin = 0) (hV : V = 0) : DmuDnu - gmn * (kin / 2 + V) = 0
doc: 【α-XI.4】Higgs の応力 T_μν = Σ D_μΦD_νΦ − g_μν(½|DΦ|² + V) は DΦ = 0、V = 0 で 0

name: neck_vacuum
stmt: theorem neck_vacuum (lam v r : ℝ) : lam / 4 * (v ^ 2 - v ^ 2) ^ 2 = 0 ∧ (0 : ℝ) * v / r = 0
doc: 真空で V(v) = (λ/4)(v² − v²)² = 0、勾配 |D_rΦ| = H′ = 0、|D_θΦ| = WH/r = 0

name: U_eq_rho
stmt: theorem U_eq_rho (g lam v W H r : ℝ) (hg : g ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0) : U g lam v W H r = rhoH g lam v W 0 H 0 r
doc: U は ρ の微分を含まない部分

name: poly_deriv
stmt: theorem poly_deriv (a b c w : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun W => a * (1 - W ^ 2) ^ 2 + b * W ^ 2 + c) (a * (2 * (1 - w ^ 2) * (-(2 * w))) + b * (2 * w)) w
doc: a(1 − W²)² + bW² + c の微分

name: force_W_zero
stmt: theorem force_W_zero (g lam v r : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun W => U g lam v W v r) 0 0
doc: 【α-XI.4】W の方程式の力の項は W = 0 で 0

name: force_H_zero
stmt: theorem force_H_zero (g lam v r : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun H => U g lam v 0 H r) 0 v
doc: 【α-XI.4】H の方程式の力の項は W = 0、H = v で 0

name: quad_expansion
stmt: theorem quad_expansion (g lam v W r : ℝ) : U g lam v W v r - U g lam v 0 v r = (v ^ 2 / r ^ 2 - 1 / (g ^ 2 * r ^ 4)) * W ^ 2 + 1 / (2 * g ^ 2 * r ^ 4) * W ^ 4
doc: 【α-XI.4】U(W) − U(0) = (v²/r² − 1/(g²r⁴))W² + W⁴/(2g²r⁴)

name: w_mass
doc: 【α-XI.4】運動の係数 K = 1/(g²r²)(ρ の W′ の項)と 2 次の係数 κ から m² = κ/K = g²v² − 1/r²

name: kinetic_coeff
stmt: theorem kinetic_coeff (g W1 r : ℝ) (hg : g ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0) : 1 / (2 * g ^ 2) * (2 * W1 ^ 2 / r ^ 2) = 1 / (g ^ 2 * r ^ 2) * W1 ^ 2
doc: ρ の W′ の項は W′²/(g²r²)

name: w_mass_neck
doc: 【α-XI.4】首 r = ℓ で m²ℓ² = −1 + m_W²ℓ²(m_W = gv)。v = 0 で IX.15 の −1

name: bf_condition
stmt: theorem bf_condition (x : ℝ) : -1 / 4 ≤ -1 + x ↔ 3 / 4 ≤ x
doc: 【α-XI.4】BF 限界:−1 + m_W²ℓ² ≥ −1/4 ⇔ m_W²ℓ² ≥ 3/4

name: delta_real
stmt: theorem delta_real (μ : ℝ) (hμ : -1 / 4 ≤ μ) : let Δ
doc: 共形次元 Δ = ½ ± √(¼ + m²ℓ²) は m²ℓ² ≥ −1/4 で実(Δ(Δ − 1) = m²ℓ²)

name: planck_condition
doc:
【α-XI.4】ℓ² = 4πG/g²、G = 1/M² なら m_W²ℓ² = 4πv²/M²、
m_W²ℓ² ≥ 3/4 ⇔ v² ≥ 3M²/(16π) ⇔ m_W² ≥ 3g²M²/(16π)

name: hardy_pointwise
stmt: theorem hardy_pointwise (s c h hd : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hsc : s ^ 2 + c ^ 2 = 1) : (1 / 2 * c * h / Real.sqrt s + Real.sqrt s * hd) ^ 2 - 1 / 4 * (Real.sqrt s * h) ^ 2 / s ^ 2 = s * hd ^ 2 + 1 / 4 * s * h ^ 2 + (-(1 / 2) * s * h ^ 2 + c * h * hd)
doc:
【α-XI.4】f = √s h、f′ = c h/(2√s) + √s h′(s = sin u > 0、s² + c² = 1)で
f′² − ¼f²/s² = s h′² + ¼ s h² + (−½ s h² + c h h′)

name: hardy_neck
stmt: theorem hardy_neck (a b : ℝ) (h hd : ℝ → ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : b < π) (hh : ∀ u, HasDerivAt h (hd u) u) (hcd : Continuous hd) (hc : Continuous h) (ha0 : h a = 0) (hb0 : h b = 0) : ∫ u in a..b, ((1 / 2 * cos u * h u / Real.sqrt (sin u) + Real.sqrt (sin u) * hd u) ^ 2 - 1 / 4 * (Real.sqrt (sin u) * h u) ^ 2 / sin u ^ 2) = ∫ u in a..b, sin u * (hd u ^ 2 + 1 / 4 * h u ^ 2)
doc:
【α-XI.4】接合 [a, b](0 < a ≤ b < π)で h(a) = h(b) = 0 なら
∫(f′² − ¼f²/sin²u) = ∫ sin u(h′² + ¼h²)

name: no_growing_mode
stmt: theorem no_growing_mode (a b μ : ℝ) (h hd : ℝ → ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : b < π) (hμ : -1 / 4 ≤ μ) (hh : ∀ u, HasDerivAt h (hd u) u) (hcd : Continuous hd) (hc : Continuous h) (ha0 : h a = 0) (hb0 : h b = 0) : 0 ≤ ∫ u in a..b, ((1 / 2 * cos u * h u / Real.sqrt (sin u) + Real.sqrt (sin u) * hd u) ^ 2 + μ * (Real.sqrt (sin u) * h u) ^ 2 / sin u ^ 2)
doc: 【α-XI.4】m²ℓ² ≥ −1/4 なら、接合で 0 になるどの試験関数でも二次形式 ∫(f′² + m²ℓ² f²/sin²u) ≥ 0

name: no_intrinsic_rate
stmt: theorem no_intrinsic_rate (l lam c r f0 f1 f2 : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0) (h : (c * r) ^ 2 * f2 + 2 * (c * r) * f1 + f0 - l ^ 4 * lam ^ 2 * f0 / (c * r) ^ 2 = 0) : r ^ 2 * (c ^ 2 * f2) + 2 * r * (c * f1) + f0 - l ^ 4 * (lam / c) ^ 2 * f0 / r ^ 2 = 0
doc: 【α-XI.1 (a)】スケール対称性:f が λ の解なら g(r) = f(cr) は λ/c の解(g′ = cf′、g″ = c²f″)

name: scaled_deriv
stmt: theorem scaled_deriv (f : ℝ → ℝ) (f1 c r : ℝ) (hf : HasDerivAt f f1 (c * r)) : HasDerivAt (fun x => f (c * x)) (f1 * c) r
doc: g(r) = f(cr) の微分(連鎖律)

name: int_sin_sq
stmt: theorem int_sin_sq (Y : ℝ) (hY : 0 < Y) : ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..Y, sin (π / Y * y) ^ 2 = Y / 2
doc: ∫₀^Y sin²(πy/Y) dy = Y/2

name: int_cos_sq
stmt: theorem int_cos_sq (Y : ℝ) (hY : 0 < Y) : ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..Y, cos (π / Y * y) ^ 2 = Y / 2
doc: ∫₀^Y cos²(πy/Y) dy = Y/2

name: Q_value
stmt: theorem Q_value (Y : ℝ) (hY : 0 < Y) : ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..Y, ((π / Y * cos (π / Y * y)) ^ 2 - 3 / 4 * sin (π / Y * y) ^ 2) = Y / 2 * ((π / Y) ^ 2 - 3 / 4)
doc: 【α-XI.1 (b)】試験関数 h = sin(πy/Y) の二次形式 Q = ∫(h′² − (3/4)h²) = (Y/2)((π/Y)² − 3/4)

name: Q_neg_iff
stmt: theorem Q_neg_iff (Y : ℝ) (hY : 0 < Y) : Y / 2 * ((π / Y) ^ 2 - 3 / 4) < 0 ↔ 2 * π / Real.sqrt 3 < Y

name: Y_lower
stmt: theorem Y_lower (L l uc : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (huc : 0 < uc) (huc2 : uc ≤ π / 2) (hjoin : sin uc = 1 / cosh (L / l)) : L / l - Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (π / (2 * uc))
doc: 【α-XI.1 (c)】接合 sin u_c = sech(L/ℓ)、0 < u_c ≤ π/2 なら Y = log(π/(2u_c)) ≥ L/ℓ − log 2

name: long_neck_unstable
stmt: theorem long_neck_unstable (L l uc : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (huc : 0 < uc) (huc2 : uc ≤ π / 2) (hjoin : sin uc = 1 / cosh (L / l)) (hL : 2 * π / Real.sqrt 3 + Real.log 2 < L / l) : let Y
doc: 【α-XI.1 (c)】L/ℓ > 2π/√3 + log 2(≈ 4.32)なら Y > 2π/√3:二次形式が負の試験関数があり、首は不安定

name: energy_conserved
stmt: theorem energy_conserved (Lt v a Lq Lv : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (hv : HasDerivAt v (a t) t) (hL : HasDerivAt Lt (Lq t * v t + Lv t * a t) t) (hEL : HasDerivAt Lv (Lq t) t) : HasDerivAt (fun s => v s * Lv s - Lt s) 0 t
doc: 【α-X.1】時間並進:E = v ∂L/∂v − L は保存(EL:d/dt ∂L/∂v = ∂L/∂q、連鎖律 dL/dt = L_q v + L_v a)

name: cyclic_momentum
stmt: theorem cyclic_momentum (Lv : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (hEL : HasDerivAt Lv 0 t) : HasDerivAt Lv 0 t
doc: 【α-X.1】循環座標:∂L/∂q = 0 なら p = ∂L/∂v は保存

name: angular_momentum
stmt: theorem angular_momentum (m : ℝ) (q0 q1 v0 v1 a0 a1 f : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (h0 : HasDerivAt q0 (v0 t) t) (h1 : HasDerivAt q1 (v1 t) t) (g0 : HasDerivAt v0 (a0 t) t) (g1 : HasDerivAt v1 (a1 t) t) (hf0 : m * a0 t = f t * q0 t) (hf1 : m * a1 t = f t * q1 t) : HasDerivAt (fun s => m * (q0 s * v1 s - q1 s * v0 s)) 0 t
doc: 【α-X.1】中心力 m q̈ = f q なら J_z = m(q₀v₁ − q₁v₀) は保存(他の成分も同じ)

name: charge_conservation
stmt: theorem charge_conservation (F : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → S) (j : Fin 4 → S) (hF : ∀ μ ν, F μ ν = -F ν μ) (hcomm : ∀ i k f, d i (d k f) = d k (d i f)) (hM : ∀ ν, ∑ μ, d μ (F μ ν) = j ν) : ∑ ν, d ν (j ν) = 0
doc: 【α-X.1】電荷の保存:∂_μF^{μν} = j^ν、F^{μν} = −F^{νμ}、∂ が可換なら ∂_ν j^ν = 0

name: wkb_orders
stmt: theorem wkb_orders (A ψ0 Sph ik : S) (hik : D ik = 0) (hψ : D ψ0 = ik * D Sph * ψ0) : D (D (A * ψ0)) = ψ0 * (ik ^ 2 * A * (D Sph) ^ 2 + ik * (2 * D A * D Sph + A * D (D Sph)) + D (D A))
doc: 【α-X.2】D(Dψ₀) = (ik)DS ψ₀ のとき D²(Aψ₀) = ψ₀[(ik)²A(DS)² + (ik)(2DA·DS + A D²S) + D²A](k = 1/ħ、i² = −1)

name: abelian_gauge_invariance
stmt: theorem abelian_gauge_invariance (A : Fin 4 → S) (lam : S) (hcomm : ∀ i k f, d i (d k f) = d k (d i f)) (μ ν : Fin 4) : d μ (A ν + d ν lam) - d ν (A μ + d μ lam) = d μ (A ν) - d ν (A μ)
doc: 【α-X.3】U(1):A ↦ A + dλ で F_{μν} = ∂_μA_ν − ∂_νA_μ は不変

name: weak_discontinuity_no_mass
stmt: theorem weak_discontinuity_no_mass (r ru rv Om r' ru' rv' Om' : ℝ) (h1 : r = r') (h2 : ru = ru') (h3 : rv = rv') (h4 : Om = Om') : msMass r ru rv Om - msMass r' ru' rv' Om' = 0
doc: 【α-X.4】弱い不連続:r、r_u、r_v、Ω が両側で等しければ [m] = 0(2 階の微分の跳びは質量を運ばない)

name: color_charge_zero
stmt: theorem color_charge_zero (r : ℝ) (Er : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hE : ∀ a, Er a = 0) : ∀ a, 4 * π * r ^ 2 * Er a = 0
doc: 【α-X.5】a₀ = a₁ = 0 の ansatz:E_r^a = ∂_t A_r^a − ∂_r A_t^a + … = 0 なので Q^a = 4πr²E_r^a = 0(両側で)

name: nonempty_cap
stmt: theorem nonempty_cap (l : ℝ) : (∀ η, HasDerivAt (fun x => l * cos x) (l * -sin η) η) ∧ (∀ η, HasDerivAt (fun x => l * -sin x) (-(l * cos η)) η) ∧ l * cos 0 = l ∧ l * -sin 0 = 0
doc: 帽子の ODE の仮定をみたす例:a = ℓ cos η

name: nonempty_attractor
doc: 弦理論のアトラクターの仮定をみたす例:p = q = 1、v₁ = v₂ = 2、e = 1、w = 1

name: nonempty_neck
stmt: theorem nonempty_neck (l : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) : CFT.JT.U l (l ^ 2) = 0 ∧ -2 / l ^ 2 + 2 * l ^ 2 / (l ^ 2) ^ 2 = 0
doc: 首の厳密解の仮定をみたす例:Φ = ℓ²、R₂ = −2/ℓ²

name: nonempty_wigner
stmt: theorem nonempty_wigner : Matrix.conjTranspose (1 : CFT.Wigner.M2) = 1 ∧ (1 : CFT.Wigner.M2) * 1 = 1 ∧ (1 : CFT.Wigner.M2) * ((1 : CFT.Wigner.M2) * 1) * Matrix.conjTranspose (1 : CFT.Wigner.M2) = 1 * 1
doc: Wigner 回転の仮定をみたす例:Λ = L₁ = L₂ = L₂⁻¹ = 1

name: nonempty_focusing
stmt: theorem nonempty_focusing (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : HasDerivAt (fun x => 2 / (x - 2)) (-(2 / (s - 2)) ^ 2 / 2) s ∧ 2 / (s - 2) < 0
doc: 焦点の定理の仮定をみたす例:θ(s) = 2/(s − 2) は [0, 1] で θ < 0、θ′ = −θ²/2

name: unit_x
stmt: theorem unit_x : IsUnit ((lam 0 - lam 1) * (lam 0 - lam 2) * (lam 1 - lam 2))
doc: 単元の積は単元

name: aligned_impossible

doc: α-II.6(Z4-E)⊘:整列型(固有値の勾配が e₀ 方向で消えない、e₁λ = e₂λ = 0)の C2 解は存在しない

name: ev_half

name: kappa_eq_neg_grad

name: bochner
stmt: theorem bochner : F.gradRic2 lam + kappaSum lam = 0
doc:
α-II.4(Z4-1, Z4-2):1 段目の両立条件は Bochner 恒等式
  |∇Ric|² + Σ_{i<j} K_ij(λ_i − λ_j)² = 0。
  実際 |∇Ric|² + κ = −(λ₀−λ₁)²·S0101 − (λ₀−λ₂)²·S0202 − (λ₁−λ₂)²·S1212(曲率の構造式の一次結合)

name: u_sq_bounds

name: integrable_iff_of_bounds

name: reflect

name: pi_side
stmt: theorem pi_side (m q : ℝ) : IntegrableOn (fun φ => (tan ((π - φ) / 2) ^ m * sin (π - φ) ^ q) ^ 2) (Ioo 0 (π / 2)) ↔ -(1 / 2) < q - m

name: zero_mode_L2
stmt: theorem zero_mode_L2 (m q : ℝ) : (IntegrableOn (fun θ => (tan (θ / 2) ^ m * sin θ ^ q) ^ 2) (Ioo 0 (π / 2)) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun φ => (tan ((π - φ) / 2) ^ m * sin (π - φ) ^ q) ^ 2) (Ioo 0 (π / 2))) ↔ |m| < q + 1 / 2
